package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;

/**
 * L0 hook for opening the Admission menu without importing higher-tier menu registration (NDE).
 *
 * <p>Higher tiers inject an opener via {@link #setOpenMenu}; this type must not name or import
 * menu DeferredRegister hubs.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-UI-001)
 */
public final class ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks {

    @Nullable
    private static BiConsumer<ServerPlayer, BlockPos> openMenu = null;

    private ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks() {
    }

    public static void setOpenMenu(@Nonnull BiConsumer<ServerPlayer, BlockPos> opener) {
        openMenu = Objects.requireNonNull(opener);
    }

    public static boolean open(@Nonnull ServerPlayer player, @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos) {
        BiConsumer<ServerPlayer, BlockPos> opener = openMenu;
        if (opener == null) {
            return false;
        }
        opener.accept(player, Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos));
        return true;
    }
}

FILE: FacehuggerSpentGoals.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.FloatGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.RandomStrollGoal;

/**
 * Rebuilds goal selectors for a spent facehugger (wander until despawn).
 *
 * <p>Goal slots 1/2 are <strong>intentional Java</strong> — mechanical lifecycle rebuild ordering
 * after attachment is spent, not designer balance tuning. See RUNTIME_AUTHORITY_AUDIT § Phase 3.
 *
 * <p>Interval is intentionally low: spent lifetime is short (~200 ticks), so the default sparse
 * {@link RandomStrollGoal} cadence leaves the facehugger idle until death.
 */
public final class FacehuggerSpentGoals {

    /** Ticks between stroll attempts — frequent enough to move visibly before spent death. */
    private static final int STROLL_INTERVAL_TICKS = 20;
    private static final double STROLL_SPEED = 0.5D;

    private FacehuggerSpentGoals() {
    }

    public static void registerWanderGoals(PathfinderMob facehugger) {
        facehugger.goalSelector.removeAllGoals(goal -> true);
        facehugger.targetSelector.removeAllGoals(goal -> true);
        facehugger.setNoAi(false);
        facehugger.getNavigation().stop();
        facehugger.goalSelector.addGoal(1, new FloatGoal(facehugger));
        facehugger.goalSelector.addGoal(
                2, new RandomStrollGoal(facehugger, STROLL_SPEED, STROLL_INTERVAL_TICKS));
    }

    /** Exposed for regression contracts — must stay below typical spent wander lifetime. */
    public static int strollIntervalTicks() {
        return STROLL_INTERVAL_TICKS;
    }
}

FILE: GlassLineOfSightHelper.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.ClipContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Raycast helper that treats glass blocks as opaque for line-of-sight checks.
 */
public final class GlassLineOfSightHelper {

    private GlassLineOfSightHelper() {
    }

    public static boolean hasClearPathWithoutGlass(Entity source, Entity target) {
        Level level = source.level();
        if (level == null) {
            return false;
        }

        Vec3 start = Objects.requireNonNull(source.getEyePosition());
        Vec3 end = Objects.requireNonNull(target.getEyePosition());
        BlockHitResult hitResult = level.clip(
                new ClipContext(
                        start,
                        end,
                        ClipContext.Block.COLLIDER,
                        ClipContext.Fluid.NONE,
                        source));

        if (hitResult.getType() == HitResult.Type.BLOCK) {
            BlockPos hitPos = Objects.requireNonNull(hitResult.getBlockPos());
            String blockName = level.getBlockState(hitPos).getBlock().getDescriptionId().toLowerCase();
            if (blockName.contains("glass")) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.QueenNestProgress;

/**
 * Goal wrapper for nest building — delegates tick/canUse to {@link QueenNestProgress}.
 * Intentionally claims no MOVE/LOOK flags so combat goals can run while the nest builds.
 */
public final class NestBuildingGoal extends Goal {

    private final QueenNestProgress nestProgress;

    public NestBuildingGoal(@Nonnull QueenNestProgress nestProgress) {
        this.nestProgress = nestProgress;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        return !nestProgress.isNestComplete();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        return !nestProgress.isNestComplete();
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        nestProgress.tick();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresUpdateEveryTick() {
        return true;
    }
}

FILE: NestPatrolHelper.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.navigation.PathNavigation;

/**
 * Helper class for nest patrol behavior patterns.
 * Centralizes duplicate logic for random position generation, territory checking, and nest movement.
 * DRY: Extracted from com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.drone.PatrolNestGoal and com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.queen.WanderNearNestGoal to eliminate duplicate nest patrol logic.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.7
 */
public class NestPatrolHelper {

    /**
     * Generates a random position within the specified radius from a center point.
     * DRY: Centralizes random position generation used in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.drone.PatrolNestGoal and com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.queen.WanderNearNestGoal.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to generate position for (used for random number generation)
     * @param centerPos The center position (nest center)
     * @param radius The radius to generate position within
     * @return A BlockPos representing a random position within the radius, or null if centerPos is null
     */
    public static BlockPos generateRandomPosition(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos centerPos, int radius) {
        if (centerPos == null) {
            return null;
        }

        // Generate random position within patrol radius
        double angle = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() * 2 * Math.PI;
        double distance = entity.getRandom().nextDouble() * radius;

        double x = centerPos.getX() + Math.cos(angle) * distance;
        double z = centerPos.getZ() + Math.sin(angle) * distance;
        double y = centerPos.getY(); // Keep same Y level as nest

        return BlockPos.containing(x, y, z);
    }

    /**
     * Checks if an entity is within the specified radius of a center position.
     * DRY: Centralizes territory/nest radius checking used in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.drone.PatrolNestGoal and com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.queen.WanderNearNestGoal.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to check
     * @param centerPos The center position (nest center)
     * @param radius The radius to check within
     * @return true if entity is within the radius, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isWithinRadius(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos centerPos, int radius) {
        if (centerPos == null) {
            return false;
        }

        double distance = centerPos.distSqr(Objects.requireNonNull(entity.blockPosition()));
        return distance <= (radius * radius);
    }

    /**
     * Moves an entity towards the nest center with a standard speed multiplier.
     * DRY: Centralizes nest movement logic used in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.drone.PatrolNestGoal and com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.queen.WanderNearNestGoal.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to move
     * @param nestPos The nest center position
     * @param speedMultiplier The speed multiplier for movement (default: 1.2 for return movement)
     */
    public static void moveTowardsNest(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos nestPos, double speedMultiplier) {
        if (nestPos == null) {
            return;
        }

        PathNavigation navigation = entity.getNavigation();
        navigation.moveTo(nestPos.getX(), nestPos.getY(), nestPos.getZ(), speedMultiplier);
    }

    /**
     * Moves an entity towards the nest center with default return speed (1.2).
     * Convenience method for standard return movement.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to move
     * @param nestPos The nest center position
     */
    public static void moveTowardsNest(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos nestPos) {
        moveTowardsNest(entity, nestPos, 1.2); // Default: slightly faster return
    }

    /**
     * Moves an entity to a random position within the nest radius with standard patrol speed.
     * DRY: Centralizes patrol movement logic used in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.drone.PatrolNestGoal and com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.species.xenomorph.ai.queen.WanderNearNestGoal.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to move
     * @param nestPos The nest center position
     * @param radius The radius to generate position within
     * @param speedMultiplier The speed multiplier for movement (default: 1.0 for patrol)
     */
    public static void moveToRandomPosition(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos nestPos, int radius, double speedMultiplier) {
        BlockPos randomPos = generateRandomPosition(entity, nestPos, radius);
        if (randomPos != null) {
            PathNavigation navigation = entity.getNavigation();
            navigation.moveTo(randomPos.getX(), randomPos.getY(), randomPos.getZ(), speedMultiplier);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Moves an entity to a random position within the nest radius with default patrol speed (1.0).
     * Convenience method for standard patrol movement.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to move
     * @param nestPos The nest center position
     * @param radius The radius to generate position within
     */
    public static void moveToRandomPosition(PathfinderMob entity, BlockPos nestPos, int radius) {
        moveToRandomPosition(entity, nestPos, radius, 1.0); // Default: standard patrol speed
    }

    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private NestPatrolHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("NestPatrolHelper is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

FILE: QueenProximityQuery.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Locates the nearest other queen within a search range.
 * Caller supplies {@code queenType} — query does not resolve registration tier.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 */
public final class QueenProximityQuery {

    private QueenProximityQuery() {
    }

    public static LivingEntity findNearest(
            ServerLevel level,
            LivingEntity self,
            int range,
            EntityType<?> queenType) {
        if (level == null || self == null || range <= 0 || queenType == null) {
            return null;
        }

        List<LivingEntity> entities = level.getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                Objects.requireNonNull(self.getBoundingBox().inflate(range)));

        LivingEntity nearest = null;
        double nearestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;

        for (LivingEntity other : entities) {
            if (other == self || other.getType() != queenType) {
                continue;
            }
            double distance = self.distanceTo(other);
            if (distance < range && distance < nearestDistance) {
                nearest = other;
                nearestDistance = distance;
            }
        }

        return nearest;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.BlockGetter;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.SoundType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.PushReaction;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.Shapes;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * Common base class for all mod blocks (both lab equipment and xenomorph blocks).
 * Provides shared functionality and eliminates code duplication.
 * 
 * This class implements the DRY principle by centralizing:
 * - Common block properties handling (shape, collision, lifecycle)
 * - Standardized logging for block lifecycle events
 * - Common abstract methods that subclasses must implement
 * - Common override methods that subclasses can customize
 * 
 * Subclasses (com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseLabBlock, com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseXenomorphBlock) extend this to provide
 * block-type-specific property creation methods.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public abstract class BaseModBlock extends Block {
    
    /**
     * Constructs a BaseModBlock with the specified properties.
     * 
     * @param properties The block properties
     */
    protected BaseModBlock(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
        ModLogger.debug("Initialized " + getClass().getSimpleName());
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the shape for this block.
     * Subclasses must implement this to define the block's collision shape.
     * 
     * @return The VoxelShape for this block
     */
    protected abstract VoxelShape getBlockShape();
    
    /**
     * Creates a full-block VoxelShape (16x16x16).
     * Helper method for consistency when blocks need a full block shape.
     * 
     * @return A full-block VoxelShape
     */
    protected static VoxelShape createFullBlockShape() {
        return Shapes.block();
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the sound type for this block.
     * Subclasses can override this for different sound characteristics.
     * 
     * @return The SoundType for this block
     */
    public SoundType getSoundType() {
        return SoundType.STONE; // Default sound type
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the push reaction for this block.
     * Subclasses can override this for different piston behavior.
     * 
     * @return The PushReaction for this block
     */
    protected PushReaction getPushReaction() {
        return PushReaction.NORMAL;
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the light level for this block.
     * Subclasses can override this for light-emitting blocks.
     * 
     * @param state The block state
     * @return The light level (0-15)
     */
    protected int getLightLevel(@Nonnull BlockState state) {
        return 0; // No light emission by default
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the map color for this block.
     * Subclasses can override this for different colors.
     * 
     * @return The MapColor for this block
     */
    @Nonnull
    protected MapColor getMapColor() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.STONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public VoxelShape getShape(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockGetter level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull CollisionContext context) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(getBlockShape());
    }
    
    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public VoxelShape getCollisionShape(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockGetter level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull CollisionContext context) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(getBlockShape());
    }
    
    /**
     * Called when the block is placed in the world.
     * Provides logging for block placement events.
     * 
     * @param state The block state
     * @param level The level where the block was placed
     * @param pos The position where the block was placed
     * @param oldState The previous block state
     * @param isMoving Whether the block is moving
     */
    @Override
    public void onPlace(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState oldState, boolean isMoving) {
        super.onPlace(state, level, pos, oldState, isMoving);
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            ModLogger.debug("Placed " + getClass().getSimpleName() + " at " + pos);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Called when the block is removed from the world.
     * Provides logging for block removal events.
     * 
     * @param state The block state
     * @param level The level where the block was removed
     * @param pos The position where the block was removed
     * @param newState The new block state
     * @param isMoving Whether the block is moving
     */
    @Override
    public void onRemove(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState newState, boolean isMoving) {
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            ModLogger.debug("Removed " + getClass().getSimpleName() + " at " + pos);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the display name for this block type.
     * Used in logging and debugging.
     * 
     * @return The display name of this block type
     */
    protected String getBlockTypeName() {
        return getClass().getSimpleName();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;

/**
 * Null-safe helpers for {@link BlockEntityType} registration.
 */
public final class BlockEntityTypeHelper {

    private BlockEntityTypeHelper() {
    }

    /**
     * Builds a custom block entity type without a datafixer schema.
     * NeoForge/Vanilla registration passes null for the datafixer type at runtime.
     */
    @Nonnull
    @SuppressWarnings("null") // Mod block entities have no datafixer schema; null is valid at runtime.
    public static <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityType<T> buildWithoutDatafixer(
            @Nonnull BlockEntityType.Builder<T> builder) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(builder.build(null));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.BreachStatus;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ContainmentVolumeId;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.lab.BreachState;

/**
 * NBT codec for specimen-pod containment identity and breach state.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence {

    static final String VOLUME_ID_KEY = "containmentVolumeId";
    static final String BREACH_STATUS_KEY = "breachStatus";
    static final String INTEGRITY_LEVEL_KEY = "breachIntegrityLevel";
    static final String BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY = "breachTimestampMillis";

    private ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence() {
    }

    public static ContainmentVolumeId readOrCreateVolumeId(CompoundTag tag) {
        if (tag != null && tag.contains(VOLUME_ID_KEY)) {
            return new ContainmentVolumeId(tag.getUUID(VOLUME_ID_KEY));
        }
        return new ContainmentVolumeId(UUID.randomUUID());
    }

    public static void writeVolumeId(CompoundTag tag, ContainmentVolumeId volumeId) {
        if (volumeId == null) {
            tag.remove(VOLUME_ID_KEY);
            return;
        }
        tag.putUUID(VOLUME_ID_KEY, Objects.requireNonNull(volumeId.id()));
    }

    public static BreachState readBreachState(CompoundTag tag) {
        if (tag == null || !tag.contains(BREACH_STATUS_KEY)) {
            return BreachState.secure();
        }
        BreachStatus status;
        try {
            status = BreachStatus.valueOf(tag.getString(BREACH_STATUS_KEY));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return BreachState.secure();
        }
        int level = tag.contains(INTEGRITY_LEVEL_KEY)
                ? tag.getInt(INTEGRITY_LEVEL_KEY)
                : BreachState.MAX_INTEGRITY;
        level = Math.max(BreachState.MIN_INTEGRITY, Math.min(BreachState.MAX_INTEGRITY, level));
        Optional<Long> timestamp = tag.contains(BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY)
                ? Optional.of(tag.getLong(BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY))
                : Optional.empty();
        try {
            return new BreachState(status, level, timestamp);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return BreachState.secure();
        }
    }

    public static void writeBreachState(CompoundTag tag, BreachState breachState) {
        if (breachState == null) {
            tag.remove(BREACH_STATUS_KEY);
            tag.remove(INTEGRITY_LEVEL_KEY);
            tag.remove(BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY);
            return;
        }
        tag.putString(BREACH_STATUS_KEY, Objects.requireNonNull(breachState.status().name()));
        tag.putInt(INTEGRITY_LEVEL_KEY, breachState.integrityLevel());
        if (breachState.breachTimestampMillis().isPresent()) {
            tag.putLong(BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY, breachState.breachTimestampMillis().get());
        } else {
            tag.remove(BREACH_TIMESTAMP_KEY);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

/**
 * NBT codec for the containment pen's authoritative occupant identity.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenOccupancyPersistence {

    static final String OCCUPANT_ENTITY_UUID_KEY = "occupantEntityUuid";

    private ContainmentPenOccupancyPersistence() {
    }

    public static Optional<UUID> readOccupantEntityId(CompoundTag tag) {
        if (tag == null || !tag.contains(OCCUPANT_ENTITY_UUID_KEY)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(tag.getUUID(OCCUPANT_ENTITY_UUID_KEY));
    }

    public static void writeOccupantEntityId(CompoundTag tag, UUID occupantEntityId) {
        if (occupantEntityId == null) {
            tag.remove(OCCUPANT_ENTITY_UUID_KEY);
            return;
        }
        tag.putUUID(OCCUPANT_ENTITY_UUID_KEY, occupantEntityId);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.Packet;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientGamePacketListener;
import net.minecraft.network.protocol.game.ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * Formed shell membership — stores the owning controller position only.
 */
public class ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity extends BlockEntity {

    @Nullable
    private BlockPos controllerPos;

    public ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity(BlockEntityType<?> type, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(type, pos, state);
    }

    public void setControllerPos(@Nonnull BlockPos controller) {
        this.controllerPos = controller.immutable();
        setChanged();
    }

    @Nullable
    public BlockPos getControllerPos() {
        return controllerPos;
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag, registries);
        if (controllerPos != null) {
            tag.putLong("controller", controllerPos.asLong());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void loadAdditional(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
        super.loadAdditional(tag, registries);
        this.controllerPos = tag.contains("controller") ? BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("controller")) : null;
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag(@Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(saveWithoutMetadata(registries));
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.function.BiFunction;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * Registration hooks for shell block entities (breaks L1/L2 upward imports onto L4).
 */
public final class ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration {

    private static BiFunction<BlockPos, BlockState, BlockEntity> factory;

    private ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration() {
    }

    public static void register(BiFunction<BlockPos, BlockState, BlockEntity> entityFactory) {
        factory = entityFactory;
    }

    public static BlockEntity create(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (factory == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration not initialized");
        }
        return factory.apply(pos, state);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BooleanProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.Shapes;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

/**
 * Formed-shell presentation shapes from face flags. Capacity uses interior volume — never these shapes.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenShellPresentation {

    public static final BooleanProperty NORTH = BooleanProperty.create("north");
    public static final BooleanProperty SOUTH = BooleanProperty.create("south");
    public static final BooleanProperty WEST = BooleanProperty.create("west");
    public static final BooleanProperty EAST = BooleanProperty.create("east");
    public static final BooleanProperty UP = BooleanProperty.create("up");
    public static final BooleanProperty DOWN = BooleanProperty.create("down");

    private static final double PANE = 2.0 / 16.0;

    private ContainmentPenShellPresentation() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockState withFaces(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            boolean north,
            boolean south,
            boolean west,
            boolean east,
            boolean up,
            boolean down) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(state
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(NORTH), north)
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(SOUTH), south)
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(WEST), west)
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(EAST), east)
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(UP), up)
                .setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(DOWN), down));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockState defaultFaces(@Nonnull BlockState base) {
        return withFaces(base, false, false, false, false, false, true);
    }

    /**
     * Faces of this shell cell that lie on the outer enclosure AABB (controller-relative).
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static BlockState facesForCell(
            @Nonnull BlockState base,
            int x,
            int y,
            int z,
            int minX,
            int maxX,
            int minY,
            int maxY,
            int minZ,
            int maxZ) {
        return withFaces(
                base,
                z == minZ,
                z == maxZ,
                x == minX,
                x == maxX,
                y == maxY,
                y == minY);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static VoxelShape shapeFromFaces(@Nonnull BlockState state) {
        VoxelShape shape = Objects.requireNonNull(Shapes.empty());
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(WEST)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, PANE, 1.0, 1.0));
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(EAST)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(1.0 - PANE, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(NORTH)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, PANE));
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(SOUTH)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(0.0, 0.0, 1.0 - PANE, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(DOWN)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, PANE, 1.0));
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(UP)))) {
            shape = or(shape, box(0.0, 1.0 - PANE, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0));
        }
        if (shape.isEmpty()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Shapes.block());
        }
        return shape;
    }

    /** @deprecated Prefer {@link #shapeFromFaces(BlockState)}. */
    @Deprecated
    @Nonnull
    public static VoxelShape openGlassShape(@Nonnull BlockState state) {
        return shapeFromFaces(state);
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static VoxelShape box(
            double x0, double y0, double z0, double x1, double y1, double z1) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Shapes.box(x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1));
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static VoxelShape or(@Nonnull VoxelShape a, @Nonnull VoxelShape b) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Shapes.or(a, b));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtUtils;
import net.minecraft.nbt.Tag;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * NBT persistence for prior shell BlockStates restored on break/breach/reload.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenShellPriorStatePersistence {

    private static final String KEY = "shellPriorStates";

    private ContainmentPenShellPriorStatePersistence() {
    }

    public static void write(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag tag,
            @Nonnull Map<BlockPos, BlockState> priorStates,
            @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider lookup) {
        if (priorStates.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        ListTag list = new ListTag();
        for (Map.Entry<BlockPos, BlockState> entry : priorStates.entrySet()) {
            CompoundTag entryTag = new CompoundTag();
            entryTag.putLong("Pos", entry.getKey().asLong());
            entryTag.put("State", Objects.requireNonNull(NbtUtils.writeBlockState(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(entry.getValue(), "prior state"))));
            list.add(entryTag);
        }
        tag.put(KEY, list);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Map<BlockPos, BlockState> read(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider lookup) {
        Map<BlockPos, BlockState> priorStates = new HashMap<>();
        if (!tag.contains(KEY, Tag.TAG_LIST)) {
            return priorStates;
        }
        ListTag list = tag.getList(KEY, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
        var blockLookup = lookup.lookupOrThrow(Objects.requireNonNull(Registries.BLOCK));
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            CompoundTag entryTag = list.getCompound(i);
            BlockPos pos = BlockPos.of(entryTag.getLong("Pos"));
            BlockState state = NbtUtils.readBlockState(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(blockLookup),
                    Objects.requireNonNull(entryTag.getCompound("State")));
            if (state != null) {
                priorStates.put(pos, state);
            }
        }
        return priorStates;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.bootstrap;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.IEventBus;

/**
 * Reflection bridge from L0 {@link BioCraftAlien} to composition-tier bootstraps.
 */
public final class ModBootstrapHooks {

    private static final String MOD_REGISTRATION_BOOTSTRAP =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_12.lifecycle.ModRegistrationBootstrap";

    private ModBootstrapHooks() {
    }

    public static void onModConstruct(@Nonnull IEventBus modEventBus) {
        invokeStatic(MOD_REGISTRATION_BOOTSTRAP, "register", modEventBus);
    }

    private static void invokeStatic(String className, String methodName, IEventBus modEventBus) {
        try {
            Class<?> bootstrap = Class.forName(className);
            bootstrap.getMethod(methodName, IEventBus.class).invoke(null, modEventBus);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to invoke " + className + "#" + methodName, e);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Function;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.transformation.TransformationConstants;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * Minecraft-bound xenomorph transformation utility.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 */
public class BaseXenomorphTransformation {

    public static <S extends LivingEntity, T extends LivingEntity> boolean transform(
            @Nonnull S sourceEntity,
            @Nonnull EntityType<T> targetType,
            @Nonnull String transformationName,
            @Nonnull Function<EntityType<T>, T> entityCreator) {
        return transformEntity(sourceEntity, targetType, transformationName, entityCreator) != null;
    }

    @Nullable
    public static <S extends LivingEntity, T extends LivingEntity> T transformEntity(
            @Nonnull S sourceEntity,
            @Nonnull EntityType<T> targetType,
            @Nonnull String transformationName) {
        return transformEntity(sourceEntity, targetType, transformationName,
                type -> type.create(Objects.requireNonNull(sourceEntity.level())));
    }

    @Nullable
    public static <S extends LivingEntity, T extends LivingEntity> T transformEntity(
            @Nonnull S sourceEntity,
            @Nonnull EntityType<T> targetType,
            @Nonnull String transformationName,
            @Nonnull Function<EntityType<T>, T> entityCreator) {
        Level level = sourceEntity.level();

        if (level.isClientSide()) {
            return null;
        }

        ModLogger.info(transformationName, "Transforming...");

        try {
            BlockPos originalPos = sourceEntity.blockPosition();
            T targetEntity = entityCreator.apply(targetType);
            if (targetEntity == null) {
                return null;
            }

            targetEntity.moveTo(
                    originalPos.getX() + TransformationConstants.ENTITY_POSITION_OFFSET,
                    originalPos.getY(),
                    originalPos.getZ() + TransformationConstants.ENTITY_POSITION_OFFSET,
                    sourceEntity.getYRot(),
                    sourceEntity.getXRot()
            );

            targetEntity.setHealth(sourceEntity.getHealth());
            sourceEntity.remove(Entity.RemovalReason.DISCARDED);
            level.addFreshEntity(targetEntity);

            ModLogger.info(transformationName, "Successfully transformed");
            return targetEntity;

        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error(transformationName, "Failed: " + e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Minecraft-side conversions between domain boundary DTOs and NeoForge types.
 */
public final class BoundaryRefs {

    private BoundaryRefs() {
    }

    public static BlockPosRef from(BlockPos pos) {
        return new BlockPosRef(pos.getX(), pos.getY(), pos.getZ());
    }

    public static BlockPos toBlockPos(BlockPosRef ref) {
        return new BlockPos(ref.x(), ref.y(), ref.z());
    }

    public static WorldRef worldFrom(Level level) {
        return new WorldRef(level.dimension().location().toString());
    }

    public static LivingEntityRef entityFrom(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String dimension = "overworld";
        if (entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel server) {
            dimension = server.dimension().location().toString();
        }
        return new LivingEntityRef(entity.getUUID(), new WorldRef(dimension));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtAccounter;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtIo;
import net.minecraft.nbt.Tag;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.handling.EntitySnapshotWorldIdentity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * Serialize / store / read entity snapshots on Capture Net carriers.
 *
 * <p>Persists faithful specimen state required for reconstitution; strips world-identity
 * fields so the restored entity receives a fresh runtime identity.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-NET-001)
 */
public final class CapturedEntitySnapshot {

    /** Root key inside {@link DataComponents#CUSTOM_DATA}. */
    public static final String ROOT_KEY = "CapturedSpecimen";

    public static final String KEY_ID = "id";
    public static final String KEY_ENTITY = "Entity";
    public static final String KEY_FORMAT = "SnapshotFormat";
    public static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;

    private CapturedEntitySnapshot() {
    }

    public static boolean isFilled(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return readRoot(stack).isPresent();
    }

    public static void write(@Nonnull ItemStack stack, @Nonnull LivingEntity entity) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "entity");
        ResourceLocation typeId = Objects.requireNonNull(
                BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getType())),
                "Entity type has no registry key");
        CompoundTag entityState = new CompoundTag();
        entity.saveWithoutId(entityState);
        stripWorldIdentity(entityState);

        CompoundTag root = new CompoundTag();
        root.putInt(KEY_FORMAT, FORMAT_VERSION);
        root.putString(KEY_ID, Objects.requireNonNull(typeId.toString()));
        root.put(KEY_ENTITY, entityState);

        CompoundTag custom = stack.getOrDefault(
                Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.EMPTY)).copyTag();
        custom.put(ROOT_KEY, root);
        stack.set(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA), Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.of(custom)));
    }

    public static void clear(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        CustomData data = stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        CompoundTag custom = data.copyTag();
        if (!custom.contains(ROOT_KEY)) {
            return;
        }
        custom.remove(ROOT_KEY);
        if (custom.isEmpty()) {
            stack.remove(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        } else {
            stack.set(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA),
                    Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.of(custom)));
        }
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Optional<CompoundTag> readRoot(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        CustomData data = stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.empty());
        }
        CompoundTag custom = data.copyTag();
        if (!custom.contains(ROOT_KEY, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.empty());
        }
        CompoundTag root = custom.getCompound(ROOT_KEY);
        if (!root.contains(KEY_ID, Tag.TAG_STRING) || !root.contains(KEY_ENTITY, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.empty());
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.of(root));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Optional<String> typeKey(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(readRoot(stack).map(root -> root.getString(KEY_ID)));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Optional<EntityType<?>> resolveType(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(typeKey(stack).flatMap(key -> {
            try {
                return BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getOptional(
                        ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(key)));
            } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                return Optional.empty();
            }
        }));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Optional<byte[]> encodePayload(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(readRoot(stack).flatMap(root -> {
            try {
                ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
                NbtIo.writeCompressed(Objects.requireNonNull(root), out);
                return Optional.of(out.toByteArray());
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                ModLogger.warn("CaptureNet", "Failed to encode entity snapshot: " + ex.getMessage());
                return Optional.empty();
            }
        }));
    }

    @Nullable
    public static CompoundTag decodePayload(@Nonnull byte[] payload) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(payload, "payload");
        try {
            return NbtIo.readCompressed(
                    new ByteArrayInputStream(payload),
                    Objects.requireNonNull(NbtAccounter.unlimitedHeap()));
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            ModLogger.warn("CaptureNet", "Failed to decode entity snapshot: " + ex.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static boolean isEntitySnapshot(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag) {
        return tag.contains(KEY_ENTITY, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND) && tag.contains(KEY_ID, Tag.TAG_STRING);
    }

    public static void stripWorldIdentity(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(tag, "tag");
        for (String key : EntitySnapshotWorldIdentity.STRIP_KEYS) {
            tag.remove(Objects.requireNonNull(key));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Apply preserved entity state onto a newly created living entity (reconstitute).
     * Does not set pose — caller snaps pose after.
     */
    public static void applyTo(@Nonnull LivingEntity living, @Nonnull CompoundTag snapshotRoot) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(living, "living");
        Objects.requireNonNull(snapshotRoot, "snapshotRoot");
        if (!isEntitySnapshot(snapshotRoot)) {
            return;
        }
        CompoundTag entityState = Objects.requireNonNull(snapshotRoot.getCompound(KEY_ENTITY).copy());
        stripWorldIdentity(entityState);
        living.load(Objects.requireNonNull(entityState));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.Resource;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * L3 boundary adapter: {@link com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.io.ResourceLoader}
 * backed by Minecraft {@link net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager}.
 *
 * <p>Type names are fully qualified so advisory import-hygiene does not confuse them with
 * same-layer {@code resources.ResourceLoader} / {@code resources.ResourceManager}.
 */
public class MinecraftResourceLoader
        implements com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.io.ResourceLoader {

    private final net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager;

    public MinecraftResourceLoader(
            @Nonnull net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        this.resourceManager = resourceManager;
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public JsonObject loadJson(String resourcePath, Class<?> contextClass) {
        try {
            ResourceLocation resourceLocation = Objects.requireNonNull(
                    ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(resourcePath)));
            Optional<Resource> resourceOpt = resourceManager.getResource(resourceLocation);

            if (resourceOpt.isEmpty()) {
                ModLogger.debug("MinecraftResourceLoader",
                        String.format("Resource not found: %s", resourcePath));
                return null;
            }

            try (InputStreamReader reader = new InputStreamReader(resourceOpt.get().open())) {
                return JsonParser.parseReader(reader).getAsJsonObject();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("MinecraftResourceLoader",
                    String.format("Failed to load JSON from %s: %s", resourcePath, e.getMessage()), e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean resourceExists(String resourcePath, Class<?> contextClass) {
        try {
            ResourceLocation resourceLocation = Objects.requireNonNull(
                    ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(resourcePath)));
            return resourceManager.getResource(resourceLocation).isPresent();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    @Nonnull
    public net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager getResourceManager() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(resourceManager);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.parasite.AttachmentStatePort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;

/**
 * NeoForge binding for {@link AttachmentStatePort} via {@link FacehuggerAttachmentEntity}.
 */
public final class NeoForgeAttachmentStateAdapter implements AttachmentStatePort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeAttachmentStateAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean supports(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return resolve(entity) != null;
    }

    @Override
    public AttachmentState getState(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return require(entity).getAttachmentState();
    }

    @Override
    public void setState(LivingEntityRef entity, AttachmentState state) {
        require(entity).setAttachmentState(state);
    }

    @Override
    public int getTicks(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return require(entity).getAttachmentTicks();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTicks(LivingEntityRef entity, int ticks) {
        require(entity).setAttachmentTicks(ticks);
    }

    @Override
    public LivingEntityRef getTarget(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return require(entity).getAttachmentTarget();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTarget(LivingEntityRef entity, LivingEntityRef target) {
        require(entity).setAttachmentTarget(target);
    }

    @Nonnull
    private FacehuggerAttachmentEntity require(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        FacehuggerAttachmentEntity contract = resolve(entity);
        if (contract == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Entity does not support attachment state: " + entity);
        }
        return contract;
    }

    private FacehuggerAttachmentEntity resolve(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        LivingEntity living = resolveEntity(entity).orElse(null);
        if (living instanceof FacehuggerAttachmentEntity attachment) {
            return attachment;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private Optional<LivingEntity> resolveEntity(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(serverLevel -> {
                    var entity = serverLevel.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        return Optional.of(living);
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.core.Holder;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffects;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.effects.DomainEffectKey;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.effects.EffectApplyOptions;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.effects.StandardMobEffectKey;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.effects.EffectApplicationPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.ModEffectRegistry;

public final class NeoForgeEffectApplicationAdapter implements EffectApplicationPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeEffectApplicationAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public void apply(LivingEntityRef target, DomainEffectKey key, int durationTicks, int amplifier, EffectApplyOptions options) {
        resolve(target).ifPresent(living -> {
            Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveDomainEffect(key);
            living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(effect, durationTicks, amplifier,
                    options.ambient(), options.showParticles(), options.showIcon()));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void applyStandard(LivingEntityRef target, StandardMobEffectKey key, int durationTicks, int amplifier, EffectApplyOptions options) {
        resolve(target).ifPresent(living -> {
            Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveStandardEffect(key);
            living.addEffect(new MobEffectInstance(effect, durationTicks, amplifier,
                    options.ambient(), options.showParticles(), options.showIcon()));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void remove(LivingEntityRef target, DomainEffectKey key) {
        resolve(target).ifPresent(living -> {
            Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveDomainEffect(key);
            living.removeEffect(effect);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void removeStandard(LivingEntityRef target, StandardMobEffectKey key) {
        resolve(target).ifPresent(living -> {
            Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveStandardEffect(key);
            living.removeEffect(effect);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasEffect(LivingEntityRef target, DomainEffectKey key) {
        return resolve(target)
                .map(living -> {
                    Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveDomainEffect(key);
                    return living.hasEffect(effect);
                })
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasStandardEffect(LivingEntityRef target, StandardMobEffectKey key) {
        return resolve(target)
                .map(living -> {
                    Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveStandardEffect(key);
                    return living.hasEffect(effect);
                })
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public int getRemainingDuration(LivingEntityRef target, DomainEffectKey key) {
        return resolve(target)
                .map(living -> {
                    Holder<MobEffect> effect = resolveDomainEffect(key);
                    MobEffectInstance instance = living.getEffect(effect);
                    return instance != null ? instance.getDuration() : 0;
                })
                .orElse(0);
    }

    private Optional<LivingEntity> resolve(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        if (ref == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(level -> {
                    var entity = level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        return Optional.of(living);
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                });
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static Holder<MobEffect> resolveDomainEffect(DomainEffectKey key) {
        return switch (key) {
            case FACEHUGGER_ATTACHMENT -> ModEffectRegistry.facehuggerAttachment();
            case FACEHUGGER_IMPLANTATION -> ModEffectRegistry.facehuggerImplantation();
            case GESTATION -> ModEffectRegistry.gestation();
            case HOST_INFECTION -> ModEffectRegistry.hostInfection();
            case SUFFOCATION -> ModEffectRegistry.suffocation();
        };
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static Holder<MobEffect> resolveStandardEffect(StandardMobEffectKey key) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(switch (key) {
            case BLINDNESS -> MobEffects.BLINDNESS;
            case SLOWNESS -> MobEffects.MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN;
            case WEAKNESS -> MobEffects.WEAKNESS;
            case HUNGER -> MobEffects.HUNGER;
            case POISON -> MobEffects.POISON;
            case DIG_SLOWDOWN -> MobEffects.DIG_SLOWDOWN;
            case SLOW_FALLING -> MobEffects.SLOW_FALLING;
            case LEVITATION -> MobEffects.LEVITATION;
        });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.spawn.SpawnContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.spawn.EntitySpawnPort;

/**
 * L0 boundary: resolves {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit} holders via FQN (no L4 import).
 *
 * <p>NDE escape hatch: {@link #resolveType} calls
 * {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntityInitRefs} by fully qualified name
 * so this adapter stays at {@code level_0} without importing {@code level_3} {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit}.
 * Do not replace with a compile-time import unless the adapter tier is raised to {@code level_3}+.
 */
public final class NeoForgeEntitySpawnAdapter implements EntitySpawnPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeEntitySpawnAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public LivingEntityRef spawnXenomorph(SpawnContext context, XenomorphType type) {
        EntityType<? extends Mob> entityType = resolveType(type);
        if (entityType == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, context.world())
                .map(level -> {
                    Mob mob = entityType.create(Objects.requireNonNull(level));
                    if (mob == null) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    mob.moveTo(context.x(), context.y(), context.z(), context.yRot(), context.xRot());
                    mob.setYHeadRot(context.headYaw());
                    level.addFreshEntity(mob);
                    return BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(mob);
                })
                .orElse(null);
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public LivingEntityRef transformXenomorph(LivingEntityRef source, XenomorphType targetType) {
        EntityType<? extends Mob> entityType = resolveType(targetType);
        if (entityType == null || source == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, source.world())
                .flatMap(level -> {
                    if (!(level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(source.entityId())) instanceof LivingEntity living)) {
                        return Optional.<LivingEntityRef>empty();
                    }
                    EntityType<? extends LivingEntity> livingType =
                            (EntityType<? extends LivingEntity>) entityType;
                    LivingEntity transformed = BaseXenomorphTransformation.transformEntity(
                            living, livingType, "TransformTo" + targetType);
                    return transformed != null
                            ? Optional.of(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(transformed))
                            : Optional.empty();
                })
                .orElse(null);
    }

    @Nullable
    private static EntityType<? extends Mob> resolveType(XenomorphType type) {
        String fieldName = switch (type) {
            case OVOMORPH -> "OVOMORPH";
            case FACEHUGGER -> "FACEHUGGER";
            case CHESTBURSTER -> "CHESTBURSTER";
            case DRONE -> "DRONE";
            case QUEEN -> "QUEEN";
            case GROWTH, PRAETOR -> null; // shelved — not registered
        };
        if (fieldName == null) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntityInitRefs.mobType(fieldName);
        } catch (IllegalStateException e) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * L3 adapter: issues escape navigation via entity pathfinding (no teleportation).
 *
 * <p>TODO(TECH-CONFIG-001): Config-migrate escape/spawn/wander/flee L3 literals only when retuning — do not JSON-churn preemptively.
 */
public final class NeoForgeEscapeNavigationAdapter {

    // TODO(TECH-CONFIG-001): Candidate literals when tuning escape feel.
    private static final double ESCAPE_DISTANCE_MULTIPLIER = 3.0;
    private static final double ESCAPE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER = 1.0;

    private NeoForgeEscapeNavigationAdapter() {}

    public static void attemptEscape(PathfinderMob entity, Level level) {
        double randomX = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.0;
        double randomZ = (level.random.nextDouble() - 0.5) * 2.0;

        entity.getNavigation().moveTo(
                entity.getX() + randomX * ESCAPE_DISTANCE_MULTIPLIER,
                entity.getY(),
                entity.getZ() + randomZ * ESCAPE_DISTANCE_MULTIPLIER,
                ESCAPE_SPEED_MULTIPLIER);

        ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeEscapeNavigationAdapter", "Attempting to walk to safety (no teleportation)");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

public final class NeoForgeLevelResolver {

    private NeoForgeLevelResolver() {}

    public static Optional<ServerLevel> resolve(@Nullable MinecraftServer server, @Nullable WorldRef worldRef) {
        if (server == null || worldRef == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        ResourceLocation dimensionId = Objects.requireNonNull(
                ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(worldRef.dimensionKey())));
        Level level = server.getLevel(Objects.requireNonNull(
                ResourceKey.create(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Registries.DIMENSION),
                        dimensionId)));
        if (level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
            return Optional.of(serverLevel);
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }
}

    public Optional<LivingEntityRef> realize(PortableSpecimen specimen, AdmissionContext context) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(specimen, "specimen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(context, "context");
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, context.world())
                .flatMap(level -> createLiving(level, specimen, context));
    }

    @Override
    public void discard(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return;
        }
        NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, entity.world()).ifPresent(level -> {
            Entity found = level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(entity.entityId()));
            if (found != null) {
                found.discard();
            }
        });
    }

    private static Optional<LivingEntityRef> createLiving(
            ServerLevel level, PortableSpecimen specimen, AdmissionContext context) {
        ResourceLocation id;
        try {
            id = ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(specimen.typeKey()));
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            ModLogger.warn("Admission", "Invalid specimen typeKey: " + specimen.typeKey());
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Optional<EntityType<?>> typeOpt = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getOptional(id);
        if (typeOpt.isEmpty()) {
            ModLogger.warn("Admission", "Unknown entity type: " + specimen.typeKey());
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        EntityType<?> entityType = typeOpt.get();
        Entity created = entityType.create(Objects.requireNonNull(level));
        if (!(created instanceof LivingEntity living)) {
            if (created != null) {
                created.discard();
            }
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        // Place before applying captured state — payloads must not overwrite admission pose.
        snapToPose(living, context);

        if (specimen.kind() == SpecimenKind.CAPTURED
                && specimen.identityPayload().isPresent()
                && specimen.identityPayload().get().length > 0) {
            applyCapturedPayload(living, specimen.identityPayload().get());
            snapToPose(living, context);
        } else if (living instanceof Mob mob) {
            mob.finalizeSpawn(
                    level,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(level.getCurrentDifficultyAt(
                            Objects.requireNonNull(mob.blockPosition()))),
                    MobSpawnType.SPAWN_EGG,
                    null);
            snapToPose(living, context);
        }

        if (!level.addFreshEntity(living)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        // Collision resolution can nudge; re-snap feet to interior floor after join.
        snapToPose(living, context);
        return Optional.of(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living)));
    }

    private static void snapToPose(LivingEntity living, AdmissionContext context) {
        living.moveTo(context.x(), context.y(), context.z(), context.yRot(), context.xRot());
        living.setYHeadRot(context.headYaw());
        living.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(Vec3.ZERO));
        living.fallDistance = 0.0F;
        living.setOnGround(true);
    }

    /**
     * Reconstitute captured payload onto a new runtime entity.
     *
     * <p>Net entity snapshots use faithful reconstitutive load (world-identity already stripped).
     * Bucket payloads are a different format — never {@link Entity#load(CompoundTag)} them.
     */
    private static void applyCapturedPayload(LivingEntity living, byte[] payload) {
        CompoundTag tag;
        try {
            tag = NbtIo.readCompressed(
                    new ByteArrayInputStream(payload),
                    Objects.requireNonNull(NbtAccounter.unlimitedHeap()));
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            ModLogger.warn("Admission", "Failed to decode captured specimen payload: " + ex.getMessage());
            return;
        }
        if (tag == null || tag.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }

        // Capture Net / transport carrier entity snapshot — preserve persistent state.
        if (CapturedEntitySnapshot.isEntitySnapshot(tag)) {
            CapturedEntitySnapshot.applyTo(Objects.requireNonNull(living), tag);
            return;
        }

        // Bucket-shaped tags: strip world identity if present, never treat as entity snapshot.
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.stripWorldIdentity(tag);

        if (living instanceof Bucketable bucketable) {
            bucketable.loadFromBucketTag(tag);
            return;
        }
        if (tag.contains("Health")) {
            living.setHealth(tag.getFloat("Health"));
        }
    }
}

FILE: NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * L3 probe: detects entity collision with occluding blocks via bounding-box samples.
 */
public final class NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe {

    private NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe() {}

    public static boolean isStuckInBlocks(@Nonnull PathfinderMob entity, @Nonnull Level level) {
        AABB boundingBox = entity.getBoundingBox();
        BlockPos[] checkPoints = {
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.minX, (int) boundingBox.minY, (int) boundingBox.minZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.maxX, (int) boundingBox.minY, (int) boundingBox.minZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.minX, (int) boundingBox.maxY, (int) boundingBox.minZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.maxX, (int) boundingBox.maxY, (int) boundingBox.minZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.minX, (int) boundingBox.minY, (int) boundingBox.maxZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.maxX, (int) boundingBox.minY, (int) boundingBox.maxZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.minX, (int) boundingBox.maxY, (int) boundingBox.maxZ),
            new BlockPos((int) boundingBox.maxX, (int) boundingBox.maxY, (int) boundingBox.maxZ),
            new BlockPos(
                    (int) ((boundingBox.minX + boundingBox.maxX) / 2),
                    (int) ((boundingBox.minY + boundingBox.maxY) / 2),
                    (int) ((boundingBox.minZ + boundingBox.maxZ) / 2))
        };

        for (BlockPos checkPos : checkPoints) {
            BlockState block = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(checkPos));
            if (!block.isAir() && block.canOcclude()) {
                if (entity.tickCount % 100 == 0) {
                    ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe", "Entity stuck in block at: " + checkPos);
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.nest.NestStructureFeatures;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.nest.NestStructureScanOffsets;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.nest.NestStructureProgressPolicy;

/**
 * MC block-scan helpers for nest structure detection.
 * Offsets and scoring live in domain; this file only probes {@link Level} blocks.
 */
public final class NestBlockScanHelper {

    private NestBlockScanHelper() {
    }

    public static boolean hasNestBlocksNearby(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Block resinBlock,
            @Nonnull Block spinyBlock,
            @Nonnull Block cocoonBlock,
            int scanRadius) {
        if (level.getBlockState(pos).getBlock() == resinBlock) {
            return true;
        }
        for (int[] offset : NestStructureScanOffsets.horizontalSquareOffsets(scanRadius)) {
            BlockPos checkPos = pos.offset(offset[0], 0, offset[1]);
            BlockState state = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(checkPos));
            Block block = state.getBlock();
            if (block == resinBlock || block == spinyBlock || block == cocoonBlock) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static int detectNestProgress(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos centerPos,
            @Nonnull Block resinBlock,
            @Nonnull Block spinyBlock,
            int scanRadius) {
        boolean hasFoundation = anyMatch(level, centerPos,
                NestStructureScanOffsets.foundationRingOffsets(scanRadius), 0, resinBlock);
        boolean hasWalls = hasFoundation
                && anyMatch(level, centerPos, NestStructureScanOffsets.wallPerimeterOffsets(scanRadius), 1, resinBlock);
        boolean hasDecorations = hasWalls
                && anyMatch(level, centerPos, NestStructureScanOffsets.horizontalSquareOffsets(scanRadius), 1, spinyBlock);
        boolean hasCenterResin = hasDecorations
                && level.getBlockState(centerPos).getBlock() == resinBlock;

        return NestStructureProgressPolicy.score(
                new NestStructureFeatures(hasFoundation, hasWalls, hasDecorations, hasCenterResin));
    }

    private static boolean anyMatch(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos center,
            int[][] offsets,
            int relativeY,
            @Nonnull Block expected) {
        for (int[] offset : offsets) {
            if (level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(
                    center.offset(offset[0], relativeY, offset[1]))).getBlock() == expected) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.client.animation.AnimationChannel;
import net.minecraft.client.animation.Keyframe;
import net.minecraft.client.animation.KeyframeAnimations;

/**
 * Null-safe helpers for Blockbench-exported model animations.
 */
public final class AnimationChannelHelper {

    public static final AnimationChannel.Target ROTATION =
            Objects.requireNonNull(AnimationChannel.Targets.ROTATION);
    public static final AnimationChannel.Target POSITION =
            Objects.requireNonNull(AnimationChannel.Targets.POSITION);
    public static final AnimationChannel.Target SCALE =
            Objects.requireNonNull(AnimationChannel.Targets.SCALE);
    public static final AnimationChannel.Interpolation CATMULLROM =
            Objects.requireNonNull(AnimationChannel.Interpolations.CATMULLROM);
    public static final AnimationChannel.Interpolation LINEAR =
            Objects.requireNonNull(AnimationChannel.Interpolations.LINEAR);

    private AnimationChannelHelper() {
    }

    public static Keyframe kfDegree(float time, float x, float y, float z) {
        return new Keyframe(
                time,
                Objects.requireNonNull(KeyframeAnimations.degreeVec(x, y, z)),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CATMULLROM));
    }

    public static Keyframe kfPosLinear(float time, float x, float y, float z) {
        return new Keyframe(
                time,
                Objects.requireNonNull(KeyframeAnimations.posVec(x, y, z)),
                Objects.requireNonNull(LINEAR));
    }

    public static Keyframe kfPos(float time, float x, float y, float z) {
        return new Keyframe(
                time,
                Objects.requireNonNull(KeyframeAnimations.posVec(x, y, z)),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CATMULLROM));
    }

    public static Keyframe kfScale(float time, float x, float y, float z) {
        return new Keyframe(
                time,
                Objects.requireNonNull(KeyframeAnimations.scaleVec(x, y, z)),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CATMULLROM));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AnimationChannel rotationChannel(Keyframe... keyframes) {
        return channel(ROTATION, keyframes);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AnimationChannel positionChannel(Keyframe... keyframes) {
        return channel(POSITION, keyframes);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AnimationChannel scaleChannel(Keyframe... keyframes) {
        return channel(SCALE, keyframes);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AnimationChannel channel(AnimationChannel.Target target, Keyframe... keyframes) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(new AnimationChannel(
                Objects.requireNonNull(target),
                Objects.requireNonNull(keyframes)));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AnimationChannel forAdd(@Nonnull AnimationChannel channel) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(channel);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;

/**
 * Calculates animation speed multipliers for transition clips (render path).
 */
public final class AnimationSpeedHelper {

    public static float calculateTransitionSpeedMultiplier(XenomorphType type, float animationLengthSeconds) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(type);
        int configuredDurationTicks = 30;

        if (config != null && config.clientParameters != null) {
            configuredDurationTicks = config.clientParameters.transitionDurationTicks;
        }

        float animationLengthTicks = animationLengthSeconds * 20.0F;
        return animationLengthTicks / configuredDurationTicks;
    }

    private AnimationSpeedHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("AnimationSpeedHelper is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}
