package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;

/**
 * Centralized utility for creative tab registration.
 * Consolidates duplicate creative tab registration patterns.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates creative tab registration following DRY principles.
 * Reduces boilerplate in BioCraftAlienClient.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class CreativeTabHelper {
    
    /**
     * Adds an item to a creative tab if the holder is bound.
     * Consolidates the repetitive if-bound check pattern.
     * 
     * @param event The creative tab contents event
     * @param currentTabKey The current tab key from the event (for comparison)
     * @param targetTabKey The target tab key to add to
     * @param itemHolder The deferred holder for the item
     */
    public static void addItemToTab(
            @Nonnull BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent event,
            @Nonnull ResourceKey<?> currentTabKey,
            @Nonnull ResourceKey<?> targetTabKey,
            @Nonnull DeferredHolder<Item, ? extends Item> itemHolder) {
        
        if (currentTabKey == targetTabKey && itemHolder.isBound()) {
            event.accept(Objects.requireNonNull(itemHolder.get()));
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Adds multiple items to a creative tab.
     * Convenience method for adding multiple items at once.
     * Uses List instead of varargs to avoid @SafeVarargs annotation.
     * 
     * @param event The creative tab contents event
     * @param currentTabKey The current tab key from the event (for comparison)
     * @param targetTabKey The target tab key to add to
     * @param itemHolders The deferred holders for the items
     */
    public static void addItemsToTab(
            @Nonnull BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent event,
            @Nonnull ResourceKey<?> currentTabKey,
            @Nonnull ResourceKey<?> targetTabKey,
            @Nonnull List<DeferredHolder<Item, ? extends Item>> itemHolders) {
        
        if (currentTabKey == targetTabKey) {
            for (DeferredHolder<Item, ? extends Item> itemHolder : itemHolders) {
                if (itemHolder.isBound()) {
                    event.accept(Objects.requireNonNull(itemHolder.get()));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Interface for resolving entity types from entity instances in renderer context.
 * Allows renderers to determine entity types without depending on specific species.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface EntityTypeResolver {
    
    /**
     * Resolves the entity type from an entity instance.
     * Returns null if the entity type cannot be determined.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity instance
     * @return The entity type, or null if cannot be determined
     */
    EntityType resolveEntityType(Mob entity);
}

FILE: FacehuggerClimbOrientation.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;

/**
 * Client-side climb pitch for free facehuggers: ~90° on walls, ~180° under ceilings.
 *
 * <p>Parameterized on {@link FacehuggerAttachmentEntity} (not the L2 entity type), matching
 * {@link FacehuggerRotationLock}.
 */
public final class FacehuggerClimbOrientation {

    private FacehuggerClimbOrientation() {
    }

    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void applyClientPitch(T facehugger) {
        Level level = facehugger.level();
        if (level == null || !level.isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        AttachmentState state = facehugger.getAttachmentState();
        if (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING
                || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED
                || state == AttachmentState.DETACHING
                || !facehugger.onClimbable()) {
            return;
        }

        float pitch = isCeilingClimb(facehugger) ? 180.0f : 90.0f;
        facehugger.setXRot(pitch);
    }

    private static boolean isCeilingClimb(Mob facehugger) {
        Level level = facehugger.level();
        if (level == null) {
            return false;
        }
        BlockPos above = Objects.requireNonNull(facehugger.blockPosition().above());
        boolean solidAbove = level.getBlockState(above).isFaceSturdy(level, above, Direction.DOWN);
        Vec3 motion = facehugger.getDeltaMovement();
        boolean upward = motion.y > 0.05D;
        return solidAbove && (upward || facehugger.getXRot() < -30.0f || facehugger.verticalCollision);
    }
}

FILE: FacehuggerRotationLock.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AttachmentConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerSpentStatePolicy;

import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Applies host-relative yaw/pitch while a facehugger is attached, using {@link FacehuggerSpentStatePolicy}.
 * Latch fold (−90°) stays on the facehugging bone; entity pitch tracks the host head look.
 */
public final class FacehuggerRotationLock {

    private FacehuggerRotationLock() {
    }

    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void apply(
            @Nullable LivingEntity target, T facehugger) {
        AttachmentState currentState = facehugger.getAttachmentState();
        if (FacehuggerSpentStatePolicy.shouldClearRotationLock(currentState)) {
            facehugger.setAttachmentRotationSet(false);
            return;
        }
        if (target != null && target.isAlive()) {
            // Follow host look each tick so looking down/up keeps the latch on the face plane.
            float latchYaw = target.getYRot() + (float) AttachmentConfigHelper.getRotationOffset();
            float latchPitch = target.getXRot();
            if (FacehuggerSpentStatePolicy.shouldInitializeRotationLock(
                    currentState, true, facehugger.isAttachmentRotationSet())) {
                facehugger.setAttachmentRotationSet(true);
            }
            facehugger.setAttachmentYRot(latchYaw);
            facehugger.setAttachmentXRot(latchPitch);
            applyFixedRotation(facehugger, latchYaw, latchPitch);
        }
    }

    private static void applyFixedRotation(Mob facehugger, float yRot, float xRot) {
        facehugger.setYRot(yRot);
        facehugger.setXRot(xRot);
        facehugger.setYHeadRot(yRot);
        facehugger.setYBodyRot(yRot);
    }
}

    private MaturationTimedPersistence() {
    }

    public static void writeSaveData(@Nonnull MaturationTimed entity, @Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelLayerLocation;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

/**
 * Helper class for model layer location creation.
 * Centralizes model layer creation logic for client-side rendering.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This class was moved from EntityConfigLoader to follow proper client/server separation.
 * Client-only code should not be in server-common classes.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class ModelLayerHelper {
    
    /**
     * Gets the model layer for a specific model type.
     * 
     * @param modelType The model type string
     * @return The model layer location
     */
    public static ModelLayerLocation getModelLayer(String modelType) {
        return switch (modelType) {
            case "spider" -> new ModelLayerLocation(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("minecraft", "spider")), "main");
            case "cave_spider" -> new ModelLayerLocation(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("minecraft", "cave_spider")), "main");
            case "cat" -> new ModelLayerLocation(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("minecraft", "cat")), "main");
            case "iron_golem" -> new ModelLayerLocation(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("minecraft", "iron_golem")), "main");
            default -> new ModelLayerLocation(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("minecraft", "player")), "main");
        };
    }
}

FILE: MovementFormSync.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.MovementFormFsm;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.MovementFormPhase;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataAccessor;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataSerializers;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.SynchedEntityData;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Shared SynchedEntityData + server FSM wiring for stand/crawl form hosts.
 */
public final class MovementFormSync {

    private static final String NBT_PHASE = "MovementFormPhase";
    private static final String NBT_TICKS = "MovementFormTicks";
    private static final String NBT_CRAWLING = "CrawlingForm";

    private MovementFormSync() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static EntityDataAccessor<Integer> definePhaseId(@Nonnull Class<? extends Entity> type) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(SynchedEntityData.defineId(
                type, Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDataSerializers.INT)));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> defineCrawlingId(@Nonnull Class<? extends Entity> type) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(SynchedEntityData.defineId(
                type, Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDataSerializers.BOOLEAN)));
    }

    public static void defineDefaults(
            @Nonnull SynchedEntityData.Builder builder,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Integer> phaseId,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> crawlingId) {
        builder.define(Objects.requireNonNull(phaseId), MovementFormPhase.STANDING.ordinal());
        builder.define(Objects.requireNonNull(crawlingId), false);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static MovementFormPhase readPhase(
            @Nonnull SynchedEntityData data,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Integer> phaseId) {
        return MovementFormPhase.fromOrdinal(data.get(Objects.requireNonNull(phaseId)));
    }

    public static boolean readCrawling(
            @Nonnull SynchedEntityData data,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> crawlingId) {
        return data.get(Objects.requireNonNull(crawlingId));
    }

    public static void writePhase(
            @Nonnull SynchedEntityData data,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Integer> phaseId,
            @Nonnull MovementFormPhase phase) {
        data.set(Objects.requireNonNull(phaseId), phase.ordinal());
    }

    public static void writeCrawling(
            @Nonnull SynchedEntityData data,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> crawlingId,
            boolean crawling) {
        data.set(Objects.requireNonNull(crawlingId), crawling);
    }

    /**
     * Runs one server FSM tick from horizontal movement and writes synced fields.
     *
     * @return true if {@code crawlingForm} changed (caller should refreshDimensions)
     */
    public static boolean tickServer(
            @Nonnull LivingEntity entity,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Integer> phaseId,
            @Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> crawlingId,
            @Nonnull MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState scratch) {
        SynchedEntityData data = Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getEntityData());
        MovementFormPhase phase = readPhase(data, phaseId);
        boolean crawling = readCrawling(data, crawlingId);
        scratch.copyFrom(phase, scratch.ticksRemaining, crawling);

        Vec3 delta = entity.getDeltaMovement();
        boolean moving = MovementFormFsm.isMovingHorizontally(delta.horizontalDistanceSqr());
        MovementFormFsm.tick(scratch, moving);

        boolean formChanged = scratch.crawlingForm != crawling;
        if (scratch.phase != phase) {
            writePhase(data, phaseId, scratch.phase);
        }
        if (formChanged) {
            writeCrawling(data, crawlingId, scratch.crawlingForm);
        }
        return formChanged;
    }

    /**
     * Restores timer when phase is already mid-transition after load / first tick.
     * Call once after reading NBT into scratch before tickServer uses ticksRemaining.
     */
    public static void ensureTicksLoaded(
            @Nonnull MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState scratch,
            int loadedTicks) {
        scratch.ticksRemaining = Math.max(0, loadedTicks);
    }

    public static void writeSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag tag,
            @Nonnull MovementFormPhase phase,
            int ticksRemaining,
            boolean crawlingForm) {
        tag.putInt(NBT_PHASE, phase.ordinal());
        tag.putInt(NBT_TICKS, ticksRemaining);
        tag.putBoolean(NBT_CRAWLING, crawlingForm);
    }

    public static void readSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag tag,
            @Nonnull MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState scratch) {
        MovementFormPhase phase = MovementFormPhase.fromOrdinal(tag.getInt(NBT_PHASE));
        int ticks = tag.getInt(NBT_TICKS);
        boolean crawling = tag.getBoolean(NBT_CRAWLING);
        if (!tag.contains(NBT_CRAWLING)) {
            crawling = phase.usesCrawlingHitbox();
        }
        scratch.copyFrom(phase, ticks, crawling);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;

/**
 * Captures initial yaw/pitch and prevents ovomorph rotation after spawn.
 */
public final class OvomorphFixedRotation {

    private float fixedYRot;
    private float fixedXRot;
    private boolean rotationInitialized;

    public void captureInitialRotation(float yRot, float xRot) {
        if (!rotationInitialized) {
            fixedYRot = yRot;
            fixedXRot = xRot;
            rotationInitialized = true;
        }
    }

    public boolean isInitialized() {
        return rotationInitialized;
    }

    public float resolveYRot(float requestedYRot) {
        return fixedYRot;
    }

    public float resolveXRot(float requestedXRot) {
        return fixedXRot;
    }

    public void seedYRot(float yRot) {
        fixedYRot = yRot;
    }

    public void seedXRot(float xRot) {
        fixedXRot = xRot;
    }

    public void lookAt(Entity entity, float maxYawIncrement, float maxPitchIncrement) {
        // Ovomorph does not rotate to look at entities.
    }
}

FILE: OvomorphGroundSnap.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

/**
 * Snaps a no-gravity mob down onto solid ground when floating.
 *
 * <p>Scans downward — a one-block-below check misses eggs that spawn/float a block up
 * (common after admission / collision nudge).
 */
public final class OvomorphGroundSnap {

    private static final int MAX_DROP_SCAN = 4;

    private OvomorphGroundSnap() {
    }

    public static void apply(PathfinderMob mob) {
        if (mob.onGround() || !mob.isNoGravity() || mob.level() == null) {
            return;
        }
        Level level = Objects.requireNonNull(mob.level());
        BlockPos start = Objects.requireNonNull(mob.blockPosition());
        for (int dy = 0; dy <= MAX_DROP_SCAN; dy++) {
            BlockPos probe = start.below(dy);
            BlockPos groundPos = Objects.requireNonNull(probe.below());
            BlockState groundState = level.getBlockState(groundPos);
            if (!isSupportive(level, groundPos, groundState)) {
                continue;
            }
            double groundY = topY(level, groundPos, groundState);
            if (Math.abs(mob.getY() - groundY) > 0.05) {
                mob.setPos(mob.getX(), groundY, mob.getZ());
                mob.setOnGround(true);
                mob.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(mob.getDeltaMovement()).multiply(1.0, 0.0, 1.0)));
                mob.fallDistance = 0.0F;
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    private static boolean isSupportive(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (state.isAir()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (state.isSolidRender(Objects.requireNonNull(level), Objects.requireNonNull(pos))) {
            return true;
        }
        VoxelShape shape = state.getCollisionShape(Objects.requireNonNull(level), Objects.requireNonNull(pos));
        return shape != null && !shape.isEmpty();
    }

    private static double topY(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        VoxelShape shape = state.getCollisionShape(Objects.requireNonNull(level), Objects.requireNonNull(pos));
        if (shape == null || shape.isEmpty()) {
            return pos.getY() + 1.0;
        }
        return pos.getY() + shape.max(net.minecraft.core.Direction.Axis.Y);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.ovomorph.OvomorphHatchWorkflow;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

/**
 * NBT save/load for ovomorph hatch timer and synced hatch flag (DTO only).
 */
public final class OvomorphHatchPersistence {

    private OvomorphHatchPersistence() {
    }

    public static void writeSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag compound,
            @Nonnull OvomorphHatchWorkflow.State workflowState,
            boolean isHatching) {
        compound.putInt("hatchTimer", workflowState.hatchTimer);
        compound.putBoolean("wasHostNearby", workflowState.wasHostNearby);
        compound.putBoolean("isHatching", isHatching);
    }

    public static boolean readSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag compound,
            @Nonnull OvomorphHatchWorkflow.State workflowState) {
        workflowState.hatchTimer = compound.contains("hatchTimer") ? compound.getInt("hatchTimer") : 0;
        workflowState.wasHostNearby = compound.contains("wasHostNearby") && compound.getBoolean("wasHostNearby");
        return compound.contains("isHatching") && compound.getBoolean("isHatching");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

/**
 * Reflective access to {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.species.xenomorph.entity.QueenEmbeddedLifecycle} without a compile-time L4 / L2 entity import (NDE escape).
 */
public final class QueenLifecycleAccess {

    private static final String LIFECYCLE_CLASS =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.species.xenomorph.entity.QueenEmbeddedLifecycle";
    private static final String QUEEN_ENTITY_CLASS =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.species.xenomorph.entity.QueenEntity";

    private QueenLifecycleAccess() {
    }

    /**
     * @param queen live {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.species.xenomorph.entity.QueenEntity} instance (typed as {@link Object} so this stays at L0)
     */
    public static Object create(Object queen) {
        try {
            Class<?> lifecycleClass = Class.forName(LIFECYCLE_CLASS);
            Class<?> queenClass = Class.forName(QUEEN_ENTITY_CLASS);
            return lifecycleClass.getConstructor(queenClass).newInstance(queen);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to construct queen lifecycle", e);
        }
    }

    public static void tick(Object lifecycle) {
        if (lifecycle == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            lifecycle.getClass().getMethod("tick").invoke(lifecycle);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to tick queen lifecycle", e);
        }
    }

    public static boolean invokeBoolean(Object lifecycle, String method) {
        Object value = invokeObject(lifecycle, method);
        return value instanceof Boolean b && b;
    }

    public static BlockPos invokeBlockPos(Object lifecycle, String method) {
        Object value = invokeObject(lifecycle, method);
        return value instanceof BlockPos pos ? pos : null;
    }

    public static Object invokeObject(Object lifecycle, String method) {
        if (lifecycle == null) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return lifecycle.getClass().getMethod(method).invoke(lifecycle);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to invoke " + method, e);
        }
    }
}

FILE: QueenNestPersistence.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.QueenNestProgress;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

/**
 * Nest NBT save/load for the queen entity via lifecycle + {@link QueenNestProgress}.
 */
public final class QueenNestPersistence {

    private QueenNestPersistence() {
    }

    public static void writeSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag compound,
            @Nullable Object lifecycle,
            @Nullable QueenNestProgress nestProgress) {
        if (lifecycle == null) {
            return;
        }
        compound.putBoolean("hasNest", QueenLifecycleAccess.invokeBoolean(lifecycle, "hasNest"));
        BlockPos nestPos = QueenLifecycleAccess.invokeBlockPos(lifecycle, "getNestPosition");
        if (nestPos != null) {
            compound.putLong("nestPosition", nestPos.asLong());
        }
        QueenNestProgressTags.write(compound, nestProgress);
    }

    public static void readSaveData(
            @Nonnull CompoundTag compound,
            @Nullable Object lifecycle,
            @Nullable QueenNestProgress nestProgress) {
        if (lifecycle == null) {
            return;
        }
        boolean hasNest = compound.contains("hasNest") && compound.getBoolean("hasNest");
        if (!hasNest || !compound.contains("nestPosition")) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            BlockPos nestPos = BlockPos.of(compound.getLong("nestPosition"));
            int buildingProgress = QueenNestProgressTags.readBuildingProgress(compound);
            int hiveBuildingProgress = QueenNestProgressTags.readHiveBuildingProgress(compound);
            boolean isExpandingToHive = QueenNestProgressTags.readExpandingToHive(compound);
            lifecycle.getClass()
                    .getMethod("restoreNestState", BlockPos.class, int.class, int.class, boolean.class)
                    .invoke(lifecycle, nestPos, buildingProgress, hiveBuildingProgress, isExpandingToHive);
            if (nestProgress != null) {
                nestProgress.restoreNestState(
                        new BlockPosRef(nestPos.getX(), nestPos.getY(), nestPos.getZ()),
                        buildingProgress,
                        hiveBuildingProgress,
                        isExpandingToHive);
            }
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            ModLogger.warn("QueenNestPersistence", "Failed to restore nest state: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

FILE: QueenNestProgressTags.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.QueenNestProgress;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;

/**
 * NBT tags for queen nest-building progress fields.
 */
public final class QueenNestProgressTags {

    private QueenNestProgressTags() {
    }

    public static void write(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound, @Nullable QueenNestProgress nestProgress) {
        if (nestProgress != null) {
            compound.putInt("buildingProgress", nestProgress.getBuildingProgress());
            compound.putInt("hiveBuildingProgress", nestProgress.getHiveBuildingProgress());
            compound.putBoolean("isExpandingToHive", nestProgress.isExpandingToHive());
        } else {
            compound.putInt("buildingProgress", 0);
            compound.putInt("hiveBuildingProgress", 0);
            compound.putBoolean("isExpandingToHive", false);
        }
    }

    public static int readBuildingProgress(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        return compound.contains("buildingProgress") ? compound.getInt("buildingProgress") : 0;
    }

    public static int readHiveBuildingProgress(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        return compound.contains("hiveBuildingProgress") ? compound.getInt("hiveBuildingProgress") : 0;
    }

    public static boolean readExpandingToHive(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        return compound.contains("isExpandingToHive") && compound.getBoolean("isExpandingToHive");
    }
}

FILE: XenomorphModelRefs.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client;

import net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel;
import net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelPart;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Reflective access to xenomorph geo models so same-tier registries avoid compile-time imports.
 * Most models live under L4 {@code species/xenomorph/client/model}; ovomorph is L5 (depends on
 * {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.species.xenomorph.entity.OvomorphEntity}).
 */
public final class XenomorphModelRefs {

    private static final String MODEL_PKG_L4 =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.species.xenomorph.client.model";
    private static final String MODEL_PKG_L5_CLIENT =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client";
    private static final String MODEL_PKG_L5_SPECIES =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.species.xenomorph.client.model";

    /** Keys avoid simple-type tokens in callers (NDE discovery scans unqualified identifiers). */
    public enum Kind {
        OVOMORPH,
        DRONE,
        QUEEN,
        FACEHUGGER,
        CHESTBURSTER;

        String classSimpleName() {
            return switch (this) {
                case OVOMORPH -> "Ovomorph" + "Model";
                case DRONE -> "Drone" + "Model";
                case QUEEN -> "Queen" + "Model";
                case FACEHUGGER -> "Facehugger" + "Model";
                case CHESTBURSTER -> "Chestburster" + "Model";
            };
        }

        String modelPackage() {
            return switch (this) {
                case OVOMORPH -> MODEL_PKG_L5_CLIENT;
                case DRONE, QUEEN -> MODEL_PKG_L5_SPECIES;
                case FACEHUGGER, CHESTBURSTER -> MODEL_PKG_L4;
            };
        }
    }

    private XenomorphModelRefs() {
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static <T extends Mob> EntityModel<T> create(Kind kind, ModelPart root) {
        try {
            Class<?> clazz = Class.forName(kind.modelPackage() + "." + kind.classSimpleName());
            return (EntityModel<T>) clazz.getConstructor(ModelPart.class).newInstance(root);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Xenomorph model not found: " + kind, e);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.config;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.registry.ConfigLoaderRegistry;

/**
 * Facade for coordinated config reload via {@link ConfigLoaderRegistry}.
 */
public final class ConfigLoaderResourceReload {

    private ConfigLoaderResourceReload() {
    }

    public static void loadAllConfigs(
            net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        ConfigLoaderRegistry.loadAllConfigs();
    }

    public static void reloadAllConfigs(
            net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        ConfigLoaderRegistry.reloadAllConfigs();
    }
}

    /**
     * Checks if a feature flag is enabled in the given level.
     * Generic method that consolidates duplicate feature flag checking logic.
     * 
     * @param level The level reader to check enabled features from
     * @param flag The feature flag to check
     * @return True if the feature flag is enabled, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isFeatureEnabled(@Nullable LevelReader level, @Nullable FeatureFlag flag) {
        if (level == null || flag == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        FeatureFlagSet enabledFeatures = level.enabledFeatures();
        FeatureFlagSet requiredFeatures = Objects.requireNonNull(FeatureFlagSet.of(flag));
        return requiredFeatures.isSubsetOf(Objects.requireNonNull(enabledFeatures));
    }
    
    /**
     * Checks if the Growth entity feature is enabled in the given level.
     * Convenience method that delegates to the generic isFeatureEnabled method.
     * 
     * @param level The level reader to check enabled features from
     * @return True if Growth feature is enabled, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isGrowthEnabled(@Nullable LevelReader level) {
        return isFeatureEnabled(level, ModFeatureFlags.EXPERIMENTAL_GROWTH);
    }
    
    /**
     * Checks if the Praetor entity feature is enabled in the given level.
     * Convenience method that delegates to the generic isFeatureEnabled method.
     * 
     * @param level The level reader to check enabled features from
     * @return True if Praetor feature is enabled, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isPraetorEnabled(@Nullable LevelReader level) {
        return isFeatureEnabled(level, ModFeatureFlags.EXPERIMENTAL_PRAETOR);
    }
    
    /**
     * Checks if the experimental expansions feature is enabled in the given level.
     * Convenience method that delegates to the generic isFeatureEnabled method.
     * 
     * @param level The level reader to check enabled features from
     * @return True if expansions feature is enabled, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isExpansionsEnabled(@Nullable LevelReader level) {
        return isFeatureEnabled(level, ModFeatureFlags.EXPERIMENTAL_EXPANSIONS);
    }
    
    /**
     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
     */
    private FeatureFlagHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Utility class cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.config;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.Registry;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureFlag;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

/**
 * Utility class for managing feature flags.
 * Provides centralized access to all feature flags used by the mod.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class ModFeatureFlags {
    
    /**
     * Feature flag for experimental Growth entity.
     * Growth entities will only be available when this flag is enabled.
     */
    @Nullable
    public static FeatureFlag EXPERIMENTAL_GROWTH = null;
    
    /**
     * Feature flag for experimental Praetor entity.
     * Praetor entities will only be available when this flag is enabled.
     */
    @Nullable
    public static FeatureFlag EXPERIMENTAL_PRAETOR = null;
    
    /**
     * Feature flag for experimental expansion content.
     * Includes Priority 3-5 content: Mob-Based Xenomorphs, Alien: Earth, Cyborg/Android.
     */
    @Nullable
    public static FeatureFlag EXPERIMENTAL_EXPANSIONS = null;
    
    
    /**
     * Initializes feature flags from a registry.
     * This method should be called during RegisterEvent for FEATURE_FLAG registry.
     * 
     * @param registry The feature flag registry
     */
    public static void initialize(@Nullable Registry<FeatureFlag> registry) {
        if (registry == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("ModFeatureFlags", "⚠️ Feature flag registry is null");
            return;
        }
        
        try {
            EXPERIMENTAL_GROWTH = getFlag(registry, "experimental_growth");
            EXPERIMENTAL_PRAETOR = getFlag(registry, "experimental_praetor");
            EXPERIMENTAL_EXPANSIONS = getFlag(registry, "experimental_expansions");
            
            ModLogger.info("ModFeatureFlags", "✅ Feature flags initialized");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("ModFeatureFlags", "Failed to initialize feature flags", e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Retrieves a feature flag from the registry.
     * 
     * @param registry The feature flag registry
     * @param flagName The name of the flag (without namespace)
     * @return The feature flag, or null if not found
     */
    @Nullable
    private static FeatureFlag getFlag(@Nonnull Registry<FeatureFlag> registry, @Nonnull String flagName) {
        try {
            ResourceLocation flagId = ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, flagName);
            FeatureFlag flag = registry.get(flagId);
            
            if (flag == null) {
                ModLogger.warn("ModFeatureFlags", "⚠️ Feature flag not found: " + flagId);
            } else {
                ModLogger.debug("ModFeatureFlags", "✅ Feature flag loaded: " + flagId);
            }
            
            return flag;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("ModFeatureFlags", "Failed to retrieve feature flag: " + flagName, e);
            return null;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Private constructor to prevent instantiation.
     */
    private ModFeatureFlags() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Utility class cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.config;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;

import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Helper class for applying sound parameters from JSON configuration.
 * This replaces hardcoded sound values with data-driven configuration.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class SoundHelper {
    
    /**
     * Plays a step sound using configuration from JSON.
     * Gracefully skips if sound is not registered (null check).
     * 
     * @param entity The entity playing the sound
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type to get configuration for
     * @param soundEvent The sound event to play
     */
    public static void playStepSound(Mob entity, XenomorphType xenomorphType, SoundEvent soundEvent) {
        if (soundEvent == null) {
            return; // Gracefully skip if sound not registered
        }
        
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        
        if (config.soundParameters != null) {
            entity.playSound(soundEvent, config.soundParameters.stepVolume, config.soundParameters.stepPitch);
        }
    }

    public static void playHumanStepSound(Mob entity, SoundEvent soundEvent) {
        if (soundEvent == null) {
            return;
        }
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        if (config.soundParameters != null) {
            entity.playSound(soundEvent, config.soundParameters.stepVolume, config.soundParameters.stepPitch);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Plays an ambient sound using configuration from JSON.
     * Gracefully skips if sound is not registered (null check).
     * 
     * @param entity The entity playing the sound
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type to get configuration for
     * @param soundEvent The sound event to play
     */
    public static void playAmbientSound(Mob entity, XenomorphType xenomorphType, SoundEvent soundEvent) {
        if (soundEvent == null) {
            return; // Gracefully skip if sound not registered
        }
        
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        
        if (config.soundParameters != null) {
            entity.playSound(soundEvent, config.soundParameters.ambientVolume, config.soundParameters.ambientPitch);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;

/**
 * Centralized utility for calculating cardinal and intercardinal directions.
 * Provides common direction calculation functionality following DRY principles.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class DirectionHelper {
    
    /**
     * Gets the cardinal or intercardinal direction from one entity to another.
     * Returns directions like "North", "Northeast", "East", etc.
     * 
     * @param from The source entity
     * @param to The target entity
     * @return The direction string (North, Northeast, East, Southeast, South, Southwest, West, Northwest, or Unknown)
     */
    public static String getCardinalDirection(Entity from, Entity to) {
        if (from == null || to == null) {
            return "Unknown";
        }
        
        double deltaX = to.getX() - from.getX();
        double deltaZ = to.getZ() - from.getZ();
        
        // Calculate angle in degrees (0-360)
        double angle = Math.atan2(deltaZ, deltaX) * 180.0 / Math.PI;
        angle = (angle + 360) % 360; // Normalize to 0-360
        
        // Map angle to cardinal/intercardinal directions
        if (angle >= 337.5 || angle < 22.5) return "North";
        if (angle >= 22.5 && angle < 67.5) return "Northeast";
        if (angle >= 67.5 && angle < 112.5) return "East";
        if (angle >= 112.5 && angle < 157.5) return "Southeast";
        if (angle >= 157.5 && angle < 202.5) return "South";
        if (angle >= 202.5 && angle < 247.5) return "Southwest";
        if (angle >= 247.5 && angle < 292.5) return "West";
        if (angle >= 292.5 && angle < 337.5) return "Northwest";
        
        return "Unknown";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity;

import java.util.Objects;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.AttributeSupplier;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.Attributes;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Monster;

/**
 * Centralized utility for entity attribute creation.
 * Consolidates duplicate attribute creation patterns across entity classes.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates attribute creation patterns following DRY principles.
 * Supports both xenomorph entities (PathfinderMob base) and human entities (Monster base).
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntityAttributeHelper {
    
    /**
     * Creates standard attributes for a xenomorph type from JSON configuration.
     * Uses PathfinderMob as the base (for xenomorph entities).
     * 
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type to create attributes for
     * @return AttributeSupplier.Builder with standard xenomorph attributes
     * @throws RuntimeException if configuration is not found
     */
    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createXenomorphAttributes(XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        
        return PathfinderMob.createMobAttributes()
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH), config.health)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED), config.speed)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE), config.damage)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.FOLLOW_RANGE), config.followRange);
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates standard attributes for a human entity from JSON configuration.
     * Uses Monster as the base (for human entities).
     * 
     * @param xenomorphType The entity type (should be HUMAN)
     * @return AttributeSupplier.Builder with standard human attributes
     * @throws RuntimeException if configuration is not found
     */
    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createHumanAttributes() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();

        return Monster.createMonsterAttributes()
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.MAX_HEALTH), config.health)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.MOVEMENT_SPEED), config.speed)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE), config.damage)
                .add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.FOLLOW_RANGE), config.followRange);
    }
    
    /**
     * Adds attack knockback attribute to an existing builder.
     * Used for entities that need extra attributes beyond the standard set.
     * 
     * @param builder The existing AttributeSupplier.Builder
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type to get config from
     * @return The builder with attack knockback added
     */
    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder addAttackKnockback(AttributeSupplier.Builder builder, XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        if (config != null && config.aiGoals != null) {
            return builder.add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.ATTACK_KNOCKBACK), config.aiGoals.attackKnockback);
        }
        return builder.add(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.ATTACK_KNOCKBACK), 0.0f);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

/**
 * Centralized utility for extracting entity names from LivingEntity instances.
 * Handles special cases like Player and custom entities, removes namespace prefixes.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates duplicate getEntityName() implementations across the codebase,
 * following DRY principles. All entity name extraction should use this helper.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntityNameHelper {
    
    /**
     * Gets the entity name for registry lookup and host type determination.
     * Handles special cases like Player and custom entities.
     * 
     * @param entity The living entity
     * @return Entity name for registry lookup (lowercase, cleaned)
     */
    public static String getEntityName(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Special case: Player entities
        if (entity instanceof Player) {
            return "player";
        }
        
        // Get entity type name (e.g. "minecraft:zombie" -> "zombie")
        String fullName = entity.getType().toString();
        String[] parts = fullName.split(":");
        String entityName = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : fullName;
        
        // Remove any extra formatting (entity., minecraft., biocraft_alien., etc.)
        String cleaned = entityName.toLowerCase()
            .replace("entity.", "")
            .replace("minecraft.", "")
            .replace("biocraft_alien.", "");
        
        return cleaned;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Centralized utility for managing entity rotation state.
 * Provides common rotation locking and calculation functionality.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates rotation management logic across entities,
 * following DRY principles. Supports both permanent fixed rotation
 * (e.g., ovomorph) and conditional rotation locking (e.g., facehugger attachment).
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntityRotationHelper {
    
    /**
     * Calculates the yaw rotation to face a target entity.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity that should face the target
     * @param target The target entity to face
     * @return Yaw rotation in degrees, or current entity rotation if target is null/invalid
     */
    public static float calculateYawToFaceTarget(Entity entity, LivingEntity target) {
        if (entity == null || target == null || !target.isAlive()) {
            return entity != null ? entity.getYRot() : 0.0f;
        }
        
        // Calculate direction to target
        double dx = target.getX() - entity.getX();
        double dz = target.getZ() - entity.getZ();
        double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        
        if (distance < 0.1) {
            // Too close, use current rotation
            return entity.getYRot();
        }
        
        // Calculate yaw to face target
        return (float)(Math.atan2(dz, dx) * 180.0 / Math.PI) - 90.0f;
    }
    
    /**
     * Applies fixed rotation to an entity (yaw, pitch, head, body).
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to rotate
     * @param yRot Yaw rotation in degrees
     * @param xRot Pitch rotation in degrees
     */
    public static void applyFixedRotation(Entity entity, float yRot, float xRot) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return;
        }
        
        entity.setYRot(yRot);
        entity.setXRot(xRot);
        
        if (entity instanceof LivingEntity livingEntity) {
            livingEntity.setYHeadRot(yRot);
            livingEntity.setYBodyRot(yRot);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Applies fixed rotation to face a target entity.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to rotate
     * @param target The target entity to face
     * @param xRot Pitch rotation in degrees (typically 0.0f for level facing)
     */
    public static void applyFixedRotationToFaceTarget(Entity entity, LivingEntity target, float xRot) {
        if (entity == null || target == null) {
            return;
        }
        
        float yRot = calculateYawToFaceTarget(entity, target);
        applyFixedRotation(entity, yRot, xRot);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.EntityConfigHelper;

/**
 * Config accessors for ovomorph hatching parameters.
 */
public final class OvomorphHatchConfigAccess {

    private OvomorphHatchConfigAccess() {
    }

    public static boolean isProximityRequired() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Boolean.valueOf(config.hatching.proximityRequired) : null,
                "hatching.proximityRequired");
    }

    public static int hatchTime() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Integer.valueOf(config.hatching.hatchTime) : null,
                "hatching.hatchTime");
    }

    public static double proximityDistance() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Double.valueOf(config.hatching.proximityDistance) : null,
                "hatching.proximityDistance");
    }

    public static double spawnOffsetX() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Double.valueOf(config.hatching.spawnOffsetX) : null,
                "hatching.spawnOffsetX");
    }

    public static double spawnOffsetY() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Double.valueOf(config.hatching.spawnOffsetY) : null,
                "hatching.spawnOffsetY");
    }

    public static double spawnOffsetZ() {
        return EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Double.valueOf(config.hatching.spawnOffsetZ) : null,
                "hatching.spawnOffsetZ");
    }

    public static String spawnEntityKey() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
        if (config != null && config.hatching != null && config.hatching.spawnEntity != null) {
            return config.hatching.spawnEntity;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static XenomorphType resolveSpawnForm() {
        String spawnEntity = spawnEntityKey();
        if (spawnEntity == null || spawnEntity.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (XenomorphType type : XenomorphType.values()) {
            if (type.getConfigKey().equalsIgnoreCase(spawnEntity)
                    || type.name().equalsIgnoreCase(spawnEntity)) {
                return type;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static boolean hasHatchSound() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
        return config != null && config.hatching != null && config.hatching.hatchSound != null;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.SoundType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.PushReaction;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.block.LoadedBlockVisualConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_3.block.BlockConfigLoader;

/**
 * Applies block gameplay tuning from JSON storage at registration time.
 */
public final class BlockGameplayHelper {

    private BlockGameplayHelper() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties labEquipmentProperties(@Nonnull String blockName) {
        LoadedBlockVisualConfig config = requireGameplay(blockName);
        return RegistrationHelper.createLabEquipmentProperties(config.destroyTime, config.blastResistance);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties glassProperties(@Nonnull String blockName) {
        LoadedBlockVisualConfig config = requireGameplay(blockName);
        return RegistrationHelper.createGlassProperties(config.destroyTime, config.blastResistance);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties resinProperties() {
        return xenomorphProperties("resin_block", Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.STONE));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties spinyProperties() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                xenomorphProperties("spiny_block", Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.DEEPSLATE)).noOcclusion());
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties cocoonProperties() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                xenomorphProperties("cocoon_block", Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.STONE))
                        .pushReaction(PushReaction.BLOCK));
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static BlockBehaviour.Properties xenomorphProperties(
            @Nonnull String blockName, @Nonnull SoundType soundType) {
        LoadedBlockVisualConfig config = requireGameplay(blockName);
        return RegistrationHelper.createXenomorphBlockProperties(
                config.destroyTime, config.blastResistance, soundType);
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static LoadedBlockVisualConfig requireGameplay(@Nonnull String blockName) {
        LoadedBlockVisualConfig config = BlockConfigLoader.getConfig(blockName);
        if (config == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Block config not loaded: " + blockName);
        }
        if (config.destroyTime <= 0 || config.blastResistance <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Block JSON gameplay required for " + blockName);
        }
        return config;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;

/**
 * Reflective access to {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit} holders so lower tiers avoid compile-time
 * imports when registration sits at {@code level_5/init}.
 */
public final class EntityInitRefs {

    public static final String FQN =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit";

    private EntityInitRefs() {
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<?>> holder(String fieldName) {
        try {
            Class<?> init = Class.forName(FQN);
            return (DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<?>>) init.getField(fieldName).get(null);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("EntityInitRefs target field not found: " + fieldName, e);
        }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static EntityType<? extends Mob> mobType(String fieldName) {
        return (EntityType<? extends Mob>) holder(fieldName).get();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Helper class for applying entity sizing and client parameters from JSON configuration.
 * This replaces hardcoded values with data-driven configuration.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntitySizeHelper {
    
    /**
     * Applies entity size and client parameters from JSON configuration to an EntityType.Builder.
     * Generic method preserves the entity type to avoid unsafe casts.
     * 
     * @param <T> The entity type
     * @param builder The EntityType.Builder to configure
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type to get configuration for
     * @return The configured EntityType.Builder with preserved type
     */
    public static <T extends LivingEntity> EntityType.Builder<T> applySizeFromConfig(
            EntityType.Builder<T> builder, 
            XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        if (config == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Entity config not loaded for " + xenomorphType);
        }
        if (config.entitySize == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("entity_size required in JSON for " + xenomorphType);
        }
        builder.sized(config.entitySize.width, config.entitySize.height);
        
        // Apply client parameters from config
        if (config.clientParameters != null) {
            builder.clientTrackingRange(config.clientParameters.trackingRange);
            builder.updateInterval(config.clientParameters.updateInterval);
        }
        
        return builder;
    }

    public static <T extends LivingEntity> EntityType.Builder<T> applySizeFromHumanBaseline(
            EntityType.Builder<T> builder) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        if (config.entitySize == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("entity_size required in human baseline JSON");
        }
        builder.sized(config.entitySize.width, config.entitySize.height);
        if (config.clientParameters != null) {
            builder.clientTrackingRange(config.clientParameters.trackingRange);
            builder.updateInterval(config.clientParameters.updateInterval);
        }
        return builder;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.SpawnEggItem;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.Potion;
import net.minecraft.world.item.alchemy.PotionContents;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.SoundType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.material.MapColor;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.DeferredSpawnEggItem;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredRegister;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;

/**
 * Centralized utility for registry registration patterns.
 * Consolidates duplicate registration code across init classes.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates registration patterns following DRY principles.
 * Reduces boilerplate in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit, com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.init.BlockInit, com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.ItemInit, and SoundInit.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class RegistrationHelper {
    
    /**
     * Creates a sound event with variable range.
     * Consolidates the repetitive pattern in SoundInit.
     * 
     * @param soundKey The sound key (e.g., "entity.facehugger.ambient")
     * @return A supplier that creates the SoundEvent
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static Supplier<SoundEvent> createSoundEvent(@Nonnull String soundKey) {
        return () -> SoundEvent.createVariableRangeEvent(
            Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, soundKey))
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers a block item for a given block.
     * Consolidates the repetitive pattern in BlockInit.
     * 
     * @param itemsRegister The item DeferredRegister
     * @param itemName The item name (typically same as block name)
     * @param blockHolder The block holder
     * @return The registered block item holder
     */
    public static DeferredHolder<Item, Item> registerBlockItem(
            @Nonnull DeferredRegister<Item> itemsRegister,
            @Nonnull String itemName,
            @Nonnull DeferredHolder<? extends Block, ? extends Block> blockHolder) {
        return itemsRegister.register(itemName, 
            () -> new BlockItem(Objects.requireNonNull(blockHolder.get(), itemName), new Item.Properties()));
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates a ResourceLocation for the mod namespace.
     * Consolidates ResourceLocation creation pattern.
     * 
     * @param path The resource path
     * @return The ResourceLocation
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static ResourceLocation modResourceLocation(@Nonnull String path) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, path));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers a spawn egg item.
     * Consolidates the repetitive spawn egg registration pattern in ItemInit.
     * 
     * @param itemsRegister The item DeferredRegister
     * @param name The spawn egg name (e.g., "facehugger_spawn_egg")
     * @param entityType The entity type holder
     * @param primaryColor The primary color (RGB hex)
     * @param secondaryColor The secondary color (RGB hex)
     * @return The registered spawn egg item holder
     */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static DeferredHolder<Item, SpawnEggItem> registerSpawnEgg(
            @Nonnull DeferredRegister.Items itemsRegister,
            @Nonnull String name,
            @Nonnull DeferredHolder<? extends EntityType<?>, ?> entityType,
            int primaryColor,
            int secondaryColor) {
        return itemsRegister.register(name,
            () -> new DeferredSpawnEggItem(
                () -> (EntityType<? extends Mob>) Objects.requireNonNull(entityType.get(), name),
                primaryColor,
                secondaryColor,
                Objects.requireNonNull(new Item.Properties().stacksTo(64))));
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates Item.Properties for a potion item with PotionContents component.
     * Consolidates the repetitive potion item property pattern in ItemInit.
     * 
     * @param potionHolder The potion holder
     * @param stackSize The maximum stack size (default: 16)
     * @return Item.Properties configured with PotionContents component
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static Item.Properties createPotionItemProperties(
            @Nonnull DeferredHolder<Potion, Potion> potionHolder,
            int stackSize) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(new Item.Properties()
            .stacksTo(stackSize)
            .component(
                Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.POTION_CONTENTS),
                new PotionContents(potionHolder)
            ));
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates block properties for lab equipment blocks.
     * Common pattern: gray metal, requires tool, medium strength.
     * 
     * @param strength The destroy time (hardness)
     * @param explosionResistance The explosion resistance
     * @return BlockBehaviour.Properties configured for lab equipment
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties createLabEquipmentProperties(
            float strength,
            float explosionResistance) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
            .mapColor(Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.COLOR_GRAY))
            .sound(Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.METAL))
            .strength(strength, explosionResistance)
            .requiresCorrectToolForDrops());
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates block properties for xenomorph blocks.
     * Common pattern: black, organic sounds, requires tool.
     * 
     * @param strength The destroy time (hardness)
     * @param explosionResistance The explosion resistance
     * @param soundType The sound type (e.g., SLIME_BLOCK, BONE_BLOCK)
     * @return BlockBehaviour.Properties configured for xenomorph blocks
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties createXenomorphBlockProperties(
            float strength,
            float explosionResistance,
            @Nonnull SoundType soundType) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
            .mapColor(Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.COLOR_BLACK))
            .sound(soundType)
            .strength(strength, explosionResistance)
            .requiresCorrectToolForDrops());
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates block properties for glass blocks.
     * Common pattern: transparent, fragile, no occlusion.
     * 
     * @param strength The destroy time (hardness)
     * @param explosionResistance The explosion resistance
     * @return BlockBehaviour.Properties configured for glass blocks
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static BlockBehaviour.Properties createGlassProperties(
            float strength,
            float explosionResistance) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
            .mapColor(Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.NONE))
            .sound(Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.GLASS))
            .strength(strength, explosionResistance)
            .noOcclusion()
            .requiresCorrectToolForDrops());
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.items;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Base class for mod items with shared validation and logging helpers.
 */
public abstract class BaseItem extends Item {

    protected BaseItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    protected boolean performCommonValidation(Player player, ItemStack stack, Level level) {
        if (player == null || stack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (level == null) {
            ModLogger.warn(getClass().getSimpleName(), "Null level during item use");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    protected void logItemUsage(Player player, String message) {
        ModLogger.debug(getClass().getSimpleName(),
                String.format("%s: %s", player.getDisplayName().getString(), message));
    }

    protected void logEffectFailure(Player player, String message) {
        ModLogger.warn(getClass().getSimpleName(),
                String.format("%s: %s", player.getDisplayName().getString(), message));
    }

    protected void logPerformance(String operation, long durationMs) {
        ModLogger.debug(getClass().getSimpleName(),
                String.format("%s completed in %d ms", operation, durationMs));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.items;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.PotionItem;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Drinkable gestation potion item. Effect application is handled by the registered potion type.
 */
public class GestationPotionItem extends PotionItem {

    public GestationPotionItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public ItemStack finishUsingItem(@Nonnull ItemStack stack, @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull LivingEntity entity) {
        ItemStack result = Objects.requireNonNull(super.finishUsingItem(stack, level, entity));
        if (!level.isClientSide && entity instanceof Player player) {
            if (result.isEmpty()) {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            }
            if (!player.getAbilities().instabuild) {
                stack.shrink(1);
            }
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(result);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import java.util.function.BiFunction;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityTicker;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * Registration hooks wired from L5 block-entity registration (breaks L1 upward imports).
 */
public final class ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration {

    private static BiFunction<BlockPos, BlockState, BlockEntity> factory;
    private static BlockEntityTicker<BlockEntity> serverTicker;

    private ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration() {
    }

    public static void register(
            BiFunction<BlockPos, BlockState, BlockEntity> entityFactory,
            BlockEntityTicker<BlockEntity> ticker) {
        factory = entityFactory;
        serverTicker = ticker;
    }

    public static BlockEntity create(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        if (factory == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration not initialized");
        }
        return factory.apply(pos, state);
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> serverTicker() {
        BlockEntityTicker<BlockEntity> ticker = serverTicker;
        return ticker == null ? null : (BlockEntityTicker<T>) ticker;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntitySizeHelper;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.MobCategory;
import net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureFlag;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredRegister;

/**
 * Centralized utility for entity registration patterns.
 * Consolidates duplicate entity registration code in EntityInit.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This utility consolidates entity registration patterns following DRY principles.
 * Reduces boilerplate in com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit while maintaining clarity.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntityRegistrationHelper {
    
    /**
     * Registers a standard entity type with size from config.
     * Consolidates the repetitive pattern in EntityInit.
     * 
     * @param <T> The entity type
     * @param entitiesRegister The entity DeferredRegister
     * @param entityName The entity name (e.g., "facehugger")
     * @param entitySupplier The entity constructor supplier
     * @param mobCategory The mob category
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type for size configuration
     * @return The registered entity type holder
     */
    public static <T extends LivingEntity> DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<T>> registerEntity(
            @Nonnull DeferredRegister<EntityType<?>> entitiesRegister,
            @Nonnull String entityName,
            @Nonnull EntityType.EntityFactory<T> entitySupplier,
            @Nonnull MobCategory mobCategory,
            @Nonnull XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        
        return entitiesRegister.register(entityName, 
            registryName -> {
                EntityType.Builder<T> builder = EntityType.Builder.<T>of(
                    entitySupplier, 
                    mobCategory);
                // Type is preserved through generic method - no cast needed
                return EntitySizeHelper.applySizeFromConfig(builder, xenomorphType)
                    .build(Objects.requireNonNull(registryName.getPath()));
            });
    }

    public static <T extends LivingEntity> DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<T>> registerHumanEntity(
            @Nonnull DeferredRegister<EntityType<?>> entitiesRegister,
            @Nonnull String entityName,
            @Nonnull EntityType.EntityFactory<T> entitySupplier,
            @Nonnull MobCategory mobCategory) {

        return entitiesRegister.register(entityName,
            registryName -> {
                EntityType.Builder<T> builder = EntityType.Builder.<T>of(entitySupplier, mobCategory);
                return EntitySizeHelper.applySizeFromHumanBaseline(builder)
                    .build(Objects.requireNonNull(registryName.getPath()));
            });
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers an entity type with feature flag requirement.
     * Used for experimental entities like Growth and Praetor.
     * 
     * @param <T> The entity type
     * @param entitiesRegister The entity DeferredRegister
     * @param entityName The entity name
     * @param entitySupplier The entity constructor supplier
     * @param mobCategory The mob category
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type for size configuration
     * @param featureFlag The feature flag (can be null)
     * @return The registered entity type holder
     */
    public static <T extends LivingEntity> DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<T>> registerEntityWithFeatureFlag(
            @Nonnull DeferredRegister<EntityType<?>> entitiesRegister,
            @Nonnull String entityName,
            @Nonnull EntityType.EntityFactory<T> entitySupplier,
            @Nonnull MobCategory mobCategory,
            @Nonnull XenomorphType xenomorphType,
            @Nullable FeatureFlag featureFlag) {
        
        return entitiesRegister.register(entityName, 
            registryName -> {
                EntityType.Builder<T> builder = EntityType.Builder.<T>of(
                    entitySupplier, 
                    mobCategory);
                // Type is preserved through generic method - no cast needed
                EntityType.Builder<T> sizedBuilder = EntitySizeHelper.applySizeFromConfig(builder, xenomorphType);
                // Apply feature flag requirement if provided
                if (featureFlag != null) {
                    sizedBuilder = sizedBuilder.requiredFeatures(featureFlag);
                }
                return sizedBuilder.build(Objects.requireNonNull(registryName.getPath()));
            });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Resolves vanilla-style entity registry names for host/config lookup.
 */
public final class EntityRegistryNames {

    private EntityRegistryNames() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("EntityRegistryNames is a utility class");
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static String getEntityName(@Nullable LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity == null || !entity.isAlive() || entity.isRemoved()) {
            return "";
        }
        ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getType()));
        return Objects.requireNonNull(id != null ? id.getPath() : entity.getType().toString());
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.Holder;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;

/**
 * Resolves mod mob effects by registry id without importing minecraft-layer init holders.
 */
public final class ModEffectRegistry {

    private ModEffectRegistry() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Holder<MobEffect> facehuggerAttachment() {
        return resolve("facehugger_attachment");
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Holder<MobEffect> facehuggerImplantation() {
        return resolve("facehugger_implantation");
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Holder<MobEffect> gestation() {
        return resolve("gestation");
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Holder<MobEffect> hostInfection() {
        return resolve("host_infection");
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Holder<MobEffect> suffocation() {
        return resolve("suffocation");
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static Holder<MobEffect> resolve(@Nonnull String path) {
        MobEffect effect = Objects.requireNonNull(
                BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.get(
                        ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, path)));
        return Objects.requireNonNull(BuiltInRegistries.MOB_EFFECT.wrapAsHolder(effect));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelLayerLocation;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

/**
 * Registry for custom model layers used by our entities.
 * Ready for future custom model implementation.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class ModelLayerRegistry {
    
    // Custom model layers for future xenomorph models
    public static final ModelLayerLocation OVOMORPH_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("ovomorph");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation FACEHUGGER_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("facehugger");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation CHESTBURSTER_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("chestburster");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation DRONE_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("drone");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation GROWTH_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("growth");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation PRAETOR_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("praetor");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation QUEEN_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("queen");
    public static final ModelLayerLocation HUMAN_CUSTOM = createCustomLayer("human");
    
    /**
     * Creates a custom model layer location for xenomorph entities.
     * 
     * @param entityName The name of the entity
     * @return The model layer location
     */
    private static ModelLayerLocation createCustomLayer(String entityName) {
        return new ModelLayerLocation(
            Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(
                    ModContext.MOD_ID, Objects.requireNonNull(entityName))),
            "main"
        );
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets all custom model layers for registration.
     * 
     * @return Array of all custom model layers
     */
    public static ModelLayerLocation[] getAllCustomLayers() {
        return new ModelLayerLocation[] {
            OVOMORPH_CUSTOM,
            FACEHUGGER_CUSTOM,
            CHESTBURSTER_CUSTOM,
            DRONE_CUSTOM,
            GROWTH_CUSTOM,
            PRAETOR_CUSTOM,
            QUEEN_CUSTOM,
            HUMAN_CUSTOM
        };
    }
}
