package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.target.NearestAttackableTargetGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Monster;

/**
 * Registry for xenomorph entity types that humans should target.
 * L3-only: uses {@link NearestAttackableTargetGoal} and {@link Monster} goal registration.
 * Any future target-type catalog (domain keys) may live L0/L2; registration stays here.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class XenomorphTargetRegistry {
    
    /**
     * Interface for registering xenomorph entity targets.
     * Allows species-specific implementations to provide target classes.
     */
    public interface XenomorphTargetProvider {
        /**
         * Gets the class of xenomorph entities to target.
         * 
         * @return The entity class to target
         */
        @Nonnull
        Class<? extends LivingEntity> getTargetClass();
        
        /**
         * Gets the priority for this target goal.
         * Lower numbers = higher priority.
         * 
         * @return The priority
         */
        int getPriority();
    }
    
    private static final List<XenomorphTargetProvider> TARGET_PROVIDERS = new ArrayList<>();
    
    /**
     * Registers a xenomorph target provider.
     * 
     * @param provider The target provider
     */
    public static void registerTarget(@Nonnull XenomorphTargetProvider provider) {
        TARGET_PROVIDERS.add(Objects.requireNonNull(provider, "xenomorph target provider"));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers all xenomorph target goals for a human entity.
     * 
     * @param human The human entity to register targets for
     */
    public static void registerXenomorphTargets(@Nonnull Monster human) {
        for (XenomorphTargetProvider provider : TARGET_PROVIDERS) {
            human.targetSelector.addGoal(
                provider.getPriority(),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(human, provider.getTargetClass(), true));
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers all xenomorph target goals for a human entity with a filter predicate.
     * 
     * @param human The human entity to register targets for
     * @param filter The filter predicate for targeting
     */
    public static void registerXenomorphTargets(
            @Nonnull Monster human,
            @Nonnull Predicate<LivingEntity> filter) {
        for (XenomorphTargetProvider provider : TARGET_PROVIDERS) {
            human.targetSelector.addGoal(
                provider.getPriority(),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(human, provider.getTargetClass(), true, filter));
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.research;

import java.util.Objects;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.SampleKind;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.research.ResearchRecord;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.research.SampleRecord;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.research.ResearchEquipmentPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.research.ResearchPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.research.ResearchService;

/**
 * Thin delegate of {@link ResearchEquipmentPort}. Not a research authority —
 * all decisions go to {@link ResearchService}; storage to {@link ResearchPort}.
 */
public final class ResearchEquipmentPortDelegate implements ResearchEquipmentPort {

    private final ResearchPort storage;

    public ResearchEquipmentPortDelegate(ResearchPort storage) {
        this.storage = Objects.requireNonNull(storage, "storage");
    }

    @Override
    public ResearchResult submitRecord(ResearchRecord record) {
        return ResearchService.record(storage, record);
    }

    @Override
    public SampleRecord collectSample(LivingEntityRef source, SampleKind kind) {
        return ResearchService.collectSample(storage, source, kind);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.research;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.HolderLookup;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.ListTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.Tag;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.saveddata.SavedData;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchCategory;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchFact;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchInstant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchRecordId;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.SampleId;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.SampleKind;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.research.ResearchRecord;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.research.SampleRecord;

/**
 * Dimension SavedData holding research records and samples. Storage mechanics only.
 * NBT codec is inlined to avoid same-layer peer imports at L0.
 */
public final class ResearchRecordsSavedData extends SavedData {

    public static final String DATA_NAME = "biocraft_alien_research_records";

    private static final String RECORDS = "records";
    private static final String SAMPLES = "samples";
    private static final String ID = "id";
    private static final String CATEGORY = "category";
    private static final String INSTANT = "instant";
    private static final String SUBJECT_ID = "subjectId";
    private static final String SUBJECT_WORLD = "subjectWorld";
    private static final String FACTS = "facts";
    private static final String KEY = "key";
    private static final String VALUE = "value";
    private static final String SOURCE_ID = "sourceId";
    private static final String SOURCE_WORLD = "sourceWorld";
    private static final String KIND = "kind";

    private final List<ResearchRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<SampleRecord> samples = new ArrayList<>();

    public ResearchRecordsSavedData() {
    }

    public static ResearchRecordsSavedData get(ServerLevel level) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
        return level.getDataStorage().computeIfAbsent(
                new Factory<>(ResearchRecordsSavedData::new, ResearchRecordsSavedData::load),
                DATA_NAME);
    }

    public static ResearchRecordsSavedData load(CompoundTag tag, HolderLookup.Provider provider) {
        ResearchRecordsSavedData data = new ResearchRecordsSavedData();
        data.records.addAll(readRecords(tag));
        data.samples.addAll(readSamples(tag));
        return data;
    }

    @Override
    public CompoundTag save(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider provider) {
        writeRecords(tag, records);
        writeSamples(tag, samples);
        return tag;
    }

    public List<ResearchRecord> records() {
        return List.copyOf(records);
    }

    public List<SampleRecord> samples() {
        return List.copyOf(samples);
    }

    public void appendRecord(ResearchRecord record) {
        records.add(Objects.requireNonNull(record, "record"));
        setDirty();
    }

    public void appendSample(SampleRecord sample) {
        samples.add(Objects.requireNonNull(sample, "sample"));
        setDirty();
    }

    /** Storage-only write for tests / round-trip. No research policy. */
    public static void writeRecords(CompoundTag tag, List<ResearchRecord> records) {
        ListTag list = new ListTag();
        for (ResearchRecord record : records) {
            list.add(writeRecord(record));
        }
        tag.put(RECORDS, list);
    }

    /** Storage-only write for tests / round-trip. No research policy. */
    public static void writeSamples(CompoundTag tag, List<SampleRecord> samples) {
        ListTag list = new ListTag();
        for (SampleRecord sample : samples) {
            list.add(writeSample(sample));
        }
        tag.put(SAMPLES, list);
    }

    public static List<ResearchRecord> readRecords(CompoundTag tag) {
        List<ResearchRecord> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tag == null || !tag.contains(RECORDS, Tag.TAG_LIST)) {
            return out;
        }
        ListTag list = tag.getList(RECORDS, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            ResearchRecord record = readRecord(list.getCompound(i));
            if (record != null) {
                out.add(record);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    public static List<SampleRecord> readSamples(CompoundTag tag) {
        List<SampleRecord> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tag == null || !tag.contains(SAMPLES, Tag.TAG_LIST)) {
            return out;
        }
        ListTag list = tag.getList(SAMPLES, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
        for (int i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
            SampleRecord sample = readSample(list.getCompound(i));
            if (sample != null) {
                out.add(sample);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static CompoundTag writeRecord(ResearchRecord record) {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        tag.putUUID(ID, Objects.requireNonNull(record.id().id(), "record id"));
        tag.putString(CATEGORY, Objects.requireNonNull(record.category().name(), "category"));
        tag.putLong(INSTANT, record.instant().value());
        if (record.subject().isPresent()) {
            LivingEntityRef subject = record.subject().get();
            tag.putUUID(SUBJECT_ID, Objects.requireNonNull(subject.entityId(), "subject id"));
            tag.putString(
                    SUBJECT_WORLD,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(subject.world().dimensionId(), "subject world"));
        }
        ListTag facts = new ListTag();
        for (ResearchFact fact : record.facts()) {
            CompoundTag factTag = new CompoundTag();
            factTag.putString(KEY, Objects.requireNonNull(fact.key(), "fact key"));
            factTag.putString(VALUE, Objects.requireNonNull(fact.value(), "fact value"));
            facts.add(factTag);
        }
        tag.put(FACTS, facts);
        return tag;
    }

    private static ResearchRecord readRecord(CompoundTag tag) {
        try {
            ResearchRecordId id = new ResearchRecordId(tag.getUUID(ID));
            ResearchCategory category = ResearchCategory.valueOf(tag.getString(CATEGORY));
            ResearchInstant instant = new ResearchInstant(tag.getLong(INSTANT));
            Optional<LivingEntityRef> subject = Optional.empty();
            if (tag.hasUUID(SUBJECT_ID) && tag.contains(SUBJECT_WORLD)) {
                subject = Optional.of(new LivingEntityRef(
                        tag.getUUID(SUBJECT_ID),
                        new WorldRef(tag.getString(SUBJECT_WORLD))));
            }
            List<ResearchFact> facts = new ArrayList<>();
            ListTag factList = tag.getList(FACTS, Tag.TAG_COMPOUND);
            for (int i = 0; i < factList.size(); i++) {
                CompoundTag factTag = factList.getCompound(i);
                facts.add(new ResearchFact(factTag.getString(KEY), factTag.getString(VALUE)));
            }
            return new ResearchRecord(id, subject, category, instant, facts);
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static CompoundTag writeSample(SampleRecord sample) {
        CompoundTag tag = new CompoundTag();
        tag.putUUID(ID, Objects.requireNonNull(sample.id().id(), "sample id"));
        tag.putUUID(SOURCE_ID, Objects.requireNonNull(sample.sourceEntity().entityId(), "source id"));
        tag.putString(
                SOURCE_WORLD,
                Objects.requireNonNull(sample.sourceEntity().world().dimensionId(), "source world"));
        tag.putLong(INSTANT, sample.instant().value());
        tag.putString(KIND, Objects.requireNonNull(sample.kind().name(), "sample kind"));
        return tag;
    }

    private static SampleRecord readSample(CompoundTag tag) {
        try {
            return new SampleRecord(
                    new SampleId(tag.getUUID(ID)),
                    new LivingEntityRef(tag.getUUID(SOURCE_ID), new WorldRef(tag.getString(SOURCE_WORLD))),
                    new ResearchInstant(tag.getLong(INSTANT)),
                    SampleKind.valueOf(tag.getString(KIND)));
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

FILE: ResourceCache.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.resources;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

/**
 * Cache for resource locations.
 * Single responsibility: Store and retrieve cached resources with expiration.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * This class handles all caching logic for resources.
 * Separated from com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.resources.ResourceManager to follow SRP.
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class ResourceCache {
    
    private static final Map<String, ResourceLocation> RESOURCE_CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, Long> CACHE_TIMESTAMPS = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final long CACHE_DURATION = 300000; // 5 minutes in milliseconds
    
    /**
     * Checks if a resource is cached and still valid.
     * 
     * @param cacheKey The cache key to check
     * @return True if the resource is cached and valid
     */
    public static boolean isResourceCached(String cacheKey) {
        if (!RESOURCE_CACHE.containsKey(cacheKey)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        Long timestamp = CACHE_TIMESTAMPS.get(cacheKey);
        if (timestamp == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if cache entry is still valid
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        boolean isValid = (currentTime - timestamp) < CACHE_DURATION;
        
        if (!isValid) {
            // Remove expired cache entry
            RESOURCE_CACHE.remove(cacheKey);
            CACHE_TIMESTAMPS.remove(cacheKey);
            ModLogger.debug("ResourceCache", "Cache entry expired for: " + cacheKey);
        }
        
        return isValid;
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets a cached resource.
     * 
     * @param cacheKey The cache key
     * @return The cached resource location, or null if not cached
     */
    public static ResourceLocation getCachedResource(String cacheKey) {
        return RESOURCE_CACHE.get(cacheKey);
    }
    
    /**
     * Caches a resource with timestamp.
     * 
     * @param cacheKey The cache key
     * @param resourceLocation The resource location to cache
     */
    public static void cacheResource(String cacheKey, ResourceLocation resourceLocation) {
        RESOURCE_CACHE.put(cacheKey, resourceLocation);
        CACHE_TIMESTAMPS.put(cacheKey, System.currentTimeMillis());
        ModLogger.debug("ResourceCache", "Cached resource: " + cacheKey);
    }
    
    /**
     * Clears the resource cache.
     */
    public static void clearCache() {
        int cacheSize = RESOURCE_CACHE.size();
        RESOURCE_CACHE.clear();
        CACHE_TIMESTAMPS.clear();
        ModLogger.info("ResourceCache", "Cleared resource cache (" + cacheSize + " entries)");
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets cache statistics.
     * 
     * @return A summary of cache statistics
     */
    public static String getCacheStats() {
        StringBuilder stats = new StringBuilder();
        stats.append("Resource Cache Statistics:\n");
        stats.append("  Cached resources: ").append(RESOURCE_CACHE.size()).append("\n");
        stats.append("  Cache duration: ").append(CACHE_DURATION / 1000).append(" seconds\n");
        
        long currentTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
        int expiredEntries = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : CACHE_TIMESTAMPS.entrySet()) {
            if ((currentTime - entry.getValue()) >= CACHE_DURATION) {
                expiredEntries++;
            }
        }
        stats.append("  Expired entries: ").append(expiredEntries).append("\n");
        
        return stats.toString();
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the number of cached resources.
     * 
     * @return The number of cached resources
     */
    public static int getCacheSize() {
        return RESOURCE_CACHE.size();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.resources;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.io.ResourcePathBuilder;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.io.ResourceValidator;

/**
 * Loader for resource locations.
 * Single responsibility: Load and create ResourceLocation objects from paths.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 */
public class ResourceLoader {

    private static ResourceLocation loadResourceWithValidation(String path, String resourceType, Object... context) {
        if (!ResourceValidator.validateResourcePath(path)) {
            String contextStr = context.length > 0 ? " for " + java.util.Arrays.toString(context) : "";
            ModLogger.error("ResourceLoader", "Invalid " + resourceType + " path generated: " + path + contextStr);
            throw new RuntimeException("Invalid " + resourceType + " path generated" + contextStr);
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(path)));
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadEntityTexture(XenomorphType type) {
        String texturePath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildPlayerTexturePath(type);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(texturePath, "texture", type);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadEntityModel(XenomorphType type) {
        String modelPath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildPlayerModelPath(type);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(modelPath, "model", type);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadEntitySound(XenomorphType type, String soundType) {
        String soundPath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildPlayerSoundPath(type, soundType);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(soundPath, "sound", type, soundType);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadMobTexture(String category, String hostType, String mobName) {
        String texturePath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildMobTexturePath(category, hostType, mobName);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(texturePath, "mob texture", category, hostType, mobName);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadMobModel(String category, String hostType, String mobName) {
        String modelPath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildMobModelPath(category, hostType, mobName);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(modelPath, "mob model", category, hostType, mobName);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadMobSound(String category, String hostType, String mobName, String soundType) {
        String soundPath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildMobSoundPath(category, hostType, mobName, soundType);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(soundPath, "mob sound", category, hostType, mobName, soundType);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadSpecialSound(String soundName) {
        String soundPath = ResourcePathBuilder.buildSpecialSoundPath(soundName);
        return loadResourceWithValidation(soundPath, "special sound", soundName);
    }

    public static String loadConfigurablePath(String basePath) {
        return ResourcePathBuilder.buildConfigurablePath(basePath);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation loadResourceWithFallback(String primaryPath, String fallbackPath) {
        if (ResourceValidator.validateResourcePath(primaryPath)) {
            ModLogger.debug("ResourceLoader", "Using primary resource path: " + primaryPath);
            return Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(primaryPath)));
        }

        ModLogger.warn("ResourceLoader", "Primary resource path invalid, trying fallback: " + fallbackPath);
        if (ResourceValidator.validateResourcePath(fallbackPath)) {
            ModLogger.success("ResourceLoader", "Using fallback resource path: " + fallbackPath);
            return Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(fallbackPath)));
        }

        ModLogger.error("ResourceLoader", "Both primary and fallback resource paths are invalid");
        return null;
    }
}

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.SpecimenExtents;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.admission.PortableSpecimen;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.SpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.CapturedEntitySnapshot;

/**
 * Specimen Source for filled Capture Net carriers (captured entity snapshot).
 *
 * <p>Owns snapshot serialization format for PortableSpecimen construction — not Net gameplay.
 * Identifies the carrier by registry id (avoids same-tier item-class coupling).
 *
 * <p>L1 by placement formula: imports L0 {@link CapturedEntitySnapshot} (not neighbor co-location).
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-NET-001)
 */
public final class CaptureNetSpecimenSource implements SpecimenSource {

    private static final String CAPTURE_NET_PATH = "capture_net";

    private final ItemStackCarrier carrier;

    public CaptureNetSpecimenSource(@Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier) {
        this.carrier = Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
    }

    public static boolean supports(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && isCaptureNet(stack) && CapturedEntitySnapshot.isFilled(stack);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canExtract() {
        return supports(carrier.get()) && CapturedEntitySnapshot.resolveType(carrier.get()).isPresent();
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<PortableSpecimen> extract() {
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (!supports(stack)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Optional<EntityType<?>> typeOpt = CapturedEntitySnapshot.resolveType(stack);
        Optional<byte[]> payload = CapturedEntitySnapshot.encodePayload(stack);
        if (typeOpt.isEmpty() || payload.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        String typeKey = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(typeOpt.get())).toString();
        return Optional.of(PortableSpecimen.captured(typeKey, extentsOf(typeOpt.get()), payload.get()));
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<SpecimenExtents> previewExtents() {
        return CapturedEntitySnapshot.resolveType(carrier.get()).map(CaptureNetSpecimenSource::extentsOf);
    }

    @Override
    public SpecimenSettlement settleAfterAdmission() {
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (!isCaptureNet(stack)) {
            return SpecimenSettlement.failed("capture net missing");
        }
        ItemStack empty = Objects.requireNonNull(stack.copy());
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.clear(empty);
        carrier.set(Objects.requireNonNull(empty));
        return SpecimenSettlement.okWithEmptyContainer(
                BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(empty.getItem())).toString());
    }

    private static boolean isCaptureNet(ItemStack stack) {
        ResourceLocation key = BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(stack.getItem()));
        return key != null
                && ModContext.MOD_ID.equals(key.getNamespace())
                && CAPTURE_NET_PATH.equals(key.getPath());
    }

    /** Empty Capture Net suitable as an Extraction sink (pen → net). */
    public static boolean isEmptyCaptureNet(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && isCaptureNet(stack) && !CapturedEntitySnapshot.isFilled(stack);
    }

    private static SpecimenExtents extentsOf(EntityType<?> type) {
        var dims = type.getDimensions();
        double width = dims.width() > 0 ? dims.width() : 0.6;
        double height = dims.height() > 0 ? dims.height() : 1.0;
        return new SpecimenExtents(width, height);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.nbt.NbtIo;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.world.item.MobBucketItem;
import net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.SpecimenExtents;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.SpecimenSettlement;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.admission.PortableSpecimen;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.SpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;

/**
 * Specimen Source for {@link MobBucketItem} carriers (captured).
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-EGG-001)
 */
public final class MobBucketSpecimenSource implements SpecimenSource {

    private final ItemStackCarrier carrier;

    public MobBucketSpecimenSource(@Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier) {
        this.carrier = Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
    }

    public static boolean supports(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && stack.getItem() instanceof MobBucketItem;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canExtract() {
        return supports(carrier.get()) && resolveType().isPresent();
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<PortableSpecimen> extract() {
        return resolveType().map(type -> {
            String typeKey = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(type)).toString();
            byte[] payload = encodeBucketPayload().orElse(null);
            return PortableSpecimen.captured(typeKey, extentsOf(type), payload);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<SpecimenExtents> previewExtents() {
        return resolveType().map(MobBucketSpecimenSource::extentsOf);
    }

    @Override
    public SpecimenSettlement settleAfterAdmission() {
        if (!supports(carrier.get())) {
            return SpecimenSettlement.failed("mob bucket missing");
        }
        carrier.set(new ItemStack(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.BUCKET)));
        return SpecimenSettlement.okWithEmptyContainer(
                BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.BUCKET)).toString());
    }

    private Optional<EntityType<?>> resolveType() {
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (!(stack.getItem() instanceof MobBucketItem)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        EntityType<?> mapped = mapVanillaBucket(stack);
        if (mapped != null) {
            return Optional.of(mapped);
        }
        CustomData data = stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA));
        if (data != null) {
            CompoundTag tag = data.copyTag();
            if (tag.contains("id")) {
                return BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getOptional(
                        net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation.parse(
                                Objects.requireNonNull(tag.getString("id"))));
            }
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    private Optional<byte[]> encodeBucketPayload() {
        CustomData data = carrier.get().get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA));
        if (data == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        CompoundTag tag = data.copyTag();
        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            NbtIo.writeCompressed(Objects.requireNonNull(tag), out);
            return Optional.of(out.toByteArray());
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            ModLogger.warn("Admission", "Failed to encode bucket payload: " + ex.getMessage());
            return Optional.empty();
        }
    }

    private static EntityType<?> mapVanillaBucket(ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.AXOLOTL_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.AXOLOTL;
        }
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.COD_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.COD;
        }
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.SALMON_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.SALMON;
        }
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.PUFFERFISH_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.PUFFERFISH;
        }
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.TROPICAL_FISH_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.TROPICAL_FISH;
        }
        if (stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.TADPOLE_BUCKET))) {
            return EntityType.TADPOLE;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static SpecimenExtents extentsOf(EntityType<?> type) {
        var dims = type.getDimensions();
        double width = dims.width() > 0 ? dims.width() : 0.6;
        double height = dims.height() > 0 ? dims.height() : 0.4;
        return new SpecimenExtents(width, height);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.SpawnEggItem;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.SpecimenExtents;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.SpecimenSettlement;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.admission.PortableSpecimen;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.SpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;

/**
 * Specimen Source for {@link SpawnEggItem} carriers (blueprint).
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-EGG-001)
 */
public final class SpawnEggSpecimenSource implements SpecimenSource {

    private final ItemStackCarrier carrier;

    public SpawnEggSpecimenSource(@Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier) {
        this.carrier = Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
    }

    public static boolean supports(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return !stack.isEmpty() && stack.getItem() instanceof SpawnEggItem;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canExtract() {
        return supports(carrier.get()) && resolveType().isPresent();
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<PortableSpecimen> extract() {
        return resolveType().map(type -> {
            String typeKey = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(type)).toString();
            return PortableSpecimen.blueprint(typeKey, extentsOf(type));
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<SpecimenExtents> previewExtents() {
        return resolveType().map(SpawnEggSpecimenSource::extentsOf);
    }

    @Override
    public SpecimenSettlement settleAfterAdmission() {
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (!supports(stack)) {
            return SpecimenSettlement.failed("spawn egg missing");
        }
        ItemStack copy = stack.copy();
        copy.shrink(1);
        carrier.set(copy);
        return SpecimenSettlement.ok();
    }

    private Optional<EntityType<?>> resolveType() {
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (!(stack.getItem() instanceof SpawnEggItem egg)) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.ofNullable(egg.getType(stack));
    }

    private static SpecimenExtents extentsOf(EntityType<?> type) {
        var dims = type.getDimensions();
        double width = dims.width() > 0 ? dims.width() : 0.6;
        double height = dims.height() > 0 ? dims.height() : 1.0;
        return new SpecimenExtents(width, height);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.ai.XenomorphTargetingHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.AvoidEntityGoal;

/**
 * Keeps combat xenomorphs clear of claimed, facehugged, and gestating hosts.
 */
public final class AvoidLifecycleHostGoal extends AvoidEntityGoal<LivingEntity> {

    private static final float AVOID_DISTANCE = 10.0F;
    private static final double WALK_SPEED = 1.0D;
    private static final double SPRINT_SPEED = 1.25D;

    public AvoidLifecycleHostGoal(PathfinderMob mob) {
        super(
                mob,
                LivingEntity.class,
                AVOID_DISTANCE,
                WALK_SPEED,
                SPRINT_SPEED,
                living -> living != null
                        && XenomorphTargetingHelper.isLifecycleProtected(
                                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living),
                                living.level().getGameTime()));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.combat.BlockDamageOrchestrator;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.api.XenomorphTyped;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

/**
 * Thin minecraft facade for xenomorph block damage — delegates to {@link BlockDamageOrchestrator}.
 */
public final class BlockDamageBridge {

    private BlockDamageBridge() {
    }

    public static boolean attemptBlockDamage(Mob entity, Level level, BlockPos pos) {
        if (entity == null || level == null || pos == null || level.isClientSide()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            return false;
        }
        var state = level.getBlockState(pos);
        if (state.isAir()) {
            return false;
        }
        String blockId = Objects.requireNonNull(
                BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(state.getBlock()))).toString();
        BlockPosRef blockPos = BoundaryRefs.from(pos);

        String entityTypeKey = null;
        if (entity instanceof XenomorphTyped typed) {
            XenomorphType type = typed.getXenomorphType();
            if (type != null) {
                entityTypeKey = type.getConfigKey();
            }
        }
        String actorLabel = entity.getType().getDescription().getString();

        return BlockDamageOrchestrator.attemptBlockDamage(
                BoundaryServices.worldMutation(),
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level),
                blockPos,
                blockId,
                entityTypeKey,
                actorLabel);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.ai.XenomorphTargetingHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Combat-only sticky-target guard for hosts claimed or occupied by the parasite lifecycle.
 *
 * <p>Must not run on facehuggers; attachment identity belongs to AttachmentBinding.
 */
public final class CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard {

    private CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard is a utility class");
    }

    public static void clearIfProtected(@Nonnull Mob mob) {
        if (mob.level().isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        LivingEntity target = mob.getTarget();
        if (target == null || !target.isAlive()) {
            return;
        }
        if (XenomorphTargetingHelper.isLifecycleProtected(
                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target), mob.level().getGameTime())) {
            mob.setTarget(null);
            mob.getNavigation().stop();
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.ai.XenomorphTargetingHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.FloatGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.LookAtPlayerGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.MeleeAttackGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.RandomLookAroundGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.RandomStrollGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.WaterAvoidingRandomStrollGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.target.HurtByTargetGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.target.NearestAttackableTargetGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

/**
 * Utility class for registering common AI goals across all species.
 * Centralizes common goal registration logic to eliminate DRY violations.
 * 
 * This is a generic version that works with any PathfinderMob, not species-specific.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class CommonGoalRegistrar {
    
    /**
     * Registers FloatGoal with specified priority.
     * DRY: Centralizes FloatGoal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     */
    public static void registerFloatGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new FloatGoal(entity));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers WaterAvoidingRandomStrollGoal with specified priority and speed.
     * DRY: Centralizes stroll goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     * @param strollSpeed The speed multiplier for strolling
     */
    public static void registerStrollGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority, double strollSpeed) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new WaterAvoidingRandomStrollGoal(entity, strollSpeed));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers RandomStrollGoal with specified priority, speed, and interval.
     * DRY: Centralizes RandomStrollGoal registration (used when interval control is needed).
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     * @param strollSpeed The speed multiplier for strolling
     * @param strollInterval The interval in ticks between stroll attempts
     */
    public static void registerRandomStrollGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority, double strollSpeed, int strollInterval) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new RandomStrollGoal(entity, strollSpeed, strollInterval));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers LookAtPlayerGoal with specified priority and range.
     * DRY: Centralizes look-at-player goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     * @param lookRange The range at which to look at players
     */
    public static void registerLookAtPlayerGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority, float lookRange) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new LookAtPlayerGoal(entity, Player.class, lookRange));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers RandomLookAroundGoal with specified priority.
     * DRY: Centralizes random look-around goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     */
    public static void registerRandomLookAroundGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new RandomLookAroundGoal(entity));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers MeleeAttackGoal with specified priority and speed.
     * DRY: Centralizes melee attack goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     * @param attackSpeed The speed multiplier for attacks
     * @param followTarget Whether to follow the target
     */
    public static void registerMeleeAttackGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority, double attackSpeed, boolean followTarget) {
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(priority, new MeleeAttackGoal(entity, attackSpeed, followTarget));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers HurtByTargetGoal with specified priority.
     * DRY: Centralizes hurt-by-target goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     */
    public static void registerHurtByTargetGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority) {
        // Humans punch drones — without this filter, revenge ignores gestating/facehugged protection.
        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(priority, new HurtByTargetGoal(entity) {
            @Override
            public boolean canUse() {
                return super.canUse() && isValidRevengeTarget(entity.getLastHurtByMob());
            }

            @Override
            public boolean canContinueToUse() {
                return super.canContinueToUse() && isValidRevengeTarget(entity.getTarget());
            }

            private static boolean isValidRevengeTarget(LivingEntity target) {
                return target != null
                        && XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target));
            }
        });
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers NearestAttackableTargetGoal for Player with specified priority.
     * DRY: Centralizes player targeting goal registration used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register the goal for
     * @param priority The priority for this goal
     * @param checkSight Whether to check line of sight
     */
    public static void registerPlayerTargetGoal(PathfinderMob entity, int priority, boolean checkSight) {
        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(priority, new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, Player.class, checkSight));
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers standard movement goals (Float, Stroll, Look).
     * DRY: Centralizes common movement goal pattern used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register goals for
     * @param aiGoals The AI goals configuration
     */
    public static void registerStandardMovementGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        registerFloatGoal(entity, 1);
        registerStrollGoal(entity, 3, aiGoals.strollSpeed);
        registerLookAtPlayerGoal(entity, 4, aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange);
        registerRandomLookAroundGoal(entity, 5);
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers standard targeting goals (HurtByTarget, Player).
     * DRY: Centralizes common targeting goal pattern used across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register goals for
     */
    public static void registerStandardTargetingGoals(PathfinderMob entity) {
        registerHurtByTargetGoal(entity, 1);
        registerPlayerTargetGoal(entity, 2, true);
    }
    
    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private CommonGoalRegistrar() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("CommonGoalRegistrar is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import java.util.Objects;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntityInitRefs;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;

/**
 * Helper class for detecting entities in the world.
 * Centralizes entity detection logic to make behavior files more focused.
 * 
 * DRY: Eliminates duplicate entity detection patterns across AI files.
 * SOLID: Makes behavior files more focused by extracting detection logic.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class EntityDetectionHelper {
    
    /**
     * Checks if there's an ovomorph entity at the specified position.
     * 
     * @param level The server level
     * @param pos The position to check
     * @return true if an ovomorph is found at the position
     */
    public static boolean hasOvomorphAt(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos) {
        if (level == null || pos == null) {
            return false;
        }
        
        return level.getEntitiesOfClass(LivingEntity.class, 
            Objects.requireNonNull(AABB.ofSize(
                Objects.requireNonNull(net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3.atCenterOf(pos)), 0.5, 0.5, 0.5)))
            .stream()
            .anyMatch(entity -> entity.getType() == EntityInitRefs.holder("OVOMORPH").get());
    }
    
    /**
     * Checks if there's an ovomorph nearby within the specified distance.
     * 
     * @param level The server level
     * @param pos The center position
     * @param distance The search distance in blocks
     * @return true if an ovomorph is found nearby
     */
    public static boolean hasOvomorphNearby(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, int distance) {
        if (level == null || pos == null || distance < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        
        for (int x = -distance; x <= distance; x++) {
            for (int z = -distance; z <= distance; z++) {
                for (int y = -2; y <= 2; y++) {
                    if (x == 0 && z == 0 && y == 0) continue; // Skip center position
                    
                    BlockPos checkPos = pos.offset(x, y, z);
                    if (hasOvomorphAt(level, checkPos)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Counts ovomorph entities in a specified area.
     * 
     * @param level The server level
     * @param centerPos The center position
     * @param searchRadius The search radius in blocks
     * @param yRange The vertical search range (from -yRange to +yRange)
     * @return The count of ovomorphs found in the area
     */
    public static int countOvomorphsInArea(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centerPos, int searchRadius, int yRange) {
        if (level == null || centerPos == null || searchRadius < 0 || yRange < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        
        int count = 0;
        for (int x = -searchRadius; x <= searchRadius; x++) {
            for (int z = -searchRadius; z <= searchRadius; z++) {
                for (int y = -yRange; y <= yRange; y++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = centerPos.offset(x, y, z);
                    if (hasOvomorphAt(level, checkPos)) {
                        count++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
    
    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private EntityDetectionHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("EntityDetectionHelper is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIConfigResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.growth.XenomorphTypeHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_6.ai.ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.Attributes;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.targeting.TargetingConditions;

/**
 * Thin MC goal for chestburster food hunting: world scan, navigation, and attack binding.
 * Activation, target validation, and consumption benefits live in {@link ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy}.
 */
public class HuntSmallAnimalsGoal extends Goal {
    private final PathfinderMob entity;
    private final EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals;
    private LivingEntity target;

    public HuntSmallAnimalsGoal(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        this.entity = entity;
        this.aiGoals = aiGoals;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        XenomorphType type = XenomorphTypeHelper.getXenomorphType(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity));
        float healthRatio = entity.getMaxHealth() > 0 ? entity.getHealth() / entity.getMaxHealth() : 1.0f;
        if (!ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.shouldActivateHunt(
                Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity)),
                healthRatio,
                AIConfigResolver.getHealthThresholdForFood(type))) {
            return false;
        }

        double searchRadius = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(aiGoals, "safety_search_radius");

        this.target = entity.level().getNearestEntity(
                Objects.requireNonNull(entity.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
                        LivingEntity.class, Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getBoundingBox().inflate(searchRadius)))),
                Objects.requireNonNull(TargetingConditions.forCombat().range(searchRadius)),
                entity,
                entity.getX(),
                entity.getY(),
                entity.getZ());

        boolean canHunt = target != null
                && ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.isValidFoodTarget(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target), aiGoals);
        if (canHunt) {
            ModLogger.debug("HuntSmallAnimalsGoal", "🍖 Found potential food target: " + target.getDisplayName().getString());
        }

        return canHunt;
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        if (target != null) {
            ModLogger.debug("HuntSmallAnimalsGoal", "🎯 Starting hunt for: " + target.getDisplayName().getString());
            entity.getNavigation().moveTo(Objects.requireNonNull(target), aiGoals.strollSpeed);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        double attackDistance = ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.resolveAttackDistance(aiGoals);

        if (target != null && target.isAlive() && entity.distanceTo(Objects.requireNonNull(target)) < attackDistance) {
            target.hurt(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(entity.damageSources().mobAttack(entity)),
                    (float) entity.getAttributeValue(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.ATTACK_DAMAGE)));
            ModLogger.debug("HuntSmallAnimalsGoal", "⚔️ Attacking food target: " + target.getDisplayName().getString());

            ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.FoodConsumptionPlan plan = ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.planFoodConsumption(aiGoals);
            if (plan.healAmount() > 0) {
                entity.heal(plan.healAmount());
                ModLogger.debug("HuntSmallAnimalsGoal", "💚 Healed " + plan.healAmount() + " HP from eating");
            }

            ChestbursterFoodHuntPolicy.applyFoodBenefits(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity)), plan);
            ModLogger.info("HuntSmallAnimalsGoal", "✅ Successfully hunted and ate: " + target.getDisplayName().getString());
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.ai.XenomorphTargetingHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.target.NearestAttackableTargetGoal;

/**
 * Thin combat target goal; priority scoring lives in {@link XenomorphTargetingHelper}.
 */
public final class PrioritizedHostTargetGoal extends NearestAttackableTargetGoal<LivingEntity> {

    public PrioritizedHostTargetGoal(PathfinderMob mob) {
        super(mob, LivingEntity.class, true,
                living -> XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living)));
    }

    @Override
    protected void findTarget() {
        List<XenomorphTargetingHelper.ScoredTarget> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<LivingEntityRef, LivingEntity> refToEntity = new HashMap<>();

        for (LivingEntity candidate : mob.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                Objects.requireNonNull(getTargetSearchArea(getFollowDistance())),
                living -> XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living)))) {
            if (!mob.getSensing().hasLineOfSight(Objects.requireNonNull(candidate))) {
                continue;
            }
            LivingEntityRef ref = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(candidate);
            XenomorphTargetingHelper.addScoredCandidate(candidates, ref, mob.distanceToSqr(Objects.requireNonNull(candidate)));
            refToEntity.put(ref, candidate);
        }

        LivingEntityRef bestRef = XenomorphTargetingHelper.selectBestTarget(candidates);
        this.target = bestRef != null ? refToEntity.get(bestRef) : null;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.ai.AISignalType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.signals.AISignalData;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.signals.AISignalSystem;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;

/**
 * Minecraft Goal base that can respond to domain AI signals.
 */
public abstract class SignalAwareGoal extends Goal {

    protected final PathfinderMob entity;

    public SignalAwareGoal(PathfinderMob entity) {
        this.entity = entity;
    }

    protected long currentGameTime() {
        return entity.level() != null ? entity.level().getGameTime() : 0L;
    }

    protected AISignalData getSignal(AISignalType signalType, double maxDistance) {
        if (entity.level() == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) {
            return null;
        }
        BlockPosRef position = BoundaryRefs.from(entity.blockPosition());
        return AISignalSystem.getSignal(signalType, position, maxDistance, currentGameTime());
    }

    protected boolean hasSignalForEntity(AISignalType signalType, java.util.UUID entityId) {
        return AISignalSystem.hasSignalForEntity(signalType, entityId, currentGameTime());
    }

    protected AISignalData broadcastSignal(
            AISignalType signalType, BlockPos position, double radius, int durationTicks) {
        if (entity.level() == null || entity.level().isClientSide()) {
            return null;
        }
        return AISignalSystem.broadcastSignal(
                signalType,
                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity),
                BoundaryRefs.from(position),
                radius,
                currentGameTime(),
                durationTicks,
                entity.getDisplayName().getString());
    }

    protected BlockPos getEntityPosition() {
        return entity.blockPosition();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.api;

import java.util.Objects;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.InfectionStage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.parasite.ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * API interface for parasite lifecycle operations.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 */
public interface ParasiteLifecycleAPI {

    static LivingEntityRef toRef(LivingEntity entity) {
        return BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity);
    }

    static boolean processParasiteLifecycle(LivingEntity facehugger, LivingEntity host) {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.processAttachment(
                Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(facehugger)), Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host)));
    }

    static boolean processParasiteLifecycleTick(LivingEntity facehugger, LivingEntity host, int attachmentTicks) {
        LivingEntityRef hostRef = Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host));
        if (facehugger instanceof FacehuggerAttachmentEntity attachment && attachment.getAttachmentTarget() != null) {
            return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.processAttachmentTick(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(facehugger)), hostRef, attachmentTicks);
        }
        if (!ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.isHostInfected(hostRef)) {
            return false;
        }
        int timeRemaining = ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.getRemainingGestationTime(hostRef);
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.processGestationTick(hostRef, timeRemaining);
    }

    static void processHostGestation(LivingEntity host) {
        ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.processGestation(Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host)));
    }

    static boolean isHostInfected(LivingEntity host) {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.isHostInfected(Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host)));
    }

    static InfectionStage getInfectionStage(LivingEntity host) {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.getInfectionStage(Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host)));
    }

    static int getRemainingGestationTime(LivingEntity host) {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.getRemainingGestationTime(Objects.requireNonNull(toRef(host)));
    }

    static int getAttachmentDuration() {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.getAttachmentDuration();
    }

    static double getAttachmentDistance() {
        return ParasiteLifecycleBootstrap.getAttachmentDistance();
    }
}

/**
 * Base class for all lab equipment blocks.
 * Provides lab-specific properties and behavior for human-made lab equipment.
 * 
 * This class extends BaseModBlock to inherit common functionality while providing:
 * - Lab-specific property creation (metallic/glass materials, tech sounds)
 * - Lab-specific default values for sound and map color
 * 
 * NOTE: Lab equipment is human-made, separate from xenomorph-created blocks
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public abstract class BaseLabBlock extends BaseModBlock {
    
    /**
     * Constructs a BaseLabBlock with the specified properties.
     * 
     * @param properties The block properties
     */
    protected BaseLabBlock(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
        ModLogger.debug("Initialized lab equipment: " + getClass().getSimpleName());
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates the base properties for lab equipment blocks.
     * All lab blocks share these common characteristics.
     * 
     * @return The base properties for lab blocks
     */
    protected static BlockBehaviour.Properties createBaseProperties() {
        return BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
                .mapColor(Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.COLOR_GRAY))  // Metallic/tech appearance
                .sound(Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.METAL))        // Tech/metal sound
                .pushReaction(PushReaction.NORMAL)  // Can be pushed by pistons
                .lightLevel((state) -> 0)       // No light emission by default
                .requiresCorrectToolForDrops(); // Requires appropriate tool
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates properties for glass/transparent lab equipment.
     * 
     * @return The properties for transparent lab blocks
     */
    protected static BlockBehaviour.Properties createGlassProperties() {
        return BlockBehaviour.Properties.of()
                .mapColor(Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.NONE))        // Transparent
                .sound(Objects.requireNonNull(SoundType.GLASS))        // Glass sound
                .pushReaction(PushReaction.NORMAL)
                .lightLevel((state) -> 0)
                .noOcclusion()                 // Transparent
                .requiresCorrectToolForDrops();
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the sound type for this block.
     * Lab blocks default to metallic sound.
     * 
     * @return The SoundType for this block
     */
    @Override
    public SoundType getSoundType() {
        return SoundType.METAL;
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the map color for this block.
     * Lab blocks default to gray (metallic appearance).
     * 
     * @return The MapColor for this block
     */
    @Override
    @Nonnull
    protected MapColor getMapColor() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(MapColor.COLOR_GRAY);
    }
}

    @Nullable
    private UUID occupantEntityUuid;
    private ContainmentVolumeId containmentVolumeId = new ContainmentVolumeId(UUID.randomUUID());
    private BreachState breachState = BreachState.secure();
    /**
     * Transient cleanse countdown (FEATURE-CLEANSE-001). Not persisted — aborted on reload.
     */
    private int cleanseTicksRemaining;

    private ContainmentPenPort port;
    private ContainmentOccupancyPort occupancyPort;
    private ContainmentPort containmentPort;

    public ContainmentPenBlockEntity(BlockEntityType<?> type, BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        super(type, pos, state);
        ModLogger.debug("Created ContainmentPenBlockEntity at " + pos);
    }

    public void bindPort(ContainmentPenPort podPort) {
        this.port = podPort;
    }

    public void bindOccupancyPort(ContainmentOccupancyPort containmentOccupancyPort) {
        this.occupancyPort = containmentOccupancyPort;
    }

    public void bindContainmentPort(ContainmentPort containment) {
        this.containmentPort = containment;
    }

    private ContainmentPenPort requirePort() {
        if (port == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentPenPort not bound");
        }
        return port;
    }

    private ContainmentOccupancyPort requireOccupancyPort() {
        if (occupancyPort == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentOccupancyPort not bound");
        }
        return occupancyPort;
    }

    private ContainmentPort requireContainmentPort() {
        if (containmentPort == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentPort not bound");
        }
        return containmentPort;
    }

    @Override
    public void loadAdditional(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider lookupProvider) {
        super.loadAdditional(tag, lookupProvider);

        String stateName = tag.contains("structureState")
                ? tag.getString("structureState")
                : ContainmentPenState.UNFORMED.name();
        try {
            this.structureState = ContainmentPenState.valueOf(stateName);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            ModLogger.warn("ContainmentPenBlockEntity", "Invalid structure state: " + stateName + ", defaulting to UNFORMED");
            this.structureState = ContainmentPenState.UNFORMED;
        }

        this.specimenType = tag.contains("specimenType") ? tag.getString("specimenType") : "none";
        this.occupantDisplayName = tag.contains("occupantDisplayName")
                ? Objects.requireNonNull(tag.getString("occupantDisplayName"))
                : "";
        this.occupantEntityUuid = ContainmentPenOccupancyPersistence.readOccupantEntityId(tag).orElse(null);
        this.containmentVolumeId = ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence.readOrCreateVolumeId(tag);
        this.breachState = ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence.readBreachState(tag);
        if (tag.contains("structureWidth")) {
            this.structureWidth = tag.getInt("structureWidth");
            this.structureDepth = tag.contains("structureDepth") ? tag.getInt("structureDepth") : structureWidth;
            this.structureHeight = tag.contains("structureHeight") ? tag.getInt("structureHeight") : structureWidth;
        } else {
            int legacy = tag.contains("structureSize") ? tag.getInt("structureSize") : 3;
            this.structureWidth = legacy;
            this.structureDepth = legacy;
            this.structureHeight = legacy;
        }
        this.structureCenter = tag.contains("structureCenter") ? BlockPos.of(tag.getLong("structureCenter")) : null;

        if (tag.contains("interiorMinX")) {
            this.interiorVolume = new InteriorVolume(
                    tag.getInt("interiorMinX"),
                    tag.getInt("interiorMinY"),
                    tag.getInt("interiorMinZ"),
                    tag.getInt("interiorMaxX"),
                    tag.getInt("interiorMaxY"),
                    tag.getInt("interiorMaxZ"));
        } else {
            this.interiorVolume = null;
        }
        if (tag.contains("outwardFacing")) {
            try {
                this.outwardFacing = HorizontalFacing.valueOf(tag.getString("outwardFacing"));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
                this.outwardFacing = null;
            }
        } else {
            this.outwardFacing = null;
        }

        this.structureBlocks = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tag.contains("structureBlocks")) {
            for (long encoded : tag.getLongArray("structureBlocks")) {
                this.structureBlocks.add(BlockPos.of(encoded));
            }
        }

        this.shellPriorStates.clear();
        this.shellPriorStates.putAll(ContainmentPenShellPriorStatePersistence.read(tag, lookupProvider));

        ModLogger.debug("Loaded ContainmentPenBlockEntity state: " + structureState);
    }

    @Override
    protected void saveAdditional(@Nonnull CompoundTag tag, @Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider lookupProvider) {
        super.saveAdditional(tag, lookupProvider);

        tag.putString("structureState", Objects.requireNonNull(structureState.name()));
        tag.putString("specimenType", Objects.requireNonNull(specimenType));
        tag.putString("occupantDisplayName", Objects.requireNonNull(occupantDisplayName));
        ContainmentPenOccupancyPersistence.writeOccupantEntityId(tag, occupantEntityUuid);
        ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence.writeVolumeId(tag, containmentVolumeId);
        ContainmentPenContainmentPersistence.writeBreachState(tag, breachState);
        tag.putInt("structureWidth", structureWidth);
        tag.putInt("structureDepth", structureDepth);
        tag.putInt("structureHeight", structureHeight);
        tag.putInt("structureSize", structureHeight);

        if (structureCenter != null) {
            tag.putLong("structureCenter", structureCenter.asLong());
        }

        if (interiorVolume != null) {
            var volume = interiorVolume;
            tag.putInt("interiorMinX", volume.minX());
            tag.putInt("interiorMinY", volume.minY());
            tag.putInt("interiorMinZ", volume.minZ());
            tag.putInt("interiorMaxX", volume.maxX());
            tag.putInt("interiorMaxY", volume.maxY());
            tag.putInt("interiorMaxZ", volume.maxZ());
        }
        if (outwardFacing != null) {
            tag.putString("outwardFacing", Objects.requireNonNull(outwardFacing.name()));
        }

        if (!structureBlocks.isEmpty()) {
            long[] encodedBlocks = structureBlocks.stream().mapToLong(pos -> pos.asLong()).toArray();
            tag.putLongArray("structureBlocks", Objects.requireNonNull(encodedBlocks));
        }

        ContainmentPenShellPriorStatePersistence.write(tag, Objects.requireNonNull(shellPriorStates), lookupProvider);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public CompoundTag getUpdateTag(@Nonnull HolderLookup.Provider registries) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(this.saveWithoutMetadata(registries));
    }

    @Override
    public Packet<ClientGamePacketListener> getUpdatePacket() {
        return ClientboundBlockEntityDataPacket.create(this);
    }

    public static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, ContainmentPenBlockView blockView) {
        if (level == null || level.isClientSide || !(blockView instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity blockEntity)) {
            return;
        }
        if (ContainmentPenWorkflow.processPeriodicTick(blockEntity.requirePort(), level.getGameTime())) {
            ContainmentService.setIntegrity(
                    blockEntity.requireContainmentPort(),
                    blockEntity.requireOccupancyPort(),
                    ContainmentIntegrity.BREACHED);
        }
        blockEntity.tickCleanseSession();
        // Living-membership: clear UUID when occupant died/despawned (do not breach).
        if (level.getGameTime() % 20L == 0L) {
            blockEntity.reconcileStaleOccupancy();
        }
    }

    /** Duration of fire VFX before entity discard (≈1 second). */
    public static final int CLEANSE_DURATION_TICKS = 20;

    public boolean isCleansing() {
        return cleanseTicksRemaining > 0;
    }

    /**
     * Starts equipment cleanse session. Occupancy is not cleared until discard finishes.
     *
     * @return {@code true} when session started
     */
    public boolean beginCleanseSession() {
        if (!isFormed() || !hasSpecimen() || isCleansing()) {
            return false;
        }
        Level level = getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        Optional<UUID> occupantId = getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        if (!(serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) {
            return false;
        }
        this.cleanseTicksRemaining = CLEANSE_DURATION_TICKS;
        living.setRemainingFireTicks(CLEANSE_DURATION_TICKS + 10);
        syncToClient();
        return true;
    }

    private void tickCleanseSession() {
        if (cleanseTicksRemaining <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        Level level = getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            cleanseTicksRemaining = 0;
            return;
        }
        Optional<UUID> occupantId = getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            cleanseTicksRemaining = 0;
            syncToClient();
            return;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        if (!(serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) {
            cleanseTicksRemaining = 0;
            reconcileStaleOccupancy();
            syncToClient();
            return;
        }

        spawnCleanseParticles(serverLevel, living);
        living.setRemainingFireTicks(Math.max(living.getRemainingFireTicks(), 20));

        cleanseTicksRemaining--;
        if (cleanseTicksRemaining > 0) {
            return;
        }

        // Equipment destroys the specimen — occupancy is not the destroyer.
        living.discard();
        reconcileStaleOccupancy();
        syncToClient();
        ModLogger.info("Cleanse", "Incinerated occupant at " + getBlockPos());
    }

    private static void spawnCleanseParticles(
            @Nonnull ServerLevel serverLevel,
            @Nonnull LivingEntity living) {
        AABB box = living.getBoundingBox();
        double cx = (box.minX + box.maxX) * 0.5;
        double cy = (box.minY + box.maxY) * 0.5;
        double cz = (box.minZ + box.maxZ) * 0.5;
        double dx = Math.max(0.2, (box.maxX - box.minX) * 0.35);
        double dy = Math.max(0.2, (box.maxY - box.minY) * 0.35);
        double dz = Math.max(0.2, (box.maxZ - box.minZ) * 0.35);
        serverLevel.sendParticles(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ParticleTypes.FLAME),
                cx,
                cy,
                cz,
                8,
                dx,
                dy,
                dz,
                0.02);
        serverLevel.sendParticles(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ParticleTypes.SMOKE),
                cx,
                cy,
                cz,
                6,
                dx,
                dy,
                dz,
                0.01);
        serverLevel.sendParticles(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ParticleTypes.LARGE_SMOKE),
                cx,
                cy,
                cz,
                2,
                dx * 0.5,
                dy * 0.5,
                dz * 0.5,
                0.0);
    }

    /**
     * Clears occupancy when the stored occupant entity is missing or dead.
     * Integrity is unchanged — only membership is reconciled.
     *
     * @return {@code true} if stale occupancy was cleared
     */
    public boolean reconcileStaleOccupancy() {
        if (occupantEntityUuid == null || !isFormed()) {
            return false;
        }
        Level level = getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        var found = serverLevel.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(occupantEntityUuid));
        if (found instanceof LivingEntity living && living.isAlive()) {
            return false;
        }
        requireOccupancyPort().clearOccupantEntityId();
        syncToClient();
        ModLogger.info(
                "ContainmentPen",
                "Cleared stale occupancy (occupant missing/dead) at " + getBlockPos());
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean validateStructure() {
        return ContainmentPenWorkflow.validateStructure(requirePort());
    }

    @Override
    public void breakStructure() {
        ContainmentPenWorkflow.breakStructure(requirePort());
        ContainmentService.setIntegrity(
                requireContainmentPort(),
                requireOccupancyPort(),
                ContainmentIntegrity.BREACHED);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFormed() {
        return structureState.isFormed();
    }

    @Override

    public String getSpecimenType() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(specimenType);
    }

        this.specimenType = type;
        setChanged();
    }

    @Override

        return occupantEntityUuid != null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getStructureSize() {
        return structureHeight;
    }

        return structureWidth;
    }

    public int getStructureDepth() {
        return structureDepth;
    }

    public int getStructureHeight() {
        return structureHeight;
    }

    @Nonnull
    public String getOccupantDisplayName() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(occupantDisplayName);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public Component formatStatusMessage(@Nonnull String translationPrefix) {
        String display = occupantDisplayName.isBlank() ? specimenType : occupantDisplayName;
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                translationPrefix + ".status",

                        "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.contains", display))));
    }

    @Override

    public Component formatEmptyMessage(@Nonnull String translationPrefix) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                translationPrefix + ".status",
                structureWidth, structureDepth, structureHeight,
                Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(translationPrefix + ".empty"))));
    }

    public void setStructureStateInternal(ContainmentPenState state) {
        this.structureState = state;
        if (!state.isFormed()) {
            this.structureCenter = null;
            this.interiorVolume = null;
            this.outwardFacing = null;
            if (!dissolvingStructure) {
                this.shellPriorStates.clear();
            }
        }
    }

    public void syncToClient() {
        setChanged();
        Level level = getLevel();
        if (level != null && !level.isClientSide) {
            BlockState state = Objects.requireNonNull(getBlockState());
            level.sendBlockUpdated(Objects.requireNonNull(getBlockPos()), state, state, 3);
        }
    }

    public boolean isDissolvingStructure() {

        setChanged();
