        this.occupantDisplayName = "";
        setChanged();
    }

    public ContainmentVolumeId getContainmentVolumeIdInternal() {
        return containmentVolumeId;
    }

    public BreachState getBreachStateInternal() {
        return breachState;
    }

    public void setBreachStateInternal(BreachState state) {
        this.breachState = Objects.requireNonNull(state);
        setChanged();
    }

    /**
     * Coarse integrity write used by {@link ContainmentPort#setIntegrity}.
     * Maps to graded breach state without gameplay reactions.
     */
    public void setCoarseIntegrityInternal(ContainmentIntegrity integrity) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(integrity);
        this.breachState = switch (integrity) {
            case INTACT -> BreachState.secure();
            case DEGRADED -> new BreachState(BreachStatus.COMPROMISED, 50, Optional.empty());
            case BREACHED -> new BreachState(
                    BreachStatus.BREACHED,
                    0,
                    breachState.breachTimestampMillis().isPresent()
                            ? breachState.breachTimestampMillis()
                            : Optional.empty());
        };
        setChanged();
    }

    public ContainmentPenState getStructureState() {
        return structureState;
    }

    /**
     * After successful structure formation, restore integrity so admit is not rejected
     * from a prior breach. Adapter-only — delegates to {@link ContainmentService#restore}.
     */
    public void restoreIntegrityAfterFormation() {
        ContainmentService.restore(requireContainmentPort());
    }

    /**
     * Requests ADMIT for an existing entity via {@link HandlingService}.
     */
    public HandlingResult requestAdmit(@Nonnull LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return HandlingService.request(
                HandlingRequest.admit(Objects.requireNonNull(entity), containmentVolumeId),
                requireContainmentPort(),
                requireOccupancyPort());
    }

    /**
     * Requests RELEASE for an existing entity via {@link HandlingService}.
     * Clears membership only — never spawns or selects organism type.
     */
    public HandlingResult requestRelease(@Nonnull LivingEntityRef entity) {
        return HandlingService.request(
                HandlingRequest.release(Objects.requireNonNull(entity), containmentVolumeId),
                requireContainmentPort(),
                requireOccupancyPort());
    }

    /** Admission Transaction access to integrity/occupancy ports (adapters only). */
    @Nonnull
    public ContainmentPort containmentPortForAdmission() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(requireContainmentPort());
    }

    @Nonnull
    public ContainmentOccupancyPort occupancyPortForAdmission() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(requireOccupancyPort());
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import net.minecraft.util.Mth;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.AttachmentEntryStrategy;

/**
 * Default facehugger attachment entry: a tail-assisted leap toward the host's face seat.
 */
public final class LeapImpulseStrategy implements AttachmentEntryStrategy {

    private static final double HORIZONTAL_SPEED = 0.8D;
    private static final double MIN_VERTICAL_SPEED = 0.35D;
    private static final double MAX_VERTICAL_SPEED = 0.8D;

    @Override
    public void begin(LivingEntity parasite, Vec3 attachmentPoint) {
        double dx = attachmentPoint.x - parasite.getX();
        double dz = attachmentPoint.z - parasite.getZ();
        double horizontalLength = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        double horizontalX = horizontalLength > 1.0E-4D ? dx / horizontalLength * HORIZONTAL_SPEED : 0.0D;
        double horizontalZ = horizontalLength > 1.0E-4D ? dz / horizontalLength * HORIZONTAL_SPEED : 0.0D;
        double verticalGap = attachmentPoint.y - parasite.getY();
        double verticalSpeed = Mth.clamp(
                verticalGap * 0.45D,
                MIN_VERTICAL_SPEED,
                MAX_VERTICAL_SPEED);

        parasite.setDeltaMovement(horizontalX, verticalSpeed, horizontalZ);
        parasite.hasImpulse = true;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.targeting.TargetingConditions;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityKind;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.ai.CombatThreatQueryPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

/**
 * L3 adapter: threat scan for flee/hide AI.
 * Uses non-combat targeting so passive hosts (e.g. Human NPCs) still count as threats
 * to juveniles that must survive rather than fight.
 */
public final class NeoForgeCombatThreatAdapter implements CombatThreatQueryPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeCombatThreatAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = Objects.requireNonNull(server);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<LivingEntityRef> findNearestCombatThreat(LivingEntityRef observer, double radius) {
        return resolvePathfinder(observer)
                .map(entity -> findNearestThreat(Objects.requireNonNull(entity), radius))
                .map(BoundaryRefs::entityFrom);
    }

    @Nullable
    public static LivingEntity findNearestThreat(@Nonnull PathfinderMob entity, double radius) {
        if (entity.level() == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return entity.level().getNearestEntity(
                Objects.requireNonNull(entity.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
                        LivingEntity.class,
                        Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getBoundingBox().inflate(radius)),
                        candidate -> isThreatCandidate(entity, candidate))),
                Objects.requireNonNull(TargetingConditions.forNonCombat().range(radius)),
                entity,
                entity.getX(),
                entity.getY(),
                entity.getZ());
    }

    private static boolean isThreatCandidate(PathfinderMob observer, LivingEntity candidate) {
        if (candidate == null || candidate == observer || !candidate.isAlive()) {
            return false;
        }
        // Creative / spectator players are observers — juveniles must not flee them.
        if (candidate instanceof Player player
                && (player.isSpectator() || player.getAbilities().instabuild)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            return true;
        }
        LivingEntityRef ref = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(candidate);
        EntityKind kind = BoundaryServices.entityQuery().classify(ref);
        if (kind == EntityKind.MOD_XENOMORPH) {
            return false;
        }
        if (kind == EntityKind.PLAYER && BoundaryServices.entityQuery().isCreativePlayer(ref)) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private Optional<PathfinderMob> resolvePathfinder(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(level -> Optional.ofNullable(level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()))))
                .filter(PathfinderMob.class::isInstance)
                .map(PathfinderMob.class::cast);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.Animal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.npc.AbstractVillager;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityKind;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.entity.EntityQueryPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.api.XenomorphTyped;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

public final class NeoForgeEntityQueryAdapter implements EntityQueryPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeEntityQueryAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(entity -> entity.isAlive() && !entity.isRemoved())
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isClientSide(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(entity -> entity.level().isClientSide())
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<String> encodeId(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> {
            @Nullable ResourceLocation id = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getType()));
            return id != null ? id.toString() : entity.getType().toString();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public EntityKind classify(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(entity -> classifyEntity(entity))
                .orElse(EntityKind.OTHER);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPlayer(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity instanceof Player).orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public String typeDescriptionId(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(entity -> entity.getType().getDescriptionId())
                .orElse("");
    }

    @Override
    public int countAttachedFacehuggers(LivingEntityRef host) {
        LivingEntity living = resolve(host).orElse(null);
        if (living == null || !living.isAlive() || living.isRemoved() || living.level() == null) {
            return 0;
        }

        int count = 0;
        for (LivingEntity entity : living.level().getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class, Objects.requireNonNull(living.getBoundingBox().inflate(0.5)))) {
            if (!(entity instanceof FacehuggerAttachmentEntity facehugger)) {
                continue;
            }
            AttachmentState state = facehugger.getAttachmentState();
            LivingEntityRef target = facehugger.getAttachmentTarget();
            if (target != null && target.equals(host) && !facehugger.isSpent()
                    && (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED)) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAlive(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.isAlive()).orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isRemoved(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.isRemoved()).orElse(true);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isCreativePlayer(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)
                .map(entity -> (Player) entity)
                .map(player -> player.getAbilities().instabuild)
                .orElse(false);
    }

    private static EntityKind classifyEntity(LivingEntity entity) {
        // Only real xenomorph forms — not all biocraft_alien entities (e.g. Human hosts).
        if (entity instanceof XenomorphTyped) {
            return EntityKind.MOD_XENOMORPH;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Player) {
            return EntityKind.PLAYER;
        }
        if (entity instanceof AbstractVillager) {
            return EntityKind.VILLAGER;
        }
        if (entity instanceof Animal) {
            return EntityKind.ANIMAL;
        }
        return EntityKind.OTHER;
    }

    private Optional<LivingEntity> resolve(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        if (ref == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(level -> {
                    var entity = level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        return Optional.of(living);
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AttachmentConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.parasite.FacehuggerSpentTransitionPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_6.parasite.FacehuggerTickWorkflow;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.FacehuggerSpentGoals;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

/**
 * NeoForge binding for {@link FacehuggerSpentTransitionPort}.
 */
public final class NeoForgeFacehuggerSpentTransitionAdapter implements FacehuggerSpentTransitionPort {

    private static final String LOG = "FacehuggerSpent";

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeFacehuggerSpentTransitionAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public void initializeSpentSession(LivingEntityRef facehugger) {
        // Fresh implant only — never call from NBT reload (VALID-LIFECYCLE-002).
        FacehuggerAttachmentEntity entity = requireFromWorld(facehugger);
        FacehuggerTickWorkflow.applyMarkAsSpent(entity);
        configureSpentWanderGoals(entity);
        int spentWanderTime = AttachmentConfigHelper.getSpentWanderTime();
        ModLogger.info(LOG, String.format("🦾 Facehugger spent session initialized — wander for %d ticks",
                spentWanderTime));
    }

    @Override
    public void resumeSpentWandering(FacehuggerAttachmentEntity facehugger) {
        // Do not resolve via world UUID — NBT restore runs before the entity is registered.
        if (facehugger == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot resume spent wandering without the loaded facehugger entity");
        }
        configureSpentWanderGoals(facehugger);
        ModLogger.info(LOG, "🦾 Facehugger spent wandering restored from save");
    }

    private static void configureSpentWanderGoals(FacehuggerAttachmentEntity entity) {
        if (entity instanceof PathfinderMob pathfinderMob) {
            FacehuggerSpentGoals.registerWanderGoals(pathfinderMob);
        }
    }

    @Nonnull
    private FacehuggerAttachmentEntity requireFromWorld(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        FacehuggerAttachmentEntity contract = resolve(entity);
        if (contract == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Entity does not support spent transition: " + entity);
        }
        return contract;
    }

    private FacehuggerAttachmentEntity resolve(LivingEntityRef entity) {
        LivingEntity living = resolveEntity(entity).orElse(null);
        if (living instanceof FacehuggerAttachmentEntity attachment) {
            return attachment;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private Optional<LivingEntity> resolveEntity(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(serverLevel -> {
                    var entity = serverLevel.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        return Optional.of(living);
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.Vec3Ref;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.BlockPosSearchPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.Vec3SearchPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * L3 bridge: PathfinderMob + MC positions ↔ L2 search policies.
 */
public final class NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter {

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface BlockPosPredicate {
        boolean test(BlockPos pos);
    }

    @FunctionalInterface
    public interface Vec3Predicate {
        boolean test(Vec3 pos);
    }

    private NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter() {}

    public static BlockPos searchBlockPosInRadius(
            PathfinderMob entity,
            double maxRadius,
            int attemptsPerRadius,
            BlockPosPredicate predicate) {
        if (entity == null || entity.level() == null || predicate == null) {
            return null;
        }

        BlockPosRef center = BoundaryRefs.from(entity.blockPosition());
        BlockPosRef found = BlockPosSearchPolicy.searchInRadius(
                center,
                maxRadius,
                attemptsPerRadius,
                bound -> entity.getRandom().nextInt(bound),
                ref -> predicate.test(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref)));
        return found != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(found) : null;
    }

    public static Vec3 searchVec3InRadius(
            PathfinderMob entity,
            Vec3 baseDirection,
            double baseDistance,
            int maxAttempts,
            Vec3Predicate predicate) {
        if (entity == null || entity.level() == null || baseDirection == null || predicate == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Vec3Ref origin = new Vec3Ref(entity.getX(), entity.getY(), entity.getZ());
        Vec3Ref direction = new Vec3Ref(baseDirection.x, baseDirection.y, baseDirection.z);
        Vec3Ref found = Vec3SearchPolicy.search(
                origin,
                direction,
                baseDistance,
                maxAttempts,
                bound -> entity.getRandom().nextInt(bound),
                ref -> predicate.test(new Vec3(ref.x(), ref.y(), ref.z())));
        return found != null ? new Vec3(found.x(), found.y(), found.z()) : null;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.SpawnSuitabilityRules;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.spawn.SpawnLocationSearchPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

/**
 * L3 adapter: MC block probes + L0 suitability rules + L2 search loop.
 */
public final class NeoForgeSpawnLocationAdapter {

    private NeoForgeSpawnLocationAdapter() {}

    @Nullable
    public static BlockPos findSafeSpawnLocation(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos originalPos,
            int searchRadius,
            int maxHeight) {
        validateSearchParams(level, originalPos, searchRadius, maxHeight);
        ModLogger.startTimer("SpawnLocationSearch");
        try {
            ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeSpawnLocationAdapter",
                    "Searching for safe spawn location around " + originalPos
                            + " (radius: " + searchRadius + ", height: " + maxHeight + ")");

            BlockPosRef origin = BoundaryRefs.from(originalPos);
            BlockPosRef found = SpawnLocationSearchPolicy.findFirstSuitable(
                    origin, searchRadius, maxHeight, ref -> isSafeSpawnLocation(level, ref));
            if (found != null) {
                BlockPos result = BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(found);
                ModLogger.success("NeoForgeSpawnLocationAdapter", "Found safe spawn location at: " + result);
                return result;
            }
            ModLogger.warn("NeoForgeSpawnLocationAdapter", "No safe spawn location found");
            return null;
        } finally {
            ModLogger.endTimer("SpawnLocationSearch");
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    public static BlockPos findSafeSpawnLocationForEntity(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos originalPos,
            int entityHeight,
            int entityWidth) {
        int searchRadius = Math.max(5, entityWidth + 1);
        int maxHeight = Math.max(10, entityHeight + 2);
        BlockPosRef origin = BoundaryRefs.from(originalPos);
        BlockPosRef found = SpawnLocationSearchPolicy.findFirstSuitable(
                origin,
                searchRadius,
                maxHeight,
                ref -> isSafeSpawnLocationForEntity(level, ref, entityHeight, entityWidth));
        return found != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(found) : null;
    }

    private static void validateSearchParams(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos originalPos,
            int searchRadius,
            int maxHeight) {
        if (searchRadius <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Search radius must be positive");
        }
        if (maxHeight <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Max height must be positive");
        }
    }

    private static boolean isSafeSpawnLocation(@Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return SpawnSuitabilityRules.isSafeSpawn(
                isAirBlock(level, pos),
                hasSolidGroundBelow(level, pos),
                hasEnoughVerticalSpace(level, pos, 2));
    }

    private static boolean isSafeSpawnLocationForEntity(
            @Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos, int entityHeight, int entityWidth) {
        return SpawnSuitabilityRules.isSafeSpawnForEntity(
                isAirBlock(level, pos),
                hasSolidGroundBelow(level, pos),
                hasEnoughVerticalSpace(level, pos, entityHeight),
                hasEnoughHorizontalSpace(level, pos, entityWidth));
    }

    private static boolean isAirBlock(@Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos))).isAir();
    }

    private static boolean hasSolidGroundBelow(@Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos) {
        BlockState belowBlock = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos.below())));
        return !belowBlock.isAir() && belowBlock.canOcclude();
    }

    private static boolean hasEnoughVerticalSpace(@Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos, int height) {
        for (int y = 1; y <= height; y++) {
            if (!isAirBlock(level, pos.offset(0, y, 0))) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean hasEnoughHorizontalSpace(@Nonnull Level level, BlockPosRef pos, int entityWidth) {
        int halfWidth = entityWidth / 2;
        for (int x = -halfWidth; x <= halfWidth; x++) {
            for (int z = -halfWidth; z <= halfWidth; z++) {
                if (x == 0 && z == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!isAirBlock(level, pos.offset(x, 0, z))) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

public final class NeoForgeWorldMutationAdapter implements WorldMutationPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeWorldMutationAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean breakBlock(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> level.destroyBlock(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos)), true))
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean placeBlock(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos, String blockId) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> {
                    Block block = Objects.requireNonNull(BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.get(
                            Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(blockId)))));
                    BlockState state = Objects.requireNonNull(block.defaultBlockState());
                    return level.setBlock(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos)), state, 3);
                })
                .orElse(false);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.EntityScanHit;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.spatial.AxisAlignedRegion;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.world.WorldQueryPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

public final class NeoForgeWorldQueryAdapter implements WorldQueryPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeWorldQueryAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public List<EntityScanHit> scanLivingEntities(WorldRef world, AxisAlignedRegion region) {
        List<EntityScanHit> hits = new ArrayList<>();
        NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world).ifPresent(level -> {
            AABB box = new AABB(
                    region.min().x(), region.min().y(), region.min().z(),
                    region.max().x(), region.max().y(), region.max().z());
            for (LivingEntity living : level.getEntitiesOfClass(LivingEntity.class, Objects.requireNonNull(box), entity -> true)) {
                UUID entityId = Objects.requireNonNull(living.getUUID(), "living entity UUID");
                hits.add(new EntityScanHit(entityId, living.distanceToSqr(Objects.requireNonNull(box.getCenter()))));
            }
        });
        return hits;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAirAt(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos))).isAir())
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canOccludeAt(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos))).canOcclude())
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isInBounds(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> level.isInWorldBounds(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos))))
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isUnbreakableAt(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> {
                    BlockPos blockPos = Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos));
                    var state = level.getBlockState(blockPos);
                    return state.getDestroySpeed(level, blockPos) < 0.0F;
                })
                .orElse(false);
    }

    @Override
    public String blockIdAt(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos) {
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, world)
                .map(level -> {
                    var block = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(pos))).getBlock();
                    @Nullable ResourceLocation key = BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(block));
                    return key != null ? key.toString() : "";
                })
                .orElse("");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.EntityTypeResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.RenderConfigProvider;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.ModelRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.TextureRegistry;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRendererProvider;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.MobRenderer;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Base class for data-driven renderers that use modular components.
 * Generic implementation that works with any EntityType, not species-specific.
 * 
 * Follows Single Responsibility Principle - only handles rendering coordination.
 * Uses dependency injection for model creation, texture resolution, and configuration.
 * 
 * Species-specific renderers should extend this class and provide:
 * - EntityTypeResolver for resolving entity types from entities
 * - ModelRegistry for model creation
 * - TextureRegistry for texture resolution
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public abstract class BaseDataDrivenRenderer<T extends Mob> extends MobRenderer<T, EntityModel<T>> {
    
    protected final ResourceLocation texture;
    protected final ModelRegistry modelRegistry;
    protected final TextureRegistry textureRegistry;
    protected final EntityTypeResolver entityTypeResolver;
    protected final EntityType entityType;
    protected final RenderConfigProvider configProvider;
    
    /**
     * Constructor with dependency injection for testing and extensibility.
     * Follows Dependency Inversion Principle.
     * 
     * @param context The renderer context
     * @param entityType The entity type for this renderer
     * @param modelRegistry The model registry for creating models
     * @param textureRegistry The texture registry for resolving textures
     * @param entityTypeResolver The resolver for determining entity types from entities
     * @param configProvider The config provider for species-specific config access
     */
    protected BaseDataDrivenRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context,
                                    EntityType entityType,
                                    ModelRegistry modelRegistry,
                                    TextureRegistry textureRegistry,
                                    EntityTypeResolver entityTypeResolver,
                                    RenderConfigProvider configProvider) {
        super(context, createModelFromConfig(context, entityType, modelRegistry, configProvider), 
              configProvider.getShadowSize(entityType));
        
        this.entityType = entityType;
        this.modelRegistry = modelRegistry;
        this.textureRegistry = textureRegistry;
        this.entityTypeResolver = entityTypeResolver;
        this.configProvider = configProvider;
        this.texture = textureRegistry.resolveTexture(entityType);
    }
    
    /**
     * Creates the appropriate model using the injected ModelRegistry.
     * Delegates model creation to the registry, following Single Responsibility Principle.
     */
    private static <T extends Mob> EntityModel<T> createModelFromConfig(EntityRendererProvider.Context context,
                                                                        EntityType entityType,
                                                                        ModelRegistry modelRegistry,
                                                                        RenderConfigProvider configProvider) {
        try {
            // Get model name from config using provider
            String modelName = configProvider.getModelName(entityType);
            if (modelName == null || modelName.isEmpty()) {
                modelName = "player";
            }
            
            return modelRegistry.createModel(context, modelName, entityType);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger.error(
                    "BaseDataDrivenRenderer",
                    "Failed to create model for " + entityType.getConfigKey()
                            + " — falling back to player: " + e.getMessage(),
                    e);
            return modelRegistry.createModel(context, "player", entityType);
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    public @Nonnull ResourceLocation getTextureLocation(@Nonnull T entity) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(texture);
    }
    
    @Override
    public void render(@Nonnull T entity, float entityYaw, float partialTick, @Nonnull PoseStack poseStack,
                      @Nonnull net.minecraft.client.renderer.MultiBufferSource bufferSource, int packedLight) {
        // Rate limit rendering debug logs to every 100 ticks (5 seconds) to reduce spam
        if (entity.tickCount % 100 == 0) {
            com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger.debug("BaseDataDrivenRenderer",
                String.format("🎨 Rendering %s at %s", entity.getType().toString(), entity.blockPosition()));
        }
        super.render(entity, entityYaw, partialTick, poseStack, bufferSource, packedLight);
    }
    
    /**
     * Applies scaling to the entity model based on configuration.
     * Uses the config provider for species-specific scaling logic.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity
     * @param poseStack The pose stack
     * @param partialTick The partial tick
     */
    @Override
    protected void scale(@Nonnull T entity, @Nonnull PoseStack poseStack, float partialTick) {
        EntityType resolvedType = entityTypeResolver != null ? entityTypeResolver.resolveEntityType(entity) : null;
        if (resolvedType != null && configProvider != null) {
            float scale = configProvider.getScale(resolvedType);
            if (scale != 1.0f) {
                poseStack.scale(scale, scale, scale);
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.client.model.HierarchicalModel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.AnimationCaller;

/**

 * Applies entity animation states to a geo model during {@code setupAnim}.

 * Species-specific implementations live at {@code level_3/.../animation/render}.

 */

public interface XenomorphModelAnimationSetup {



    <T extends LivingEntity> void setupAnimations(

            @Nonnull T entity,

            @Nonnull HierarchicalModel<T> model,

            @Nonnull AnimationCaller animator,

            float ageInTicks);



    default <T extends LivingEntity> void resetPose(@Nonnull HierarchicalModel<T> model) {

        model.root().getAllParts().forEach(part -> part.resetPose());

    }

}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.client.model.EntityModel;
import net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel;
import net.minecraft.client.model.SilverfishModel;

import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRendererProvider;

/**
 * Xenomorph-specific model registry implementation.
 * Handles model creation for xenomorph entities.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class XenomorphModelRegistry implements ModelRegistry {
    
    @Override
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public <T extends Mob> EntityModel<T> createModel(EntityRendererProvider.Context context, 
                                                       String modelName, 
                                                       EntityType entityType) {
        String normalizedName = modelName.toLowerCase();
        
        ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", 
            String.format("🔧 Creating model: '%s' for %s", normalizedName, entityType.getConfigKey()));
        
        return (EntityModel<T>) switch (normalizedName) {
            // Vanilla models
            case "spider" -> new SpiderModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.SPIDER))));
            case "cave_spider" -> new SpiderModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.CAVE_SPIDER))));
            case "silverfish" -> new SilverfishModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.SILVERFISH))));
            case "endermite" -> new SpiderModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.ENDERMITE))));
            case "player" -> new HumanoidModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.PLAYER))));
            case "iron_golem" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🔧 Creating iron golem model using scaled humanoid model");
                yield new HumanoidModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.PLAYER))));
            }
            case "enderdragon_egg" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🥚 Creating ender dragon egg model using slime model (egg-shaped)");
                yield new SlimeModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.SLIME))));
            }
            
            // Custom xenomorph models
            case "ovomorph_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom ovomorph model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.OVOMORPH, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.OVOMORPH_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "drone_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom drone model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.DRONE, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.DRONE_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "queen_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom queen model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.QUEEN, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.QUEEN_CUSTOM))));
            }
            
            // V2 model paths
            case "biocraft_alien:models/entity/drone_v2" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating v2 drone model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.DRONE, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.DRONE_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "biocraft_alien:models/entity/ovomorph_v2" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating v2 ovomorph model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.OVOMORPH, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.OVOMORPH_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "biocraft_alien:models/entity/queen_v2" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating v2 queen model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.QUEEN, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.QUEEN_CUSTOM))));
            }
            
            // Custom xenomorph models
            case "facehugger_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom facehugger model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.FACEHUGGER, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.FACEHUGGER_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "chestburster_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom chestburster model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.CHESTBURSTER, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.CHESTBURSTER_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "growth_custom" -> {
                // Growth mesh not shipped yet — reuse chestburster custom model/animations.
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry",
                        "🎨 Creating growth model via chestburster_custom (interim)");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(
                        XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.CHESTBURSTER,
                        Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(
                                Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.CHESTBURSTER_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "praetor_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom praetor model");
                yield new HumanoidModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.PLAYER)))); // Fallback
            }
            case "human_custom" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating custom human model");
                yield new HumanoidModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.PLAYER)))); // Fallback
            }
            
            // V2 model paths
            case "biocraft_alien:models/entity/chestburster_v2" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating v2 chestburster model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.CHESTBURSTER, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.CHESTBURSTER_CUSTOM))));
            }
            case "biocraft_alien:models/entity/facehugger_v2" -> {
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphModelRegistry", "🎨 Creating v2 facehugger model");
                yield XenomorphModelRefs.create(XenomorphModelRefs.Kind.FACEHUGGER, Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayerRegistry.FACEHUGGER_CUSTOM))));
            }
            
            default -> {
                ModLogger.warn("XenomorphModelRegistry", 
                    String.format("⚠️ Unknown model '%s', using player model fallback", normalizedName));
                yield new HumanoidModel<>(Objects.requireNonNull(context.bakeLayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ModelLayers.PLAYER))));
            }
        };
    }

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.RenderConfigProvider;

/**
 * Xenomorph-specific render configuration adapter.
 * Resolves model name, shadow size, and scale from entity JSON config.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 */
public class XenomorphRenderConfigProvider implements RenderConfigProvider {

    @Override
    public String getModelName(EntityType entityType) {
        if (!(entityType instanceof XenomorphType xenomorphType)) {
            return "player";
        }

        try {
            EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
            String modelName = (config != null && config.model != null) ? config.model : "player";

            ModLogger.info("XenomorphRenderConfigProvider",
                    String.format("Loading model for %s: '%s' (config: %s)",
                            entityType.getConfigKey(), modelName, config != null ? "loaded" : "null"));

            return modelName;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphRenderConfigProvider",
                    String.format("Failed to get model name for %s: %s, using fallback",
                            entityType.getConfigKey(), e.getMessage()));
            return "player";
        }
    }

    @Override
    public float getShadowSize(EntityType entityType) {
        if (!(entityType instanceof XenomorphType xenomorphType)) {
            return 0.5f;
        }
        return EntityConfigStorage.getShadowSize(xenomorphType);
    }

    @Override
    public float getScale(EntityType entityType) {
        if (!(entityType instanceof XenomorphType xenomorphType)) {
            return 1.0f;
        }

        try {
            EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
            if (config != null && config.entitySize != null) {
                return config.entitySize.scale;
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphRenderConfigProvider",
                    String.format("Failed to get scale for %s: %s", entityType.getConfigKey(), e.getMessage()));
        }

        return 1.0f;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntityInitRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.RendererRegistry;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRenderer;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EntityRendererProvider;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.EntityRenderersEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.registries.DeferredHolder;

/**
 * Xenomorph-specific renderer registry.
 *
 * <p>NDE escape hatch: {@link #registerOne} loads
 * {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client.XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer$*}
 * via {@code Class.forName} so this registry stays at a lower tier without compile-time L5 imports.
 */
public class XenomorphRendererRegistry implements RendererRegistry {

    private static final String RENDERER_BASE =
            "com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client.XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer$";

    private static String rendererFqn(String rendererClass) {
        return RENDERER_BASE + rendererClass;
    }

    @Override
    public void registerRenderers(EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event) {
        ModLogger.info("XenomorphRendererRegistry", "Loading xenomorph renderers...");

        int registeredCount = 0;
        int[] failedCount = {0};

        registeredCount += registerAndTrack(event, "FACEHUGGER", "FacehuggerRenderer", failedCount);
        registeredCount += registerAndTrack(event, "CHESTBURSTER", "ChestbursterRenderer", failedCount);
        registeredCount += registerAndTrack(event, "DRONE", "DroneRenderer", failedCount);
        // TODO(FEATURE-GROWTH-001): Wire GROWTH renderer when com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit registers it.
        // TODO(FEATURE-GROWTH-002): Wire PRAETOR renderer when com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.EntityInit registers it.
        // GROWTH / PRAETOR renderers shelved with entity registration.
        registeredCount += registerAndTrack(event, "QUEEN", "QueenRenderer", failedCount);
        registeredCount += registerAndTrack(event, "OVOMORPH", "OvomorphRenderer", failedCount);

        if (failedCount[0] > 0) {
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphRendererRegistry",
                    String.format("Xenomorph renderer registration completed with %d successful and %d failed registrations",
                            registeredCount, failedCount[0]));
        } else {
            ModLogger.info("XenomorphRendererRegistry",
                    String.format("All xenomorph renderers loaded successfully (%d renderers)", registeredCount));
        }
    }

    private int registerAndTrack(
            EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event,
            String entityKey,
            String rendererClass,
            int[] failedCount) {
        int result = registerOne(event, EntityInitRefs.holder(entityKey), rendererClass);
        if (result == 0) {
            failedCount[0]++;
        }
        return result;
    }

    private int registerOne(
            EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event,
            DeferredHolder<EntityType<?>, EntityType<?>> holder,
            String rendererClass) {
        try {
            EntityType<?> entityType = holder.get();
            var ctor = Class.forName(rendererFqn(rendererClass))
                    .getConstructor(EntityRendererProvider.Context.class);
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            var castedEntityType = (EntityType<Entity>) entityType;
            event.registerEntityRenderer(Objects.requireNonNull(castedEntityType), context -> {
                try {
                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                    EntityRenderer<Entity> renderer = (EntityRenderer<Entity>) ctor.newInstance(context);
                    return renderer;
                } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to construct " + rendererClass, e);
                }
            });
            ModLogger.debug("XenomorphRendererRegistry", "Registered " + rendererClass);
            return 1;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("XenomorphRendererRegistry", "Failed to register " + rendererClass + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return 0;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String getSpeciesName() {
        return "xenomorph";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.EntityType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.TextureRegistry;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

/**
 * Xenomorph-specific texture registry implementation.
 * Handles texture resolution for xenomorph entities.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class XenomorphTextureRegistry implements TextureRegistry {
    
    private static final ResourceLocation DEFAULT_FALLBACK = ResourceLocation.parse("minecraft:textures/entity/cat/cat.png");
    
    @Override
    public ResourceLocation resolveTexture(EntityType entityType) {
        // Cast to XenomorphType for config access
        if (!(entityType instanceof XenomorphType xenomorphType)) {
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                String.format("⚠️ EntityType %s is not a XenomorphType, using default texture", entityType.getConfigKey()));
            return DEFAULT_FALLBACK;
        }
        
        try {
            EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
            
            if (config == null) {
                ModLogger.warn("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                    String.format("⚠️ No config found for %s, using default texture", entityType.getConfigKey()));
                return DEFAULT_FALLBACK;
            }
            
            // Prioritize primary texture for proper rendering
            if (config.texture != null && !config.texture.isEmpty()) {
                ResourceLocation primaryTexture = ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(config.texture));
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                    String.format("🎨 Using primary texture for %s: %s", entityType.getConfigKey(), config.texture));
                
                // DEBUG: Check if texture resource exists
                if (xenomorphType == XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER) {
                    ModLogger.info("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                        String.format("🦾 DEBUG: Facehugger texture path: %s", config.texture));
                    ModLogger.info("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                        String.format("🦾 DEBUG: Parsed ResourceLocation: %s", primaryTexture));
                }
                
                return primaryTexture;
            }
            
            // Fall back to fallback texture if primary is not available
            if (config.textureFallback != null && !config.textureFallback.isEmpty()) {
                ResourceLocation fallbackTexture = ResourceLocation.parse(Objects.requireNonNull(config.textureFallback));
                ModLogger.info("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                    String.format("🎨 Using fallback texture for %s: %s", entityType.getConfigKey(), config.textureFallback));
                return fallbackTexture;
            }
            
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                String.format("⚠️ No texture config for %s, using default", entityType.getConfigKey()));
            return DEFAULT_FALLBACK;
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.warn("XenomorphTextureRegistry", 
                String.format("⚠️ Failed to resolve texture for %s: %s", entityType.getConfigKey(), e.getMessage()));
            return DEFAULT_FALLBACK;
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.config;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.io.ResourceLoader;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.registry.ConfigLoaderBase;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.MinecraftResourceLoader;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Abstract base class for configuration loaders using Minecraft's resource manager.
 * Extends ConfigLoaderBase and provides net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager-based resource loading.
 * 
 * This abstract class implements the DRY principle by centralizing:
 * - Common loading lifecycle (load, validate, cache, reload)
 * - Standardized error handling and logging patterns
 * - Resource path building helpers
 * - Validation framework
 * - Thread-safe caching
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * Enhanced to extend ConfigLoaderBase and use ResourceLoader strategy pattern.
 * Supports flexible resource loading while maintaining backward compatibility.
 * 
 * @param <T> The type of configuration object this loader manages
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public abstract class BaseConfigLoader<T> extends ConfigLoaderBase<T> {
    
    protected static final Gson GSON = new GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create();
    protected ResourceLoader resourceLoader;
    protected net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager;
    
    /**
     * Constructs a BaseConfigLoader with the specified name.
     * 
     * @param loaderName The name of this loader for logging purposes
     */
    protected BaseConfigLoader(String loaderName) {
        super(loaderName);
    }
    
    /**
     * Sets the net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager and creates a MinecraftResourceLoader.
     * Must be called before loadConfigs().
     * 
     * @param resourceManager The Minecraft net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager
     */
    public void setResourceManager(net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        this.resourceManager = resourceManager;
        this.resourceLoader = new MinecraftResourceLoader(Objects.requireNonNull(resourceManager));
    }
    
    /**
     * Sets a custom ResourceLoader strategy.
     * Allows using different resource loading mechanisms.
     * 
     * @param resourceLoader The resource loader to use
     */
    protected void setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader resourceLoader) {
        this.resourceLoader = resourceLoader;
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the resource path for a specific configuration.
     * Subclasses must implement this to define where their configs are located.
     * 
     * @param configName The name of the configuration
     * @return The resource path for the configuration
     */
    protected abstract String getResourcePath(String configName);
    
    /**
     * Gets the class type for deserialization.
     * Subclasses must implement this to define their config class.
     * 
     * @return The class type for this loader's configuration
     */
    protected abstract Class<T> getConfigClass();
    
    /**
     * Validates a loaded configuration.
     * Subclasses can override this for custom validation logic.
     * 
     * @param config The configuration to validate
     * @param configName The name of the configuration
     * @return True if the configuration is valid
     */
    protected boolean validateConfig(T config, String configName) {
        return config != null;
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the default configuration names to load.
     * Subclasses must implement this to define which configs to load by default.
     * 
     * @return Array of default configuration names
     */
    protected abstract String[] getDefaultConfigNames();
    
    /**
     * Loads all configurations from JSON files.
     * Requires net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager to be set via setResourceManager() or loadConfigs(net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager).
     */
    @Override
    public void loadConfigs() {
        if (resourceManager == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Minecraft resource manager not set. Call setResourceManager() or loadConfigs(...) first.");
        }
        loadConfigs(resourceManager);
    }
    
    /**
     * Loads all configurations from JSON files.
     * Sets net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager and delegates to loadConfigs().
     * 
     * @param resourceManager The resource manager to load from
     */
    public void loadConfigs(net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        setResourceManager(resourceManager);
        
        if (loaded) {
            ModLogger.debug(loaderName + " configurations already loaded");
            return;
        }
        
        ModLogger.loading("Loading " + loaderName + " configurations...");
        ModLogger.startTimer(loaderName + "_load");
        
        try {
            clearConfigs();
            String[] configNames = getDefaultConfigNames();
            for (String configName : configNames) {
                loadConfig(configName);
            }
            
            setLoaded(true);
            ModLogger.endTimer(loaderName + "_load");
            ModLogger.success("Loaded " + getConfigCount() + " " + loaderName + " configurations");
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("Failed to load " + loaderName + " configurations", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to load " + loaderName + " configurations", e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Loads a specific configuration.
     * 
     * @param configName The name of the configuration to load
     */
    protected void loadConfig(String configName) {
        if (resourceLoader == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ResourceLoader not initialized. Call setResourceManager() first.");
        }
        
        try {
            String resourcePath = getResourcePath(configName);
            com.google.gson.JsonObject jsonData = resourceLoader.loadJson(resourcePath, this.getClass());
            
            if (jsonData != null) {
                T config = GSON.fromJson(jsonData, getConfigClass());
                
                if (validateConfig(config, configName)) {
                    putConfig(configName, config);
                    ModLogger.success("Loaded " + loaderName + " config: " + configName);
                } else {
                    ModLogger.warn("Invalid " + loaderName + " config: " + configName);
                }
            } else {
                ModLogger.warn(loaderName + " config not found: " + configName);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("Failed to load " + loaderName + " config " + configName, e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to load " + loaderName + " config " + configName, e);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets a configuration by name.
     * 
     * @param configName The name of the configuration
     * @return The configuration, or null if not found
     */
    public T getConfig(String configName) {
        if (!loaded) {
            ModLogger.warn("Attempting to get config before " + loaderName + " is loaded: " + configName);
            return null;
        }
        return super.getConfigInternal(configName);
    }
    
    /**
     * Reloads all configurations.
     * Requires net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager to be set.
     */
    @Override
    public void reloadConfigs() {
        if (resourceManager == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Minecraft resource manager not set. Cannot reload.");
        }
        reloadConfigs(resourceManager);
    }
    
    /**
     * Reloads all configurations.
     * 
     * @param resourceManager The resource manager
     */
    public void reloadConfigs(net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        ModLogger.loading("Reloading " + loaderName + " configurations...");
        clearConfigs();
        setLoaded(false);
        loadConfigs(resourceManager);
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets all loaded configuration names.
     * 
     * @return Set of all loaded configuration names
     */
    public java.util.Set<String> getLoadedConfigNames() {
        return getConfigNames();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.effects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffect;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectCategory;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.entity.EntityValidationHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

/**
 * Base class for all xenomorph-related effects.
 * Provides common effect logic and behavior shared across xenomorph effects.
 * 
 * This abstract class implements the DRY principle by centralizing:
 * - Common effect configuration access patterns
 * - Standardized logging for effect lifecycle events
 * - Common error handling and validation
 * - Effect lifecycle hooks (onApply, onTick, onRemove)
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.0.1
 */
public abstract class BaseXenomorphEffect extends MobEffect {
    
    /**
     * Constructs a BaseXenomorphEffect with the specified category and color.
     * 
     * @param category The effect category (HARMFUL, BENEFICIAL, NEUTRAL)
     * @param color The color of the effect
     */
    protected BaseXenomorphEffect(MobEffectCategory category, int color) {
        super(category, color);
        ModLogger.debug("Initialized " + getClass().getSimpleName());
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the effect name for logging purposes.
     * 
     * @return The name of this effect
     */
    protected String getEffectName() {
        return getClass().getSimpleName();
    }
    
    /**
     * Called when the effect is applied to an entity.
     * Subclasses can override this for custom application logic.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is being applied to
     * @param amplifier The amplifier level
     */
    protected void onApply(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        ModLogger.debug("Applied " + getEffectName() + " to " + entity.getDisplayName().getString());
    }
    
    /**
     * Called when the effect is removed from an entity.
     * Subclasses can override this for custom removal logic.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is being removed from
     * @param amplifier The amplifier level
     */
    protected void onRemove(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        ModLogger.debug("Removed " + getEffectName() + " from " + entity.getDisplayName().getString());
    }
    
    /**
     * Called each tick while the effect is active.
     * Subclasses must implement this to define the effect's behavior.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is active on
     * @param amplifier The amplifier level
     * @return True if the effect should continue, false to remove it
     */
    protected abstract boolean onTick(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier);
    
    /**
     * Determines if the effect should apply this tick.
     * Subclasses can override this for custom tick timing.
     * 
     * @param duration The remaining duration in ticks
     * @param amplifier The amplifier level
     * @return True if the effect should apply this tick
     */
    protected boolean shouldApplyThisTick(int duration, int amplifier) {
        return true; // Apply every tick by default
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates that the entity can have this effect applied.
     * Uses centralized LivingEntityChecks for consistency with codebase validation patterns.
     * Subclasses can override this for custom validation logic.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to validate
     * @return True if the entity can have this effect
     */
    protected boolean canApplyTo(LivingEntity entity) {
        return !EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity), BoundaryServices.entityQuery());
    }
    
    /**
     * Gets the configuration key for this effect.
     * Used for loading effect-specific configuration.
     * 
     * @return The configuration key for this effect
     */
    protected String getConfigKey() {
        return getClass().getSimpleName().toLowerCase().replace("effect", "");
    }
    
    @Override
    public boolean applyEffectTick(@Nonnull LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        // Validate entity
        if (!canApplyTo(entity)) {
            ModLogger.warn("Cannot apply " + getEffectName() + " to invalid entity");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Apply the effect
        try {
            return onTick(entity, amplifier);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("Error applying " + getEffectName() + " to " + entity.getDisplayName().getString(), e);
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    public boolean shouldApplyEffectTickThisTick(int duration, int amplifier) {
        return shouldApplyThisTick(duration, amplifier);
    }
    
    @Override
    public void onEffectAdded(@Nonnull LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onEffectAdded(entity, amplifier);
        onApply(entity, amplifier);
    }
    
    /**
     * Logs effect application with standardized format.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is being applied to
     * @param message Additional message to log
     */
    protected void logEffectApplication(LivingEntity entity, String message) {
        ModLogger.info("Applied " + getEffectName() + " to " + entity.getDisplayName().getString() + ": " + message);
    }
    
    /**
     * Logs effect removal with standardized format.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is being removed from
     * @param message Additional message to log
     */
    protected void logEffectRemoval(LivingEntity entity, String message) {
        ModLogger.info("Removed " + getEffectName() + " from " + entity.getDisplayName().getString() + ": " + message);
    }
    
    /**
     * Logs effect tick with standardized format.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity the effect is active on
     * @param message Additional message to log
     */
    protected void logEffectTick(LivingEntity entity, String message) {
        ModLogger.debug("Tick " + getEffectName() + " on " + entity.getDisplayName().getString() + ": " + message);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.api.XenomorphTyped;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity.EntityAttributeHelper;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.AttributeSupplier;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Minecraft base class for xenomorph mob entities (persistence + shared mob behavior).
 *
 * <p>No combat or attachment policy ticks here — those belong in focused helpers
 * ({@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.species.xenomorph.ai.shared.CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard}, attachment binding).
 */
public abstract class BaseXenomorphEntity extends PathfinderMob implements XenomorphTyped {

    public BaseXenomorphEntity(EntityType<? extends BaseXenomorphEntity> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
        this.setPersistenceRequired();
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();
        if (!this.isPersistenceRequired()) {
            this.setPersistenceRequired();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean removeWhenFarAway(double distanceToClosestPlayer) {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresCustomPersistence() {
        return true;
    }

    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createBaseAttributes() {
        return PathfinderMob.createMobAttributes();
    }

    protected static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributesForType(XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        return EntityAttributeHelper.createXenomorphAttributes(xenomorphType);
    }

    @Override
    public abstract XenomorphType getXenomorphType();

    protected void logPersistenceStatus() {
        ModLogger.debug(
                "BaseXenomorphEntity",
                String.format(
                        "🦾 %s at %s - Persistence: %s, Required: %s",
                        this.getType().toString(),
                        this.blockPosition(),
                        this.isPersistenceRequired(),
                        this.requiresCustomPersistence()));
    }
}
