FILE: FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.parasite.AttachmentRules;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.parasite.FacehuggerAttachmentEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.parasite.HostEligibilityService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * NBT save/load and deferred latched-host UUID restoration for facehugger attachment state.
 *
 * <p>Persists {@code latchedHostUUID} from {@link com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.parasite.AttachmentBinding},
 * not combat {@code Mob.getTarget()}. Legacy {@code targetUUID} is still read.
 *
 * <p>S2B playtest-confirmed (2026-07-24): NBT fields only; caller resumes (never re-inits).
 */
public final class FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence {

    private static final String NBT_LATCHED_HOST_UUID = "latchedHostUUID";
    private static final String NBT_LEGACY_TARGET_UUID = "targetUUID";

    private FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence() {
    }

    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void writeSaveData(
            @Nonnull T facehugger, @Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        compound.putInt("attachmentTicks", facehugger.getAttachmentTicks());
        compound.putString("attachmentState", Objects.requireNonNull(facehugger.getAttachmentState().name()));
        compound.putInt("spentTimer", facehugger.getSpentTimer());

        if (facehugger.isAttachmentRotationSet()) {
            compound.putFloat("attachmentYRot", facehugger.getAttachmentYRot());
            compound.putFloat("attachmentXRot", facehugger.getAttachmentXRot());
            compound.putBoolean("attachmentRotationSet", true);
        }

        UUID latchedHost = facehugger.attachmentBinding().hostUUID();
        if (latchedHost != null && !AttachmentRules.isSpentState(facehugger.getAttachmentState())) {
            compound.putUUID(NBT_LATCHED_HOST_UUID, Objects.requireNonNull(latchedHost));
        }
    }

    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void readSaveData(
            @Nonnull T facehugger, @Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        facehugger.setAttachmentTicks(
                compound.contains("attachmentTicks") ? compound.getInt("attachmentTicks") : 0);
        facehugger.setSpentTimer(
                compound.contains("spentTimer") ? compound.getInt("spentTimer") : 0);

        if (compound.contains("attachmentState")) {
            try {
                facehugger.restoreAttachmentState(AttachmentState.valueOf(compound.getString("attachmentState")));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
                ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence",
                        String.format("⚠️ Invalid attachment state '%s' in save data, defaulting to FREE",
                                compound.getString("attachmentState")));
                facehugger.restoreAttachmentState(AttachmentState.FREE);
            }
        } else {
            facehugger.restoreAttachmentState(AttachmentState.FREE);
        }

        // Legacy NBT: isSpent boolean migrated to SPENT_WANDERING
        if (compound.contains("isSpent") && compound.getBoolean("isSpent")) {
            facehugger.restoreAttachmentState(AttachmentState.SPENT_WANDERING);
        }

        if (AttachmentRules.isSpentState(facehugger.getAttachmentState())) {
            facehugger.setTarget(null);
            facehugger.attachmentBinding().clear();
            facehugger.setAttachmentTicks(0);
            facehugger.setAttachmentRotationSet(false);
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence",
                    "🦾 Loaded spent facehugger — SPENT_WANDERING state restored");
        } else {
            if (compound.contains("attachmentRotationSet") && compound.getBoolean("attachmentRotationSet")) {
                facehugger.setAttachmentYRot(compound.contains("attachmentYRot")
                        ? compound.getFloat("attachmentYRot") : 0.0f);
                facehugger.setAttachmentXRot(compound.contains("attachmentXRot")
                        ? compound.getFloat("attachmentXRot") : 0.0f);
                facehugger.setAttachmentRotationSet(true);
            }

            UUID pendingHost = null;
            if (compound.contains(NBT_LATCHED_HOST_UUID)) {
                pendingHost = compound.getUUID(NBT_LATCHED_HOST_UUID);
            } else if (compound.contains(NBT_LEGACY_TARGET_UUID)) {
                pendingHost = compound.getUUID(NBT_LEGACY_TARGET_UUID);
            }
            if (pendingHost != null) {
                facehugger.setPendingTargetUUID(pendingHost);
            }
        }

        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence",
                String.format("🦾 Loaded facehugger state: attachmentTicks=%d, state=%s, spentTimer=%d",
                        facehugger.getAttachmentTicks(), facehugger.getAttachmentState(),
                        facehugger.getSpentTimer()));
    }

    /**
     * Restores latched host into {@link com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.parasite.AttachmentBinding}
     * after world load. Also syncs combat target for approach AI when still approaching.
     */
    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void restoreLatchedHostFromUUID(
            @Nonnull T facehugger) {
        UUID hostUUID = facehugger.getPendingTargetUUID();
        if (hostUUID == null || facehugger.level() == null || facehugger.level().isClientSide) {
            return;
        }

        Entity entity = null;
        if (facehugger.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
            entity = serverLevel.getEntity(hostUUID);
        }

        if (entity instanceof LivingEntity livingEntity && livingEntity.isAlive()
                && HostEligibilityService.isValidFacehuggerHost(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(livingEntity))) {
            var hostRef = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(livingEntity);
            AttachmentState state = facehugger.getAttachmentState();
            if (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING
                    || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED
                    || state == AttachmentState.READY_TO_ATTACH) {
                facehugger.setAttachmentTarget(hostRef);
            }
            // Approach / look AI may still use combat target; not the attachment source of truth.
            facehugger.setTarget(livingEntity);
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence",
                    String.format("🦾 Restored latched host %s from UUID", livingEntity.getDisplayName().getString()));
        } else {
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence",
                    String.format("⚠️ Skipped restoring latched host UUID %s - not found, dead, or not a valid host",
                            hostUUID));
        }
        facehugger.setPendingTargetUUID(null);
    }

    /** @deprecated use {@link #restoreLatchedHostFromUUID} */
    @Deprecated
    public static <T extends Mob & FacehuggerAttachmentEntity> void restoreTargetFromUUID(@Nonnull T facehugger) {
        restoreLatchedHostFromUUID(facehugger);
    }
}

FILE: OvomorphHostQuery.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.EntityConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_2.parasite.HostClaimService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_5.ovomorph.OvomorphHostSelectionPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.GlassLineOfSightHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * MC-side host proximity scan for ovomorph hatching; viability rules delegate to L2 policy.
 *
 * <p>Creative players are never viable hatch triggers. Glass between egg and host blocks LOS
 * (containment: a host outside glass will not wake an egg inside, and vice versa).
 *
 * <p>S2B playtest-confirmed (2026-07-24): hatch on host in range; creative ignored. Mesh polish = Stage 5.
 */
public final class OvomorphHostQuery {

    private static final String LOG = "OvomorphHostQuery";
    private static long lastRejectLogMs;

    private OvomorphHostQuery() {
    }

    public static LivingEntity findNearestViableHost(@Nonnull Mob ovomorph) {
        double proximityDistance = EntityConfigHelper.getConfigValueRequired(
                XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                config -> config.hatching != null ? Double.valueOf(config.hatching.proximityDistance) : null,
                "hatching.proximityDistance");

        Level level = ovomorph.level();
        if (level == null) {
            return null;
        }

        List<LivingEntity> nearbyEntities = level.getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                Objects.requireNonNull(ovomorph.getBoundingBox().inflate(proximityDistance)),
                entity -> entity != ovomorph && entity.isAlive());

        LivingEntity nearestHost = null;
        double nearestDistance = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        LivingEntity blockedViableHost = null;
        String blockReason = null;

        for (LivingEntity entity : nearbyEntities) {
            var hostRef = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity);
            if (OvomorphHostSelectionPolicy.isCreativePlayer(hostRef)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!OvomorphHostSelectionPolicy.isViableHost(hostRef)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (HostClaimService.isHostClaimedByOther(
                    entity.getUUID(), ovomorph.getUUID(), level.getGameTime())) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!ovomorph.hasLineOfSight(entity)) {
                blockedViableHost = entity;
                blockReason = "no line of sight";
                continue;
            }
            if (!GlassLineOfSightHelper.hasClearPathWithoutGlass(ovomorph, entity)) {
                blockedViableHost = entity;
                blockReason = "glass between egg and host (containment LOS)";
                continue;
            }
            double distance = ovomorph.distanceTo(Objects.requireNonNull(entity));
            if (distance < nearestDistance) {
                nearestDistance = distance;
                nearestHost = entity;
            }
        }

        if (nearestHost == null && blockedViableHost != null && blockReason != null) {
            logRejectThrottled(blockedViableHost, blockReason);
        }
        return nearestHost;
    }

    private static void logRejectThrottled(LivingEntity host, String reason) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastRejectLogMs < 5000L) {
            return;
        }
        lastRejectLogMs = now;
        ModLogger.info(
                LOG,
                "🥚 Viable host "
                        + host.getDisplayName().getString()
                        + " in range but did not wake ovomorph — "
                        + reason);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.registry.ConfigContractException;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfigPaths;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.config.SoundHelper;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.Holder;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Centralized sound registry for xenomorph entities.
 * Runtime sound IDs are read from entity JSON via {@link EntityConfigStorage}.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.0.1
 */
public class XenomorphSoundRegistry {

    /**
     * Gets the ambient sound for a xenomorph type.
     *
     * @param type The xenomorph type
     * @return The ambient sound event, or null if not registered in the sound registry
     */
    public static SoundEvent getAmbientSound(XenomorphType type) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(type);
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.ambientSound, type, "visual.ambient_sound");
    }

    /**
     * Gets the hurt sound for a xenomorph type.
     *
     * @param type The xenomorph type
     * @return The hurt sound event, or null if not registered in the sound registry
     */
    public static SoundEvent getHurtSound(XenomorphType type) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(type);
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.hurtSound, type, "visual.hurt_sound");
    }

    /**
     * Gets the death sound for a xenomorph type.
     *
     * @param type The xenomorph type
     * @return The death sound event, or null if not registered in the sound registry
     */
    public static SoundEvent getDeathSound(XenomorphType type) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(type);
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.deathSound, type, "visual.death_sound");
    }

    /**
     * Gets a special sound event by unqualified mod-local key.
     *
     * @param soundKey The special sound key (e.g., "xenomorph.intelligence_activate")
     * @return The sound event, or null if not found
     */
    public static SoundEvent getSpecialSound(String soundKey) {
        return resolveModLocalSoundEvent(soundKey);
    }

    public static void playStepSound(Mob entity, XenomorphType type) {
        SoundEvent soundEvent = getAmbientSound(type);
        SoundHelper.playStepSound(entity, type, soundEvent);
    }

    public static SoundEvent getHumanAmbientSound() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.ambientSound, EntityConfigPaths.humanBaselineResourcePath(), "visual.ambient_sound");
    }

    public static SoundEvent getHumanHurtSound() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.hurtSound, EntityConfigPaths.humanBaselineResourcePath(), "visual.hurt_sound");
    }

    public static SoundEvent getHumanDeathSound() {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        return resolveSoundEvent(config.deathSound, EntityConfigPaths.humanBaselineResourcePath(), "visual.death_sound");
    }

    public static void playHumanStepSound(Mob entity) {
        SoundHelper.playHumanStepSound(entity, getHumanAmbientSound());
    }

    private static SoundEvent resolveSoundEvent(String soundRef, XenomorphType type, String fieldPath) {
        return resolveSoundEvent(soundRef, EntityConfigPaths.resourcePath(type), fieldPath);
    }

    private static SoundEvent resolveSoundEvent(String soundRef, String resourcePath, String fieldPath) {
        ResourceLocation soundLocation = parseSoundLocation(soundRef, resourcePath, fieldPath);
        return lookupRegisteredSound(soundLocation);
    }

    private static SoundEvent resolveModLocalSoundEvent(String soundKey) {
        ResourceLocation soundLocation = Objects.requireNonNull(
                ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, Objects.requireNonNull(soundKey)));
        return lookupRegisteredSound(soundLocation);
    }

    private static ResourceLocation parseSoundLocation(String soundRef, String resourcePath, String fieldPath) {
        if (soundRef == null || soundRef.isBlank()) {
            throw new ConfigContractException(
                    "XenomorphSoundRegistry", resourcePath, fieldPath, "required when entity config is loaded");
        }
        ResourceLocation location = ResourceLocation.tryParse(soundRef);
        if (location == null) {
            throw new ConfigContractException(
                    "XenomorphSoundRegistry", resourcePath, fieldPath,
                    "invalid ResourceLocation: " + soundRef);
        }
        return location;
    }

    private static SoundEvent lookupRegisteredSound(ResourceLocation soundLocation) {
        Holder.Reference<SoundEvent> holder = BuiltInRegistries.SOUND_EVENT
                .getHolder(Objects.requireNonNull(soundLocation))
                .orElse(null);
        if (holder != null && holder.isBound()) {
            return holder.value();
        }
        return null;
    }
}

FILE: XenomorphTypeHelper.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.api.XenomorphTyped;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * MC-layer helper: resolves {@link XenomorphType} from {@link LivingEntity} via {@link XenomorphTyped}.
 *
 * <p>Distinct from {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.growth.XenomorphTypeHelper}
 * which operates on {@code LivingEntityRef} through {@code BoundaryServices}. Do not merge.
 */
public final class XenomorphTypeHelper {

    public static XenomorphType getXenomorphType(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity == null || !entity.isAlive() || entity.isRemoved()) {
            return null;
        }
        if (entity instanceof XenomorphTyped typed) {
            return typed.getXenomorphType();
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static XenomorphType getXenomorphType(PathfinderMob entity) {
        XenomorphType type = getXenomorphType((LivingEntity) entity);
        return type != null ? type : XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER;
    }

    public static boolean isXenomorph(LivingEntity entity) {
        return getXenomorphType(entity) != null;
    }

    public static String getEntityTypeName(LivingEntity entity) {
        XenomorphType type = getXenomorphType(entity);
        if (type != null) {
            return switch (type) {
                case FACEHUGGER -> "Facehugger";
                case CHESTBURSTER -> "Chestburster";
                case DRONE -> "Drone";
                case GROWTH -> "Growth";
                case PRAETOR -> "Praetor";
                case QUEEN -> "Queen";
                case OVOMORPH -> "Ovomorph";
            };
        }
        return entity.getType().getDescription().getString();
    }

    private XenomorphTypeHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("XenomorphTypeHelper is a utility class");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.items;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResultHolder;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Item;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.TooltipFlag;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.CaptureEligibilityAdapter;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.CapturedEntitySnapshot;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.items.BaseItem;

/**
 * Capture Net — transport carrier only.
 *
 * <p>Asks {@link CaptureEligibilityAdapter#canCapture} and, if allowed, stores an entity
 * snapshot. Does not interpret organism type, fit, pens, or Admission.
 *
 * <p>L1 so it may import L0 boundary snapshot helpers (NDE); L1 admission sources identify
 * the item by registry id rather than this type.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-NET-001): melee capture playtest slice.
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-NET-002): throwable / launcher follow-on.
 */
public class CaptureNetItem extends BaseItem {

    public static final String REGISTRY_PATH = "capture_net";

    public CaptureNetItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public InteractionResult interactLivingEntity(
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull LivingEntity target,
            @Nonnull InteractionHand hand) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");
        Objects.requireNonNull(target, "target");
        Objects.requireNonNull(hand, "hand");

        if (player.level().isClientSide) {
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        if (CapturedEntitySnapshot.isFilled(stack)) {
            return InteractionResult.FAIL;
        }
        // Carrier ignorance: only capture-eligibility policy — no organism branches.
        if (!CaptureEligibilityAdapter.canCapture(target)) {
            return InteractionResult.FAIL;
        }

        ItemStack filled = stack.copy();
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.write(Objects.requireNonNull(filled), target);
        player.setItemInHand(hand, Objects.requireNonNull(filled));
        target.discard();

        player.level().playSound(
                null,
                Objects.requireNonNull(player.blockPosition()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(SoundEvents.WOOL_PLACE),
                SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                0.8f,
                1.1f);
        logItemUsage(player, "Captured entity into net");
        return InteractionResult.CONSUME;
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public InteractionResultHolder<ItemStack> use(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull InteractionHand hand) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");
        Objects.requireNonNull(hand, "hand");
        ItemStack stack = Objects.requireNonNull(player.getItemInHand(hand));
        if (!CapturedEntitySnapshot.isFilled(stack)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.pass(stack));
        }
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.success(stack));
        }
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.fail(stack));
        }
        ItemStack result = releaseIntoWorld(serverLevel, player, stack);
        if (result == null) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.fail(stack));
        }
        player.setItemInHand(hand, Objects.requireNonNull(result));
        return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.consume(result));
    }

    /**
     * @return emptied stack on success, or {@code null} on failure
     */
    @Nullable
    private ItemStack releaseIntoWorld(
            @Nonnull ServerLevel level,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Optional<EntityType<?>> typeOpt = CapturedEntitySnapshot.resolveType(stack);
        Optional<CompoundTag> rootOpt = CapturedEntitySnapshot.readRoot(stack);
        if (typeOpt.isEmpty() || rootOpt.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        Entity created = typeOpt.get().create(level);
        if (!(created instanceof LivingEntity living)) {
            if (created != null) {
                created.discard();
            }
            return null;
        }
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.applyTo(living, Objects.requireNonNull(rootOpt.get()));
        Vec3 look = player.getLookAngle();
        living.moveTo(
                player.getX() + look.x * 1.5,
                player.getY(),
                player.getZ() + look.z * 1.5,
                player.getYRot(),
                0.0F);
        living.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(Vec3.ZERO));
        living.fallDistance = 0.0F;
        if (!level.addFreshEntity(living)) {
            return null;
        }
        ItemStack emptied = Objects.requireNonNull(stack.copy());
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.clear(emptied);
        level.playSound(
                null,
                Objects.requireNonNull(player.blockPosition()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(SoundEvents.WOOL_BREAK),
                SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                0.8f,
                0.9f);
        logItemUsage(player, "Released entity from net");
        return emptied;
    }

    @Override
    public void appendHoverText(
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack,
            @Nullable Item.TooltipContext context,
            @Nonnull List<Component> tooltip,
            @Nonnull TooltipFlag flag) {
        super.appendHoverText(stack, Objects.requireNonNull(context), tooltip, flag);
        if (CapturedEntitySnapshot.isFilled(stack)) {
            String typeKey = CapturedEntitySnapshot.typeKey(stack).orElse("unknown");
            tooltip.add(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "tooltip.biocraft_alien.capture_net.filled", typeKey)));
            tooltip.add(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "tooltip.biocraft_alien.capture_net.release")));
        } else {
            tooltip.add(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "tooltip.biocraft_alien.capture_net.empty")));
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.items;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.component.CustomData;

/**
 * Opaque filled-marker helpers for {@link DnaVialItem} (FEATURE-DNA-VIAL-001).
 *
 * <p>Workflow state only — not DNA biology. Opaque payload must not be interpreted
 * outside DNA. Client contents overlay reads this marker for container occupancy only
 * (sample present); it must never imply DNA analysis or mutation state.
 */
public final class DnaVialItemHelper {

    /** Root key inside {@link DataComponents#CUSTOM_DATA}. */
    public static final String ROOT_KEY = "DnaVialOpaque";

    /** Non-interpretable presence token — not biology. */
    private static final String KEY_FILLED = "Filled";

    private DnaVialItemHelper() {
    }

    public static boolean isDnaVial(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        if (stack.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        ResourceLocation key = BuiltInRegistries.ITEM.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(stack.getItem()));
        return key != null && DnaVialItem.REGISTRY_PATH.equals(key.getPath());
    }

    public static boolean isEmpty(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return isDnaVial(stack) && !isFilled(stack);
    }

    public static boolean isFilled(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        if (!isDnaVial(stack)) {
            return false;
        }
        CustomData data = stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        CompoundTag custom = data.copyTag();
        if (!custom.contains(ROOT_KEY)) {
            return false;
        }
        CompoundTag root = custom.getCompound(ROOT_KEY);
        return root.getBoolean(KEY_FILLED);
    }

    /**
     * Marks the vial filled with an opaque token. Does not inspect entity biology.
     */
    public static void markFilled(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        if (!isDnaVial(stack)) {
            return;
        }
        CompoundTag root = new CompoundTag();
        root.putBoolean(KEY_FILLED, true);
        CompoundTag custom = stack.getOrDefault(
                Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.EMPTY)).copyTag();
        custom.put(ROOT_KEY, root);
        stack.set(
                Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA),
                Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.of(custom)));
    }

    public static void clear(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        CustomData data = stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        if (data == null || data.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        CompoundTag custom = data.copyTag();
        if (!custom.contains(ROOT_KEY)) {
            return;
        }
        custom.remove(ROOT_KEY);
        if (custom.isEmpty()) {
            stack.remove(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA));
        } else {
            stack.set(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_DATA),
                    Objects.requireNonNull(CustomData.of(custom)));
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.observation;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.decoration.ArmorStand;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.observation.MovementState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.observation.ObservationInstant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.observation.ObservationPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.detection.MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

/**
 * Minecraft adapter that supplies unfiltered motion facts for a scan window.
 */
public final class MotionTrackerObservationPort implements ObservationPort {

    private static final double MOVING_SPEED_SQR = 0.0025D;

    private final ObservationInstant instant;
    private final List<ObservationFact> facts;
    private final Map<UUID, LivingEntity> entitiesById;

    private MotionTrackerObservationPort(
            ObservationInstant instant,
            List<ObservationFact> facts,
            Map<UUID, LivingEntity> entitiesById) {
        this.instant = instant;
        this.facts = List.copyOf(facts);
        this.entitiesById = Map.copyOf(entitiesById);
    }

    public static MotionTrackerObservationPort scan(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull Player observer,
            double radius) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
        Objects.requireNonNull(observer, "observer");
        AABB scanArea = Objects.requireNonNull(observer.getBoundingBox()).inflate(radius);
        List<ObservationFact> facts = new ArrayList<>();
        Map<UUID, LivingEntity> byId = new HashMap<>();
        for (LivingEntity entity : level.getEntitiesOfClass(LivingEntity.class, Objects.requireNonNull(scanArea))) {
            if (entity == observer) {
                continue;
            }
            LivingEntityRef ref = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity);
            if (ref == null) {
                continue;
            }
            MovementState movement = classifyMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(entity));
            facts.add(new ObservationFact(ref, movement));
            byId.put(entity.getUUID(), entity);
        }
        long ordering = level.getGameTime();
        return new MotionTrackerObservationPort(new ObservationInstant(ordering), facts, byId);
    }

    @Override
    public ObservationInstant currentInstant() {
        return instant;
    }

    @Override
    public List<ObservationFact> facts() {
        return facts;
    }

    @Nullable
    public LivingEntity resolve(@Nonnull LivingEntityRef ref) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(ref, "ref");
        return entitiesById.get(ref.entityId());
    }

    public static MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.EntityTraits traits(
            @Nonnull LivingEntity entity,
            @Nonnull MovementState movement) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "entity");
        boolean player = entity instanceof Player;
        boolean armorStand = entity instanceof ArmorStand;
        boolean spectator = player && ((Player) entity).isSpectator();
        boolean friendlyMob = !player
                && !armorStand
                && entity.getType().getCategory().isFriendly();
        return new MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.EntityTraits(
                player, friendlyMob, armorStand, spectator, movement);
    }

    private static MovementState classifyMovement(@Nonnull LivingEntity entity) {
        Vec3 delta = entity.getDeltaMovement();
        if (delta == null) {
            return MovementState.STILL;
        }
        return delta.lengthSqr() > MOVING_SPEED_SQR ? MovementState.MOVING : MovementState.STILL;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.resources;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Function;

import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.io.ResourceValidator;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.resources.ResourceCache;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.resources.ResourceLoader;

/**
 * Orchestrator for resource management.
 * Coordinates loading, caching, and validation of resources.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FLUX
 */
public class ResourceManager {

    public static ResourceLocation getEntityTexture(XenomorphType type) {
        ResourceValidator.validateResourceType(type);

        String cacheKey = "texture_" + type.name();
        if (ResourceCache.isResourceCached(cacheKey)) {
            ModLogger.debug("ResourceManager", "Using cached texture: " + type);
            return ResourceCache.getCachedResource(cacheKey);
        }

        ModLogger.startTimer("TextureLoad_" + type.name());
        try {
            ResourceLocation resourceLocation = ResourceLoader.loadEntityTexture(type);
            ResourceCache.cacheResource(cacheKey, resourceLocation);
            ModLogger.success("ResourceManager", "Generated texture resource: " + resourceLocation);
            return resourceLocation;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("ResourceManager", "Failed to get entity texture for " + type + ": " + e.getMessage(), e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Failed to get entity texture", e);
        } finally {
            ModLogger.endTimer("TextureLoad_" + type.name());
        }
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getEntityModel(XenomorphType type) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadEntityModel(type);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getEntitySound(XenomorphType type, String soundType) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadEntitySound(type, soundType);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getMobTexture(String category, String hostType, String mobName) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadMobTexture(category, hostType, mobName);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getMobModel(String category, String hostType, String mobName) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadMobModel(category, hostType, mobName);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getMobSound(String category, String hostType, String mobName, String soundType) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadMobSound(category, hostType, mobName, soundType);
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getSpecialSound(String soundName) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadSpecialSound(soundName);
    }

    private static Map<XenomorphType, ResourceLocation> getAllResources(
            Function<XenomorphType, ResourceLocation> loader) {
        Map<XenomorphType, ResourceLocation> resources = new HashMap<>();
        for (XenomorphType type : XenomorphType.values()) {
            resources.put(type, loader.apply(type));
        }
        return resources;
    }

    public static Map<XenomorphType, ResourceLocation> getAllTextures() {
        return getAllResources(ResourceManager::getEntityTexture);
    }

    public static Map<XenomorphType, ResourceLocation> getAllModels() {
        return getAllResources(ResourceManager::getEntityModel);
    }

    public static boolean validateResourcePath(String path) {
        return ResourceValidator.validateResourcePath(path);
    }

    public static String buildConfigurablePath(String basePath) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadConfigurablePath(basePath);
    }

    public static void clearCache() {
        ResourceCache.clearCache();
    }

    public static String getCacheStats() {
        return ResourceCache.getCacheStats();
    }

    public static ResourceLocation getResourceWithFallback(String primaryPath, String fallbackPath) {
        return ResourceLoader.loadResourceWithFallback(primaryPath, fallbackPath);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.CommonGoalRegistrar;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * Base class for standard AI behavior patterns.
 * Provides common goal registration patterns shared across all species.
 * 
 * Species-specific AI classes can extend this or use its static methods.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class BaseStandardAI {
    
    /**
     * Registers standard AI goals using configuration parameters.
     * This is the basic mob behavior pattern shared across all species.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register goals for
     * @param aiGoals The AI goals configuration from JSON
     */
    public static void registerStandardGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        registerMovementAndMeleeGoals(entity, aiGoals);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStandardTargetingGoals(entity);
    }

    /**
     * Shared movement and melee attack registration for standard xenomorph AI patterns.
     */
    public static void registerMovementAndMeleeGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStandardMovementGoals(entity, aiGoals);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerMeleeAttackGoal(entity, 2, aiGoals.meleeAttackSpeed, false);
    }
    
    /**
     * Registers defensive AI goals with modified speeds.
     * Used by defensive entities (like humans) that are more cautious.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register goals for
     * @param aiGoals The AI goals configuration from JSON
     * @param defensiveSpeedMultiplier The multiplier for defensive speed (e.g., 0.8 for slower)
     */
    public static void registerDefensiveGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals, double defensiveSpeedMultiplier) {
        // Register standard movement goals with defensive speed modifications
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerFloatGoal(entity, 1);
        
        // Defensive melee attack - slower, more cautious
        double defensiveAttackSpeed = aiGoals.meleeAttackSpeed * defensiveSpeedMultiplier;
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerMeleeAttackGoal(entity, 2, defensiveAttackSpeed, false);
        
        // Cautious movement - slower, stays near safety
        double defensiveStrollSpeed = aiGoals.strollSpeed * (defensiveSpeedMultiplier * 0.75); // Even slower for movement
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStrollGoal(entity, 3, defensiveStrollSpeed);
        
        // Standard look range
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerLookAtPlayerGoal(entity, 4, aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerRandomLookAroundGoal(entity, 5);
        
        // Defensive targeting - only attack when threatened
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStandardTargetingGoals(entity);
    }
    
    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private BaseStandardAI() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("BaseStandardAI is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.nest.EggLayingPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.EggLayingWorkflow;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.EggLayingConfigAccess;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.EntityDetectionHelper;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * Spatial validation for queen egg laying.
 */
public final class EggLayingAreaValidator {

    private final EggLayingConfigAccess configAccess;

    public EggLayingAreaValidator(EggLayingConfigAccess configAccess) {
        this.configAccess = configAccess;
    }

    public boolean canLayEggInArea(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centerPos) {
        EggLayingWorkflow.Limits limits = configAccess.limits();
        var world = BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level);
        var center = BoundaryRefs.from(centerPos);

        int eggCount = countEggsInArea(world, center, limits);
        int chunkEggCount = countEggsInSameChunk(level, centerPos, limits);

        if (!EggLayingWorkflow.canLayInArea(eggCount, chunkEggCount, limits)) {
            if (!EggLayingPolicy.isChunkBelowEggLimit(chunkEggCount, limits.maxEggsPerChunk())) {
                ModLogger.info("EggLayingAreaValidator",
                        "Chunk egg limit reached: " + chunkEggCount + "/" + limits.maxEggsPerChunk());
            } else {
                ModLogger.info("EggLayingAreaValidator",
                        "Area egg limit reached: " + eggCount + "/" + limits.maxEggsInArea());
            }
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isSuitableEggLocation(ServerLevel level, BlockPosRef pos) {
        if (!isLocationClearOfEggs(BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level), pos, configAccess.getMinDistanceBetweenEggs())) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockPos blockPos = new BlockPos(pos.x(), pos.y(), pos.z());
        BlockState groundBlock = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(blockPos.below()));
        BlockState airBlock = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(blockPos));
        BlockState airAbove = level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(blockPos.above()));

        return groundBlock.canOcclude() && airBlock.isAir() && airAbove.isAir();
    }

    private int countEggsInArea(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef center, EggLayingWorkflow.Limits limits) {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            return 0;
        }
        return EggLayingWorkflow.countEggsInArea(
                BoundaryServices.worldQuery(),
                BoundaryServices.formQuery(),
                world,
                center,
                limits);
    }

    private boolean isLocationClearOfEggs(WorldRef world, BlockPosRef pos, int minDistance) {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            return true;
        }
        return EggLayingWorkflow.isLocationClearOfEggs(
                BoundaryServices.worldQuery(),
                BoundaryServices.formQuery(),
                world,
                pos,
                minDistance);
    }

    private int countEggsInSameChunk(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centerPos, EggLayingWorkflow.Limits limits) {
        int chunkEggCount = 0;
        int searchRadius = limits.searchRadius();

        for (int x = -searchRadius; x <= searchRadius; x++) {
            for (int z = -searchRadius; z <= searchRadius; z++) {
                for (int y = -limits.verticalSearchRange(); y <= limits.verticalSearchRange(); y++) {
                    BlockPos checkPos = centerPos.offset(x, y, z);
                    if (EntityDetectionHelper.hasOvomorphAt(level, checkPos)
                            && level.getChunkAt(Objects.requireNonNull(checkPos)).getPos().equals(level.getChunkAt(centerPos).getPos())) {
                        chunkEggCount++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return chunkEggCount;
    }
}

FILE: FleeFromThreatsGoal.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary.NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter;

import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Goal for fleeing from threats when the chestburster cannot win a fight.
 * Creative / spectator players are excluded by {@code NeoForgeCombatThreatAdapter} (observers).
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 */
public class FleeFromThreatsGoal extends Goal {
    private final PathfinderMob entity;
    private final EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals;
    private LivingEntity threat;
    private int repathCooldown;

    public FleeFromThreatsGoal(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        this.entity = entity;
        this.aiGoals = aiGoals;
        this.setFlags(Objects.requireNonNull(EnumSet.of(Flag.MOVE)));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        return refreshThreat() != null;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        return refreshThreat() != null;
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        repathCooldown = 0;
        ModLogger.info("FleeFromThreatsGoal", "🏃 Chestburster fleeing from threat");
        pathAwayFromThreat();
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        if (threat == null) {
            return;
        }
        entity.getLookControl().setLookAt(Objects.requireNonNull(threat), 30.0f, 30.0f);
        if (--repathCooldown <= 0 || entity.getNavigation().isDone()) {
            pathAwayFromThreat();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void stop() {
        threat = null;
        entity.getNavigation().stop();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresUpdateEveryTick() {
        return true;
    }

    private LivingEntity refreshThreat() {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized() || entity.level() == null) {
            threat = null;
            return null;
        }
        double fleeDistance = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(aiGoals, "flee_distance");
        Optional<LivingEntityRef> threatRef = BoundaryServices.combatThreat()
                .findNearestCombatThreat(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(Objects.requireNonNull(entity)), fleeDistance);
        this.threat = threatRef
                .filter(ref -> entity.level() instanceof ServerLevel)
                .map(ref -> ((ServerLevel) Objects.requireNonNull(entity.level()))
                        .getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId())))
                .filter(LivingEntity.class::isInstance)
                .map(LivingEntity.class::cast)
                .filter(living -> living.isAlive())
                .orElse(null);

        if (threat != null && entity.distanceTo(Objects.requireNonNull(threat)) >= fleeDistance) {
            threat = null;
        }
        return threat;
    }

    private void pathAwayFromThreat() {
        if (threat == null) {
            return;
        }
        Vec3 threatPos = Objects.requireNonNull(threat.position());
        Vec3 entityPos = Objects.requireNonNull(entity.position());
        Vec3 fleeDirection = Objects.requireNonNull(entityPos.subtract(threatPos).normalize());

        Vec3 fleePos = NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter.searchVec3InRadius(
                entity,
                fleeDirection,
                8.0,
                10,
                pos -> entity.level().getBlockState(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(BlockPos.containing(Objects.requireNonNull(pos)))).isAir());

        if (fleePos != null) {
            double escapeSpeedMultiplier = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(
                    aiGoals, "escape_speed_multiplier");
            entity.getNavigation().moveTo(
                    fleePos.x, fleePos.y, fleePos.z, aiGoals.strollSpeed * escapeSpeedMultiplier);
            repathCooldown = 20;
        } else {
            ModLogger.warn("FleeFromThreatsGoal", "⚠️ Could not find safe flee position");
            repathCooldown = 10;
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIConfigResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_3.ai.ChestbursterHidePolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary.NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.LightLayer;

/**
 * Goal for hiding in dark places.
 * Extracted from EscapeAndHideBehaviorCoordinator for single responsibility.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.0.2
 */
public class HideInDarkPlacesGoal extends Goal {
    private final PathfinderMob entity;
    private final EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals;
    private BlockPos hidePos;
    
    public HideInDarkPlacesGoal(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        this.entity = entity;
        this.aiGoals = aiGoals;
    }
    
    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            return false;
        }
        double threatRadius = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(aiGoals, "safety_search_radius");
        boolean hasThreats = BoundaryServices.combatThreat()
                .hasCombatThreatNearby(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(Objects.requireNonNull(entity)), threatRadius);

        if (!ChestbursterHidePolicy.shouldSeekHide(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity), hasThreats)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        ModLogger.debug("HideInDarkPlacesGoal", "🌑 Threats detected, seeking dark hiding place");
        return true;
    }
    
    @Override
    public void start() {
        this.hidePos = findDarkHidingSpot();
        if (hidePos != null) {
            ModLogger.debug("HideInDarkPlacesGoal", "🏃 Moving to dark hiding spot: " + hidePos.toString());
            if (entity.level() != null) {
                ModLogger.debug("HideInDarkPlacesGoal", "✅ Found dark hiding spot at light level: " + entity.level().getBrightness(LightLayer.BLOCK, Objects.requireNonNull(hidePos)));
            }
            entity.getNavigation().moveTo(hidePos.getX(), hidePos.getY(), hidePos.getZ(), aiGoals.strollSpeed);
        } else {
            ModLogger.warn("HideInDarkPlacesGoal", "⚠️ Could not find suitable dark hiding spot");
        }
    }
    
    private BlockPos findDarkHidingSpot() {
        double maxSearchRadius = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(aiGoals, "hide_search_radius");
        int searchAttempts = AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromMovement(aiGoals, "search_attempts");
        int lightLevelDark = AIConfigResolver.getLightLevelDark(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER);
        
        return NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter.searchBlockPosInRadius(
            entity,
            maxSearchRadius,
            searchAttempts,
            pos -> {
                if (entity.level() == null) {
                    return false;
                }
                WorldRef world = BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(entity.level());
                BlockPosRef ref = BoundaryRefs.from(pos);
                int brightness = entity.level().getBrightness(LightLayer.BLOCK, Objects.requireNonNull(pos));
                return ChestbursterHidePolicy.isValidHideSpot(world, ref, brightness, lightLevelDark);
            }
        );
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.IronGolem;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.animal.SnowGolem;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.npc.AbstractVillager;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

/**
 * Helper class for registering standard targeting goals across form packages.
 * Centralizes duplicate targeting logic from DroneAI and QueenAI to eliminate DRY violations.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.7
 */
public class StandardTargetingHelper {

    /**
     * Registers standard targeting goals for xenomorph entities.
     * Registers: HurtByTargetGoal, Player, Villager, Animal, Golem, SnowGolem, LivingEntity.
     * DRY: Extracted from DroneAI and QueenAI to eliminate duplicate targeting code.
     *
     * @param entity The entity to register targeting goals for
     * @param type   xenomorph type whose {@code goal_priorities} map supplies slot ordering
     */
    public static void registerStandardTargetingGoals(PathfinderMob entity, XenomorphType type) {
        // Stay clear of claimed / facehugged / gestating hosts (siblings incubating).
        entity.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "avoid_hosts"),
                new AvoidLifecycleHostGoal(entity));

        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerHurtByTargetGoal(
                entity, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "hurt_by_target"));

        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "target_player"),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, Player.class, true,
                        living -> XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living))));
        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "target_villager"),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, AbstractVillager.class, true,
                        living -> XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living))));
        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "target_animal"),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, Animal.class, true,
                        living -> XenomorphTargetingHelper.isValidTargetEntity(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living))));

        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "target_iron_golem"),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, IronGolem.class, true));
        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "target_snow_golem"),
                new NearestAttackableTargetGoal<>(entity, SnowGolem.class, true));

        entity.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(type, "prioritized_host"),
                new PrioritizedHostTargetGoal(entity));
    }

    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private StandardTargetingHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("StandardTargetingHelper is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;

/**
 * L4 indirection for specimen-pod block entity type (breaks L5 com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.blocks.ModBlockEntities ↔ Bootstrap cycle).
 *
 * <p>NDE escape hatch: registration lives at {@code level_5} while this supplier indirection
 * at {@code level_2} lets L2 specimen-pod behavior reference the block entity type without a
 * compile-time import of the L5 registration class.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry {

    private static Supplier<BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity>> supplier;

    private ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry() {
    }

    public static void register(Supplier<BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity>> typeSupplier) {
        supplier = typeSupplier;
    }

    public static BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity> get() {
        if (supplier == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry not initialized");
        }
        return supplier.get();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.ItemInteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.BlockItem;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.context.BlockPlaceContext;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.EntityBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Mirror;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Rotation;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityTicker;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.BlockStateProperties;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.properties.DirectionProperty;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenVariant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseLabBlock;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Controller block for the containment pen multiblock structure.
 *
 * <p>Thin Minecraft block adapter: registration/ticker/use hooks and variant identity.
 * Player interaction outcomes live in {@link ContainmentPenInteractions}; structure I/O in the port adapter.
 *
 * <p>Shell proxies call {@link #interactAtController}.
 */
public class ContainmentPenControllerBlock extends BaseLabBlock implements EntityBlock {

    public static final DirectionProperty FACING = BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_FACING;

    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = createFullBlockShape();

    protected final ContainmentPenVariant variant;

    public ContainmentPenControllerBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties) {
        this(properties, ContainmentPenVariant.GENERIC);
    }

    protected ContainmentPenControllerBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties, ContainmentPenVariant variant) {
        super(properties);
        this.variant = variant;
        registerDefaultState(Objects.requireNonNull(
                stateDefinition.any().setValue(Objects.requireNonNull(FACING), Direction.NORTH)));
    }

    public static ContainmentPenControllerBlock forVariant(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties, ContainmentPenVariant variant) {
        return new ContainmentPenControllerBlock(properties, variant);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public ContainmentPenVariant variant() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(variant);
    }

    /**
     * Shared entry for controller and shell proxies. Resolves variant, then delegates interaction SRP.
     */
    @Nonnull
    public static InteractionResult interactAtController(
            @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos, @Nonnull Player player) {
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(controllerPos);
        if (!(blockEntity instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity)) {
            return InteractionResult.PASS;
        }

        ContainmentPenVariant resolved = ContainmentPenVariant.GENERIC;
        if (level.getBlockState(controllerPos).getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenControllerBlock controller) {
            resolved = controller.variant();
        }
        return ContainmentPenInteractions.interact(
                level, controllerPos, player, Objects.requireNonNull(resolved), podEntity);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getBlockShape() {
        return SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(@Nonnull StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(FACING);
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public BlockState getStateForPlacement(@Nonnull BlockPlaceContext context) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(defaultBlockState()
                .setValue(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(FACING),
                        Objects.requireNonNull(context.getHorizontalDirection().getOpposite())));
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    protected BlockState rotate(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull Rotation rotation) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(state.setValue(
                Objects.requireNonNull(FACING),
                Objects.requireNonNull(rotation.rotate(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(FACING)))))));
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    protected BlockState mirror(@Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull Mirror mirror) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(state.rotate(Objects.requireNonNull(
                mirror.getRotation(Objects.requireNonNull(state.getValue(Objects.requireNonNull(FACING)))))));
    }

    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        return ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration.create(pos, state);
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(
            @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            return null;
        }
        return ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration.serverTicker();
    }

    @Override
    protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        return interactAtController(level, pos, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack,
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        // Allow placing the last build block against the controller instead of consuming the click.
        if (stack.getItem() instanceof BlockItem) {
            return ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
        }
        InteractionResult result = interactAtController(level, pos, player);
        return result.consumesAction()
                ? ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS
                : ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRemove(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull BlockState newState,
            boolean isMoving) {
        if (!state.is(Objects.requireNonNull(newState.getBlock()))) {
            BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(pos);
            if (blockEntity instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity) {
                podEntity.breakStructure();
            }
        }
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
    }
}
