package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.Direction;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.handling.HandlingResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ContainmentFitRules;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.HorizontalFacing;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.InteriorVolume;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenVariant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Form / admit / release / status interaction for containment pens.
 *
 * <p>Single responsibility: player-facing interaction outcomes against an already-resolved
 * controller {@link ContainmentPenBlockEntity}. Does not own block registration or multiblock I/O.
 *
 * <p>Variant is passed in so this type never depends on {@code ContainmentPenControllerBlock}
 * (avoids same-layer cycles under NDE).
 */
public final class ContainmentPenInteractions {

    private ContainmentPenInteractions() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static InteractionResult interact(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity) {
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        if (!podEntity.isFormed()) {
            handleStructureFormation(podEntity, player, controllerPos, variant);
        } else {
            handleFormedStructureInteraction(podEntity, player, level, controllerPos, variant);
        }
        return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    /**
     * One-shot incomplete→complete formation. No-op if already formed or layout incomplete.
     *
     * @return true when this call newly formed the structure
     */
    public static boolean tryFormIfComplete(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant,
            @Nullable Player player) {
        if (podEntity.isFormed()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!podEntity.validateStructure()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!podEntity.isFormed()) {
            return false;
        }
        completeFormation(podEntity, controllerPos, variant, player);
        return true;
    }

    private static void handleStructureFormation(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant) {
        if (tryFormIfComplete(podEntity, pos, variant, player)) {
            return;
        }
        player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(
                Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.invalid_structure")));
        ModLogger.debug(variant.logPrefix(), "Invalid structure attempt by " + player.getName().getString() + " at " + pos);
    }

    private static void completeFormation(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant,
            @Nullable Player player) {
        // Variant specimenType stays presentation-only; do not overload with occupant identity.
        podEntity.setSpecimenType(Objects.requireNonNull(variant.specimenType()));
        podEntity.restoreIntegrityAfterFormation();
        podEntity.syncToClient();
        if (player != null) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(variant.translationPrefix()) + ".structure_formed")));
        }
        ModLogger.info(
                variant.logPrefix(),
                "Structure formed"
                        + (player != null ? " by " + player.getName().getString() : "")
                        + " at "
                        + pos);
    }

    private static void handleFormedStructureInteraction(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant) {
        if (podEntity.hasSpecimen()) {
            if (player.isShiftKeyDown()) {
                HandlingResult result = releaseOccupantOutside(podEntity, level, player);
                if (result.accepted()) {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(
                            Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.released")));
                } else {
                    player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                            "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.release_failed",
                            result.reason() == null ? "unknown" : result.reason())));
                }
            } else if (player instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer serverPlayer
                    && com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks.open(
                            serverPlayer, pos)) {
                // Occupied: open Admission/Extraction menu (sneak still releases to world).
            } else {
                player.sendSystemMessage(podEntity.formatStatusMessage(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(variant.translationPrefix())));
            }
            return;
        }

        LivingEntity candidate = findNearestAdmittable(level, pos, podEntity, player);
        if (candidate != null) {
            InteriorVolume interior = podEntity.getInteriorVolume();
            if (interior == null
                    || !ContainmentFitRules.fits(
                            interior.extentX(),
                            interior.extentY(),
                            interior.extentZ(),
                            candidate.getBbWidth(),
                            candidate.getBbHeight())) {
                player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.too_large")));
                ModLogger.info(
                        variant.logPrefix(),
                        "Admit rejected — entity does not fit interior: " + candidate.getUUID());
                return;
            }

            LivingEntityRef ref = Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(candidate));
            HandlingResult result = podEntity.requestAdmit(ref);
            if (result.accepted()) {
                teleportIntoInterior(candidate, pos, interior);
                podEntity.setOccupantDisplayNameInternal(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(candidate.getDisplayName().getString()));
                podEntity.syncToClient();
                player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.admitted",
                        candidate.getDisplayName())));
                ModLogger.info(variant.logPrefix(), "Admitted " + candidate.getUUID() + " at " + pos);
            } else {
                player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.admit_failed",
                        result.reason() == null ? "unknown" : result.reason())));
            }
            return;
        }

        // No nearby living specimen — open Admission menu for PortableSpecimen carriers.
        if (player instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer serverPlayer
                && com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks.open(
                        serverPlayer, pos)) {
            return;
        }
        player.sendSystemMessage(podEntity.formatEmptyMessage(
                Objects.requireNonNull(variant.translationPrefix())));
    }

    /**
     * Release clears membership then moves the living entity outside the sealed volume so it
     * is not stranded at the interior cell.
     */
    private static HandlingResult releaseOccupantOutside(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull Player player) {
        UUID occupantId = podEntity.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal().orElse(null);
        if (occupantId == null) {
            return HandlingResult.rejected("containment has no occupant");
        }
        LivingEntityRef ref = new LivingEntityRef(occupantId, BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level));
        HandlingResult result = podEntity.requestRelease(ref);
        if (!result.accepted()) {
            return result;
        }
        podEntity.clearOccupantDisplayNameInternal();
        if (level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) {
            LivingEntity living = findLivingByUuid(serverLevel, occupantId);
            if (living != null) {
                teleportOutsideVolume(living, podEntity);
            }
        }
        podEntity.syncToClient();
        return result;
    }

    private static void teleportIntoInterior(
            LivingEntity entity, BlockPos controllerPos, InteriorVolume interior) {
        entity.teleportTo(
                controllerPos.getX() + interior.centerX(),
                controllerPos.getY() + interior.centerY(),
                controllerPos.getZ() + interior.centerZ());
        entity.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(Vec3.ZERO));
        entity.fallDistance = 0.0F;
        entity.setOnGround(true);
    }

    private static void teleportOutsideVolume(LivingEntity entity, ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity) {
        BlockPos controllerPos = podEntity.getBlockPos();
        HorizontalFacing outward = podEntity.getOutwardFacing();
        Direction face = toMc(outward);
        BlockPos outside = controllerPos.relative(Objects.requireNonNull(face), 1);
        entity.teleportTo(outside.getX() + 0.5, controllerPos.getY(), outside.getZ() + 0.5);
        entity.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(Vec3.ZERO));
        entity.fallDistance = 0.0F;
    }

    private static Direction toMc(@Nullable HorizontalFacing facing) {
        if (facing == null) {
            return Direction.SOUTH;
        }
        return switch (facing) {
            case NORTH -> Direction.NORTH;
            case SOUTH -> Direction.SOUTH;
            case WEST -> Direction.WEST;
            case EAST -> Direction.EAST;
        };
    }

    @Nullable
    private static LivingEntity findLivingByUuid(ServerLevel level, UUID id) {
        var found = level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(id));
        return found instanceof LivingEntity living && living.isAlive() ? living : null;
    }

    @Nullable
    private static LivingEntity findNearestAdmittable(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity,
            @Nonnull Player player) {
        AABB box = volumeAabb(controllerPos, podEntity).inflate(0.25);
        InteriorVolume interior = podEntity.getInteriorVolume();
        double cx = controllerPos.getX() + (interior != null ? interior.centerX() : 0.5);
        double cy = controllerPos.getY() + (interior != null ? interior.centerY() + 0.5 : 1.5);
        double cz = controllerPos.getZ() + (interior != null ? interior.centerZ() : 0.5);
        List<LivingEntity> candidates = level.getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                Objects.requireNonNull(box),
                entity -> entity.isAlive() && entity != player && !(entity instanceof Player));
        return candidates.stream()
                .min(Comparator.comparingDouble(e -> e.distanceToSqr(cx, cy, cz)))
                .orElse(null);
    }

    static AABB volumeAabb(BlockPos controllerPos, ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity) {
        InteriorVolume interior = podEntity.getInteriorVolume();
        if (interior != null) {
            return new AABB(
                    controllerPos.getX() + interior.minX() - 1,
                    controllerPos.getY() + interior.minY() - 1,
                    controllerPos.getZ() + interior.minZ() - 1,
                    controllerPos.getX() + interior.maxX() + 2,
                    controllerPos.getY() + interior.maxY() + 2,
                    controllerPos.getZ() + interior.maxZ() + 2);
        }
        int w = Math.max(1, podEntity.getStructureWidth() / 2);
        int h = Math.max(1, podEntity.getStructureHeight() - 1);
        return new AABB(
                controllerPos.getX() - w,
                controllerPos.getY(),
                controllerPos.getZ() - w,
                controllerPos.getX() + w + 1,
                controllerPos.getY() + h + 1,
                controllerPos.getZ() + w + 1);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks;

import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.ItemInteractionResult;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.research.ResearchResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.observation.ObservationSnapshot;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.research.ResearchRecord;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.research.ResearchCapture;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.research.ResearchEquipmentPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.observation.ObservationService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.research.ResearchEquipmentPortDelegate;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseLabBlock;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.observation.MotionTrackerObservationPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.research.WorldResearchPort;

/**
 * Observation Capture Terminal — L3 ingress/presentation only.
 *
 * <p>Collects an observation and hands off via delegated {@link ResearchEquipmentPort}.
 * Does not validate, allowlist, persist, or sample.
 */
public class ObservationCaptureTerminalBlock extends BaseLabBlock {

    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = createFullBlockShape();
    private static final double CAPTURE_RANGE = 4.0D;

    public ObservationCaptureTerminalBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getBlockShape() {
        return SHAPE;
    }

    @Override
    protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        return capture(level, pos, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack,
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        InteractionResult result = capture(level, pos, player);
        return result.consumesAction()
                ? ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS
                : ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
    }

    private InteractionResult capture(Level level, BlockPos pos, Player player) {
        if (level.isClientSide) {
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return InteractionResult.PASS;
        }

        LivingEntity target = findNearest(serverLevel, pos, player);
        if (target == null) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(
                    Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.research.no_target")));
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        MotionTrackerObservationPort observationPort =
                MotionTrackerObservationPort.scan(serverLevel, Objects.requireNonNull(player), CAPTURE_RANGE);
        LivingEntityRef ref = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target);
        Optional<ObservationSnapshot> snapshot = ObservationService.observe(observationPort, ref);
        if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
            // Target may be outside scan relative to player; re-scan around block using player as observer.
            snapshot = ObservationService.observe(observationPort).stream()
                    .filter(s -> ref.equals(s.entity()))
                    .findFirst();
        }
        if (snapshot.isEmpty()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(
                    Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.research.no_target")));
            return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
        }

        ResearchRecord record = ResearchCapture.fromObservation(snapshot.get());
        ResearchEquipmentPort equipment = new ResearchEquipmentPortDelegate(new WorldResearchPort(serverLevel));
        ResearchResult result = equipment.submitRecord(record);
        if (result.accepted()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(
                    Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.research.capture_accepted")));
        } else {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.research.capture_rejected",
                    result.reason() == null ? "unknown" : result.reason())));
        }
        return InteractionResult.SUCCESS;
    }

    private static LivingEntity findNearest(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, Player player) {
        AABB box = new AABB(Objects.requireNonNull(pos)).inflate(CAPTURE_RANGE);
        List<LivingEntity> candidates = level.getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                Objects.requireNonNull(box),
                entity -> entity.isAlive() && entity != player && !(entity instanceof Player));
        return candidates.stream()
                .min(Comparator.comparingDouble(
                        e -> e.distanceToSqr(pos.getX() + 0.5, pos.getY() + 0.5, pos.getZ() + 0.5)))
                .orElse(null);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseXenomorphBlock;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

/**
 * Spiny Block - Decorative xenomorph body part blocks.
 * Used as decorative elements in nest structures.
 * Multiple variants represent different body parts (spine, arm, head, etc.).
 * 
 * Extends BaseXenomorphBlock to inherit common xenomorph block properties
 * and standardized logging. Implements DRY principle by using base class
 * functionality while providing decorative-specific characteristics.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class SpinyBlock extends BaseXenomorphBlock {
    
    private static final VoxelShape SHAPE = Block.box(0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 16.0D, 16.0D, 16.0D);
    
    /**
     * Constructs a SpinyBlock with the specified properties.
     * Used by DeferredRegister.Blocks.registerBlock() which automatically sets the block ID.
     * 
     * @param properties The block properties (with ID already set)
     */
    public SpinyBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getBlockShape() {
        return SHAPE;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.particles.ParticleTypes;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.attributes.AttributeModifier;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.common.NeoForgeMod;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentCondition;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.Vec3Ref;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.parasite.AttachmentGeometry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.spawn.SpawnContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.entity.EntityPresentationPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.AttachmentEntryStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.boundary.LeapImpulseStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;

public final class NeoForgeEntityPresentationAdapter implements EntityPresentationPort {

    private static final ResourceLocation FACEHUGGER_FLIGHT_LOCK_ID = Objects.requireNonNull(
            ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(ModContext.MOD_ID, "facehugger_attachment_flight_lock"));
    private static final int MAX_ATTACHMENT_ENTRY_TICKS = 8;

    private final MinecraftServer server;
    private final AttachmentEntryStrategy attachmentEntryStrategy = new LeapImpulseStrategy();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, AttachmentEntrySession> attachmentEntrySessions =
            new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public NeoForgeEntityPresentationAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public String displayName(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.getDisplayName().getString()).orElse("");
    }

    @Override
    public float healthRatio(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(entity -> entity.getHealth() / entity.getMaxHealth())
                .orElse(1.0f);
    }

    @Override
    public float maxHealth(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.getMaxHealth()).orElse(0.0f);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyMagicDamage(LivingEntityRef target, float amount) {
        resolve(target).ifPresent(living -> living.hurt(
                Objects.requireNonNull(living.damageSources().magic()), amount));
    }

    @Override
    public void kill(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(living -> living.hurt(
                Objects.requireNonNull(living.damageSources().magic()), Float.MAX_VALUE));
    }

    @Override
    public void spawnDamageIndicatorParticles(LivingEntityRef ref, int count, float spread) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(living -> {
            if (living.level() instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                serverLevel.sendParticles(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(ParticleTypes.DAMAGE_INDICATOR),
                        living.getX(),
                        living.getY() + living.getBbHeight() * 0.5,
                        living.getZ(),
                        count,
                        spread, spread, spread,
                        0.1);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void spawnExplosionParticles(LivingEntityRef ref, int count, float spread) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(living -> {
            if (living.level() instanceof net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel serverLevel) {
                serverLevel.sendParticles(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(ParticleTypes.EXPLOSION),
                        living.getX(),
                        living.getY() + living.getBbHeight() * 0.5,
                        living.getZ(),
                        count,
                        spread, spread, spread,
                        0.5);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public SpawnContext spawnContextAt(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref)
                .map(living -> SpawnContext.at(
                        BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(living.level()),
                        living.getX(),
                        living.getY(),
                        living.getZ(),
                        living.getYRot(),
                        living.getXRot(),
                        living.getYHeadRot()))
                .orElseGet(() -> SpawnContext.at(
                        BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(server.overworld()), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0));
    }

    @Override
    public void setInvulnerable(LivingEntityRef ref, boolean value) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> entity.setInvulnerable(value));
    }

    @Override
    public void setNoGravity(LivingEntityRef ref, boolean value) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> entity.setNoGravity(value));
    }

    @Override
    public void setDeltaMovement(LivingEntityRef ref, double x, double y, double z) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> entity.setDeltaMovement(x, y, z));
    }

    @Override
    public void setRotation(LivingEntityRef ref, float yRot, float xRot) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            entity.setYRot(yRot);
            entity.setXRot(xRot);
        });
    }

    @Override
    public Vec3Ref getAttachmentPoint(LivingEntityRef host, double heightRatio) {
        return resolve(host)
                .map(h -> AttachmentGeometry.attachmentPoint(
                        h.getX(),
                        h.getY(),
                        h.getZ(),
                        h.getYRot(),
                        h.getBbWidth(),
                        h.getBbHeight(),
                        heightRatio,
                        h.getEyeHeight()))
                .orElse(null);
    }

    @Override
    public double distanceToAttachmentPoint(LivingEntityRef parasite, LivingEntityRef host, double heightRatio) {
        LivingEntity parasiteEntity = resolve(parasite).orElse(null);
        Vec3Ref point = getAttachmentPoint(host, heightRatio);
        if (parasiteEntity == null || point == null) {
            return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        }
        return AttachmentGeometry.distance(
                new Vec3Ref(parasiteEntity.getX(), parasiteEntity.getY(), parasiteEntity.getZ()),
                point);
    }

    @Override
    public double horizontalDistanceToAttachmentPoint(
            LivingEntityRef parasite,
            LivingEntityRef host,
            double heightRatio) {
        LivingEntity parasiteEntity = resolve(parasite).orElse(null);
        Vec3Ref point = getAttachmentPoint(host, heightRatio);
        if (parasiteEntity == null || point == null) {
            return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        }
        return AttachmentGeometry.horizontalDistance(
                new Vec3Ref(parasiteEntity.getX(), parasiteEntity.getY(), parasiteEntity.getZ()),
                point);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean performAttachmentEntry(
            LivingEntityRef parasite,
            LivingEntityRef host,
            double heightRatio,
            double latchReach) {
        LivingEntity parasiteEntity = resolve(parasite).orElse(null);
        Vec3Ref point = getAttachmentPoint(host, heightRatio);
        if (parasiteEntity == null || host == null || point == null) {
            return false;
        }

        UUID parasiteId = parasiteEntity.getUUID();
        AttachmentEntrySession session = attachmentEntrySessions.get(parasiteId);
        if (session == null || !session.hostId().equals(host.entityId())) {
            attachmentEntryStrategy.begin(
                    parasiteEntity,
                    new Vec3(point.x(), point.y(), point.z()));
            attachmentEntrySessions.put(
                    parasiteId,
                    new AttachmentEntrySession(host.entityId(), parasiteEntity.tickCount));
            return false;
        }

        double distance = AttachmentGeometry.distance(
                new Vec3Ref(parasiteEntity.getX(), parasiteEntity.getY(), parasiteEntity.getZ()),
                point);
        boolean reachedSeat = distance <= Math.max(0.35D, latchReach);
        boolean entryTimedOut = parasiteEntity.tickCount - session.startTick() >= MAX_ATTACHMENT_ENTRY_TICKS;
        if (reachedSeat || entryTimedOut) {
            attachmentEntrySessions.remove(parasiteId, session);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void positionOnHost(LivingEntityRef facehugger, LivingEntityRef host, double faceHeightRatio) {
        resolve(facehugger).ifPresent(fh -> {
            Vec3Ref point = getAttachmentPoint(host, faceHeightRatio);
            if (point == null) {
                return;
            }
            fh.setPos(point.x(), point.y(), point.z());
            fh.setNoGravity(true);
            fh.setDeltaMovement(0, 0, 0);
            attachmentEntrySessions.remove(fh.getUUID());
        });
    }

    @Override
    public double distance(LivingEntityRef a, LivingEntityRef b) {
        LivingEntity first = resolve(a).orElse(null);
        LivingEntity second = resolve(b).orElse(null);
        if (first == null || second == null) {
            return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        }
        return first.distanceTo(second);
    }

    @Override
    public int tickCount(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.tickCount).orElse(0);
    }

    @Override
    public long currentGameTime(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        return resolve(ref).map(entity -> entity.level().getGameTime()).orElse(0L);
    }

    @Override
    public void releaseUsingItem(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            if (entity.isUsingItem()) {
                entity.releaseUsingItem();
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void applyPlayerAttachmentPose(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref)
                .filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)
                .map(entity -> (Player) entity)
                .ifPresent(player -> {
            player.setXRot(90.0f);
            player.setSprinting(false);
            player.setSwimming(false);
            player.setJumping(false);
            player.getAbilities().flying = false;
            lockCreativeFlight(player);
            player.getAbilities().invulnerable = false;
            player.getAbilities().mayBuild = false;
            player.onUpdateAbilities();
            player.stopUsingItem();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void restorePlayerAttachmentPose(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref)
                .filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player)
                .map(entity -> (Player) entity)
                .ifPresent(player -> {
            player.setXRot(0.0f);
            player.getAbilities().mayBuild = true;
            unlockCreativeFlight(player);
            player.getAbilities().flying = false;
            player.onUpdateAbilities();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void freezeMobHost(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                mob.getNavigation().stop();
                mob.setNoAi(true);
                mob.setTarget(null);
                mob.setDeltaMovement(0, 0, 0);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void unfreezeMobHost(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                mob.setNoAi(false);
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void applyAttachmentCondition(LivingEntityRef ref, AttachmentCondition condition) {
        if (condition == null) {
            return;
        }
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            switch (condition) {
                case DISABLE_MOVEMENT -> {
                    entity.setDeltaMovement(0, 0, 0);
                    if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                        mob.getNavigation().stop();
                        mob.setNoAi(true);
                        mob.setTarget(null);
                    }
                }
                case DISABLE_ATTACKING -> {
                    if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                        mob.setTarget(null);
                    }
                }
                case DISABLE_JUMPING -> entity.setJumping(false);
                case DISABLE_SPRINTING -> entity.setSprinting(false);
                case DISABLE_SWIMMING -> entity.setSwimming(false);
                case DISABLE_FLYING -> {
                    if (entity instanceof Player player) {
                        player.getAbilities().flying = false;
                        lockCreativeFlight(player);
                        player.onUpdateAbilities();
                    }
                }
                case DISABLE_USING_ITEMS -> {
                    if (entity.isUsingItem()) {
                        entity.releaseUsingItem();
                    }
                }
                case DISABLE_LOOKING, DISABLE_RIDING, DISABLE_BREAKING_BLOCKS,
                        DISABLE_PLACING_BLOCKS, DISABLE_INTERACTING -> {
                    // Enforced via no-AI for mobs; player interaction hooks can bind later.
                    if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                        mob.setNoAi(true);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void clearAttachmentConditions(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        resolve(ref).ifPresent(entity -> {
            if (entity instanceof Mob mob) {
                mob.setNoAi(false);
            }
            if (entity instanceof Player player) {
                unlockCreativeFlight(player);
                player.onUpdateAbilities();
            }
        });
    }

    private static void lockCreativeFlight(Player player) {
        var flight = player.getAttribute(Objects.requireNonNull(NeoForgeMod.CREATIVE_FLIGHT));
        if (flight != null && !flight.hasModifier(Objects.requireNonNull(FACEHUGGER_FLIGHT_LOCK_ID))) {
            flight.addTransientModifier(new AttributeModifier(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(FACEHUGGER_FLIGHT_LOCK_ID),
                    -1.0,
                    AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL));
        }
    }

    private static void unlockCreativeFlight(Player player) {
        var flight = player.getAttribute(Objects.requireNonNull(NeoForgeMod.CREATIVE_FLIGHT));
        if (flight != null) {
            flight.removeModifier(Objects.requireNonNull(FACEHUGGER_FLIGHT_LOCK_ID));
        }
    }

    private record AttachmentEntrySession(UUID hostId, int startTick) {
    }

    private Optional<LivingEntity> resolve(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        if (ref == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(level -> {
                    var entity = level.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        return Optional.of(living);
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                });
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.boundary;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIConfigResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.SurvivalSuffocationPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.XenomorphTypeHelper;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * L3 survival probe: reads MC entity state and applies L2 suffocation policy.
 */
public final class NeoForgeSuffocationProbe {

    private NeoForgeSuffocationProbe() {}

    public static boolean isSuffocating(PathfinderMob entity) {
        if (entity.isInWall()) {
            ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeSuffocationProbe", "Entity detected as in wall - triggering escape");
            return true;
        }

        XenomorphType type = XenomorphTypeHelper.getXenomorphType(entity);
        boolean stuck = NeoForgeStuckInBlocksProbe.isStuckInBlocks(entity, Objects.requireNonNull(entity.level()));
        double lowThreshold = AIConfigResolver.getLowAirSupplyThreshold(type);
        double criticalThreshold = AIConfigResolver.getCriticalAirSupplyThreshold(type);

        boolean suffocating = SurvivalSuffocationPolicy.isSuffocating(
                false,
                stuck,
                entity.getAirSupply(),
                entity.getMaxAirSupply(),
                lowThreshold,
                criticalThreshold);

        if (suffocating) {
            if (stuck) {
                ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeSuffocationProbe",
                        "Entity stuck in blocks with low air supply - triggering escape");
            } else {
                ModLogger.debug("NeoForgeSuffocationProbe",
                        "Entity has critically low air supply - triggering escape");
            }
        }
        return suffocating;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.boundary;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.xenomorph.XenomorphFormQueryPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeLevelResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.XenomorphTypeHelper;

public final class NeoForgeXenomorphFormQueryAdapter implements XenomorphFormQueryPort {

    private final MinecraftServer server;

    public NeoForgeXenomorphFormQueryAdapter(@Nonnull MinecraftServer server) {
        this.server = server;
    }

    @Override
    public XenomorphType resolveForm(LivingEntityRef ref) {
        if (ref == null) {
            return XenomorphType.DRONE;
        }
        UUID entityId = Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId(), "entityId");
        return NeoForgeLevelResolver.resolve(server, ref.world())
                .flatMap(level -> {
                    var entity = level.getEntity(entityId);
                    if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                        // Non-xenomorphs (humans, pigs, etc.) return null — never Optional.of(null).
                        return Optional.ofNullable(XenomorphTypeHelper.getXenomorphType(living));
                    }
                    return Optional.empty();
                })
                .orElse(null);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.ai.AIContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.ai.AIContextPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIContextThresholdsConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AnimationTransitionConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.XenomorphTypeHelper;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Thin adapter: reads Minecraft entity state and delegates to {@link AIContextPolicy}.
 *
 * <p>Resolves xenomorph type via MC-layer {@link XenomorphTypeHelper} (LivingEntity /
 * XenomorphTyped) so client animation ticks never depend on BoundaryServices.
 */
public class AIContextDetector {

    public static class TransitionSpeedModifiers {
        public float normalModifier;
        public float stalkingModifier;
        public float chasingModifier;
        public float fightingModifier;

        public TransitionSpeedModifiers() {
        }

        public static TransitionSpeedModifiers fromConfig(EntityConfig config) {
            AIContextPolicy.TransitionSpeedModifiers domain = AnimationTransitionConfigHelper.resolve(config);
            TransitionSpeedModifiers modifiers = new TransitionSpeedModifiers();
            modifiers.normalModifier = domain.normalModifier();
            modifiers.stalkingModifier = domain.stalkingModifier();
            modifiers.chasingModifier = domain.chasingModifier();
            modifiers.fightingModifier = domain.fightingModifier();
            return modifiers;
        }

        AIContextPolicy.TransitionSpeedModifiers toDomain() {
            return new AIContextPolicy.TransitionSpeedModifiers(
                    normalModifier, stalkingModifier, chasingModifier, fightingModifier);
        }
    }

    public static AIContext detectContext(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (!(entity instanceof Mob mob)) {
            return AIContext.NORMAL;
        }

        XenomorphType type = XenomorphTypeHelper.getXenomorphType(entity);
        if (type == null) {
            return AIContext.NORMAL;
        }

        AIContextPolicy.ContextThresholds thresholds = AIContextThresholdsConfigHelper.resolve(type);

        var target = mob.getTarget();
        if (target == null) {
            return AIContextPolicy.classify(new AIContextPolicy.ContextInputs(
                    false,
                    false,
                    mob.isCrouching(),
                    Double.MAX_VALUE,
                    mob.getLastHurtByMob() != null,
                    mob.getNavigation().isInProgress(),
                    null
            ), thresholds);
        }

        boolean targetAlive = target.isAlive();
        double distanceToTargetSq = mob.distanceToSqr(target);

        Double distanceToPathTargetSq = null;
        if (mob.getNavigation().isInProgress()) {
            var pathTarget = mob.getNavigation().getTargetPos();
            if (pathTarget != null) {
                distanceToPathTargetSq = mob.distanceToSqr(
                        pathTarget.getX(), pathTarget.getY(), pathTarget.getZ());
            }
        }

        return AIContextPolicy.classify(new AIContextPolicy.ContextInputs(
                true,
                targetAlive,
                mob.isCrouching(),
                distanceToTargetSq,
                mob.getLastHurtByMob() != null,
                mob.getNavigation().isInProgress(),
                distanceToPathTargetSq
        ), thresholds);
    }

    public static float getTransitionSpeedModifier(AIContext context, TransitionSpeedModifiers modifiers) {
        if (modifiers == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("TransitionSpeedModifiers is required");
        }
        return AIContextPolicy.transitionSpeedModifier(context, modifiers.toDomain());
    }

    public static float getTransitionSpeedModifier(LivingEntity entity, AIContext context, TransitionSpeedModifiers modifiers) {
        if (modifiers != null) {
            return AIContextPolicy.transitionSpeedModifier(context, modifiers.toDomain());
        }
        XenomorphType type = XenomorphTypeHelper.getXenomorphType(entity);
        if (type == null) {
            return AIContextPolicy.transitionSpeedModifier(context,
                    new AIContextPolicy.TransitionSpeedModifiers(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f));
        }
        return AIContextPolicy.transitionSpeedModifier(context, AnimationTransitionConfigHelper.resolve(type));
    }

    private AIContextDetector() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("AIContextDetector is a utility class");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.config;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.ai.AIBehaviorConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.ai.AIBehaviorConfigNames;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.ai.AIBehaviorConfigCatalog;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.config.BaseConfigLoader;
import net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager;

/**
 * Loads AI behavior configurations from JSON files.
 *
 * <p>Populates {@link AIBehaviorConfigCatalog} (L1) on load/reload for {@code BehaviorConfigHelper}.
 *
 * <p>S2B playtest-confirmed (2026-07-24): AIBehavior configs load on world open.
 * <p>TODO(DEBT-CONFIG-001): MC-JSON-01 — design L1 parse ownership; naive move pulls ResourceManager into L1.
 * TODO(DEBT-RESOURCE-004): S2B observe only — promote if soft AIBehavior fallback masks a bad load.
 */
public class AIBehaviorConfigLoader extends BaseConfigLoader<AIBehaviorConfig> {

    private static AIBehaviorConfigLoader instance;

    private AIBehaviorConfigLoader() {
        super("AIBehaviorConfigLoader");
    }

    public static AIBehaviorConfigLoader getInstance() {
        if (instance == null) {
            instance = new AIBehaviorConfigLoader();
        }
        return instance;
    }

    @Override
    protected void putConfig(String configName, AIBehaviorConfig config) {
        super.putConfig(configName, config);
        AIBehaviorConfigCatalog.register(configName, config);
    }

    @Override
    protected void clearConfigs() {
        super.clearConfigs();
        AIBehaviorConfigCatalog.clear();
    }

    @Override
    protected String getResourcePath(String configName) {
        return "biocraft_alien:ai_behaviors/" + configName + ".json";
    }

    @Override
    protected Class<AIBehaviorConfig> getConfigClass() {
        return AIBehaviorConfig.class;
    }

    @Override
    protected String[] getDefaultConfigNames() {
        return AIBehaviorConfigNames.shipped();
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean validateConfig(AIBehaviorConfig config, String configName) {
        if (config == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("AI behavior config is null: " + configName);
            return false;
        }
        if (config.behaviorType == null || config.behaviorType.isEmpty()) {
            ModLogger.warn("AI behavior config missing behaviorType: " + configName);
            return false;
        }
        if (config.speedMultipliers == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("AI behavior config missing speedMultipliers: " + configName);
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static AIBehaviorConfig getBehaviorConfig(String behaviorType) {
        return getInstance().getConfig(behaviorType);
    }

    public static void loadBehaviorConfigs(ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        getInstance().loadConfigs(resourceManager);
    }

    public static boolean areConfigsLoaded() {
        return getInstance().isLoaded();
    }

    public static void reloadBehaviorConfigs(ResourceManager resourceManager) {
        getInstance().reloadConfigs(resourceManager);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment.ContainmentOccupancyPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Minecraft persistence adapter for specimen-pod occupancy.
 */
public final class ContainmentOccupancyPortAdapter implements ContainmentOccupancyPort {

    private final ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity;

    public ContainmentOccupancyPortAdapter(ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        this.entity = Objects.requireNonNull(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isStructureFormed() {
        return entity.isFormed();
    }

    @Override
    public WorldRef controllerWorld() {
        if (entity.getLevel() == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Containment pen is not attached to a level");
        }
        return BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(entity.getLevel());
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<UUID> occupantEntityId() {
        return entity.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
    }

    @Override
    public void setOccupantEntityId(UUID occupantEntityId) {
        entity.setOccupantEntityUuidInternal(Objects.requireNonNull(occupantEntityId));
    }

    @Override
    public void clearOccupantEntityId() {
        entity.clearOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Cleanse / incinerate the contained living occupant (FEATURE-CLEANSE-001).
 *
 * <p>Equipment owns the destroy path — does not use Handling RELEASE.
 * Occupancy reconciles after the entity is discarded.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenCleanseRunner {

    private ContainmentPenCleanseRunner() {
    }

    /**
     * @return {@code true} when a cleanse session was started on the pen
     */
    public static boolean beginCleanse(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ServerPlayer player) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");

        Level level = pen.getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!canCleanse(pen, serverLevel)) {
            if (pen.hasSpecimen() && !pen.isCleansing()) {
                pen.reconcileStaleOccupancy();
            }
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_failed")));
            return false;
        }

        if (!pen.beginCleanseSession()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_failed")));
            return false;
        }

        player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_started")));
        ModLogger.info("Cleanse", "Began cleanse at " + pen.getBlockPos());
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean canCleanse(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ServerLevel serverLevel) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(serverLevel, "serverLevel");
        if (!pen.isFormed() || !pen.hasSpecimen() || pen.isCleansing()) {
            return false;
        }
        Optional<UUID> occupantId = pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        return serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living && living.isAlive();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.items.DnaVialItemHelper;

/**
 * DNA vial Sample / Inject workflow (FEATURE-DNA-VIAL-001).
 *
 * <p>Introduces the DNA workflow, not DNA biology. Sample marks an opaque filled
 * token only — never inspects or serializes entity biology. Inject is unavailable
 * until Stage 4.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenDnaVialRunner {

    private ContainmentPenDnaVialRunner() {
    }

    /**
     * Dual-mode: empty vial → Sample; filled vial → Inject (unavailable).
     *
     * @return {@code true} when Sample filled the vial or Inject reported unavailable
     */
    public static boolean sampleOrInject(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ItemStackCarrier vialCarrier,
            @Nonnull ServerPlayer player) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(vialCarrier, "vialCarrier");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");

        Level level = pen.getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!pen.isFormed() || !pen.hasSpecimen() || pen.isCleansing()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.vial_failed")));
            return false;
        }

        ItemStack stack = vialCarrier.get();
        if (!DnaVialItemHelper.isDnaVial(stack)) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.vial_failed")));
            return false;
        }

        Optional<UUID> occupantId = pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.vial_failed")));
            return false;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        if (!(serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) {
            pen.reconcileStaleOccupancy();
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.vial_failed")));
            return false;
        }
        // Presence check only — do not inspect or serialize entity biology (3B invariant).

        if (DnaVialItemHelper.isEmpty(stack)) {
            ItemStack filled = Objects.requireNonNull(stack.copy());
            DnaVialItemHelper.markFilled(filled);
            vialCarrier.set(filled);
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.sample_ok")));
            ModLogger.info("DnaVial", "Sampled opaque marker at " + pen.getBlockPos());
            return true;
        }

        if (DnaVialItemHelper.isFilled(stack)) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.inject_unavailable")));
            return true;
        }

        player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.vial_failed")));
        return false;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.handling.HandlingResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.CapturedEntitySnapshot;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission.CaptureNetSpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * First Extraction slice: occupancy → filled Capture Net (FEATURE-EXTRACT-001).
 *
 * <p>Does not use AdmissionTransaction — Extraction never admits.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenExtractionRunner {

    private ContainmentPenExtractionRunner() {
    }

    /**
     * @return {@code true} when the occupant was snapshotted into the net and discarded
     */
    public static boolean extract(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier,
            @Nonnull ServerPlayer player) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");

        Level level = pen.getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed", "not on server")));
            return false;
        }
        if (!pen.isFormed() || !pen.hasSpecimen()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed", "no occupant")));
            return false;
        }

        ItemStack slot = carrier.get();
        if (!CaptureNetSpecimenSource.isEmptyCaptureNet(slot)) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed", "empty capture net required")));
            return false;
        }

        Optional<UUID> occupantId = pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed", "no occupant")));
            return false;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        if (!(serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) {
            pen.reconcileStaleOccupancy();
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed",
                    "occupant lost; pen cleared")));
            return false;
        }

        LivingEntityRef ref = Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(living));
        HandlingResult release = pen.requestRelease(ref);
        if (!release.accepted()) {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_failed",
                    release.reason() == null ? "release rejected" : release.reason())));
            return false;
        }

        ItemStack filled = Objects.requireNonNull(slot.copy());
        CapturedEntitySnapshot.write(filled, living);
        living.discard();
        pen.clearOccupantDisplayNameInternal();
        carrier.set(Objects.requireNonNull(filled));
        pen.syncToClient();

        player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.extraction_committed")));
        ModLogger.info("Extraction", "Extracted occupant into capture net at " + pen.getBlockPos());
        return true;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.component.DataComponents;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.item.Items;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Apply Name Tag to the contained living occupant (FEATURE-LAB-NAMING-001).
 *
 * <p>Safe vanilla {@code CustomName} adapter — entity remains naming owner.
 * Does not write containment presentation cache.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenNamingRunner {

    private ContainmentPenNamingRunner() {
    }

    /**
     * @return {@code true} when the Name Tag was consumed (including identical-name no-op success)
     */
    public static boolean applyNameTag(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ItemStackCarrier namingCarrier,
            @Nonnull ServerPlayer player) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(namingCarrier, "namingCarrier");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");

        Level level = pen.getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!pen.isFormed() || !pen.hasSpecimen()) {
            return false;
        }

        ItemStack stack = namingCarrier.get();
        if (!isApplicableNameTag(stack)) {
            return false;
        }

        Optional<UUID> occupantId = pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        if (occupantId.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        UUID id = Objects.requireNonNull(occupantId.get());
        if (!(serverLevel.getEntity(id) instanceof LivingEntity living) || !living.isAlive()) {
            pen.reconcileStaleOccupancy();
            return false;
        }

        Component name = Objects.requireNonNull(stack.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME)));
        living.setCustomName(name);
        living.setCustomNameVisible(true);

        ItemStack remaining = stack.copy();
        remaining.shrink(1);
        namingCarrier.set(Objects.requireNonNull(remaining));

        player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "message.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.name_applied")));
        ModLogger.info("Naming", "Applied Name Tag to occupant at " + pen.getBlockPos());
        return true;
    }

    public static boolean isApplicableNameTag(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(stack, "stack");
        return stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.NAME_TAG))
                && stack.has(Objects.requireNonNull(DataComponents.CUSTOM_NAME));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ContainmentIntegrity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ContainmentVolumeId;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.WorldRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.lab.BreachState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment.ContainmentPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;

/**
 * Minecraft persistence adapter for specimen-pod containment integrity/breach.
 *
 * <p>Occupancy is intentionally absent — use {@link ContainmentOccupancyPortAdapter}.
 */
public final class ContainmentPortAdapter implements ContainmentPort {

    private final ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity;

    public ContainmentPortAdapter(ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        this.entity = Objects.requireNonNull(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public ContainmentVolumeId volumeId() {
        return entity.getContainmentVolumeIdInternal();
    }

    @Override
    public ContainmentIntegrity integrity() {
        return entity.getBreachStateInternal().toIntegrity();
    }

    @Override
    public void setIntegrity(ContainmentIntegrity integrity) {
        entity.setCoarseIntegrityInternal(Objects.requireNonNull(integrity));
    }

    @Override
    public BreachState breachState() {
        return entity.getBreachStateInternal();
    }

    @Override
    public void setBreachState(BreachState breachState) {
        entity.setBreachStateInternal(Objects.requireNonNull(breachState));
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<WorldRef> controllerWorld() {
        if (entity.getLevel() == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(entity.getLevel()));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.SpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission.MobBucketSpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission.SpawnEggSpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission.CaptureNetSpecimenSource;

/**
 * Resolves an {@link ItemStack} carrier to a {@link SpecimenSource} implementation.
 *
 * <p>L1: imports L0 carrier sources; Capture Net source is same-package (registry-driven, no item import).
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-EGG-001)
 */
public final class ItemSpecimenSourceFactory {

    private ItemSpecimenSourceFactory() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Optional<SpecimenSource> create(@Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
        ItemStack stack = carrier.get();
        if (SpawnEggSpecimenSource.supports(stack)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.of(new SpawnEggSpecimenSource(carrier)));
        }
        if (MobBucketSpecimenSource.supports(stack)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.of(new MobBucketSpecimenSource(carrier)));
        }
        if (CaptureNetSpecimenSource.supports(stack)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.of(new CaptureNetSpecimenSource(carrier)));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Optional.empty());
    }

    public static boolean isSupported(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
        return SpawnEggSpecimenSource.supports(stack)
                || MobBucketSpecimenSource.supports(stack)
                || CaptureNetSpecimenSource.supports(stack);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.effects;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.parasite.HostEffectManager;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectCategory;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.effects.BaseXenomorphEffect;

/**
 * Custom effect applied to hosts during facehugger attachment.
 * Immobilizes the host and applies visual/audio effects.
 * 
 * Extends BaseXenomorphEffect to inherit common effect behavior
 * and standardized logging. Implements DRY principle by using base class
 * functionality while providing host immobilization-specific behavior.
 * 
 * This effect is designed to be:
 * - Short duration (refreshed each tick)
 * - Configurable via JSON
 * - Simple and focused on host immobilization
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.2
 */
public class FacehuggerAttachmentEffect extends BaseXenomorphEffect {
    
    public FacehuggerAttachmentEffect() {
        super(MobEffectCategory.HARMFUL, 0x4B0082); // Dark purple color
    }
    
    @Override
    protected boolean onTick(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        // Delegate to focused HostEffectManager
        HostEffectManager.applyHostImmobilization(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity));
        
        return true; // Continue effect
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void onApply(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onApply(entity, amplifier);
        logEffectApplication(entity, "Host immobilized for facehugger attachment");
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void onRemove(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        HostEffectManager.removeHostEffects(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity));
        super.onRemove(entity, amplifier);
        logEffectRemoval(entity, "Host immobilization removed");

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.effects;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.FacehuggerImplantationAdapter;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectCategory;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.effects.BaseXenomorphEffect;

/**
 * Custom effect applied to facehuggers during implantation.
 * Manages facehugger positioning, rotation, and state during attachment.
 *
 * Extends BaseXenomorphEffect to inherit common effect behavior
 * and standardized logging. Implements DRY principle by using base class
 * functionality while providing facehugger implantation-specific behavior.
 *
 * This effect is designed to be:
 * - Applied to the facehugger entity itself
 * - Manages positioning and rotation
 * - Prevents damage and movement during implantation
 * - Simple and focused on facehugger state
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.2
 */
public class FacehuggerImplantationEffect extends BaseXenomorphEffect {

    public FacehuggerImplantationEffect() {
        super(MobEffectCategory.NEUTRAL, 0x8B4513); // Brown color
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onTick(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        FacehuggerImplantationAdapter.applyImplantationState(entity);

        if (entity.tickCount % 100 == 0) {
            logEffectTick(entity, "Facehugger is implanting - immobile and protected");
        }

        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onApply(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onApply(entity, amplifier);
        logEffectApplication(entity, "Facehugger implantation started - entity immobilized");
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRemove(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onRemove(entity, amplifier);
        FacehuggerImplantationAdapter.removeImplantationState(entity);
        logEffectRemoval(entity, "Facehugger implantation completed - entity mobility restored");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.effects;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectCategory;
import net.minecraft.world.effect.MobEffectInstance;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.gestation.GestationManager;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.ModEffectRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.effects.BaseXenomorphEffect;

/**
 * Gestation effect for xenomorph embryo development.
 * MC tick glue only — logic in {@link GestationManager} (L2).
 */
public class GestationEffect extends BaseXenomorphEffect {

    public static final GestationEffect INSTANCE = new GestationEffect();

    public GestationEffect() {
        super(MobEffectCategory.HARMFUL, 0x8B0000);
    }

    @Override
    protected boolean onTick(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        if (entity.level().isClientSide) {
            return true;
        }

        ModLogger.debug("GestationEffect",
                String.format("GestationEffect.onTick() called for %s (type: %s)",
                        entity.getDisplayName().getString(), entity.getClass().getSimpleName()));

        var gestationEffect = Objects.requireNonNull(ModEffectRegistry.gestation());
        if (!entity.hasEffect(gestationEffect)) {
            ModLogger.warn("GestationEffect",
                    String.format("Entity %s does not have gestation effect", entity.getDisplayName().getString()));
            return true;
        }

        MobEffectInstance effect = entity.getEffect(gestationEffect);
        if (effect == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("GestationEffect",
                    String.format("Effect instance is null for %s", entity.getDisplayName().getString()));
            return true;
        }

        ModLogger.debug("GestationEffect",
                String.format("Effect duration read: %d ticks for %s",
                        effect.getDuration(), entity.getDisplayName().getString()));
        return GestationManager.handleGestationTick(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(entity), effect.getDuration());
    }

    @Override
    protected void onApply(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onApply(entity, amplifier);
        logEffectApplication(entity, "Xenomorph embryo gestation started");
    }

    @Override
    protected void onRemove(LivingEntity entity, int amplifier) {
        super.onRemove(entity, amplifier);
        logEffectRemoval(entity, "Xenomorph embryo gestation completed");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataAccessor;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.SynchedEntityData;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity.EntityAttributeHelper;
