import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.api.EntityGrowthAPI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.BaseXenomorphEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.XenomorphSoundRegistry;

/**
 * Drone entity - the worker xenomorph.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class DroneEntity extends BaseXenomorphEntity implements MaturationTimed {

    @Nonnull
    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Integer> DATA_FORM_PHASE =
            MovementFormSync.definePhaseId(DroneEntity.class);
    @Nonnull
    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> DATA_CRAWLING_FORM =
            MovementFormSync.defineCrawlingId(DroneEntity.class);

    // Animation state tracking for rendering (driven by XenomorphAnimationClientHooks)
    public final AnimationState walkingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState idleAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState standingToCrawlingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState crawlingToStandingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState jumpingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState fallingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    
    // Legacy transition ticks (clip completion is server-owned via MovementFormPhase)
    public int standingToCrawlingStartTick = -1;
    public int crawlingToStandingStartTick = -1;
    /** Synced crawl hitbox flag; server FSM is authoritative. */
    public boolean crawlingForm = false;

    @Nonnull
    private final MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState formState = new MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState();
    
    private int maturationTimer = 0;
    
    public DroneEntity(EntityType<? extends DroneEntity> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
    }

    @Override
    protected void defineSynchedData(@Nonnull SynchedEntityData.Builder builder) {
        super.defineSynchedData(builder);
        MovementFormSync.defineDefaults(builder, DATA_FORM_PHASE, DATA_CRAWLING_FORM);
    }
    
    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributes() {
        return EntityAttributeHelper.addAttackKnockback(
            createAttributesForType(XenomorphType.DRONE), 
            XenomorphType.DRONE
        );
    }
    
    @Override
    public XenomorphType getXenomorphType() {
        return XenomorphType.DRONE;
    }

    @Nonnull
    public MovementFormPhase getMovementFormPhase() {
        return MovementFormSync.readPhase(syncedData(), DATA_FORM_PHASE);
    }

    /** Updates crawl/stand form and refreshes the collision box when the form changes. */
    public void setCrawlingForm(boolean crawling) {
        if (this.crawlingForm == crawling) {
            return;
        }
        this.crawlingForm = crawling;
        if (!level().isClientSide()) {
            MovementFormSync.writeCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, crawling);
        }
        this.refreshDimensions();
    }

    @Override
    public void onSyncedDataUpdated(@Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<?> key) {
        super.onSyncedDataUpdated(key);
        if (DATA_CRAWLING_FORM.equals(key)) {
            boolean crawling = MovementFormSync.readCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM);
            if (this.crawlingForm != crawling) {
                this.crawlingForm = crawling;
                this.refreshDimensions();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    protected EntityDimensions getDefaultDimensions(@Nonnull Pose pose) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(XenomorphType.DRONE);
        if (config != null && config.entitySize != null) {
            EntityConfig.EntitySizeConfig size = config.entitySize;
            if (this.crawlingForm) {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDimensions.scalable(
                        size.crawlWidthOrStanding(), size.crawlHeightOrStanding()));
            }
            return Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDimensions.scalable(size.width, size.height));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(super.getDefaultDimensions(pose));
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void registerGoals() {
        XenomorphGoalRegistration.registerGoals(this, XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getAmbientSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getAmbientSound(XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getHurtSound(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource) {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHurtSound(XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getDeathSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getDeathSound(XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    protected void playStepSound(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        XenomorphSoundRegistry.playStepSound(this, XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }
    
    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();
        if (!level().isClientSide()) {
            CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard.clearIfProtected(this);
            EntityGrowthAPI.processEntityGrowth(this);
            boolean formChanged = MovementFormSync.tickServer(
                    this, DATA_FORM_PHASE, DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, formState);
            this.crawlingForm = formState.crawlingForm;
            if (formChanged) {
                this.refreshDimensions();
            }
        }
    }
    
    public int getMaturationTimer() {
        return this.maturationTimer;
    }
    
    public void setMaturationTimer(int timer) {
        this.maturationTimer = timer;
    }
    
    @Override
    public void addAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.addAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        MaturationTimedPersistence.writeSaveData(this, compound);
        MovementFormSync.writeSaveData(
                compound, formState.phase, formState.ticksRemaining, formState.crawlingForm);
    }
    
    @Override
    public void readAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.readAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        MaturationTimedPersistence.readSaveData(this, compound);
        MovementFormSync.readSaveData(compound, formState);
        MovementFormSync.writePhase(syncedData(), DATA_FORM_PHASE, formState.phase);
        MovementFormSync.writeCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, formState.crawlingForm);
        this.crawlingForm = formState.crawlingForm;
        this.refreshDimensions();
    }
    
    @Nonnull
    private SynchedEntityData syncedData() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(this.entityData);
    }

    public BlockPos findNearestNest() {
        if (level().isClientSide()) {
            return null;
        }
        var nest = DroneTerritoryHelper.findNearestNest(BoundaryRefs.from(blockPosition()));
        return nest != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(nest) : null;
    }

    public boolean isWithinNestTerritory() {
        if (level().isClientSide()) {
            return false;
        }
        return DroneTerritoryHelper.isWithinNestTerritory(BoundaryRefs.from(blockPosition()));
    }
}

/**
 * Facehugger entity — aggressive parasite that impregnates hosts.
 *
 * <p>Helpers: {@link FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence}, {@link FacehuggerRotationLock},
 * {@link FacehuggerSpentGoals}. Latched host identity is {@link AttachmentBinding}, not combat target.
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.0.1
 */
public class FacehuggerEntity extends BaseXenomorphEntity
        implements FacehuggerAttachmentEntity {

    private static final EntityDataAccessor<String> DATA_ATTACHMENT_STATE = Objects.requireNonNull(
            SynchedEntityData.defineId(
                    FacehuggerEntity.class,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDataSerializers.STRING)));
    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> DATA_CLIMBING = Objects.requireNonNull(
            SynchedEntityData.defineId(
                    FacehuggerEntity.class,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDataSerializers.BOOLEAN)));

    private int attachmentTicks = 0;
    private AttachmentState attachmentState = AttachmentState.FREE;
    private int spentTimer = 0;
    private float attachmentYRot = 0.0f;
    private float attachmentXRot = 0.0f;
    private boolean attachmentRotationSet = false;
    private final AttachmentBinding attachmentBinding = new AttachmentBinding();
    @Nullable
    private UUID pendingTargetUUID = null;

    public final AnimationState walkAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState idleAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState attachmentAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState jumpingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState fallingAnimationState = new AnimationState();

    public FacehuggerEntity(EntityType<? extends FacehuggerEntity> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
    }

    @Override
    protected void defineSynchedData(@Nonnull SynchedEntityData.Builder builder) {
        super.defineSynchedData(builder);
        builder.define(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_ATTACHMENT_STATE), Objects.requireNonNull(AttachmentState.FREE.name()));
        builder.define(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_CLIMBING), false);
    }

    private void setClimbing(boolean climbing) {
        this.entityData.set(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_CLIMBING), climbing);
    }

    public boolean isClimbing() {
        return this.entityData.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_CLIMBING));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onClimbable() {
        return this.isClimbing();
    }

    @Override
    public AttachmentState getAttachmentState() {
        // Client must read synced data — local field is server-authoritative only.
        if (this.level() != null && this.level().isClientSide()) {
            return parseAttachmentState(this.entityData.get(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_ATTACHMENT_STATE)));
        }
        return attachmentState;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentState(AttachmentState state) {
        if (state == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.attachmentState != state) {
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerEntity",
                    String.format("🦾 Facehugger %s state changed: %s -> %s",
                            this.getDisplayName().getString(), this.attachmentState, state));
            this.attachmentState = state;
            this.entityData.set(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_ATTACHMENT_STATE), Objects.requireNonNull(state.name()));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void restoreAttachmentState(AttachmentState state) {
        AttachmentState restored = state != null ? state : AttachmentState.FREE;
        this.attachmentState = restored;
        this.entityData.set(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_ATTACHMENT_STATE), Objects.requireNonNull(restored.name()));
    }

    private static AttachmentState parseAttachmentState(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            return AttachmentState.FREE;
        }
        try {
            return AttachmentState.valueOf(name);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return AttachmentState.FREE;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public int getSpentTimer() {
        return spentTimer;
    }

    @Override
    public void setSpentTimer(int ticks) {
        this.spentTimer = ticks;
    }

    @Override
    public float getAttachmentYRot() {
        return attachmentYRot;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentYRot(float yRot) {
        this.attachmentYRot = yRot;
    }

    @Override
    public float getAttachmentXRot() {
        return attachmentXRot;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentXRot(float xRot) {
        this.attachmentXRot = xRot;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isAttachmentRotationSet() {
        return attachmentRotationSet;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentRotationSet(boolean set) {
        this.attachmentRotationSet = set;
    }

    @Override
    @Nullable
    public UUID getPendingTargetUUID() {
        return pendingTargetUUID;
    }

    @Override
    public void setPendingTargetUUID(@Nullable UUID uuid) {
        this.pendingTargetUUID = uuid;
    }

    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributes() {
        return createAttributesForType(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    public XenomorphType getXenomorphType() {
        return XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER;
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerGoals() {
        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerEntity",
                "🦾 Facehugger " + this.getDisplayName().getString() + " registering AI goals...");
        XenomorphGoalRegistration.registerGoals(this, XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerEntity",
                String.format("🦾 Facehugger %s AI goals registered - goalSelector size: %d, targetSelector size: %d",
                        this.getDisplayName().getString(),
                        this.goalSelector.getAvailableGoals().size(),
                        this.targetSelector.getAvailableGoals().size()));
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getAmbientSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getAmbientSound(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getHurtSound(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource) {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHurtSound(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getDeathSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getDeathSound(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    protected void playStepSound(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        XenomorphSoundRegistry.playStepSound(this, XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hurt(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource, float amount) {
        LivingEntity host = resolveLatchedHostEntity();
        if (host != null && AttachmentRules.shouldRedirectDamageToHost(this.getAttachmentState(), this.attachmentTicks)) {
            if (host.isAlive()) {
                host.hurt(damageSource, amount);
            }
            return false;
        }
        return super.hurt(damageSource, amount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean doHurtTarget(@Nonnull Entity target) {
        return AttachmentRules.shouldFacehuggerDealDamage();
    }

    @Override
    public void push(@Nonnull Entity entity) {
        if (AttachmentRules.isImmovableDuringAttachment(this.getAttachmentState(), this.attachmentTicks)) {
            return;
        }
        super.push(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPushable() {
        if (AttachmentRules.isImmovableDuringAttachment(this.getAttachmentState(), this.attachmentTicks)) {
            return false;
        }
        return super.isPushable();
    }

    public static boolean isEntityBeingFacehugged(LivingEntity entity) {
        return ParasiteLifecycleAPI.getInfectionStage(entity) == InfectionStage.ATTACHING;
    }

    @Override
    public void markAsSpent() {
        FacehuggerTickWorkflow.applyMarkAsSpent(this);
        FacehuggerSpentGoals.registerWanderGoals(this);

        int spentWanderTime = AttachmentConfigHelper.getSpentWanderTime();
        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerEntity",
                String.format("🦾 Facehugger %s marked as spent - will wander for %d ticks",
                        this.getDisplayName().getString(), spentWanderTime));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isSpent() {
        return AttachmentRules.isSpentState(getAttachmentState());
    }

    @Override
    public AttachmentBinding attachmentBinding() {
        return attachmentBinding;
    }

    @Override
    public LivingEntityRef getAttachmentTarget() {
        return attachmentBinding.host();
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentTarget(LivingEntityRef target) {
        if (target == null) {
            attachmentBinding.clear();
            return;
        }
        attachmentBinding.bind(target);
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the latched host living entity from {@link AttachmentBinding} (not combat target).
     */
    @Nullable
    public LivingEntity resolveLatchedHostEntity() {
        LivingEntityRef ref = attachmentBinding.host();
        if (ref == null || !(this.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return null;
        }
        Entity entity = serverLevel.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(ref.entityId()));
        if (entity instanceof LivingEntity living && living.isAlive()) {
            return living;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Host for latch lifecycle: binding when latched, else combat target for approach AI only.
     */
    @Nullable
    public LivingEntity resolveLifecycleHostEntity() {
        AttachmentState state = getAttachmentState();
        if (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED) {
            return resolveLatchedHostEntity();
        }
        return getTarget();
    }

    @Override
    public int getAttachmentTicks() {
        return attachmentTicks;
    }

    @Override
    public void setAttachmentTicks(int ticks) {
        this.attachmentTicks = ticks;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresCustomPersistence() {
        return !this.isDeadOrDying();
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();

        if (!this.level().isClientSide()) {
            // Always-on spider climb for facehuggers when not locked onto a host.
            boolean canClimb = !AttachmentRules.isImmovableDuringAttachment(
                    this.getAttachmentState(), this.attachmentTicks);
            this.setClimbing(canClimb && this.horizontalCollision);

            // Combat owns getTarget — clear sticky unavailable hosts; never touch AttachmentBinding.
            AttachmentState combatState = this.getAttachmentState();
            if (combatState != AttachmentState.ATTACHING && combatState != AttachmentState.ATTACHED) {
                LivingEntity combatTarget = this.getTarget();
                if (combatTarget != null
                        && !HostAvailabilityService.isHostAvailable(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(combatTarget))) {
                    this.setTarget(null);
                }
            }
        }

        if (this.onClimbable() && !AttachmentRules.isImmovableDuringAttachment(this.getAttachmentState(), this.attachmentTicks)) {
            Vec3 motion = this.getDeltaMovement();
            this.setDeltaMovement(motion.x, Math.max(motion.y, 0.2D), motion.z);
            this.fallDistance = 0.0F;
        }

        FacehuggerClimbOrientation.applyClientPitch(this);

        int spentResult = FacehuggerTickWorkflow.processSpentState(
                Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(this)), spentTimer, new FacehuggerTickWorkflow.SpentCallbacks(
                        () -> this.die(Objects.requireNonNull(this.damageSources().generic())),
                        () -> {
                            if (!this.level().isClientSide) {
                                this.discard();
                            }
                        }));
        if (spentResult >= 0) {
            this.spentTimer = spentResult;
            return;
        }

        if (this.pendingTargetUUID != null && !AttachmentRules.isSpentState(this.attachmentState)) {
            FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence.restoreLatchedHostFromUUID(this);
        }

        LivingEntity host = resolveLifecycleHostEntity();
        FacehuggerRotationLock.apply(host, this);

        if (host != null && FacehuggerTickWorkflow.shouldDieWithHost(
                Objects.requireNonNull(this.getAttachmentState()), host.isAlive())) {
            FacehuggerTickWorkflow.applyHostDeathReset(this);
            this.die(Objects.requireNonNull(this.damageSources().generic()));
            return;
        }

        if (host != null && host.isAlive()) {
            // Attachment progression is server-authoritative; client only drives animation state.
            if (!this.level().isClientSide()) {
                FacehuggerTickWorkflow.processAttachmentTick(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(this)),
                        Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(host)));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void remove(@Nonnull Entity.RemovalReason reason) {
        if (!this.level().isClientSide) {
            AISignalSystem.clearSignalsForEntity(this.getUUID());
        }
        super.remove(reason);
    }

    @Override
    public void addAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.addAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence.writeSaveData(this, compound);
    }

    @Override
    public void readAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.readAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        FacehuggerAttachmentPersistence.readSaveData(this, compound);
        // Pass this entity directly — NBT restore runs before world UUID lookup can find us.
        if (!this.level().isClientSide && AttachmentRules.isSpentState(this.attachmentState)) {
            if (FacehuggerSpentTransitionServices.isInitialized()) {
                FacehuggerSpentTransitionServices.spentTransition().resumeSpentWandering(this);
            } else {
                FacehuggerSpentGoals.registerWanderGoals(this);
            }
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Human entity for testing xenomorph interactions.
 * Simple, concrete implementation focused on basic survival behavior.
 *
 * <p>TODO(BUG-HOST-002): Accepted Debt — resolve biocraft_alien:human without generic organic fallback.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class HumanEntity extends Monster {

    private static final String NBT_HUMAN_TYPE = "HumanType";

    private HumanEntityType humanType = HumanEntityType.VILLAGER;

    public HumanEntity(EntityType<? extends Monster> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
    }

    public HumanEntityType getHumanType() {
        return humanType;
    }

    public void setHumanType(HumanEntityType humanType) {
        this.humanType = humanType != null ? humanType : HumanEntityType.VILLAGER;
    }

    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributes() {
        return EntityAttributeHelper.createHumanAttributes();
    }

    /**
     * Facehug latch must hard-stop saved momentum / AI (especially after world reload).
     */
    @Override
    public void aiStep() {
        if (isFacehugged()) {
            this.setDeltaMovement(0.0D, Math.min(0.0D, this.getDeltaMovement().y), 0.0D);
            this.getNavigation().stop();
            this.setTarget(null);
            this.setNoAi(true);
        }
        super.aiStep();
        if (isFacehugged()) {
            this.setDeltaMovement(0.0D, Math.min(0.0D, this.getDeltaMovement().y), 0.0D);
        }
    }

    private boolean isFacehugged() {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized() || this.level().isClientSide()) {
            return false;
        }
        return BoundaryServices.effects().hasEffect(
                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(this), DomainEffectKey.FACEHUGGER_ATTACHMENT);
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerGoals() {
        HumanGoalRegistration.registerGoals(this);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getAmbientSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHumanAmbientSound();
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getHurtSound(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource) {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHumanHurtSound();
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getDeathSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHumanDeathSound();
    }

    @Override
    protected void playStepSound(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        XenomorphSoundRegistry.playHumanStepSound(this);
    }

    @Override
    public void addAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.addAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        compound.putString(NBT_HUMAN_TYPE, Objects.requireNonNull(humanType.name()));
    }

    @Override
    public void readAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.readAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        if (compound.contains(NBT_HUMAN_TYPE)) {
            try {
                humanType = HumanEntityType.valueOf(compound.getString(NBT_HUMAN_TYPE));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
                humanType = HumanEntityType.VILLAGER;
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.spawn.SpawnContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ovomorph.OvomorphHatchExecutor;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.api.XenomorphTyped;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.config.SoundHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchConfigAccess;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.XenomorphSoundRegistry;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.AABB;

/**
 * Hatch spawn side effects for ovomorphs (spawn, sound, removal).
 */
public final class OvomorphHatchEffects {

    private OvomorphHatchEffects() {
    }

    public static void executeHatch(Mob ovomorph, LivingEntity nearestHost) {
        try {
            XenomorphType spawnForm = OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.resolveSpawnForm();
            if (!OvomorphHatchExecutor.canExecuteHatch(spawnForm)) {
                ModLogger.error("OvomorphHatchEffects", "Cannot hatch - no spawn entity configured");
                return;
            }

            double spawnX = ovomorph.getX() + OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.spawnOffsetX();
            double spawnY = ovomorph.getY() + OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.spawnOffsetY();
            double spawnZ = ovomorph.getZ() + OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.spawnOffsetZ();
            float spawnYRot = ovomorph.getYRot();

            boolean spawned = spawnHatchedForm(ovomorph, spawnForm, spawnX, spawnY, spawnZ, spawnYRot);
            if (!spawned) {
                ModLogger.error("OvomorphHatchEffects",
                        "Cannot hatch - failed to spawn form: " + spawnForm.getConfigKey());
                return;
            }

            if (OvomorphHatchExecutor.shouldBindSpawnedHostTarget(
                    spawnForm,
                    nearestHost != null ? BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(nearestHost) : null)) {
                assignFacehuggerTarget(ovomorph.level(), spawnX, spawnY, spawnZ, nearestHost);
            }

            playHatchSound(ovomorph);
            ovomorph.remove(Entity.RemovalReason.DISCARDED);

            ModLogger.info("OvomorphHatchEffects",
                    "Ovomorph hatched into " + spawnForm.getConfigKey() + " at " + ovomorph.blockPosition());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("OvomorphHatchEffects", "Failed to hatch ovomorph: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    private static boolean spawnHatchedForm(
            Mob ovomorph,
            XenomorphType spawnForm,
            double x,
            double y,
            double z,
            float yRot) {
        Level level = ovomorph.level();
        if (level == null || level.isClientSide()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            ModLogger.error("OvomorphHatchEffects", "Cannot hatch - BoundaryServices not initialized");
            return false;
        }

        SpawnContext context = SpawnContext.at(
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level),
                x,
                y,
                z,
                yRot,
                0f,
                0f);
        return BoundaryServices.spawn().spawnForm(spawnForm, context);
    }

    private static void assignFacehuggerTarget(
            Level level,
            double spawnX,
            double spawnY,
            double spawnZ,
            LivingEntity nearestHost) {
        if (level == null) {
            return;
        }

        AABB spawnBox = new AABB(
                spawnX - 0.5, spawnY - 0.5, spawnZ - 0.5,
                spawnX + 0.5, spawnY + 0.5, spawnZ + 0.5);
        for (Mob mob : level.getEntitiesOfClass(Mob.class, spawnBox, mob -> mob.isAlive())) {
            if (mob instanceof XenomorphTyped typed
                    && typed.getXenomorphType() == XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER) {
                mob.setTarget(nearestHost);
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    private static void playHatchSound(Mob ovomorph) {
        if (OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.hasHatchSound()) {
            SoundHelper.playAmbientSound(
                    ovomorph,
                    XenomorphType.OVOMORPH,
                    XenomorphSoundRegistry.getAmbientSound(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH));
        }
    }
}

FILE: OvomorphHatchPortAdapter.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ovomorph.OvomorphHatchPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchConfigAccess;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchHost;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchHostClaim;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.OvomorphHostQuery;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * NeoForge adapter for {@link OvomorphHatchPort}.
 */
public final class OvomorphHatchPortAdapter implements OvomorphHatchPort {

    private final OvomorphHatchHost host;

    public OvomorphHatchPortAdapter(OvomorphHatchHost host) {
        this.host = host;
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPosRef position() {
        return BoundaryRefs.from(host.mob().blockPosition());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isProximityRequired() {
        return OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.isProximityRequired();
    }

    @Override
    public int hatchTime() {
        return OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.hatchTime();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isViableHostNearby() {
        return OvomorphHostQuery.findNearestViableHost(Objects.requireNonNull(host.mob())) != null;
    }

    @Override
    public void cancelHatching() {
        OvomorphHatchHostClaim.clearForEgg(host.mob().getUUID());
        host.setHatching(false);
        host.stopOpeningAnimation();
    }

    @Override
    public void executeHatch() {
        LivingEntity nearestHost = OvomorphHostQuery.findNearestViableHost(Objects.requireNonNull(host.mob()));
        try {
            OvomorphHatchEffects.executeHatch(Objects.requireNonNull(host.mob()), nearestHost);
        } finally {
            OvomorphHatchHostClaim.clearForEgg(host.mob().getUUID());
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.nbt.CompoundTag;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.EntityDataAccessor;
import net.minecraft.network.syncher.SynchedEntityData;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent;
import net.minecraft.world.damagesource.DamageSource;

/**
 * Queen entity — final xenomorph lifecycle stage.
 *
 * <p>NDE: lifecycle is {@link QueenLifecycleAccess} → L4 {@code com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.species.xenomorph.entity.QueenEmbeddedLifecycle} via reflection.
 * Nest progress is {@link QueenNestProgress} (L5 NestBuildingAI) persisted via {@link QueenNestPersistence}.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 */
public class QueenEntity extends BaseXenomorphEntity {

    @Nonnull
    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Integer> DATA_FORM_PHASE =
            MovementFormSync.definePhaseId(QueenEntity.class);
    @Nonnull
    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> DATA_CRAWLING_FORM =
            MovementFormSync.defineCrawlingId(QueenEntity.class);

    private final Object lifecycle;
    private QueenNestProgress nestProgress;
    @Nonnull
    private final MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState formState = new MovementFormFsm.MovementFormState();

    public final AnimationState movingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState idleAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState standingToCrawlingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState crawlingToStandingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState jumpingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState fallingAnimationState = new AnimationState();

    public int standingToCrawlingStartTick = -1;
    public int crawlingToStandingStartTick = -1;
    /** Synced crawl hitbox flag; server FSM is authoritative. */
    public boolean crawlingForm = false;

    public QueenEntity(EntityType<? extends QueenEntity> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
        this.lifecycle = QueenLifecycleAccess.create(this);
    }

    @Override
    protected void defineSynchedData(@Nonnull SynchedEntityData.Builder builder) {
        super.defineSynchedData(builder);
        MovementFormSync.defineDefaults(builder, DATA_FORM_PHASE, DATA_CRAWLING_FORM);
    }

    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributes() {
        return createAttributesForType(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    public XenomorphType getXenomorphType() {
        return XenomorphType.QUEEN;
    }

    @Nonnull
    public MovementFormPhase getMovementFormPhase() {
        return MovementFormSync.readPhase(syncedData(), DATA_FORM_PHASE);
    }

    /** Updates crawl/stand form and refreshes the collision box when the form changes. */
    public void setCrawlingForm(boolean crawling) {
        if (this.crawlingForm == crawling) {
            return;
        }
        this.crawlingForm = crawling;
        if (!level().isClientSide()) {
            MovementFormSync.writeCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, crawling);
        }
        this.refreshDimensions();
    }

    @Override
    public void onSyncedDataUpdated(@Nonnull EntityDataAccessor<?> key) {
        super.onSyncedDataUpdated(key);
        if (DATA_CRAWLING_FORM.equals(key)) {
            boolean crawling = MovementFormSync.readCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM);
            if (this.crawlingForm != crawling) {
                this.crawlingForm = crawling;
                this.refreshDimensions();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    protected EntityDimensions getDefaultDimensions(@Nonnull Pose pose) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
        if (config != null && config.entitySize != null) {
            EntityConfig.EntitySizeConfig size = config.entitySize;
            if (this.crawlingForm) {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDimensions.scalable(
                        size.crawlWidthOrStanding(), size.crawlHeightOrStanding()));
            }
            return Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDimensions.scalable(size.width, size.height));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(super.getDefaultDimensions(pose));
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerGoals() {
        XenomorphGoalRegistration.registerGoals(this, XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getAmbientSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getAmbientSound(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getHurtSound(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource) {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHurtSound(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getDeathSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getDeathSound(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    protected void playStepSound(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        XenomorphSoundRegistry.playStepSound(this, XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    public void addAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.addAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        QueenNestPersistence.writeSaveData(compound, lifecycle, nestProgress);
        MovementFormSync.writeSaveData(
                compound, formState.phase, formState.ticksRemaining, formState.crawlingForm);
    }

    @Override
    public void readAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.readAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        QueenNestPersistence.readSaveData(compound, lifecycle, nestProgress);
        MovementFormSync.readSaveData(compound, formState);
        MovementFormSync.writePhase(syncedData(), DATA_FORM_PHASE, formState.phase);
        MovementFormSync.writeCrawling(syncedData(), DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, formState.crawlingForm);
        this.crawlingForm = formState.crawlingForm;
        this.refreshDimensions();
    }

    @Nonnull
    private SynchedEntityData syncedData() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(this.entityData);
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();
        if (!level().isClientSide()) {
            CombatLifecycleHostTargetGuard.clearIfProtected(this);
            boolean formChanged = MovementFormSync.tickServer(
                    this, DATA_FORM_PHASE, DATA_CRAWLING_FORM, formState);
            this.crawlingForm = formState.crawlingForm;
            if (formChanged) {
                this.refreshDimensions();
            }
        }
        QueenLifecycleAccess.tick(lifecycle);
    }

    public boolean hasNest() {
        return QueenNestRegistry.hasNest(getUUID());
    }

    public BlockPos getNestPosition() {
        BlockPosRef ref = QueenNestRegistry.getNestCenter(getUUID());
        return ref != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref) : null;
    }

    public Object getAvoidanceAI() {
        return QueenLifecycleAccess.invokeObject(lifecycle, "getAvoidanceAI");
    }

    public QueenNestProgress getNestProgress() {
        return nestProgress;
    }

    public void setNestProgress(QueenNestProgress nestProgress) {
        this.nestProgress = nestProgress;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.items;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvents;
import net.minecraft.sounds.SoundSource;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand;
import net.minecraft.world.InteractionResultHolder;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.observation.ObservationSnapshot;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_3.items.MotionTrackerConfigLoader;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.detection.MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.observation.ObservationService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.entity.DirectionHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.items.BaseItem;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.observation.MotionTrackerObservationPort;

/**
 * Motion Tracker — presentation consumer of {@link ObservationService} facts.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-TRACKER-001): Polish model/screen/SFX after movement semantics.
 */
public class MotionTrackerItem extends BaseItem {

    public MotionTrackerItem(Properties properties) {
        super(properties);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public InteractionResultHolder<ItemStack> use(
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull InteractionHand hand) {
        ItemStack itemStack = Objects.requireNonNull(player.getItemInHand(hand));

        if (!performCommonValidation(player, itemStack, level)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.fail(itemStack));
        }

        if (!level.isClientSide) {
            long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();

            try {
                if (player.getCooldowns().isOnCooldown(this)) {
                    player.displayClientMessage(
                            Objects.requireNonNull(
                                    Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.motion_tracker.charging")),
                            true);
                    return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.fail(itemStack));
                }

                scanForEntities(level, player);
                player.getCooldowns().addCooldown(this, MotionTrackerConfigLoader.cooldownTicks());
                BlockPos soundPos = Objects.requireNonNull(player.blockPosition());
                level.playSound(
                        null,
                        soundPos,
                        Objects.requireNonNull(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_PLING.value()),
                        SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                        0.5f,
                        1.0f);
                logItemUsage(player, "Motion tracker activated");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                logEffectFailure(player, "Motion tracker scan failed: " + e.getMessage());
            } finally {
                logPerformance("motion_tracker_scan", System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime);
            }
        }

        return Objects.requireNonNull(InteractionResultHolder.sidedSuccess(itemStack, level.isClientSide));
    }

    private void scanForEntities(@Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull Player player) {
        MotionTrackerObservationPort port = MotionTrackerObservationPort.scan(
                level, player, MotionTrackerConfigLoader.detectionRadius());
        MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.IgnoreSettings ignores = new MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.IgnoreSettings(
                MotionTrackerConfigLoader.ignorePlayers(),
                MotionTrackerConfigLoader.ignoreFriendlyMobs(),
                MotionTrackerConfigLoader.ignoreArmorStands(),
                MotionTrackerConfigLoader.ignoreSpectators(),
                MotionTrackerConfigLoader.reportStill());

        int entitiesFound = 0;
        int maxReport = MotionTrackerConfigLoader.maxEntitiesToReport();
        for (ObservationSnapshot snapshot : ObservationService.observe(port)) {
            if (entitiesFound >= maxReport) {
                break;
            }
            LivingEntity entity = port.resolve(Objects.requireNonNull(snapshot.entity(), "snapshot entity"));
            if (entity == null) {
                continue;
            }
            MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.EntityTraits traits =
                    MotionTrackerObservationPort.traits(
                            entity, Objects.requireNonNull(snapshot.movement(), "snapshot movement"));
            if (!MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.shouldReport(traits, ignores)) {
                continue;
            }

            double distance = player.distanceTo(Objects.requireNonNull(entity));
            String direction = DirectionHelper.getCardinalDirection(player, entity);
            String entityType = entity.getType().getDescription().getString();

            player.displayClientMessage(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                            "message.biocraft_alien.motion_tracker.detected",
                            entityType,
                            direction,
                            String.format("%.1f", distance))),
                    false);
            entitiesFound++;
        }

        if (entitiesFound == 0) {
            player.displayClientMessage(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(
                            Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.motion_tracker.no_entities")),
                    false);
        } else if (MotionTrackerConsumerPolicy.shouldPlayAlertTone(
                entitiesFound, MotionTrackerConfigLoader.alertToneEntityThreshold())) {
            BlockPos soundPos = Objects.requireNonNull(player.blockPosition());
            level.playSound(
                    null,
                    soundPos,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value()),
                    SoundSource.PLAYERS,
                    0.7f,
                    0.5f);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.GoalPriorityResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.CommonGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.HuntSmallAnimalsGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.FleeFromThreatsGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.HideInDarkPlacesGoal;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * Registers escape-and-hide goals for chestburster entities from JSON config.
 */
public final class ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar {

    private ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar() {
    }

    public static void registerGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerFloatGoal(
                entity, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "float"));
        double movementSpeedMultiplier = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromMovement(
                aiGoals, "movement_speed_multiplier");
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStrollGoal(
                entity,
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "stroll"),
                aiGoals.strollSpeed * movementSpeedMultiplier);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerRandomLookAroundGoal(
                entity, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "random_look"));

        if (AIConfigHelper.getBoolean(aiGoals.targetSelection, "avoid_all_threats", false)) {
            entity.goalSelector.addGoal(
                    GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "flee"),
                    new FleeFromThreatsGoal(entity, aiGoals));
        }
        if (AIConfigHelper.getBoolean(aiGoals.specialAbilities, "eat_small_animals", false)) {
            entity.goalSelector.addGoal(
                    GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "hunt"),
                    new HuntSmallAnimalsGoal(entity, aiGoals));
        }
        if (AIConfigHelper.getBoolean(aiGoals.movement, "hide_in_dark_places", false)) {
            entity.goalSelector.addGoal(
                    GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "hide"),
                    new HideInDarkPlacesGoal(entity, aiGoals));
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.EggLayingWorkflow;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.EggLayingConfigAccess;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.EggLayingAreaValidator;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Thin MC wrapper for queen egg laying. Orchestration: {@link EggLayingWorkflow}.
 */
public class EggLayingAI {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private final EggLayingConfigAccess configAccess;
    private final EggLayingAreaValidator areaValidator;
    // S2B playtest-confirmed (2026-07-24): queen lays eggs; timer-across-reload accepted.
    private int eggLayingTimer = 0;

    public EggLayingAI(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
        this.configAccess = EggLayingConfigAccess.forQueen();
        this.areaValidator = new EggLayingAreaValidator(configAccess);
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (queen.level().isClientSide() || !queen.hasNest()) {
            return;
        }

        EggLayingWorkflow.TickResult result =
                EggLayingWorkflow.advanceTimer(eggLayingTimer, configAccess.getEggLayingInterval());
        eggLayingTimer = result.nextTimer();
        if (result.shouldAttemptLay()) {
            ModLogger.debug("EggLayingAI", "Egg laying timer reached, attempting to lay egg");
            attemptEggLaying();
        }
    }

    private void attemptEggLaying() {
        Level level = queen.level();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return;
        }

        BlockPos queenPos = queen.blockPosition();
        if (!areaValidator.canLayEggInArea(serverLevel, queenPos)) {
            ModLogger.info("EggLayingAI", "Cannot lay egg - area too crowded or chunk limit reached");
            return;
        }

        BlockPosRef centerRef = BoundaryRefs.from(queenPos);
        BlockPosRef eggRef = EggLayingWorkflow.findCandidateLocation(
                centerRef, configAccess.limits(), ref -> areaValidator.isSuitableEggLocation(serverLevel, ref));
        if (eggRef == null) {
            ModLogger.info("EggLayingAI", "No suitable location found for egg laying");
            return;
        }

        BlockPos eggPos = new BlockPos(eggRef.x(), eggRef.y(), eggRef.z());
        ModLogger.debug("EggLayingAI", "Laying egg at position: " + eggPos);
        OvomorphSpawnBinding.layEgg(serverLevel, eggPos, queen);
    }
}

/**
 * Thin MC Goal for facehugger approach / attachment: navigation, look, and signal I/O.
 * Activation, claim, and approach FSM decisions live in {@link FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy}.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 */
public class FacehuggerAttachmentGoal extends SignalAwareGoal {

    private static final int GEOMETRY_LOG_INTERVAL_TICKS = 40;

    private final FacehuggerEntity facehugger;
    private AISignalData activeSignal;
    private final EntityConfig config;

    public FacehuggerAttachmentGoal(FacehuggerEntity facehugger) {
        super(facehugger);
        this.facehugger = facehugger;
        this.setFlags(Objects.requireNonNull(EnumSet.of(Flag.MOVE, Flag.LOOK)));
        this.config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        LivingEntity target = this.facehugger.getTarget();

        boolean validTarget = !EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(
                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target), BoundaryServices.entityQuery());
        boolean validHost = validTarget && HostValidationHelper.isValidHostForFacehugger(target);

        if (validTarget && !validHost) {
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                    String.format("🦾 Target %s is not a valid host for facehugging - skipping",
                            Objects.requireNonNull(target).getDisplayName().getString()));
        }

        UUID targetId = validTarget ? Objects.requireNonNull(target).getUUID() : null;
        boolean hostClaimedBySignal = targetId != null
                && HostClaimService.isHostClaimedByOther(
                        targetId, facehugger.getUUID(), currentGameTime());

        if (validTarget && hostClaimedBySignal) {
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                    String.format("🦾 Target %s is already targeted/reserved by another facehugger - skipping",
                            Objects.requireNonNull(target).getDisplayName().getString()));
        }

        double configFollowRange = config != null ? config.followRange : 0.0;
        double attributeFollowRange = this.facehugger.getAttribute(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.FOLLOW_RANGE)) != null
                ? this.facehugger.getAttributeValue(Objects.requireNonNull(Attributes.FOLLOW_RANGE))
                : 0.0;
        double followRange = FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.resolveFollowRange(configFollowRange, attributeFollowRange);
        double distance = validTarget ? this.facehugger.distanceTo(Objects.requireNonNull(target)) : Double.MAX_VALUE;

        return FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.canActivateAttachment(
                this.facehugger.isSpent(),
                validHost,
                hostClaimedBySignal,
                distance,
                followRange);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        // Latched host comes from AttachmentBinding; approach still uses combat getTarget().
        LivingEntity host = resolveGoalHost();
        boolean hostInvalid = EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(
                BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(host), BoundaryServices.entityQuery());

        boolean hostAttachedByOther = false;
        if (!hostInvalid) {
            UUID targetId = Objects.requireNonNull(host).getUUID();
            hostAttachedByOther = HostClaimService.isHostClaimedByOther(
                    targetId, facehugger.getUUID(), currentGameTime());
        }

        boolean attachmentInProgress = false;
        if (config != null) {
            int totalDuration = config.attachmentDuration + config.implantationDelay;
            attachmentInProgress = FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.resolveAttachmentInProgress(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(this.facehugger.getAttachmentState()),
                    this.facehugger.getAttachmentTicks(),
                    totalDuration);
        }

        return FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.shouldContinueAttachment(
                hostInvalid, hostAttachedByOther, attachmentInProgress);
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        this.facehugger.setAttachmentTicks(0);
        this.facehugger.getNavigation().stop();

        LivingEntity target = this.facehugger.getTarget();
        if (FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.shouldBroadcastHostTargeted(
                !EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target), BoundaryServices.entityQuery()))) {
            LivingEntity broadcastTarget = Objects.requireNonNull(target);
            BlockPos targetPos = broadcastTarget.blockPosition();
            double signalRadius = AIConfigHelper.getDoubleFromMovement(config, "signal_radius", 16.0);
            int signalDuration = AIConfigHelper.getIntFromMovement(config, "signal_duration", 200);

            activeSignal = broadcastSignal(
                    AISignalType.HOST_TARGETED,
                    targetPos,
                    signalRadius,
                    signalDuration);

            if (activeSignal != null) {
                activeSignal.getMetadata().put("targetEntityId", broadcastTarget.getUUID());
                ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                        String.format("📡 Facehugger %s broadcast HOST_TARGETED signal for %s",
                                this.facehugger.getDisplayName().getString(),
                                broadcastTarget.getDisplayName().getString()));
            }
        }

        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                String.format("🦾 Facehugger %s starting attachment goal with target %s",
                        this.facehugger.getDisplayName().getString(),
                        target != null ? target.getDisplayName().getString() : "null"));
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        LivingEntity host = resolveGoalHost();
        if (EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(host), BoundaryServices.entityQuery())) {
            return;
        }
        if (config == null || config.attachmentParameters == null) {
            return;
        }

        LivingEntity attachmentHost = Objects.requireNonNull(host);
        AttachmentState state = Objects.requireNonNull(this.facehugger.getAttachmentState());

        // Orientation ownership: nav/look only while FREE/APPROACHING; latch owned by RotationLock.
        if (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED) {
            this.facehugger.getNavigation().stop();
            ensureHostAttachedSignal(attachmentHost);
            return;
        }

        if (state == AttachmentState.FREE || state == AttachmentState.APPROACHING) {
            this.facehugger.getLookControl().setLookAt(
                    attachmentHost, config.attachmentParameters.lookAngle, config.attachmentParameters.lookAngle);
        }

        double heightRatio = AttachmentConfigHelper.getFaceHeightRatio();
        LivingEntityRef hostRef = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(attachmentHost);
        LivingEntityRef parasiteRef = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(this.facehugger);
        EntityPresentationPort presentation = BoundaryServices.presentation();
        double originDistance = this.facehugger.distanceTo(attachmentHost);
        double attachmentDistance = presentation.distanceToAttachmentPoint(parasiteRef, hostRef, heightRatio);
        double horizontalDistance = presentation.horizontalDistanceToAttachmentPoint(
                parasiteRef, hostRef, heightRatio);
        double latchReach = config.attachmentParameters.minDistance;
        Vec3Ref attachmentPoint = presentation.getAttachmentPoint(hostRef, heightRatio);

        logGeometryIfDue(
                attachmentHost,
                state,
                originDistance,
                attachmentDistance,
                horizontalDistance,
                latchReach,
                attachmentPoint);

        boolean canBeginAttachment =
                AttachmentGeometry.canBeginAttachment(horizontalDistance, latchReach);
        if (canBeginAttachment) {
            this.facehugger.getNavigation().stop();
            this.facehugger.setAttachmentState(AttachmentState.APPROACHING);
            boolean entryComplete = presentation.performAttachmentEntry(
                    parasiteRef, hostRef, heightRatio, latchReach);
            if (!entryComplete) {
                return;
            }
        }

        FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.ApproachTickDecision decision =
                FacehuggerAttachmentPolicy.resolveApproachTick(
                        state,
                        canBeginAttachment ? 0.0D : horizontalDistance,
                        latchReach);

        if (decision.shouldMoveTowardHost()) {
            if (attachmentPoint != null) {
                this.facehugger.getNavigation().moveTo(
                        attachmentPoint.x(),
                        attachmentHost.getY(),
                        attachmentPoint.z(),
                        config.attachmentParameters.moveSpeed);
            } else {
                this.facehugger.getNavigation().moveTo(attachmentHost, config.attachmentParameters.moveSpeed);
            }
            this.facehugger.setAttachmentState(decision.nextState());
        } else if (decision.shouldStopNavigation()) {
            this.facehugger.getNavigation().stop();
            this.facehugger.setAttachmentState(decision.nextState());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void stop() {
        if (activeSignal != null) {
            AISignalSystem.clearSignal(activeSignal);
            activeSignal = null;
        }
        AttachmentState state = Objects.requireNonNull(this.facehugger.getAttachmentState());
        // Mid-latch cancel (not spent): clear noGravity / effects before domain FREE reset.
        if (AttachmentRules.shouldProcessImplantationTick(state)) {
            FacehuggerAttachmentManager.abortLatchCleanup(
                    Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(this.facehugger)),
                    this.facehugger.getAttachmentTarget());
        }
        FacehuggerTickWorkflow.applyAttachmentGoalCancelled(Objects.requireNonNull(this.facehugger));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresUpdateEveryTick() {
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Latched: {@link FacehuggerEntity#resolveLatchedHostEntity()} via binding.
     * Approach: combat {@code getTarget()} only.
     */
    @Nullable
    private LivingEntity resolveGoalHost() {
        AttachmentState state = this.facehugger.getAttachmentState();
        if (state == AttachmentState.ATTACHING || state == AttachmentState.ATTACHED) {
            return this.facehugger.resolveLatchedHostEntity();
        }
        return this.facehugger.getTarget();
    }

    private void logGeometryIfDue(
            LivingEntity host,
            AttachmentState state,
            double originDistance,
            double attachmentDistance,
            double horizontalDistance,
            double latchReach,
            @Nullable Vec3Ref attachmentPoint) {
        if (this.facehugger.tickCount % GEOMETRY_LOG_INTERVAL_TICKS != 0) {
            return;
        }
        String pointStr = attachmentPoint == null
                ? "null"
                : String.format("(%.2f, %.2f, %.2f)", attachmentPoint.x(), attachmentPoint.y(), attachmentPoint.z());
        ModLogger.info(
                "FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                String.format(
                        "📐 latch-geometry host=%s w=%.2f h=%.2f originDist=%.2f attachDist=%.2f "
                                + "horizDist=%.2f min=%.2f max=%.2f attachPoint=%s state=%s",
                        host.getType().toShortString(),
                        host.getBbWidth(),
                        host.getBbHeight(),
                        originDistance,
                        attachmentDistance,
                        horizontalDistance,
                        latchReach,
                        config.attachmentParameters.maxDistance,
                        pointStr,
                        state));
    }

    private void ensureHostAttachedSignal(LivingEntity host) {
        if (activeSignal != null && activeSignal.getType() == AISignalType.HOST_ATTACHED) {
            return;
        }
        if (activeSignal != null) {
            AISignalSystem.clearSignal(activeSignal);
            activeSignal = null;
        }
        double signalRadius = AIConfigHelper.getDoubleFromMovement(config, "signal_radius", 16.0);
        int signalDuration = config.attachmentDuration + config.implantationDelay + 40;
        activeSignal = broadcastSignal(
                AISignalType.HOST_ATTACHED,
                host.blockPosition(),
                signalRadius,
                signalDuration);
        if (activeSignal != null) {
            activeSignal.getMetadata().put("targetEntityId", host.getUUID());
            ModLogger.info("FacehuggerAttachmentGoal",
                    String.format("📡 Facehugger %s broadcast HOST_ATTACHED signal for %s",
                            this.facehugger.getDisplayName().getString(),
                            host.getDisplayName().getString()));
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.entity.EntityValidationHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_4.parasite.HostAvailabilityService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_2.parasite.HostClaimService;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.HostValidationHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.target.NearestAttackableTargetGoal;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;

/**
 * Host targeting goal for facehuggers that uses the host logic system.
 * Targets entities based on their host type and DNA configuration.
 *
 * <p>Uses the {@link NearestAttackableTargetGoal} Predicate constructor — a 1-arg
 * {@code canAttack(LivingEntity)} does not override vanilla
 * {@code canAttack(LivingEntity, TargetingConditions)} on 1.21.1.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.2
 */
public class HostTargetingGoal extends NearestAttackableTargetGoal<LivingEntity> {

    public HostTargetingGoal(FacehuggerEntity facehugger) {
        // Interval 5, mustSee=false, mustReach=false — hatch may leave no target; still hunt hosts.
        super(facehugger, LivingEntity.class, 5, false, false,
                living -> isValidHostCandidate(facehugger, living));
    }

    private static boolean isValidHostCandidate(FacehuggerEntity facehugger, LivingEntity target) {
        if (facehugger.isSpent()) {
            ModLogger.debug("HostTargetingGoal", "🦾 HostTargetingGoal: Facehugger is spent - cannot target new hosts");
            return false;
        }

        if (EntityValidationHelper.isInvalid(BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target), BoundaryServices.entityQuery())) {
            ModLogger.debug("HostTargetingGoal", "🦾 HostTargetingGoal: Target is null or dead");
            return false;
        }

        if (target instanceof Player player && player.getAbilities().instabuild) {
            ModLogger.debug("HostTargetingGoal",
                    String.format("🦾 HostTargetingGoal: Target %s is in creative mode - cannot be targeted",
                            target.getDisplayName().getString()));
            return false;
        }

        var hostRef = BoundaryRefs.entityFrom(target);
        if (!HostAvailabilityService.isHostAvailable(hostRef)) {
            return false;
        }

        long gameTime = target.level().getGameTime();
        if (HostClaimService.isHostClaimedByOther(
                target.getUUID(), facehugger.getUUID(), gameTime)) {
            return false;
        }

        boolean isValid = HostValidationHelper.isValidHostForFacehugger(target);
        ModLogger.debug("HostTargetingGoal",
                String.format("🦾 HostTargetingGoal: Target %s is valid host: %s",
                        target.getDisplayName().getString(), isValid));
        return isValid;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.spawn.SpawnContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;

/**
 * Spawns ovomorph entities when the queen lays eggs.
 */
public final class OvomorphSpawnBinding {

    private OvomorphSpawnBinding() {
    }

    public static void layEgg(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, QueenEntity queen) {
        if (!BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            ModLogger.error("OvomorphSpawnBinding", "Cannot lay egg - BoundaryServices not initialized");
            return;
        }

        SpawnContext context = SpawnContext.at(
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level),
                pos.getX() + 0.5,
                pos.getY(),
                pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                queen.getYRot(),
                queen.getXRot(),
                0f);

        boolean spawned = BoundaryServices.spawn().spawnForm(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH, context);
        if (spawned) {
            ModLogger.info("OvomorphSpawnBinding", "Queen laid an egg at: " + pos);
        } else {
            ModLogger.error("OvomorphSpawnBinding", "Failed to lay egg - spawn port rejected spawn");
        }
    }
}

FILE: PatrolNestGoal.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.ConfigCacheHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.territory.DroneTerritoryHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.territory.QueenTerritory;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.NestPatrolHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.DroneEntity;

/**
 * AI goal for drone nest patrol behavior.
 * Drones wander within nest territory boundary when not in combat.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class PatrolNestGoal extends Goal {

    private final DroneEntity drone;
    private BlockPos nestCenter;
    private int patrolRadius;
    private int patrolTimer = 0;
    private boolean pathFailed;
    private EntityConfig config;

    public PatrolNestGoal(DroneEntity drone) {
        this.drone = drone;
        // Do not always claim MOVE — combat goals must be able to run.
        this.setFlags(Objects.requireNonNull(EnumSet.noneOf(Flag.class)));
        this.config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }

    private int getPatrolInterval() {
        return AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "patrol_interval");
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        LivingEntity target = drone.getTarget();
        if (target != null && target.isAlive()) {
            return false;
        }
        return findNearestNest();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        if (pathFailed) {
            return false;
        }
        LivingEntity target = drone.getTarget();
        if (target != null && target.isAlive()) {
            return false;
        }
        return findNearestNest();
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        findNearestNest();
        patrolTimer = 0;
        pathFailed = false;
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        if (nestCenter == null) {
            return;
        }

        patrolTimer++;

        int interval = getPatrolInterval();
        if (patrolTimer >= interval) {
            if (!moveToGroundPatrolTarget()) {
                pathFailed = true;
                drone.getNavigation().stop();
                ModLogger.debug("PatrolNestGoal", "⚠️ Patrol path failed — stopping patrol");
                return;
            }
            ModLogger.debug("PatrolNestGoal", "🔄 Drone moving to random patrol position within radius: " + patrolRadius);
            patrolTimer = 0;
        }

        if (!NestPatrolHelper.isWithinRadius(drone, nestCenter, patrolRadius)) {
            NestPatrolHelper.moveTowardsNest(drone, nestCenter);
            ModLogger.debug("PatrolNestGoal", "🏠 Drone returning to nest center");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void stop() {
        nestCenter = null;
        pathFailed = false;
        drone.getNavigation().stop();
    }

    private boolean moveToGroundPatrolTarget() {
        BlockPos randomPos = NestPatrolHelper.generateRandomPosition(drone, nestCenter, patrolRadius);
        if (randomPos == null) {
            return false;
        }
        int groundY = drone.level().getHeight(
                Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES,
                randomPos.getX(),
                randomPos.getZ());
        Vec3 target = new Vec3(randomPos.getX() + 0.5D, groundY, randomPos.getZ() + 0.5D);
        return drone.getNavigation().moveTo(target.x, target.y, target.z, 1.0D);
    }

    private boolean findNearestNest() {
        QueenTerritory nearestTerritory = DroneTerritoryHelper.findNearestTerritory(
                BoundaryRefs.from(drone.blockPosition()), 64);

        if (nearestTerritory != null) {
            this.nestCenter = BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(nearestTerritory.getCenterPos());
            this.patrolRadius = nearestTerritory.getRadius();
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresUpdateEveryTick() {
        return false;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.Vec3Ref;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;

import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3;

/**
 * Per-queen avoidance state and goal factory. Detection and math delegate to focused types.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FLUX
 */
public class QueenAvoidanceAI {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private QueenEntity nearestOtherQueen;
    private double avoidanceStrength;

    public QueenAvoidanceAI(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
    }

    public void tick() {
        if (queen.level().isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(queen.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return;
        }

        int minDistance = TerritoryConfig.getMinQueenDistance();
        EntityType<?> queenType = queen.getType();
        var nearest = QueenProximityQuery.findNearest(serverLevel, queen, minDistance, queenType);
        nearestOtherQueen = nearest instanceof QueenEntity queenEntity ? queenEntity : null;

        if (nearestOtherQueen == null) {
            avoidanceStrength = 0.0;
            return;
        }

        double distance = queen.distanceTo(nearestOtherQueen);
        avoidanceStrength = AvoidancePolicy.computeAvoidanceStrength(distance, minDistance);

        if (AvoidancePolicy.shouldLogStrongAvoidance(avoidanceStrength)) {
            ModLogger.info("QueenAvoidanceAI",
                    "Queen avoiding other queen - Distance: " + String.format("%.1f", distance)
                            + " blocks, Strength: " + String.format("%.2f", avoidanceStrength));
        }
    }

    public Goal createGoal() {
        return new QueenAvoidanceGoal();
    }

    public Vec3 getAvoidanceDirection() {
        if (nearestOtherQueen == null || avoidanceStrength <= 0.0) {
            return null;
        }

        Vec3Ref flee = AvoidancePolicy.fleeDirection(
                toRef(queen.position()),
                toRef(nearestOtherQueen.position()),
                avoidanceStrength);
        return toVec3(flee);
    }

    public boolean shouldAvoid() {
        return nearestOtherQueen != null && AvoidancePolicy.shouldFlee(avoidanceStrength);
    }

    public QueenEntity getNearestOtherQueen() {
        return nearestOtherQueen;
    }

    public double getAvoidanceStrength() {
        return avoidanceStrength;
    }

    private static Vec3Ref toRef(Vec3 position) {
        return new Vec3Ref(position.x, position.y, position.z);
    }

    private static Vec3 toVec3(Vec3Ref ref) {
        return new Vec3(ref.x(), ref.y(), ref.z());
    }

    private final class QueenAvoidanceGoal extends Goal {

        private final EntityConfig config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.QUEEN);

        QueenAvoidanceGoal() {
            setFlags(Objects.requireNonNull(EnumSet.of(Flag.MOVE)));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canUse() {
            return shouldAvoid();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean canContinueToUse() {
            return shouldAvoid();
        }

        @Override
        public boolean requiresUpdateEveryTick() {
            return true;
        }

        @Override
        public void tick() {
            QueenAvoidanceAI.this.tick();
            Vec3 direction = getAvoidanceDirection();
            if (direction == null) {
                return;
            }

            double distanceMultiplier = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromSpecialAbilities(
                    config, "avoidance_distance_multiplier");
            double speedMultiplier = AIConfigHelper.requireDoubleFromSpecialAbilities(
                    config, "avoidance_speed_multiplier");

            Vec3 fleePos = NeoForgePositionSearchAdapter.searchVec3InRadius(
                    queen,
                    direction,
                    8.0 * distanceMultiplier,
                    10,
                    pos -> queen.level().getBlockState(
                            Objects.requireNonNull(BlockPos.containing(Objects.requireNonNull(pos)))).isAir());

            if (fleePos != null) {
                queen.getNavigation().moveTo(fleePos.x, fleePos.y, fleePos.z, speedMultiplier);
            } else {
                queen.getNavigation().moveTo(
                        queen.getX() + direction.x * distanceMultiplier,
                        queen.getY(),
                        queen.getZ() + direction.z * distanceMultiplier,
                        speedMultiplier);
            }
        }
    }
}
