package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.ai.SurvivalBehaviorRules;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.ai.SurvivalAIConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.ai.SurvivalAIConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.NeoForgeEscapeNavigationAdapter;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.BlockDamageBridge;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.boundary.NeoForgeSuffocationProbe;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;


/**
 * Minecraft implementation of xenomorph survival behavior.
 *
 * Bridges Minecraft entity state into domain survival rules
 * and performs Minecraft-specific escape actions.
 *
 * Responsibilities:
 * - Detect Minecraft suffocation state
 * - Track Minecraft tick state
 * - Execute escape actions
 *
 * Does not contain survival decision rules.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: REFACTORED
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class SurvivalAIGoal extends Goal {

    private static final String AI_NAME = "SurvivalAI";

    private final PathfinderMob entity;
    private final Level level;
    private final SurvivalAIConfig config;

    private int stuckTimer = 0;
    private int escapeCooldown = 0;


    public SurvivalAIGoal(PathfinderMob entity) {
        this.entity = entity;
        this.level = entity.level();
        this.config = SurvivalAIConfigStorage.getConfig();
    }


    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {

        if (!NeoForgeSuffocationProbe.isSuffocating(entity)) {
            return false;
        }

        return SurvivalBehaviorRules.shouldEscapeSuffocation(
                getAirRatio(),
                isStuck(),
                config.suffocationCriticalThreshold,
                config.suffocationLowThreshold);
    }


    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {

        return NeoForgeSuffocationProbe.isSuffocating(entity)
                && !SurvivalBehaviorRules.isStuck(
                        stuckTimer,
                        config.stuckThresholdTicks);
    }


    @Override
    public void start() {

        ModLogger.info(
                AI_NAME,
                "🚨 Entity suffocating, attempting to move to safety");

        stuckTimer = 0;
    }


    @Override
    public void tick() {

        stuckTimer++;
        escapeCooldown--;

        if (SurvivalBehaviorRules.canAttemptEscape(escapeCooldown)) {

            escapeCooldown =
                    config.escapeAttemptIntervalTicks;

            attemptEscape();
        }
    }


    private void attemptEscape() {

        BlockPos feet = entity.blockPosition();

        BlockDamageBridge.attemptBlockDamage(
                entity,
                level,
                feet);

        BlockDamageBridge.attemptBlockDamage(
                entity,
                level,
                feet.above());

        NeoForgeEscapeNavigationAdapter
                .attemptEscape(entity, level);
    }


    private boolean isStuck() {

        return SurvivalBehaviorRules.isStuck(
                stuckTimer,
                config.stuckThresholdTicks);
    }


    private double getAirRatio() {

        int maxAir = entity.getMaxAirSupply();

        if (maxAir <= 0) {
            return 1.0;
        }

        return (double) entity.getAirSupply() / maxAir;
    }


    @Override
    public void stop() {

        if (!NeoForgeSuffocationProbe.isSuffocating(entity)) {

            ModLogger.info(
                    AI_NAME,
                    "✅ Entity successfully moved to safety");
        }

        stuckTimer = 0;
        escapeCooldown = 0;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_3.territory.TerritoryConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.territory.QueenNestRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.NestPatrolHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;

import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;
import net.minecraft.world.level.levelgen.Heightmap;

/**
 * Queen nest home leash: return when outside nest radius; stroll randomly when home.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FUNCTIONAL — S2B playtest OK (nest / wander).
 */
public final class WanderNearNestGoal extends Goal {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private int repathCooldown;

    public WanderNearNestGoal(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
        this.setFlags(Objects.requireNonNull(EnumSet.noneOf(Flag.class)));
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        if (!queen.hasNest()) {
            return false;
        }
        BlockPos center = nestCenter();
        if (center == null) {
            return false;
        }
        int radius = nestHomeRadius();
        // Outside nest — always reclaim home (higher-priority combat/avoidance preempt this goal).
        if (!NestPatrolHelper.isWithinRadius(queen, center, radius)) {
            return true;
        }
        return queen.getRandom().nextInt(3) == 0;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        if (!queen.hasNest()) {
            return false;
        }
        BlockPos center = nestCenter();
        if (center == null) {
            return false;
        }
        int radius = nestHomeRadius();
        if (!NestPatrolHelper.isWithinRadius(queen, center, radius)) {
            return true;
        }
        return !queen.getNavigation().isDone();
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        pickNestWanderTarget();
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        BlockPos center = nestCenter();
        if (center == null) {
            return;
        }
        int radius = nestHomeRadius();
        if (!NestPatrolHelper.isWithinRadius(queen, center, radius)) {
            NestPatrolHelper.moveTowardsNest(queen, center);
            repathCooldown = 20;
            return;
        }
        if (--repathCooldown <= 0 && queen.getNavigation().isDone()) {
            pickNestWanderTarget();
        }
    }

    private void pickNestWanderTarget() {
        BlockPos center = nestCenter();
        if (center == null) {
            return;
        }
        int radius = nestHomeRadius();
        if (!NestPatrolHelper.isWithinRadius(queen, center, radius)) {
            NestPatrolHelper.moveTowardsNest(queen, center);
            repathCooldown = 20;
            return;
        }

        BlockPos randomPos = NestPatrolHelper.generateRandomPosition(queen, center, radius);
        if (randomPos == null) {
            return;
        }
        int targetY = queen.level().getHeight(
                Heightmap.Types.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES,
                randomPos.getX(),
                randomPos.getZ());
        if (queen.getNavigation().moveTo(randomPos.getX() + 0.5, targetY, randomPos.getZ() + 0.5, 0.6D)) {
            repathCooldown = 40;
        }
    }

    private BlockPos nestCenter() {
        BlockPosRef centerRef = QueenNestRegistry.getNestCenter(queen.getUUID());
        if (centerRef == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(centerRef);
    }

    private static int nestHomeRadius() {
        return Math.max(TerritoryConfig.getNestInnerRadius(), TerritoryConfig.getNestRadius() / 2);
    }
}

            @Override
            @Nonnull
            public Class<? extends LivingEntity> getTargetClass() {
                return ChestbursterEntity.class;
            }
            
            @Override

            @Override
            @Nonnull
            public Class<? extends LivingEntity> getTargetClass() {
                return DroneEntity.class;
            }

                return QueenEntity.class;
            }

            }
        });

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.ai.AIContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.client.AIContextDetector;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Helper class for animation transition duration calculations.
 * Extracted from animation handlers to eliminate duplicate logic.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: STABLE
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
public class AnimationTransitionHelper {
    
    /**
     * Gets the transition duration from entity config, adjusted by AI context.
     * Falls back to 30 ticks (1.5 seconds) if config is not available.
     * 
     * TUNING: Adjust "transition_duration_ticks" and "transition_modifiers" in entity JSON config files
     * (e.g., data/biocraft_alien/entity/xenomorph/human/drone.json under "client_parameters")
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to get transition duration for
     * @param xenomorphType The xenomorph type for config lookup
     * @return Transition duration in ticks (clamped to 10-60 ticks)
     */
    public static int getTransitionDuration(LivingEntity entity, XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);
        int baseDuration = 30; // Default fallback: 1.5 seconds at 20 TPS
        
        if (config != null && config.clientParameters != null) {
            baseDuration = config.clientParameters.transitionDurationTicks;
        }
        
        // Detect AI context and apply speed modifier
        AIContext context = AIContextDetector.detectContext(entity);
        AIContextDetector.TransitionSpeedModifiers modifiers = AIContextDetector.TransitionSpeedModifiers.fromConfig(config);
        float speedModifier = AIContextDetector.getTransitionSpeedModifier(entity, context, modifiers);
        
        // Apply modifier (faster = shorter duration, slower = longer duration)
        int adjustedDuration = Math.round(baseDuration / speedModifier);
        
        // Clamp to reasonable bounds (10-60 ticks)
        return Math.max(10, Math.min(60, adjustedDuration));
    }
    
    // Private constructor to prevent instantiation
    private AnimationTransitionHelper() {
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("AnimationTransitionHelper is a utility class and cannot be instantiated");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.ChestbursterEntity;

/**
 * Handles all animation state updates for Chestburster entities.
 * Triggers serpentine animation when chestburster is moving.
 *
 * <p>FILE STATUS: PLANNED — serpentine/jump/fall wired; polish deferred to client slice.
 */
public final class ChestbursterAnimationStateHandler {
    
    // TODO: CRITICAL - Missing transition animations. Entities instant-switch between standing (idle) and crawling (movement) poses. Need smooth transition animations between states (stand-to-crawl, crawl-to-stand).
    // TODO: Create hiding animation (curled up, defensive) - needed for hiding behavior
    // TODO: Create maturation animation (growing, transforming) - needed for maturation visual feedback
    // TODO: Create hunting animation (stalking, attacking) - needed for hunting behavior
    
    public static void updateAnimationState(ChestbursterEntity entity) {
        // Detect jump/fall states (highest priority)
        boolean isJumping = !entity.onGround() && entity.getDeltaMovement().y > 0.0D;
        boolean isFalling = !entity.onGround() && entity.getDeltaMovement().y <= 0.0D;
        boolean isMoving = entity.getDeltaMovement().horizontalDistanceSqr() > 1.0E-6D;
        
        // Priority: jumping/falling > movement > idle
        if (isJumping) {
            // Entity is jumping - play jump animation (will use default pose if animation doesn't exist)
            if (!entity.jumpingAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.jumpingAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
            entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.serpentineAnimationState.stop();
            return;
        }
        
        if (isFalling) {
            // Entity is falling - play fall animation (will use default pose if animation doesn't exist)
            if (!entity.fallingAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.fallingAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
            entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.serpentineAnimationState.stop();
            return;
        }
        
        // Not jumping or falling - stop jump/fall animations
        entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
        entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();
        
        // Trigger serpentine animation based on horizontal movement
        if (isMoving) {
            // Start serpentine animation if not already running
            if (!entity.serpentineAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.serpentineAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
        } else {
            // Stop serpentine animation if standing still
            entity.serpentineAnimationState.stop();
        }
    }
}

 * Render-time animation binding for chestburster geo models.
 */
public final class ChestbursterModelAnimationSetup implements XenomorphModelAnimationSetup {

    public static final ChestbursterModelAnimationSetup INSTANCE = new ChestbursterModelAnimationSetup();

    private ChestbursterModelAnimationSetup() {
    }

    @Override
    public <T extends LivingEntity> void setupAnimations(
            @Nonnull T entity,
            @Nonnull HierarchicalModel<T> model,
            @Nonnull AnimationCaller animator,
            float ageInTicks) {
        if (!(entity instanceof ChestbursterEntity chestburster)) {
            return;
        }

        resetPose(model);

        if (chestburster.serpentineAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(chestburster.serpentineAnimationState, ChestbursterModelAnimation.serpentine, ageInTicks);
        }
    }
}

            AnimationDefinition crawlingToStanding,
            AnimationDefinition crawlPose,
            AnimationDefinition idleStanding,
            AnimationDefinition idleCrawl) {
    }

    private CrawlingFormAnimationSetup() {
    }

    public static <T extends LivingEntity> void apply(
            XenomorphModelAnimationSetup setup,
            T entity,
            HierarchicalModel<T> model,
            AnimationCaller animator,
            float ageInTicks,
            XenomorphType type,
            float transitionLengthSeconds,
            AnimationStates states,
            AnimationDefinitions definitions) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(setup).resetPose(Objects.requireNonNull(model));

        if (states.standingToCrawling().isStarted()) {
            float speedMultiplier = AnimationSpeedHelper.calculateTransitionSpeedMultiplier(
                    type, transitionLengthSeconds);
            animator.animate(states.standingToCrawling(), definitions.standingToCrawling(),
                    ageInTicks * speedMultiplier);
        } else if (states.crawlingToStanding().isStarted()) {
            float speedMultiplier = AnimationSpeedHelper.calculateTransitionSpeedMultiplier(
                    type, transitionLengthSeconds);
            animator.animate(states.crawlingToStanding(), definitions.crawlingToStanding(),
                    ageInTicks * speedMultiplier);
        } else if (states.moving().isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(states.moving(), definitions.crawlPose(), ageInTicks);
        } else if (states.idle().isStarted()) {
            boolean useCrawlIdle = isCrawlingForm(entity);
            AnimationDefinition idleClip = useCrawlIdle ? definitions.idleCrawl() : definitions.idleStanding();
            animator.animate(states.idle(), idleClip, ageInTicks);
        }
    }

    private static boolean isCrawlingForm(LivingEntity entity) {
        if (entity instanceof DroneEntity drone) {
            return drone.crawlingForm;
        }
        if (entity instanceof QueenEntity queen) {
            return queen.crawlingForm;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

FILE: FacehuggerAnimationStateHandler.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.parasite.AttachmentState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;

/**
 * Handles all animation state updates for Facehugger entities.
 * Triggers animations based on state: attachment (highest priority) > walking > idle.
 * Climbing keeps walk animation (no jump/fall T-pose).
 *
 * <p>TODO(BUG-LIFECYCLE-001): Stage 5 polish — Enderman / looking-down seat distance residual.
 */
public final class FacehuggerAnimationStateHandler {

    private FacehuggerAnimationStateHandler() {
    }

    public static void updateAnimationState(FacehuggerEntity entity) {
        AttachmentState attachmentState = entity.getAttachmentState();
        boolean isAttaching = attachmentState == AttachmentState.ATTACHING
                || attachmentState == AttachmentState.ATTACHED
                || entity.isNoGravity();
        boolean isClimbing = entity.onClimbable();
        boolean isMoving = isClimbing
                || entity.getDeltaMovement().horizontalDistanceSqr() > 1.0E-6D
                || Math.abs(entity.getDeltaMovement().y) > 1.0E-6D && isClimbing;

        if (isAttaching) {
            if (!entity.attachmentAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.attachmentAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
            entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.walkAnimationState.stop();
            entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
        } else if (isMoving || isClimbing) {
            // Keep locomotion while climbing/airborne — skip jump/fall until clips exist.
            entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();
            if (!entity.walkAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.walkAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
            entity.attachmentAnimationState.stop();
            entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
        } else {
            entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
            entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();
            if (!entity.idleAnimationState.isStarted()) {
                entity.idleAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
            entity.attachmentAnimationState.stop();
            entity.walkAnimationState.stop();
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.FacehuggerModelAnimation;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client.XenomorphModelAnimationSetup;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;

import net.minecraft.client.model.HierarchicalModel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Render-time animation binding for facehugger geo models.
 */
public final class FacehuggerModelAnimationSetup implements XenomorphModelAnimationSetup {

    public static final FacehuggerModelAnimationSetup INSTANCE = new FacehuggerModelAnimationSetup();

    private FacehuggerModelAnimationSetup() {
    }

    @Override
    public <T extends LivingEntity> void setupAnimations(
            @Nonnull T entity,
            @Nonnull HierarchicalModel<T> model,
            @Nonnull AnimationCaller animator,
            float ageInTicks) {
        if (!(entity instanceof FacehuggerEntity facehugger)) {
            return;
        }

        resetPose(model);

        if (facehugger.attachmentAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(facehugger.attachmentAnimationState, FacehuggerModelAnimation.facehugging, ageInTicks);
        } else if (facehugger.walkAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(facehugger.walkAnimationState, FacehuggerModelAnimation.walk, ageInTicks);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.LivingEntityRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.handling.HandlingResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenVariant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPenBehavior;

import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;

/**
 * Minecraft-bound containment pen behavior using {@link ContainmentPenVariant} policy from L2.
 *
 * <p>Release/admit go through {@link ContainmentPenBlockEntity#requestRelease} /
 * {@link ContainmentPenBlockEntity#requestAdmit} — never organism-type spawn.
 */
public class AbstractContainmentPenBehavior implements ContainmentPenBehavior {

    private final ContainmentPenVariant variant;

    protected AbstractContainmentPenBehavior(@Nonnull ContainmentPenVariant variant) {
        this.variant = variant;
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public String getSpecimenType() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(variant.specimenType());
    }

    @Nonnull
    protected String getTranslationPrefix() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(variant.translationPrefix());
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public String getLogPrefix() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(variant.logPrefix());
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public Component getStructureFormedMessage() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(getTranslationPrefix() + ".structure_formed"));
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public Component getStatusMessage(@Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        String display = entity.getOccupantDisplayName().isBlank()
                ? entity.getSpecimenType()
                : entity.getOccupantDisplayName();
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                getTranslationPrefix() + ".status",
                entity.getStructureWidth(), entity.getStructureDepth(), entity.getStructureHeight(),
                Component.translatable("message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.contains", display)));
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public Component getEmptyMessage(@Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                getTranslationPrefix() + ".status",
                entity.getStructureWidth(), entity.getStructureDepth(), entity.getStructureHeight(),
                Component.translatable(getTranslationPrefix() + ".empty")));
    }

    /**
     * Releases the current occupant via handling — membership only, no spawn.
     */
    protected HandlingResult releaseOccupant(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity,
            @Nonnull ServerLevel level) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(entity, "entity");
        Objects.requireNonNull(level, "level");
        UUID occupantId = entity.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal().orElse(null);
        if (occupantId == null) {
            return HandlingResult.rejected("containment has no occupant");
        }
        LivingEntityRef ref = new LivingEntityRef(occupantId, BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level));
        return entity.requestRelease(ref);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.item.ItemEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.admission.AdmissionResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.InteriorVolume;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.admission.AdmissionContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.SpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.admission.AdmissionServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_3.admission.AdmissionTransaction;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ItemSpecimenSourceFactory;

/**
 * Runs an Admission Transaction against a formed containment pen controller.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-UI-001)
 */
public final class ContainmentPenAdmissionRunner {

    private ContainmentPenAdmissionRunner() {
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static AdmissionResult contain(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen,
            @Nonnull ItemStackCarrier carrier,
            @Nonnull ServerPlayer player) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen, "pen");
        Objects.requireNonNull(carrier, "carrier");
        Objects.requireNonNull(player, "player");

        Level level = pen.getLevel();
        if (!(level instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(AdmissionResult.rollback("not on server"));
        }
        InteriorVolume interior = pen.getInteriorVolume();
        if (interior == null || !pen.isFormed()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(AdmissionResult.rollback("containment structure is not formed"));
        }

        Optional<SpecimenSource> sourceOpt = ItemSpecimenSourceFactory.create(carrier);
        if (sourceOpt.isEmpty()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(AdmissionResult.rollback("unsupported specimen source"));
        }

        BlockPos pos = pen.getBlockPos();
        AdmissionContext context = AdmissionContext.atInteriorCenter(
                pen.getContainmentVolumeIdInternal(),
                interior,
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(serverLevel),
                pos.getX(),
                pos.getY(),
                pos.getZ());

        AdmissionResult result = AdmissionTransaction.run(
                sourceOpt.get(),
                AdmissionServices.realization(),
                pen.containmentPortForAdmission(),
                pen.occupancyPortForAdmission(),
                context);

        if (result.committed()) {
            pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal().ifPresent(uuid -> {
                if (serverLevel.getEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(uuid)) instanceof LivingEntity living) {
                    pen.setOccupantDisplayNameInternal(
                            Objects.requireNonNull(living.getDisplayName().getString()));
                    // Re-seat after ADMIT / collision nudge (esp. no-gravity ovomorph).
                    living.teleportTo(context.x(), context.y(), context.z());
                    living.setDeltaMovement(Objects.requireNonNull(net.minecraft.world.phys.Vec3.ZERO));
                    living.fallDistance = 0.0F;
                    living.setOnGround(true);
                }
            });
            pen.syncToClient();
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.admission_committed")));
            ModLogger.info("Admission", "Committed admission at " + pos);
        } else {
            player.sendSystemMessage(Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "message.biocraft_alien.containment_pen.admission_rolled_back",
                    result.reason() == null ? "unknown" : result.reason())));
        }

        // Inventory-full / leftover empty container: drop at controller if carrier empty after settle
        // and settlement requested empty bucket but stack was cleared oddly — drop one bucket as safety.
        ensureEmptyContainerDropped(serverLevel, pos, carrier.get());
        return Objects.requireNonNull(result);
    }

    private static void ensureEmptyContainerDropped(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, ItemStack carrierStack) {
        // Bucket settle replaces in-slot; if somehow empty with no stack, drop a bucket for UX safety.
        if (!carrierStack.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        // no-op when slot emptied by spawn-egg consume — correct behavior
    }

    public static void dropStackAtController(Level level, BlockPos pos, ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack.isEmpty() || level.isClientSide) {
            return;
        }
        ItemEntity entity = new ItemEntity(
                level,
                pos.getX() + 0.5,
                pos.getY() + 1.0,
                pos.getZ() + 0.5,
                stack);
        level.addFreshEntity(entity);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment;

import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.level.BlockEvent;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.lab.ContainmentPenBlueprint;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenVariant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks.ContainmentPenControllerBlock;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks.ContainmentPenInteractions;

/**
 * Place-triggered one-shot formation when a build cell completes a valid pen enclosure.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenFormationTrigger {

    private static final int SCAN = Math.max(
            ContainmentPenBlueprint.MAX_WIDTH, Math.max(ContainmentPenBlueprint.MAX_DEPTH, ContainmentPenBlueprint.MAX_HEIGHT));

    private ContainmentPenFormationTrigger() {
    }

    public static void onBlockPlaced(BlockEvent.EntityPlaceEvent event) {
        if (event.getLevel().isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!(event.getLevel() instanceof Level level)) {
            return;
        }
        BlockPos placed = event.getPos();
        Player player = event.getEntity() instanceof Player p ? p : null;
        tryFormControllersNear(level, placed, player);
    }

    public static void tryFormControllersNear(Level level, BlockPos worldPos, @Nullable Player player) {
        BlockPos.MutableBlockPos cursor = new BlockPos.MutableBlockPos();
        for (int dy = -SCAN; dy <= SCAN; dy++) {
            for (int dx = -SCAN; dx <= SCAN; dx++) {
                for (int dz = -SCAN; dz <= SCAN; dz++) {
                    cursor.set(worldPos.getX() + dx, worldPos.getY() + dy, worldPos.getZ() + dz);
                    BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(cursor);
                    if (!(be instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity) || podEntity.isFormed()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    ContainmentPenVariant variant = ContainmentPenVariant.GENERIC;
                    if (level.getBlockState(cursor).getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenControllerBlock controller) {
                        variant = controller.variant();
                    }
                    ContainmentPenInteractions.tryFormIfComplete(
                            podEntity,
                            Objects.requireNonNull(cursor.immutable()),
                            Objects.requireNonNull(variant),
                            player);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityTicker;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntityType;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockBehaviour;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.StateDefinition;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.CollisionContext;
import net.minecraft.world.phys.shapes.VoxelShape;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenShellPresentation;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.BaseLabBlock;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks.ContainmentPenControllerBlock;

/**
 * Formed containment-pen shell — interaction proxy + role-based presentation.
 *
 * <p>Controller link is {@link ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity#getControllerPos()}. Capacity uses
 * interior volume on the controller — never these shapes.
 */
public class ContainmentPenShellBlock extends BaseLabBlock implements EntityBlock {

    private static final VoxelShape FULL = createFullBlockShape();

    private final boolean openPanePresentation;

    public ContainmentPenShellBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties) {
        this(properties, false);
    }

    public ContainmentPenShellBlock(BlockBehaviour.Properties properties, boolean openPanePresentation) {
        super(properties);
        this.openPanePresentation = openPanePresentation;
        registerDefaultState(Objects.requireNonNull(
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.defaultFaces(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(stateDefinition.any()))));
    }

    public boolean openPanePresentation() {
        return openPanePresentation;
    }

    @Override
    protected void createBlockStateDefinition(@Nonnull StateDefinition.Builder<Block, BlockState> builder) {
        builder.add(
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.NORTH,
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.SOUTH,
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.WEST,
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.EAST,
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.UP,
                ContainmentPenShellPresentation.DOWN);
    }

    @Override
    protected VoxelShape getBlockShape() {
        return FULL;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public BlockEntity newBlockEntity(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
        return ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration.create(pos, state);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public <T extends BlockEntity> BlockEntityTicker<T> getTicker(
            @Nonnull Level level, @Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockEntityType<T> type) {
        return null;
    }

    @Nullable
    public static BlockPos controllerPos(Level level, BlockPos shellPos) {
        BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(shellPos));
        if (be instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity shell) {
            return shell.getControllerPos();
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public VoxelShape getShape(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull BlockGetter level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull CollisionContext context) {
        if (openPanePresentation) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(ContainmentPenShellPresentation.shapeFromFaces(state));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(FULL);
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public VoxelShape getCollisionShape(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull BlockGetter level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull CollisionContext context) {
        return getShape(state, level, pos, context);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean propagatesSkylightDown(
            @Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockGetter level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos) {
        return openPanePresentation || super.propagatesSkylightDown(state, level, pos);
    }

    @Override
    public float getShadeBrightness(
            @Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockGetter level, @Nonnull BlockPos pos) {
        return openPanePresentation ? 1.0F : super.getShadeBrightness(state, level, pos);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean skipRendering(
            @Nonnull BlockState state, @Nonnull BlockState adjacentState, @Nonnull Direction side) {
        if (openPanePresentation && adjacentState.getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock adjacent
                && adjacent.openPanePresentation()) {
            return true;
        }
        return super.skipRendering(state, adjacentState, side);
    }

    @Override
    protected InteractionResult useWithoutItem(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        BlockPos controller = controllerPos(level, pos);
        if (controller == null) {
            return InteractionResult.PASS;
        }
        return ContainmentPenControllerBlock.interactAtController(level, controller, player);
    }

    @Override
    protected ItemInteractionResult useItemOn(
            @Nonnull ItemStack stack,
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull Player player,
            @Nonnull net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand,
            @Nonnull BlockHitResult hit) {
        if (stack.getItem() instanceof BlockItem) {
            return ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
        }
        BlockPos controller = controllerPos(level, pos);
        if (controller == null) {
            return ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
        }
        InteractionResult result = ContainmentPenControllerBlock.interactAtController(level, controller, player);
        return result.consumesAction()
                ? ItemInteractionResult.SUCCESS
                : ItemInteractionResult.PASS_TO_DEFAULT_BLOCK_INTERACTION;
    }

    @Override
    public void onRemove(
            @Nonnull BlockState state,
            @Nonnull Level level,
            @Nonnull BlockPos pos,
            @Nonnull BlockState newState,
            boolean isMoving) {
        if (!state.is(Objects.requireNonNull(newState.getBlock())) && !level.isClientSide) {
            BlockPos controller = controllerPos(level, pos);
            if (controller != null) {
                BlockEntity blockEntity = level.getBlockEntity(controller);
                if (blockEntity instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity podEntity
                        && podEntity.isFormed()
                        && !podEntity.isDissolvingStructure()) {
                    podEntity.breakStructure();
                }
            }
        }
        super.onRemove(state, level, pos, newState, isMoving);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.entity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ovomorph.OvomorphHatchPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.ovomorph.OvomorphHatchWorkflow;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchHost;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.OvomorphHatchPortAdapter;

/**
 * Per-egg hatch workflow session: timer state + port-driven tick progression.
 */
public final class OvomorphHatchSession {

    private final OvomorphHatchHost host;
    private final OvomorphHatchPort hatchPort;
    private final OvomorphHatchWorkflow.State workflowState = new OvomorphHatchWorkflow.State();

    public OvomorphHatchSession(OvomorphHatchHost host) {
        this.host = host;
        this.hatchPort = new OvomorphHatchPortAdapter(host);
    }

    public OvomorphHatchWorkflow.State workflowState() {
        return workflowState;
    }

    public void startHatching(int tickCount) {
        if (!host.isHatching()) {
            host.setHatching(true);
            OvomorphHatchWorkflow.onHatchingStarted(hatchPort, workflowState);
            host.startOpeningAnimation(tickCount);
            ModLogger.info("OvomorphHatchSession",
                    "Ovomorph started hatching at " + host.mob().blockPosition());
        }
    }

    public void processTick(int tickCount) {
        if (host.isHatching()) {
            OvomorphHatchWorkflow.processTick(hatchPort, workflowState, tickCount);
        }
    }
}

    public static final DeferredRegister<MobEffect> EFFECTS =

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.nest;

import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.territory.QueenNestRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.territory.QueenTerritory;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.territory.TerritoryManager;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.territory.NestTerritoryFactory;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;

/**
 * Territory restore / register binding for nest building port.
 */
public final class NestPortTerritoryBinding {

    private NestPortTerritoryBinding() {
    }

    public static BlockPos restoreNestState(
            QueenEntity queen,
            BlockPosRef nestCenter,
            boolean expandingToHive) {
        BlockPos nestPosition = BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(nestCenter);
        UUID queenUUID = queen.getUUID();
        if (NestTerritoryFactory.shouldRegisterMissingTerritory(
                TerritoryManager.getTerritory(queenUUID) != null)) {
            TerritoryManager.registerTerritory(
                    queenUUID,
                    NestTerritoryFactory.createTerritory(
                            nestCenter,
                            expandingToHive,
                            queenUUID,
                            queen.level().getGameTime()));
        }
        return nestPosition;
    }

    public static BlockPos registerTerritory(
            QueenEntity queen,
            BlockPosRef nestPos,
            boolean hiveStage,
            Consumer<BlockPos> nestPositionSink) {
        UUID queenUUID = queen.getUUID();
        QueenTerritory territory = NestTerritoryFactory.createTerritory(
                nestPos,
                hiveStage,
                queenUUID,
                queen.level().getGameTime());
        TerritoryManager.registerTerritory(queenUUID, territory);
        QueenNestRegistry.registerNest(queenUUID, nestPos);
        BlockPos resolved = BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(nestPos);
        nestPositionSink.accept(resolved);
        return resolved;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIGoalConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.GoalPriorityResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.AICompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.ChestbursterEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.SurvivalAIGoal;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Chestburster goal composition via {@link AICompositionStrategy}.
 */
public final class ChestbursterCompositionStrategy implements AICompositionStrategy {

    private static final ChestbursterCompositionStrategy INSTANCE = new ChestbursterCompositionStrategy();

    public static void registerGoals(ChestbursterEntity chestburster) {
        INSTANCE.applyGoals(chestburster);
    }

    public static int getMaturationTime() {
        return AIGoalConfigHelper.getMaturationTime(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyGoals(Mob mob) {
        if (!(mob instanceof ChestbursterEntity chestburster)) {
            return;
        }
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER);
        if (config != null && config.aiGoals != null) {
            ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar.registerGoals(chestburster, config.aiGoals);
        }
        chestburster.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER, "survival"),
                new SurvivalAIGoal(chestburster));
    }

    @Override
    public String strategyName() {
        return "chestburster";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIGoalConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.ConfigCacheHelper;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.DroneEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.DroneSwarmGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.PatrolNestGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.SurvivalAIGoal;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

/**
 * Drone goal composition via {@link AICompositionStrategy}.
 * Owns swarm + targeting registration for drone (no parallel BehaviorFactory path).
 */
public final class DroneCompositionStrategy implements AICompositionStrategy {

    private static final DroneCompositionStrategy INSTANCE = new DroneCompositionStrategy();

    public static void registerGoals(DroneEntity drone) {
        INSTANCE.applyGoals(drone);
    }

    public static int getMaturationTime() {
        return AIGoalConfigHelper.getMaturationTime(XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyGoals(Mob mob) {
        if (!(mob instanceof DroneEntity drone)) {
            return;
        }
        drone.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.DRONE, "survival"), new SurvivalAIGoal(drone));
        drone.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.DRONE, "patrol"), new PatrolNestGoal(drone));

        EntityConfig config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.DRONE);
        if (config != null && config.aiGoals != null) {
            DroneSwarmGoalRegistrar.registerGoals(drone, config.aiGoals);
        }

        StandardTargetingHelper.registerStandardTargetingGoals(drone, XenomorphType.DRONE);
    }

    @Override
    public String strategyName() {
        return "drone";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.AIGoalConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.registry.ConfigContractException;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.ConfigCacheHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.GoalPriorityResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.AICompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.CommonGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.FacehuggerAttachmentGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.HostTargetingGoal;

/**
 * Facehugger goal composition via {@link AICompositionStrategy}.
 */
public final class FacehuggerCompositionStrategy implements AICompositionStrategy {

    private static final FacehuggerCompositionStrategy INSTANCE = new FacehuggerCompositionStrategy();

    public static void registerGoals(FacehuggerEntity facehugger) {
        INSTANCE.applyGoals(facehugger);
    }

    public static int getAttachmentDuration() {
        return AIGoalConfigHelper.getAttachmentDuration(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyGoals(Mob mob) {
        if (!(mob instanceof FacehuggerEntity facehugger)) {
            return;
        }
        ModLogger.info("FacehuggerCompositionStrategy",
                "🤖 Applying facehugger composition for " + facehugger.getDisplayName().getString());

        EntityConfig config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
        if (config == null || config.aiGoals == null) {
            throw new ConfigContractException(
                    "FacehuggerCompositionStrategy",
                    "entity/xenomorph/human/facehugger.json",
                    "ai_goals missing");
        }

        double strollSpeed = config.aiGoals.strollSpeed;
        float lookRange = config.aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange;

        int floatPriority = GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "float");
        int attachmentPriority = GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "attachment");
        int strollPriority = GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "stroll");
        int lookPriority = GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "look_at_player");
        int randomLookPriority = GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "random_look");

        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerFloatGoal(facehugger, floatPriority);
        facehugger.goalSelector.addGoal(attachmentPriority, new FacehuggerAttachmentGoal(facehugger));
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerStrollGoal(facehugger, strollPriority, strollSpeed);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerLookAtPlayerGoal(facehugger, lookPriority, lookRange);
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerRandomLookAroundGoal(facehugger, randomLookPriority);

        facehugger.targetSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER, "host_target"),
                new HostTargetingGoal(facehugger));
    }

    @Override
    public String strategyName() {
        return "facehugger";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.HumanEntityType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.XenomorphTargetRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.DefensiveVillagerAI;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.monster.Monster;

/**
 * Human-specific AI behavior factory.
 * Routes human entities to the correct AI behavior class based on behavior_type.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class HumanAIBehaviorFactory {
    
    /**
     * Registers AI goals for a human entity based on its JSON configuration.
     * Uses behavior_type to determine which AI class to use.
     * 
     * @param entity The entity to register goals for
     * @param humanType The human type to get configuration for
     */
    public static void registerAIBehavior(PathfinderMob entity, HumanEntityType humanType) {
        EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getHumanBaselineConfig();
        
        if (config == null || config.aiGoals == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("HumanAIBehaviorFactory", "⚠️ No AI goals config found for " + humanType);
            return;
        }
        
        String behaviorType = config.aiGoals.behaviorType;
        if (behaviorType == null) {
            ModLogger.warn("HumanAIBehaviorFactory", "⚠️ No behavior type specified for " + humanType + " - using fallback");
            behaviorType = "defensive_villager";
        }
        ModLogger.debug("HumanAIBehaviorFactory", "🤖 Registering AI behavior: " + behaviorType + " for " + humanType);
        
        // Route to appropriate AI behavior class based on behavior_type
        switch (behaviorType) {
            case "defensive_villager":
                DefensiveVillagerAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
                break;
                
            default:
                ModLogger.warn("HumanAIBehaviorFactory", "⚠️ Unknown behavior type: " + behaviorType + " for " + humanType);
                // Fallback to defensive villager behavior
                DefensiveVillagerAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
                break;
        }

        if (entity instanceof Monster human) {
            XenomorphTargetRegistry.registerXenomorphTargets(human);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.init.EntityInitRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.RendererRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.HumanEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client.HumanRenderer;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.EntityType;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.EntityRenderersEvent;

/**
 * Human-specific renderer registry.
 * Registers all human entity renderers.
 * 
 * FILE STATUS: NEW
 * 
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.8
 */
public class HumanRendererRegistry implements RendererRegistry {
    
    @Override
    public void registerRenderers(EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event) {
        ModLogger.info("HumanRendererRegistry", "Loading human renderers...");
        
        int registeredCount = 0;
        int failedCount = 0;
        
        // Register human renderers
        try {
            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
            EntityType<HumanEntity> humanType = (EntityType<HumanEntity>) EntityInitRefs.holder("HUMAN").get();
            event.registerEntityRenderer(Objects.requireNonNull(humanType), HumanRenderer::new);
            ModLogger.debug("HumanRendererRegistry", "✅ Registered Human renderer");
            registeredCount++;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("HumanRendererRegistry", "Failed to register Human renderer: " + e.getMessage());
            failedCount++;
        }
        
        if (failedCount > 0) {
            ModLogger.warn("HumanRendererRegistry", 
                String.format("⚠️ Human renderer registration completed with %d successful and %d failed registrations", 
                    registeredCount, failedCount));
        } else {
            ModLogger.info("HumanRendererRegistry", 
                String.format("✅ All human renderers loaded successfully (%d renderers)", registeredCount));
        }
    }
    
    @Override
    public String getSpeciesName() {
        return "human";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.client.animation.state;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.MovementFormFsm;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.entity.MovementFormPhase;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.DroneEntity;

/**
 * Client animation observes synced {@link MovementFormPhase}; does not own crawlingForm.
 * Wired from {@code XenomorphAnimationClientHooks}.
 */
public final class DroneAnimationStateHandler {

    private DroneAnimationStateHandler() {
    }

    public static void updateAnimationState(DroneEntity entity) {
        boolean isMoving = MovementFormFsm.isMovingHorizontally(
                entity.getDeltaMovement().horizontalDistanceSqr());
        MovementFormPhase phase = entity.getMovementFormPhase();

        entity.jumpingAnimationState.stop();
        entity.fallingAnimationState.stop();

        switch (phase) {
            case TRANSITION_TO_CRAWL -> {
                ensureStarted(entity.standingToCrawlingAnimationState, entity);
                entity.standingToCrawlingStartTick = entity.tickCount;
                entity.crawlingToStandingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.crawlingToStandingStartTick = -1;
                entity.walkingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
            }
            case CRAWLING -> {
                entity.standingToCrawlingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.standingToCrawlingStartTick = -1;
                entity.crawlingToStandingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.crawlingToStandingStartTick = -1;
                if (isMoving) {
                    ensureStarted(entity.walkingAnimationState, entity);
                    entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
                } else {
                    ensureStarted(entity.idleAnimationState, entity);
                    entity.walkingAnimationState.stop();
                }
            }
            case TRANSITION_TO_STAND -> {
                ensureStarted(entity.crawlingToStandingAnimationState, entity);
                entity.crawlingToStandingStartTick = entity.tickCount;
                entity.standingToCrawlingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.standingToCrawlingStartTick = -1;
                entity.walkingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
            }
            case STANDING -> {
                entity.standingToCrawlingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.standingToCrawlingStartTick = -1;
                entity.crawlingToStandingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.crawlingToStandingStartTick = -1;
                entity.walkingAnimationState.stop();
                ensureStarted(entity.idleAnimationState, entity);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void ensureStarted(net.minecraft.world.entity.AnimationState state, DroneEntity entity) {
        if (!state.isStarted()) {
            state.start(entity.tickCount);
        }
    }
}

	public static final ModelLayerLocation LAYER_LOCATION = ModelDefinitionHelper.layerLocation(ModContext.MOD_ID, "facehugger");
	/** Baked wrapper root — {@code resetPose}/{@code animate} traverse from here so channels resolve {@code facehugger → …}. */
	private final ModelPart root;
	private final ModelPart facehugger;
	private final ModelPart body;
	private final ModelPart legs;
	private final ModelPart right_legs;
	private final ModelPart right_leg1;
	private final ModelPart right_leg2;
	private final ModelPart right_leg3;
	private final ModelPart right_leg4;
	private final ModelPart left_legs;
	private final ModelPart left_leg1;
	private final ModelPart left_leg2;
	private final ModelPart left_leg3;
	private final ModelPart left_leg4;
	private final ModelPart tail;
	private final ModelPart tail_base;
	private final ModelPart tail_tip;

	public FacehuggerModel(ModelPart root) {
		this.root = root;
		this.facehugger = root.getChild("facehugger");
		this.body = this.facehugger.getChild("body");
		this.legs = this.facehugger.getChild("legs");
		this.right_legs = this.legs.getChild("right_legs");
		this.right_leg1 = this.right_legs.getChild("right_leg1");
		this.right_leg2 = this.right_legs.getChild("right_leg2");
		this.right_leg3 = this.right_legs.getChild("right_leg3");
		this.right_leg4 = this.right_legs.getChild("right_leg4");
		this.left_legs = this.legs.getChild("left_legs");
		this.left_leg1 = this.left_legs.getChild("left_leg1");
		this.left_leg2 = this.left_legs.getChild("left_leg2");
		this.left_leg3 = this.left_legs.getChild("left_leg3");
		this.left_leg4 = this.left_legs.getChild("left_leg4");
		this.tail = this.facehugger.getChild("tail");
		this.tail_base = this.tail.getChild("tail_base");
		this.tail_tip = this.tail.getChild("tail_tip");
	}

	public static LayerDefinition createBodyLayer() {
		MeshDefinition meshdefinition = new MeshDefinition();

		PartDefinition legs = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(facehugger,"legs", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, -0.6667F));

		PartDefinition right_leg2 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(right_legs,"right_leg2", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.5F));

		PartDefinition right_leg2_r1 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(right_leg2,"right_leg2_r1", ModelDefinitionHelper.boxed(ModelDefinitionHelper.cube().texOffs(2, 1).addBox(-0.5F, 0.0F, -0.5F, 1.0F, 4.0F, 1.0F, ModelDefinitionHelper.deformation(0.0F))), ModelDefinitionHelper.offsetAndRotation(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F, -0.3927F, 1.9635F, 0.2182F));

		PartDefinition right_leg3 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(right_legs,"right_leg3", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, -0.5F));

		PartDefinition left_leg1_r1 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(left_leg1,"left_leg1_r1", ModelDefinitionHelper.boxed(ModelDefinitionHelper.cube().texOffs(2, 1).mirror().addBox(-0.5F, 0.0F, -0.5F, 1.0F, 4.0F, 1.0F, ModelDefinitionHelper.deformation(0.0F)).mirror(false)), ModelDefinitionHelper.offsetAndRotation(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F, -0.3927F, -2.3562F, 0.0F));

		PartDefinition left_leg2 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(left_legs,"left_leg2", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.5F));

		PartDefinition left_leg4 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(left_legs,"left_leg4", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, -1.5F));

		PartDefinition left_leg4_r1 = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(left_leg4,"left_leg4_r1", ModelDefinitionHelper.boxed(ModelDefinitionHelper.cube().texOffs(2, 1).mirror().addBox(-0.5F, 0.0F, -0.5F, 1.0F, 4.0F, 1.0F, ModelDefinitionHelper.deformation(0.0F)).mirror(false)), ModelDefinitionHelper.offsetAndRotation(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F, -0.3927F, -0.7854F, -0.1309F));

		PartDefinition tail = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(facehugger,"tail", ModelDefinitionHelper.cube(), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, 1.3333F));

		PartDefinition tail_base = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(tail,"tail_base", ModelDefinitionHelper.boxed(ModelDefinitionHelper.cube().texOffs(0, 0).mirror().addBox(-0.5F, -0.5F, -2.0F, 1.0F, 1.0F, 6.0F, ModelDefinitionHelper.deformation(0.0F)).mirror(false)), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, 0.0F));

		PartDefinition tail_tip = ModelDefinitionHelper.child(tail,"tail_tip", ModelDefinitionHelper.boxed(ModelDefinitionHelper.cube().texOffs(0, 0).mirror().addBox(-0.25F, -0.25F, 0.0F, 0.5F, 0.5F, 2.0F, ModelDefinitionHelper.deformation(0.0F)).mirror(false)), ModelDefinitionHelper.offset(0.0F, 0.0F, 4.0F));

		return ModelDefinitionHelper.layer(meshdefinition, 16, 16);
	}

	@Override
	public ModelPart root() {
		// Wrapper root so attachment can rotate shared parent "facehugger" (body/legs/tail siblings).
		return this.root;
	}

	@Override
	public void setupAnim(@Nonnull T entity, float limbSwing, float limbSwingAmount, float ageInTicks, float netHeadYaw, float headPitch) {
		// Delegate to entity-specific animation helper for all animation logic
		// Pass this::animate to allow helper to call the protected animate method
		FacehuggerModelAnimationSetup.INSTANCE.setupAnimations(entity, this, this::animate, ageInTicks);
	}

	@Override
	public void renderToBuffer(@Nonnull PoseStack poseStack, @Nonnull VertexConsumer vertexConsumer, int packedLight, int packedOverlay, int color) {
		facehugger.render(poseStack, vertexConsumer, packedLight, packedOverlay);
	}
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;
import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.network.FriendlyByteBuf;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.Container;
import net.minecraft.world.SimpleContainer;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Inventory;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu;

import net.minecraft.world.inventory.DataSlot;
