import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ItemStackCarrier;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.admission.CaptureNetSpecimenSource;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.items.DnaVialItemHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPenCleanseRunner;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPenDnaVialRunner;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPenExtractionRunner;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPenNamingRunner;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ItemSpecimenSourceFactory;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment.ContainmentPenAdmissionRunner;

/**
 * Containment UI (pen consumer): Overview + DNA vial workflow slots/actions.
 *
 * <p>Receives {@link MenuType} from registration (L4) so this L3 type never imports the
 * menu DeferredRegister hub (NDE — no upward dependency).
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-UI-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-EXTRACT-001): pen → Capture Net slice
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-UI-IDENTITY-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-UI-PREVIEW-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-LAB-NAMING-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-CLEANSE-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-DNA-VIAL-001)
 */
public final class ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu extends AbstractContainerMenu {

    /** Shared button id: Contain when pen empty, Extract when occupied. */
    public static final int BUTTON_TRANSFER = 0;

    /** Apply Name Tag to occupied specimen. */
    public static final int BUTTON_APPLY_NAME = 1;

    /** Begin cleanse / incinerate of occupied specimen. */
    public static final int BUTTON_CLEANSE = 2;

    /** Dual-mode Sample / Inject on DNA page. */
    public static final int BUTTON_DNA_VIAL = 3;

    /** @deprecated use {@link #BUTTON_TRANSFER} */
    @Deprecated
    public static final int BUTTON_CONTAIN = BUTTON_TRANSFER;

    private static final int SLOT_NAMING = 0;
    private static final int SLOT_TRANSFER = 1;
    private static final int SLOT_DNA_VIAL = 2;
    private static final int PLAYER_INV_START = 3;
    private static final int PLAYER_INV_END = 39;

    /** Overview naming slot index — screen may gate interaction by page. */
    public static final int OVERVIEW_SLOT_NAMING = SLOT_NAMING;

    /** Overview transfer slot index — screen may gate interaction by page. */
    public static final int OVERVIEW_SLOT_TRANSFER = SLOT_TRANSFER;

    /** DNA page vial slot index — screen may gate interaction by page. */
    public static final int DNA_SLOT_VIAL = SLOT_DNA_VIAL;

    private final Container naming = new SimpleContainer(1);
    private final Container transfer = new SimpleContainer(1);
    private final Container dnaVial = new SimpleContainer(1);
    private final ContainerLevelAccess access;
    private final BlockPos controllerPos;
    /** Synced from server BE — client gate while cleansing. */
    private int cleansingFlag;

    public ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu(
            @Nonnull MenuType<?> type,
            int containerId,
            @Nonnull Inventory playerInventory,
            @Nonnull BlockPos controllerPos,
            @Nonnull ContainerLevelAccess access) {
        super(Objects.requireNonNull(type, "type"), containerId);
        this.controllerPos = Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos);
        this.access = Objects.requireNonNull(access);

        this.addSlot(new Slot(Objects.requireNonNull(naming), 0, 26, 52) {
            @Override
            public boolean mayPlace(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePen(playerInventory.player);
                return pen != null
                        && pen.hasSpecimen()
                        && !pen.isCleansing()
                        && stack.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.NAME_TAG));
            }
        });

        this.addSlot(new Slot(Objects.requireNonNull(transfer), 0, 80, 52) {
            @Override
            public boolean mayPlace(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePen(playerInventory.player);
                if (pen != null && pen.isCleansing()) {
                    return false;
                }
                if (pen != null && pen.hasSpecimen()) {
                    return CaptureNetSpecimenSource.isEmptyCaptureNet(stack);
                }
                return ItemSpecimenSourceFactory.isSupported(stack);
            }
        });

        this.addSlot(new Slot(Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial), 0, 80, 40) {
            @Override
            public boolean mayPlace(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePen(playerInventory.player);
                if (pen != null && pen.isCleansing()) {
                    return false;
                }
                return DnaVialItemHelper.isDnaVial(stack);
            }
        });

        for (int row = 0; row < 3; row++) {
            for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
                this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col + row * 9 + 9, 8 + col * 18, 84 + row * 18));
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 9; col++) {
            this.addSlot(new Slot(playerInventory, col, 8 + col * 18, 142));
        }

        this.addDataSlot(new DataSlot() {
            @Override
            public int get() {
                ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePenFromAccess();
                return pen != null && pen.isCleansing() ? 1 : 0;
            }

            @Override
            public void set(int value) {
                cleansingFlag = value;
            }
        });
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu fromNetwork(
            @Nonnull MenuType<?> type,
            int containerId,
            @Nonnull Inventory playerInventory,
            @Nonnull FriendlyByteBuf buf) {
        BlockPos pos = Objects.requireNonNull(buf.readBlockPos());
        return new ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu(
                type,
                containerId,
                playerInventory,
                pos,
                Objects.requireNonNull(ContainerLevelAccess.NULL));
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu forServer(
            @Nonnull MenuType<?> type,
            int containerId,
            @Nonnull Inventory playerInventory,
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen) {
        BlockPos pos = Objects.requireNonNull(pen.getBlockPos());
        return new ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu(
                type,
                containerId,
                playerInventory,
                pos,
                Objects.requireNonNull(ContainerLevelAccess.create(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(pen.getLevel()), pos)));
    }

    public boolean isPenOccupied() {
        ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePenFromAccess();
        if (pen != null) {
            return pen.hasSpecimen();
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Client-safe occupancy check using the player's current level.
     */
    public boolean isPenOccupied(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (level != null
                && level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos))
                        instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen) {
            return pen.hasSpecimen();
        }
        return isPenOccupied();
    }

    public boolean canContain() {
        return !isPenOccupied()
                && !isCleansing()
                && ItemSpecimenSourceFactory.isSupported(Objects.requireNonNull(transfer.getItem(0)));
    }

    public boolean canContain(@Nullable Level level) {
        return !isPenOccupied(level)
                && !isCleansing(level)
                && ItemSpecimenSourceFactory.isSupported(Objects.requireNonNull(transfer.getItem(0)));
    }

    public boolean canExtract() {
        return isPenOccupied()
                && !isCleansing()
                && CaptureNetSpecimenSource.isEmptyCaptureNet(Objects.requireNonNull(transfer.getItem(0)));
    }

    public boolean canExtract(@Nullable Level level) {
        return isPenOccupied(level)
                && !isCleansing(level)
                && CaptureNetSpecimenSource.isEmptyCaptureNet(Objects.requireNonNull(transfer.getItem(0)));
    }

    /**
     * Apply enabled iff occupied, living occupant resolved, named Name Tag, and not cleansing.
     */
    public boolean canApplyName(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (!isPenOccupied(level) || isCleansing(level)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!ContainmentPenNamingRunner.isApplicableNameTag(Objects.requireNonNull(naming.getItem(0)))) {
            return false;
        }
        return resolveOccupantLiving(level) != null;
    }

    /**
     * Sample enabled iff occupied, living occupant, empty DNA vial, not cleansing.
     */
    public boolean canSample(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (!isPenOccupied(level) || isCleansing(level)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!DnaVialItemHelper.isEmpty(Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial.getItem(0)))) {
            return false;
        }
        return resolveOccupantLiving(level) != null;
    }

    /**
     * Inject button enabled when filled vial + living occupant (action still Stage 4 unavailable).
     */
    public boolean canInject(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (!isPenOccupied(level) || isCleansing(level)) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!DnaVialItemHelper.isFilled(Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial.getItem(0)))) {
            return false;
        }
        return resolveOccupantLiving(level) != null;
    }

    public boolean canDnaVialAction(@Nullable Level level) {
        return canSample(level) || canInject(level);
    }

    public boolean isDnaVialFilled() {
        return DnaVialItemHelper.isFilled(Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial.getItem(0)));
    }

    /**
     * Cleanse enabled iff occupied, living occupant resolved, and not already cleansing.
     */
    public boolean canCleanse(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (!isPenOccupied(level) || isCleansing(level)) {
            return false;
        }
        return resolveOccupantLiving(level) != null;
    }

    public boolean isCleansing() {
        ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePenFromAccess();
        if (pen != null) {
            return pen.isCleansing();
        }
        return cleansingFlag != 0;
    }

    public boolean isCleansing(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (level != null && !level.isClientSide
                && level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos))
                        instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen) {
            return pen.isCleansing();
        }
        // Client: transient cleanse ticks are not on the BE — use synced DataSlot.
        if (level != null && level.isClientSide) {
            return cleansingFlag != 0;
        }
        return isCleansing();
    }

    /**
     * Occupant UUID from containment occupancy — identity display resolves the live entity on the client.
     */
    @Nullable
    public UUID occupantEntityUuid(@Nullable Level level) {
        if (level == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!(level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos))
                instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen)) {
            return null;
        }
        Optional<UUID> occupantId = pen.getOccupantEntityUuidInternal();
        return occupantId.orElse(null);
    }

    @Nullable
    public LivingEntity resolveOccupantLiving(@Nullable Level level) {
        UUID occupantId = occupantEntityUuid(level);
        if (occupantId == null || level == null) {
            return null;
        }
        AABB search = Objects.requireNonNull(
                new AABB(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos)).inflate(24.0));
        List<LivingEntity> found = level.getEntitiesOfClass(
                LivingEntity.class,
                search,
                entity -> occupantId.equals(entity.getUUID()) && entity.isAlive());
        return found.isEmpty() ? null : found.get(0);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean clickMenuButton(@Nonnull Player player, int buttonId) {
        if (player.level().isClientSide) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!(player instanceof ServerPlayer serverPlayer)) {
            return false;
        }
        ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen = resolvePen(player);
        if (pen == null || !pen.isFormed()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (pen.isCleansing() && buttonId != BUTTON_CLEANSE) {
            return false;
        }
        if (buttonId == BUTTON_CLEANSE) {
            return ContainmentPenCleanseRunner.beginCleanse(pen, serverPlayer);
        }
        if (buttonId == BUTTON_DNA_VIAL) {
            ItemStackCarrier vialCarrier = new ItemStackCarrier() {
                @Override
                @Nonnull
                public ItemStack get() {
                    return Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial.getItem(0));
                }

                @Override
                public void set(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                    dnaVial.setItem(0, stack);
                    broadcastChanges();
                }
            };
            return ContainmentPenDnaVialRunner.sampleOrInject(pen, vialCarrier, serverPlayer);
        }
        if (buttonId == BUTTON_APPLY_NAME) {
            ItemStackCarrier namingCarrier = new ItemStackCarrier() {
                @Override
                @Nonnull
                public ItemStack get() {
                    return Objects.requireNonNull(naming.getItem(0));
                }

                @Override
                public void set(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                    naming.setItem(0, stack);
                    broadcastChanges();
                }
            };
            return ContainmentPenNamingRunner.applyNameTag(pen, namingCarrier, serverPlayer);
        }
        if (buttonId != BUTTON_TRANSFER) {
            return false;
        }
        ItemStackCarrier carrier = new ItemStackCarrier() {
            @Override
            @Nonnull
            public ItemStack get() {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(transfer.getItem(0));
            }

            @Override
            public void set(@Nonnull ItemStack stack) {
                transfer.setItem(0, stack);
                broadcastChanges();
            }
        };
        if (pen.hasSpecimen()) {
            return ContainmentPenExtractionRunner.extract(pen, carrier, serverPlayer);
        }
        ContainmentPenAdmissionRunner.contain(pen, carrier, serverPlayer);
        return true;
    }

    @Nullable
    private ContainmentPenBlockEntity resolvePenFromAccess() {
        return access.evaluate((level, pos) -> {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(pos));
            return be instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen ? pen : null;
        }).orElseGet(() -> null);
    }

    @Nullable
    private ContainmentPenBlockEntity resolvePen(Player player) {
        return access.evaluate((level, pos) -> {
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(pos));
            return be instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen ? pen : null;
        }).orElseGet(() -> {
            if (player.level().getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos))
                    instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen) {
                return pen;
            }
            return null;
        });
    }

    @Override
    public boolean stillValid(@Nonnull Player player) {
        if (player.level().getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos))
                instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity) {
            return player.distanceToSqr(
                            controllerPos.getX() + 0.5,
                            controllerPos.getY() + 0.5,
                            controllerPos.getZ() + 0.5)
                    <= 64.0;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    @Nonnull
    public ItemStack quickMoveStack(@Nonnull Player player, int index) {
        ItemStack result = ItemStack.EMPTY;
        Slot slot = this.slots.get(index);
        if (slot == null || !slot.hasItem()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
        }
        ItemStack raw = slot.getItem();
        result = Objects.requireNonNull(raw.copy());
        boolean occupied = isPenOccupied(player.level());

        if (index == SLOT_NAMING || index == SLOT_TRANSFER || index == SLOT_DNA_VIAL) {
            if (!this.moveItemStackTo(raw, PLAYER_INV_START, PLAYER_INV_END, true)) {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            }
        } else {
            // From player inventory
            if (DnaVialItemHelper.isDnaVial(raw)) {
                if (!this.moveItemStackTo(raw, SLOT_DNA_VIAL, SLOT_DNA_VIAL + 1, false)) {
                    return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
            } else if (occupied && raw.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.NAME_TAG))) {
                if (!this.moveItemStackTo(raw, SLOT_NAMING, SLOT_NAMING + 1, false)) {
                    return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
                }
            } else if (!occupied && raw.is(Objects.requireNonNull(Items.NAME_TAG))) {
                // Empty pen: Name Tag stays in inventory
                return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            } else if (!this.moveItemStackTo(raw, SLOT_TRANSFER, SLOT_TRANSFER + 1, false)) {
                return Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY);
            }
        }
        if (raw.isEmpty()) {
            slot.setByPlayer(Objects.requireNonNull(ItemStack.EMPTY));
        } else {
            slot.setChanged();
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(result);
    }

    @Override
    public void removed(@Nonnull Player player) {
        super.removed(player);
        this.access.execute((level, pos) -> {
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(naming));
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(transfer));
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial));
        });
        if (access == ContainerLevelAccess.NULL && !player.level().isClientSide) {
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(naming));
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(transfer));
            clearContainer(player, Objects.requireNonNull(dnaVial));
        }
    }

    @Nonnull
    public BlockPos controllerPos() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(controllerPos);
    }

    @Nonnull
    public static Component title() {
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                Component.translatable("menu.biocraft_alien.containment_pen_admission"));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ContainmentPenState;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_2.lab.ContainmentPenBlueprint;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment.ContainmentPenShellBlock;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * NeoForge adapter for {@link ContainmentPenPort} — block scans and structure metadata only.
 *
 * <p>Shell proxy place/dissolve lives in {@link ContainmentPenShellFormation} (SRP).
 */
public final class ContainmentPenPortAdapter implements ContainmentPenPort {

    private final ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity;

    public ContainmentPenPortAdapter(ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        this.entity = entity;
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPosRef controllerPosition() {
        return BoundaryRefs.from(entity.getBlockPos());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isControllerBlock() {
        return entity.getLevel() != null;
    }

    @Override
    public ContainmentPenState structureState() {
        return entity.getStructureState();
    }

    @Override
    public void setStructureState(ContainmentPenState state) {
        entity.setStructureStateInternal(state);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFormed() {
        return entity.isFormed();
    }

    @Override
    public int structureSize() {
        return entity.getStructureSize();
    }

    @Override
    public void setStructureSize(int size) {
        entity.setStructureSizeInternal(size);
    }

    @Override
    public List<BlockPosRef> structureBlocks() {
        List<BlockPosRef> refs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (BlockPos pos : entity.getStructureBlocksInternal()) {
            refs.add(BoundaryRefs.from(pos));
        }
        return refs;
    }

    @Override
    public void setStructureBlocks(List<BlockPosRef> blocks) {
        List<BlockPos> positions = new ArrayList<>(blocks.size());
        for (BlockPosRef ref : blocks) {
            positions.add(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref));
        }
        entity.setStructureBlocksInternal(positions);
    }

    @Override
    public void markDirty() {
        entity.setChanged();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isOccupied(int offsetX, int offsetY, int offsetZ) {
        var level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null) {
            return false;
        }
        BlockState state = level.getBlockState(
                Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getBlockPos().offset(offsetX, offsetY, offsetZ)));
        // Validation occupancy: real structure blocks only — ignore formed shell proxies.
        if (state.isAir() || state.getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean formedStructureIntact() {
        var level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null) {
            return false;
        }
        List<BlockPos> blocks = entity.getStructureBlocksInternal();
        if (blocks.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        for (BlockPos pos : blocks) {
            if (!(level.getBlockState(Objects.requireNonNull(pos)).getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isControllerAt(BlockPosRef worldPos) {
        var level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return level.getBlockEntity(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(worldPos)))
                instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
    }

    @Override
    public void destroyBlock(BlockPosRef worldPos) {
        var level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null || worldPos == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
            boolean broken = BoundaryServices.mutation().breakBlock(
                    BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level),
                    worldPos,
                    true);
            if (broken) {
                return;
            }
        }
        level.destroyBlock(Objects.requireNonNull(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(worldPos)), true);
    }

    @Override
    public void dissolveFormedStructure() {
        ContainmentPenShellFormation.dissolveProxies(entity);
    }

    @Override
    public void logDebug(String message) {
        ModLogger.debug("ContainmentPenBlockEntity", message);
    }

    @Override
    public void logInfo(String message) {
        ModLogger.info("ContainmentPen", message);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyValidationResult(ContainmentPenBlueprint.ContainmentPenValidationResult result) {
        BlockPosRef center = controllerPosition();
        List<BlockPos> worldPositions =
                toBlockPosList(ContainmentPenBlueprint.shellCellsToWorld(center, result.shellCells()));
        entity.setStructureStateInternal(entity.getStructureState().transitionOnValidate(result.isValid()));
        if (result.isValid()) {
            entity.setInteriorVolumeInternal(result.interior());
            entity.setOutwardFacingInternal(result.outward());
            ContainmentPenShellFormation.placeProxies(
                    entity, result.shellCells(), worldPositions, result.interior());
            entity.setStructureBlocksInternal(worldPositions);
            entity.setStructureCenterInternal(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(center));
            entity.setStructureDimensionsInternal(result.width(), result.depth(), result.height());
            logInfo(result.reason() + " structure formed at " + center);
        }
        markDirty();
    }

    private static List<BlockPos> toBlockPosList(List<BlockPosRef> refs) {
        List<BlockPos> positions = new ArrayList<>(refs.size());
        for (BlockPosRef ref : refs) {
            positions.add(BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref));
        }
        return positions;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

import javax.annotation.Nullable;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.Registries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Block;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.InteriorVolume;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.lab.ShellCell;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.lab.ShellRole;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenShellPresentation;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment.ContainmentPenShellBlock;

/**
 * Places and dissolves formed shell proxies. Maps {@link ShellRole} → proxy block only.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenShellFormation {

    private static final ResourceLocation GLASS_SHELL_ID =
            ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("biocraft_alien", "containment_pen_shell");
    private static final ResourceLocation FLOOR_SHELL_ID =
            ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath("biocraft_alien", "containment_pen_shell_iron");

    private ContainmentPenShellFormation() {
    }

    public static void placeProxies(
            ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity,
            List<ShellCell> cells,
            List<BlockPos> worldPositions,
            InteriorVolume interior) {
        Level level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null || level.isClientSide || interior == null) {
            return;
        }
        BlockPos controller = entity.getBlockPos();
        int minX = interior.minX() - 1;
        int maxX = interior.maxX() + 1;
        int minY = interior.minY() - 1;
        int maxY = interior.maxY() + 1;
        int minZ = interior.minZ() - 1;
        int maxZ = interior.maxZ() + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < cells.size(); i++) {
            ShellCell cell = cells.get(i);
            BlockPos worldPos = Objects.requireNonNull(worldPositions.get(i));
            BlockState current = level.getBlockState(worldPos);
            if (current.getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock) {
                continue;
            }
            BlockState shellBase = shellDefaultForRole(level, cell.role());
            if (shellBase == null) {
                ModLogger.debug("ContainmentPenShellFormation", "shell not registered; skipping proxy placement");
                return;
            }
            entity.putShellPriorStateInternal(worldPos, current);
            BlockState shellState = ContainmentPenShellPresentation.facesForCell(
                    shellBase,
                    cell.x(),
                    cell.y(),
                    cell.z(),
                    minX,
                    maxX,
                    minY,
                    maxY,
                    minZ,
                    maxZ);
            level.setBlock(worldPos, Objects.requireNonNull(shellState), 3);
            BlockEntity be = level.getBlockEntity(worldPos);
            if (be instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity shellBe) {
                shellBe.setControllerPos(Objects.requireNonNull(controller));
            }
        }
    }

    public static void dissolveProxies(ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity) {
        Level level = entity.getLevel();
        if (level == null || level.isClientSide) {
            entity.clearShellPriorStatesInternal();
            return;
        }
        entity.setDissolvingStructureInternal(true);
        try {
            Map<BlockPos, BlockState> priors = entity.getShellPriorStatesInternal();
            for (BlockPos pos : new ArrayList<>(entity.getStructureBlocksInternal())) {
                BlockPos safePos = Objects.requireNonNull(pos);
                BlockState prior = priors.get(safePos);
                if (prior != null) {
                    level.setBlock(safePos, Objects.requireNonNull(prior), 3);
                } else if (level.getBlockState(safePos).getBlock() instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock) {
                    level.removeBlock(safePos, false);
                }
            }
            entity.clearShellPriorStatesInternal();
        } finally {
            entity.setDissolvingStructureInternal(false);
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    private static BlockState shellDefaultForRole(Level level, ShellRole role) {
        ResourceLocation id = role == ShellRole.FLOOR ? FLOOR_SHELL_ID : GLASS_SHELL_ID;
        Block block = level.registryAccess().registryOrThrow(Objects.requireNonNull(Registries.BLOCK)).get(id);
        if (block instanceof ContainmentPenShellBlock) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(block).defaultBlockState();
        }
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Ovomorph entity — stationary egg that hatches when disturbed.
 *
 * <p>Hatch: {@link OvomorphHatchHost} + {@link OvomorphHatchSession} + {@link OvomorphHatchPortAdapter}.
 */
public class OvomorphEntity extends PathfinderMob implements XenomorphTyped, OvomorphHatchHost {

    private static final EntityDataAccessor<Boolean> DATA_IS_HATCHING = Objects.requireNonNull(
            SynchedEntityData.defineId(
                    OvomorphEntity.class,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(EntityDataSerializers.BOOLEAN)));

    private final OvomorphHatchSession hatchSession = new OvomorphHatchSession(this);
    private final OvomorphFixedRotation fixedRotation = new OvomorphFixedRotation();

    public final AnimationState openingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState closingAnimationState = new AnimationState();
    public final AnimationState idleAnimationState = new AnimationState();

    public OvomorphEntity(EntityType<? extends OvomorphEntity> entityType, Level level) {
        super(entityType, level);
        this.setNoGravity(true);
        this.setPersistenceRequired();
    }

    public static AttributeSupplier.Builder createAttributes() {
        return EntityAttributeHelper.createXenomorphAttributes(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
    }

    @Override
    protected void defineSynchedData(@Nonnull SynchedEntityData.Builder builder) {
        super.defineSynchedData(builder);
        builder.define(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_IS_HATCHING), false);
    }

    @Override
    public XenomorphType getXenomorphType() {
        return XenomorphType.OVOMORPH;
    }

    @Override
    protected void registerGoals() {
        XenomorphGoalRegistration.registerGoals(this, XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        super.tick();

        if (!fixedRotation.isInitialized()) {
            fixedRotation.captureInitialRotation(this.getYRot(), this.getXRot());
        }

        if (!this.isPersistenceRequired()) {
            this.setPersistenceRequired();
        }

        OvomorphGroundSnap.apply(this);
        hatchSession.processTick(this.tickCount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean removeWhenFarAway(double distanceToClosestPlayer) {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean requiresCustomPersistence() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public PathfinderMob mob() {
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isHatching() {
        return getEntityData().get(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_IS_HATCHING));
    }

    @Override
    public void setHatching(boolean hatching) {
        getEntityData().set(Objects.requireNonNull(DATA_IS_HATCHING), hatching);
    }

    @Override
    public void startOpeningAnimation(int tickCount) {
        openingAnimationState.startIfStopped(tickCount);
    }

    @Override
    public void stopOpeningAnimation() {
        openingAnimationState.stop();
    }

    public AnimationState getOpeningAnimationState() {
        return openingAnimationState;
    }

    public void startHatching() {
        if (!isHatching()) {
            LivingEntity host = OvomorphHostQuery.findNearestViableHost(this);
            if (host != null) {
                OvomorphHatchHostClaim.claim(host.getUUID(), this.getUUID());
            }
        }
        hatchSession.startHatching(this.tickCount);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canBeCollidedWith() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void remove(@Nonnull Entity.RemovalReason reason) {
        OvomorphHatchHostClaim.clearForEgg(this.getUUID());
        super.remove(reason);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hurt(@Nonnull DamageSource source, float amount) {
        if (this.level().isClientSide()) {
            return false;
        }
        // Kill/burn/damage attempts trigger birth animation — facehugger emerges after open, not instantly.
        boolean livingHit = source.getDirectEntity() instanceof LivingEntity;
        boolean environmentalThreat = amount > 0.0f; // fire, lava, explosions, etc.
        if (OvomorphDamageHatchPolicy.shouldStartHatch(livingHit) || environmentalThreat) {
            if (!isHatching()) {
                startHatching();
                ModLogger.info("OvomorphEntity", "Damage triggered birth animation (" + source.getMsgId() + ")");
            }
        }
        // Absorb damage so the egg finishes opening instead of vanishing mid-birth.
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getAmbientSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getAmbientSound(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getHurtSound(@Nonnull DamageSource damageSource) {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getHurtSound(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
    }

    @Override
    protected SoundEvent getDeathSound() {
        return XenomorphSoundRegistry.getDeathSound(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH);
    }

    @Override
    public void setYRot(float yRot) {
        // Field initializers run after super(...); Entity ctor may call setYRot first.
        if (fixedRotation == null || !fixedRotation.isInitialized()) {
            super.setYRot(yRot);
            if (fixedRotation != null) {
                fixedRotation.seedYRot(yRot);
            }
        } else {
            super.setYRot(fixedRotation.resolveYRot(yRot));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void setXRot(float xRot) {
        if (fixedRotation == null || !fixedRotation.isInitialized()) {
            super.setXRot(xRot);
            if (fixedRotation != null) {
                fixedRotation.seedXRot(xRot);
            }
        } else {
            super.setXRot(fixedRotation.resolveXRot(xRot));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void lookAt(@Nonnull Entity entity, float maxYawIncrement, float maxPitchIncrement) {
        if (fixedRotation == null) {
            return;
        }
        fixedRotation.lookAt(entity, maxYawIncrement, maxPitchIncrement);
    }

    @Override
    public void push(@Nonnull Entity entity) {
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPushable() {
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    protected void playStepSound(@Nonnull BlockPos pos, @Nonnull BlockState state) {
    }

    @Override
    public void addAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.addAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        OvomorphHatchPersistence.writeSaveData(
                compound,
                Objects.requireNonNull(hatchSession.workflowState()),
                isHatching());
    }

    @Override
    public void readAdditionalSaveData(@Nonnull CompoundTag compound) {
        super.readAdditionalSaveData(compound);
        setHatching(OvomorphHatchPersistence.readSaveData(
                compound,
                Objects.requireNonNull(hatchSession.workflowState())));
    }
}

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;

/**
 * Server-side queen lifecycle at L4 so L3 AI types remain importable without same-tier edges.

 * <p><b>Lifecycle split (Option A):</b>
 * <ul>
 *   <li>This object owns {@link QueenAvoidanceAI} and {@link EggLayingAI} (ticked from {@link #tick()}).</li>
 *   <li>Nest building is owned by L7 {@code NestBuildingAI} on {@code QueenEntity#setNestProgress}
 *       ({@link com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.QueenNestProgress});
 *       {@link #getNestBuildingAI()} on lifecycle remains unused.</li>
 *   <li>{@link #restoreNestState} restores {@code QueenNestRegistry} only; workflow progress is
 *       restored via {@code QueenNestPersistence} into the typed nest progress port.</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Stub progress accessors ({@link #getBuildingProgress}, {@link #getHiveBuildingProgress},
 * {@link #isExpandingToHive}) are legacy; {@code QueenEntity} NBT now reads live values from
 * {@code QueenNestProgress} when present.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FLUX
 */
public final class QueenEmbeddedLifecycle {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private final QueenAvoidanceAI avoidanceAI;
    private final EggLayingAI eggLayingAI;

    public QueenEmbeddedLifecycle(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
        this.avoidanceAI = new QueenAvoidanceAI(queen);
        this.eggLayingAI = new EggLayingAI(queen);
    }

    public void tick() {
        avoidanceAI.tick();
        eggLayingAI.tick();
    }

    public QueenAvoidanceAI getAvoidanceAI() {
        return avoidanceAI;
    }

    public Object getNestBuildingAI() {
        return null;
    }

    public boolean hasNest() {
        return QueenNestRegistry.hasNest(queen.getUUID());
    }

    public BlockPos getNestPosition() {
        BlockPosRef ref = QueenNestRegistry.getNestCenter(queen.getUUID());
        return ref != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref) : null;
    }

    public int getBuildingProgress() {
        return 0;
    }

    public int getHiveBuildingProgress() {
        return 0;
    }

    public boolean isExpandingToHive() {
        return false;
    }

    public void restoreNestState(
            BlockPos nestPos,
            int buildingProgress,
            int hiveBuildingProgress,
            boolean isExpandingToHive) {
        if (nestPos == null) {
            return;
        }
        QueenNestRegistry.registerNest(queen.getUUID(), BoundaryRefs.from(nestPos));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.lifecycle;

import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.config.ConfigReloadAdapter;

import net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.PreparableReloadListener;
import net.minecraft.server.packs.resources.ResourceManager;
import net.minecraft.util.profiling.ProfilerFiller;

/**
 * Minecraft reload listener that refreshes mod configuration and systems.
 */
public final class ConfigReloadListener implements PreparableReloadListener {

    private static final @Nonnull Object NO_PREP_DATA = new Object();

    public static final @Nonnull ConfigReloadListener INSTANCE = new ConfigReloadListener();

    private ConfigReloadListener() {
    }

    @Override
    public CompletableFuture<Void> reload(
            @Nonnull PreparationBarrier barrier,
            @Nonnull ResourceManager resourceManager,
            @Nonnull ProfilerFiller preparationsProfiler,
            @Nonnull ProfilerFiller reloadProfiler,
            @Nonnull Executor backgroundExecutor,
            @Nonnull Executor gameExecutor) {
        return barrier.wait(NO_PREP_DATA).thenRunAsync(
                () -> ConfigReloadAdapter.reloadAll(resourceManager),
                gameExecutor);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.lifecycle;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.signals.AISignalSystem;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.boundary.BoundaryBootstrap;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.config.AIBehaviorConfigLoader;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.server.ServerStartingEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.ServerTickEvent;

/**
 * Server lifecycle: boundary ports, periodic systems enablement.
 */
public final class ModServerBootstrap {

    private ModServerBootstrap() {
    }

    public static void onServerStarting(ServerStartingEvent event) {
        BoundaryBootstrap.onServerStarting(event);
        AIBehaviorConfigLoader.loadBehaviorConfigs(event.getServer().getResourceManager());
        ModLogger.info("ModServerBootstrap", "Server starting - xenomorph systems ready");
    }

    public static void onServerTick(ServerTickEvent.Post event) {
        if (event.getServer().getTickCount() % 100 == 0) {
            AISignalSystem.cleanupExpiredSignals(event.getServer().getTickCount());
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchHostClaim;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.entity.OvomorphHostQuery;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.entity.OvomorphEntity;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.Goal;

/**
 * Triggers ovomorph hatching when a viable living host is nearby with line of sight.
 * Creative-mode players are never considered hosts.
 */
public final class HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal extends Goal {

    private final PathfinderMob entity;

    public HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal(PathfinderMob entity, double range) {
        this.entity = entity;
        // range retained for call-site compatibility; proximity comes from hatching JSON via OvomorphHostQuery
    }

    public HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal(PathfinderMob entity) {
        this.entity = entity;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canUse() {
        if (entity instanceof OvomorphEntity ovomorph) {
            return !ovomorph.isHatching() && OvomorphHostQuery.findNearestViableHost(ovomorph) != null;
        }
        return false;
    }

    @Override
    public void start() {
        if (entity instanceof OvomorphEntity ovomorph) {
            LivingEntity host = OvomorphHostQuery.findNearestViableHost(ovomorph);
            if (host != null) {
                OvomorphHatchHostClaim.claim(host.getUUID(), ovomorph.getUUID());
            }
            ovomorph.startHatching();
            ModLogger.info(
                    "HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal",
                    "🥚 Viable host detected ("
                            + (host != null ? host.getDisplayName().getString() : "unknown")
                            + ") — starting hatch");
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
        return false;
    }
}

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.init.BlockInit;

/**
 * Registry for all block entities in the mod.
 *
 * <p>Containment pen factory wiring is invoked from {@code DeferredRegisterBootstrap} before
 * {@link #register(IEventBus)} so {@link ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration} is ready.
 */
public class ModBlockEntities {

    public static final DeferredRegister<BlockEntityType<?>> BLOCK_ENTITIES =
        DeferredRegister.create(Objects.requireNonNull(Registries.BLOCK_ENTITY_TYPE), ModContext.MOD_ID);

    public static final DeferredHolder<BlockEntityType<?>, BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity>> CONTAINMENT_PEN_CONTROLLER =
        BLOCK_ENTITIES.register("containment_pen_controller",
            registryName -> createContainmentPenControllerType());

    public static final DeferredHolder<BlockEntityType<?>, BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity>> CONTAINMENT_PEN_SHELL =
        BLOCK_ENTITIES.register("containment_pen_shell",
            registryName -> createContainmentPenShellType());

    private static BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity> createContainmentPenControllerType() {
        BlockEntityType.Builder<ContainmentPenBlockEntity> builder = Objects.requireNonNull(BlockEntityType.Builder.of(
                (pos, state) -> (ContainmentPenBlockEntity) ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration.create(pos, state),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.CONTAINMENT_PEN_CONTROLLER.get(), "containment_pen_controller")
        ));
        BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenBlockEntity> type = BlockEntityTypeHelper.buildWithoutDatafixer(builder);
        ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry.register(() -> type);
        return type;
    }

    private static BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity> createContainmentPenShellType() {
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity>[] holder = new BlockEntityType[1];
        BlockEntityType.Builder<ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity> builder = Objects.requireNonNull(
                BlockEntityType.Builder.of(
                        (pos, state) -> new ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity(holder[0], pos, state),
                        Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.CONTAINMENT_PEN_SHELL.get(), "containment_pen_shell"),
                        Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.CONTAINMENT_PEN_SHELL_IRON.get(), "containment_pen_shell_iron")));
        BlockEntityType<ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity> type = BlockEntityTypeHelper.buildWithoutDatafixer(builder);
        holder[0] = type;
        ContainmentPenShellBlockEntityRegistration.register(
                (pos, state) -> new ContainmentPenShellBlockEntity(type, pos, state));
        return type;
    }

    public static void register(@Nonnull IEventBus modEventBus) {
        BLOCK_ENTITIES.register(Objects.requireNonNull(modEventBus));
    }
}

FILE: OvomorphAnimationStateHandler.java
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.entity.OvomorphEntity;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.network.chat.Component;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;

/**
 * Handles all animation state updates for Ovomorph entities.
 *
 * <p>FILE STATUS: PLANNED — hatch open/close wired; polish deferred to client slice.
 */
public final class OvomorphAnimationStateHandler {

    private OvomorphAnimationStateHandler() {
    }

    public static void updateAnimationState(OvomorphEntity entity) {
        boolean isHatching = entity.isHatching();
        boolean isOpeningStarted = entity.openingAnimationState.isStarted();
        boolean isClosingStarted = entity.closingAnimationState.isStarted();
        boolean isIdleStarted = entity.idleAnimationState.isStarted();

        if (isHatching) {
            if (!isOpeningStarted) {
                ModLogger.info("OvomorphAnimationStateHandler",
                    String.format("🥚 Starting ovomorph opening animation (tick: %d, hatching: true)", entity.tickCount));
                entity.openingAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
                if (isClosingStarted) {
                    entity.closingAnimationState.stop();
                }
                if (isIdleStarted) {
                    entity.idleAnimationState.stop();
                }

                Level level = entity.level();
                if (level != null && !level.isClientSide()) {
                    level.getEntitiesOfClass(Player.class, Objects.requireNonNull(entity.getBoundingBox().inflate(32)))
                            .forEach(player ->
                                    player.displayClientMessage(
                                            Objects.requireNonNull(Component.literal("🥚 Ovomorph animation started!")), true));
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (isOpeningStarted) {
                ModLogger.info("OvomorphAnimationStateHandler", "🥚 Stopping ovomorph opening animation, starting closing animation");
                entity.openingAnimationState.stop();
                entity.closingAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            } else if (!isClosingStarted && !isIdleStarted) {
                entity.idleAnimationState.start(entity.tickCount);
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE: OvomorphModelAnimationSetup.java

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client;

import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.AnimationCaller;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.client.OvomorphModelAnimation;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client.XenomorphModelAnimationSetup;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.entity.OvomorphEntity;

import net.minecraft.client.model.HierarchicalModel;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity;

/**
 * Render-time animation binding for ovomorph geo models.
 */
public final class OvomorphModelAnimationSetup implements XenomorphModelAnimationSetup {

    public static final OvomorphModelAnimationSetup INSTANCE = new OvomorphModelAnimationSetup();

    private OvomorphModelAnimationSetup() {
    }

    @Override
    public <T extends LivingEntity> void setupAnimations(
            @Nonnull T entity,
            @Nonnull HierarchicalModel<T> model,
            @Nonnull AnimationCaller animator,
            float ageInTicks) {
        if (!(entity instanceof OvomorphEntity ovomorph)) {
            return;
        }

        resetPose(model);

        if (ovomorph.openingAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(ovomorph.openingAnimationState, OvomorphModelAnimation.opening, ageInTicks);
        } else if (ovomorph.closingAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(ovomorph.closingAnimationState, OvomorphModelAnimation.closing, ageInTicks);
        } else if (ovomorph.idleAnimationState.isStarted()) {
            animator.animate(ovomorph.idleAnimationState, OvomorphModelAnimation.idle, ageInTicks);
        }
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.EntityRenderersEvent;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.RendererRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.client.XenomorphRendererRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.client.HumanRendererRegistry;

/**
 * Centralized renderer loading system.
 * Uses registry pattern to allow species-specific renderers to register themselves.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FLUX
 * This file coordinates multiple renderer registries and will change as new species are added.
 *
 * Renderer registries are registered via static initialization to ensure they're available
 * before EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers fires (which can occur during resource reload).
 *
 * @author BioCraft
 * @since 0.1.0
 */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = ModContext.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public class RendererLoader {

    private static final List<RendererRegistry> REGISTRIES = new ArrayList<>();

    static {
        try {
            registerRegistry(new XenomorphRendererRegistry());
            registerRegistry(new HumanRendererRegistry());
            ModLogger.debug("RendererLoader", "Renderer registries initialized via static block");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("RendererLoader", "Failed to initialize renderer registries: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    public static void registerRegistry(@Nonnull RendererRegistry registry) {
        REGISTRIES.add(registry);
        ModLogger.debug("RendererLoader", "Registered renderer registry: " + registry.getSpeciesName());
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void registerRenderers(@Nonnull EntityRenderersEvent.RegisterRenderers event) {
        ModLogger.info("RendererLoader", "Loading renderers from " + REGISTRIES.size() + " registries...");

        int totalRegistered = 0;
        int totalFailed = 0;

        for (RendererRegistry registry : REGISTRIES) {
            try {
                ModLogger.debug("RendererLoader", "Registering renderers for: " + registry.getSpeciesName());
                registry.registerRenderers(event);
                totalRegistered++;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                ModLogger.error("RendererLoader",
                        "Failed to register renderers for " + registry.getSpeciesName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
                totalFailed++;
            }
        }

        if (totalFailed > 0) {
            ModLogger.warn("RendererLoader",
                    String.format("Renderer registration completed with %d successful and %d failed registries",
                            totalRegistered, totalFailed));
        } else {
            ModLogger.info("RendererLoader",
                    String.format("All renderer registries loaded successfully (%d registries)", totalRegistered));
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Xenomorph-specific data-driven renderer.
 *
 * <p>NDE escape hatch: loaded by L4 {@code XenomorphRendererRegistry} via
 * {@code Class.forName} on inner classes ({@code XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer$*}) so the L4
 * registry stays at {@code level_4} without compile-time L3 imports.
 *
 * FILE STATUS: FLUX
 */
public class XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<T extends Mob> extends BaseDataDrivenRenderer<T> {

    public XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context, XenomorphType entityType) {
        this(context, entityType,
                XenomorphModelRegistryFactory.create(),
                new XenomorphTextureRegistry(),
                new XenomorphEntityTypeResolver(),
                new XenomorphRenderConfigProvider());
    }

    protected XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context,
                                          EntityType entityType,
                                          ModelRegistry modelRegistry,
                                          TextureRegistry textureRegistry,
                                          EntityTypeResolver entityTypeResolver,
                                          RenderConfigProvider configProvider) {
        super(context, entityType, modelRegistry, textureRegistry, entityTypeResolver, configProvider);
    }

    public static final class FacehuggerRenderer extends XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<FacehuggerEntity> {
        public FacehuggerRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
            super(context, XenomorphType.FACEHUGGER);
        }
    }

    public static final class ChestbursterRenderer extends XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<ChestbursterEntity> {
        public ChestbursterRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
            super(context, XenomorphType.CHESTBURSTER);
        }
    }

    public static final class DroneRenderer extends XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<DroneEntity> {
        public DroneRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
            super(context, XenomorphType.DRONE);
        }
    }

    public static final class GrowthRenderer extends XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<GrowthEntity> {
        public GrowthRenderer(EntityRendererProvider.Context context) {
            super(context, XenomorphType.GROWTH);
        }
    }

    public static final class PraetorRenderer extends XenomorphDataDrivenRenderer<PraetorEntity> {

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.containment_pen;

import java.util.Objects;
import javax.annotation.Nonnull;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer;
import net.minecraft.world.SimpleMenuProvider;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.admission.ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment.ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.MenuInit;

/**
 * Wires Admission menu open hook and opens menus for formed empty pens.
 *
 * <p>L4: imports L3 menu + L1 block entity (formula). Same-package MenuInit — no same-tier import.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-ADMIT-UI-001)
 */
public final class ContainmentPenAdmissionMenus {

    private ContainmentPenAdmissionMenus() {
    }

    public static void wireHooks() {
        ContainmentPenAdmissionHooks.setOpenMenu(ContainmentPenAdmissionMenus::openAt);
    }

    private static void openAt(@Nonnull ServerPlayer player, @Nonnull BlockPos pos) {
        BlockEntity be = player.level().getBlockEntity(pos);
        if (!(be instanceof ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen)) {
            return;
        }
        open(player, pen);
    }

    public static void open(@Nonnull ServerPlayer player, @Nonnull ContainmentPenBlockEntity pen) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(player);
        Objects.requireNonNull(pen);
        player.openMenu(
                new SimpleMenuProvider(
                        (id, inv, p) -> ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.forServer(
                                Objects.requireNonNull(MenuInit.CONTAINMENT_PEN_ADMISSION.get()),
                                id,
                                inv,
                                pen),
                        ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.title()),
                buf -> buf.writeBlockPos(Objects.requireNonNull(pen.getBlockPos())));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.containment_pen;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment.ContainmentOccupancyPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment.ContainmentPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.containment_pen.ContainmentPenVariant;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.blocks.containment_pen.ContainmentPenBlockView;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.registry.ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.blocks.ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentOccupancyPortAdapter;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.containment.ContainmentPortAdapter;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment.ContainmentPenBehaviors;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.containment.ContainmentPenPortAdapter;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.entity.BlockEntity;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * Wires L2 block entity construction and L3 port adapters from L5 registration tier.
 */
public final class ContainmentPenBlockEntityBootstrap {

    private ContainmentPenBlockEntityBootstrap() {
    }

    public static void wire() {
        ContainmentPenBehaviors.forVariant(Objects.requireNonNull(ContainmentPenVariant.GENERIC));
        ModLogger.info("ContainmentPenBlockEntityBootstrap", "Containment pen behavior factory verified");
        ContainmentPenBlockEntityRegistration.register(
                ContainmentPenBlockEntityBootstrap::createEntity,
                ContainmentPenBlockEntityBootstrap::tick);
    }

    public static ContainmentPenBlockEntity createEntity(BlockPos pos, BlockState state) {
        ContainmentPenBlockEntity entity = new ContainmentPenBlockEntity(
                ContainmentPenBlockEntityTypeRegistry.get(), pos, state);
        ContainmentPenPort port = new ContainmentPenPortAdapter(entity);
        ContainmentOccupancyPort occupancyPort = new ContainmentOccupancyPortAdapter(entity);
        ContainmentPort containmentPort = new ContainmentPortAdapter(entity);
        entity.bindPort(port);
        entity.bindOccupancyPort(occupancyPort);
        entity.bindContainmentPort(containmentPort);
        return entity;
    }

    private static void tick(Level level, BlockPos pos, BlockState state, BlockEntity be) {
        if (be instanceof ContainmentPenBlockView view) {
            ContainmentPenBlockEntity.tick(level, pos, state, view);
        }
    }
}

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.lifecycle.ModServerBootstrap;

import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.AddReloadListenerEvent;

/**
 * Registers NeoForge lifecycle and reload listeners at mod construction.
 */
public final class ReloadListenerBootstrap {

    private ReloadListenerBootstrap() {
    }

    public static void register() {
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(ReloadListenerBootstrap::onAddReloadListeners);
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(ModServerBootstrap::onServerStarting);
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(ModServerBootstrap::onServerTick);
        NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.addListener(
                com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.containment.ContainmentPenFormationTrigger::onBlockPlaced);
    }

    private static void onAddReloadListeners(@Nonnull AddReloadListenerEvent event) {
        event.addListener(ConfigReloadListener.INSTANCE);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.nest;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.NestingConfigHelper;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.init.BlockInit;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Structure presence / progress probes for nest building port.
 */
public final class NestPortStructureProbe {

    private NestPortStructureProbe() {
    }

    public static boolean hasNestStructureNearby(QueenEntity queen) {
        int scanRadius = NestingConfigHelper.resolveScanRadius(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
        return NestBlockScanHelper.hasNestBlocksNearby(
                Objects.requireNonNull(queen.level()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(queen.blockPosition()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.RESIN_BLOCK.get()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.SPINY_BLOCK.get()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.COCOON_BLOCK.get()),
                scanRadius);
    }

    public static int detectedNestStructureProgress(QueenEntity queen) {
        int scanRadius = NestingConfigHelper.resolveScanRadius(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
        return NestBlockScanHelper.detectNestProgress(
                Objects.requireNonNull(queen.level()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(queen.blockPosition()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.RESIN_BLOCK.get()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.SPINY_BLOCK.get()),
                scanRadius);
    }
}

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.init.BlockInit;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Random;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.core.registries.BuiltInRegistries;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;
import net.minecraft.world.level.Level;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.Blocks;
import net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState;

/**
 * MC executor for nest structure placement.
 * Layout planning: {@link NestLayoutPlanner}; places one block per call so the queen
 * builds block-by-block instead of whole layers at once.
 *
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-NEST-002): avoid aggressive overwrite — skip valuable/non-replaceable
 * blocks (chests, machines, containment, player builds) and prefer air/soft terrain.
 */
public class NestStructureGenerator {

    private record PhaseKey(ResourceKey<Level> dimension, BlockPos center, int phase) {
    }

    private static final Map<PhaseKey, Deque<NestLayoutPlanner.PlacementIntent>> PENDING =
            new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public static boolean buildNestPhase(ServerLevel level, BlockPos centerPos, int phase) {
        try {
            PhaseKey key = new PhaseKey(level.dimension(), centerPos.immutable(), phase);
            Deque<NestLayoutPlanner.PlacementIntent> queue = PENDING.get(key);
            if (queue == null) {
                List<NestLayoutPlanner.PlacementIntent> intents =
                        NestLayoutPlanner.planPhase(phase, NestLayoutPlanner.getHiveStructureSize(), new Random());
                if (intents.isEmpty()) {
                    ModLogger.warn("NestStructureGenerator", "Unknown building phase: " + phase);
                    return false;
                }
                queue = new ArrayDeque<>(intents);
                PENDING.put(key, queue);
            }

            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                NestLayoutPlanner.PlacementIntent intent = queue.poll();
                if (intent == null) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (placeOneIntent(level, centerPos, intent)) {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (queue.isEmpty()) {
                PENDING.remove(key);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.error("NestStructureGenerator", "Failed to build nest phase " + phase + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static boolean placeOneIntent(
            ServerLevel level,
            BlockPos centerPos,
            NestLayoutPlanner.PlacementIntent intent) {
        NestLayoutPlanner.BlockOffset offset = intent.offset();
        BlockPos pos = Objects.requireNonNull(centerPos.offset(offset.x(), offset.y(), offset.z()));

        if (intent.blockKind() == NestLayoutPlanner.BlockKind.AIR_ENTRANCE) {
            if (level.getBlockState(pos).getBlock() != Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.RESIN_BLOCK.get())) {
                return false;
            }
            return placeBlock(level, pos, Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState());
        }

        if (!canPlaceBlockAt(level, pos)) {
            return false;
        }
        return placeBlock(level, pos, blockStateForKind(intent.blockKind()));
    }

    private static BlockState blockStateForKind(NestLayoutPlanner.BlockKind kind) {
        return switch (kind) {
            case RESIN -> Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.RESIN_BLOCK.get()).defaultBlockState();
            case SPINY -> Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.SPINY_BLOCK.get()).defaultBlockState();
            case COCOON -> Objects.requireNonNull(BlockInit.COCOON_BLOCK.get()).defaultBlockState();
            case AIR_ENTRANCE -> Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState();
        };
    }

    private static boolean placeBlock(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos, BlockState blockState) {
        try {
            WorldRef worldRef = BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(level);
            BlockPosRef posRef = BoundaryRefs.from(pos);
            String blockId = Objects.requireNonNull(
                    BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(Objects.requireNonNull(blockState.getBlock()))).toString();

            boolean placed;
            if (BoundaryServices.isInitialized()) {
                placed = BoundaryServices.mutation().placeBlock(worldRef, posRef, blockId);
            } else {
                placed = level.setBlock(Objects.requireNonNull(pos), Objects.requireNonNull(blockState), 3);
            }

            if (placed) {
                ModLogger.info("NestStructureGenerator", "Placed 1 " + blockId + " at " + pos);
            }
            return placed;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            ModLogger.warn("NestStructureGenerator", "Failed to place block at " + pos + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static int getTotalPhases() {
        return NestLayoutPlanner.getTotalPhases();
    }

    public static int getHiveStructureSize() {
        return NestLayoutPlanner.getHiveStructureSize();
    }

    private static boolean canPlaceBlockAt(ServerLevel level, BlockPos pos) {
        BlockPos checkPos = Objects.requireNonNull(pos);
        if (!level.isInWorldBounds(checkPos)) {
            return false;
        }

        BlockState currentState = level.getBlockState(checkPos);

        if (currentState.getBlock() == Blocks.BEDROCK || currentState.getBlock() == Blocks.BARRIER) {
            return false;
        }

        // TODO(FEATURE-NEST-002): reject non-replaceable / player-valuable blocks; prefer air.
        return true;
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.ai;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.GoalPriorityResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.hatch.OvomorphHatchConfigAccess;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.CommonGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.ai.HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * Patient Egg AI behavior - stationary, wait for hatching.
 */
public final class PatientEggAI {

    private PatientEggAI() {
    }

    public static void registerGoals(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig.AIGoalsConfig aiGoals) {
        ModLogger.debug("PatientEggAI", "Setting up data-driven egg AI");

        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerFloatGoal(
                entity, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH, "float"));

        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerRandomLookAroundGoal(
                entity, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH, "random_look"));
        if (aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange > 0.0f) {
            CommonGoalRegistrar.registerLookAtPlayerGoal(
                    entity,
                    GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH, "look"),
                    aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange);
        }

        if (AIConfigHelper.getBoolean(aiGoals.specialAbilities, "proximity_detection", false)) {
            entity.goalSelector.addGoal(
                    GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.OVOMORPH, "hatch"),
                    new HatchWhenPlayerNearbyGoal(entity));
        }

        ModLogger.debug(
                "PatientEggAI",
                "Egg hatch host detection range: "
                        + OvomorphHatchConfigAccess.proximityDistance()
                        + " blocks (living hosts; creative players ignored)");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.items.DnaVialItemHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.init.ItemInit;
import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.client.renderer.item.ItemProperties;
import net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.client.event.RegisterColorHandlersEvent;

/**
 * Client-only sample-vial contents overlay (presentation).
 *
 * <p>{@code biocraft_alien:filled} means container occupancy (opaque sample marker
 * present) — not DNA validity or analysis state. Gameplay must not depend on the
 * property or tint handler.
 */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = ModContext.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public final class DnaVialClientVisuals {

    /** Placeholder contents tint (ARGB); conveys sample present only. */
    private static final int CONTENTS_TINT = 0xFF2E8B57;

    private DnaVialClientVisuals() {
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onClientSetup(FMLClientSetupEvent event) {
        event.enqueueWork(() -> ItemProperties.register(
                Objects.requireNonNull(ItemInit.DNA_VIAL.get()),
                Objects.requireNonNull(ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(
                        ModContext.MOD_ID, "filled")),
                (stack, level, entity, seed) ->
                        DnaVialItemHelper.isFilled(stack) ? 1.0F : 0.0F));
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onItemColors(RegisterColorHandlersEvent.Item event) {
        event.register(
                (stack, tintIndex) -> {
                    // layer0 = potion_overlay on filled model only
                    if (tintIndex != 0 || !DnaVialItemHelper.isFilled(stack)) {
                        return -1;
                    }
                    return CONTENTS_TINT;
                },
                Objects.requireNonNull(ItemInit.DNA_VIAL.get()));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.client;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModContext;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.ChestbursterEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.DroneEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client.ChestbursterAnimationStateHandler;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.client.FacehuggerAnimationStateHandler;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.entity.OvomorphEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.client.animation.state.DroneAnimationStateHandler;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.client.animation.state.QueenAnimationStateHandler;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.client.OvomorphAnimationStateHandler;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity;
import net.neoforged.api.distmarker.Dist;
import net.neoforged.bus.api.SubscribeEvent;
import net.neoforged.fml.common.EventBusSubscriber;
import net.neoforged.neoforge.event.tick.EntityTickEvent;

/**
 * Client-only animation tick wiring. State handlers live at {@code level_3/.../animation/state}.
 */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = ModContext.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public final class XenomorphAnimationClientHooks {

    private XenomorphAnimationClientHooks() {
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void onEntityTick(EntityTickEvent.Post event) {
        Entity entity = event.getEntity();
        if (!entity.level().isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        if (entity instanceof DroneEntity drone) {
            DroneAnimationStateHandler.updateAnimationState(drone);
        } else if (entity instanceof FacehuggerEntity facehugger) {
            FacehuggerAnimationStateHandler.updateAnimationState(facehugger);
        } else if (entity instanceof ChestbursterEntity chestburster) {
            ChestbursterAnimationStateHandler.updateAnimationState(chestburster);
        } else if (entity instanceof OvomorphEntity ovomorph) {
            OvomorphAnimationStateHandler.updateAnimationState(ovomorph);
        } else if (entity instanceof QueenEntity queen) {
            QueenAnimationStateHandler.updateAnimationState(queen);
        }
    }
}
