 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-DNA-UI-001)
 * <p>TODO(FEATURE-DNA-VIAL-001)
 */
@EventBusSubscriber(modid = ModContext.MOD_ID, value = Dist.CLIENT)
public final class ContainmentPenAdmissionScreen
        extends AbstractContainerScreen<ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu> {

    private ContainmentScreenPage page = ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW;

    private Button dnaNavButton;
    private Button backNavButton;
    private Button transferButton;
    private Button applyNameButton;
    private Button cleanseButton;
    private Button dnaVialButton;
    private Button confirmYesButton;
    private Button confirmCancelButton;
    private boolean confirmCleanseVisible;

    public ContainmentPenAdmissionScreen(
            @Nonnull ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu menu,
            @Nonnull Inventory playerInventory,
            @Nonnull Component title) {
        super(menu, playerInventory, title);
        this.imageWidth = 176;
        this.imageHeight = 166;
    }

    @SubscribeEvent
    public static void registerMenuScreens(RegisterMenuScreensEvent event) {
        event.register(
                Objects.requireNonNull(MenuInit.CONTAINMENT_PEN_ADMISSION.get()),
                ContainmentPenAdmissionScreen::new);
    }

    @Override
    protected void init() {
        super.init();
        this.confirmCleanseVisible = false;
        this.page = ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW;

        this.dnaNavButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.page_dna")),
                        button -> setPage(ContainmentScreenPage.DNA))
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 8, this.topPos + 4, 40, 14)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.dnaNavButton));

        this.backNavButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.page_back")),
                        button -> setPage(ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW))
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 8, this.topPos + 4, 40, 14)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.backNavButton));

        this.cleanseButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse")),
                        button -> showCleanseConfirm())
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 118, this.topPos + 4, 50, 14)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.cleanseButton));

        this.applyNameButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.apply_name")),
                        button -> {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.gameMode != null) {
                                this.minecraft.gameMode.handleInventoryButtonClick(
                                        this.menu.containerId,
                                        ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.BUTTON_APPLY_NAME);
                            }
                        })
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 46, this.topPos + 51, 30, 20)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.applyNameButton));

        this.transferButton = Button.builder(
                        transferLabel(),
                        button -> {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.gameMode != null) {
                                this.minecraft.gameMode.handleInventoryButtonClick(
                                        this.menu.containerId,
                                        ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.BUTTON_TRANSFER);
                            }
                        })
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 100, this.topPos + 51, 56, 20)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.transferButton));

        this.dnaVialButton = Button.builder(
                        dnaVialLabel(),
                        button -> {
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.gameMode != null) {
                                this.minecraft.gameMode.handleInventoryButtonClick(
                                        this.menu.containerId,
                                        ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.BUTTON_DNA_VIAL);
                            }
                        })
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 100, this.topPos + 38, 56, 20)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.dnaVialButton));

        this.confirmYesButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_yes")),
                        button -> {
                            hideCleanseConfirm();
                            if (this.minecraft != null && this.minecraft.gameMode != null) {
                                this.minecraft.gameMode.handleInventoryButtonClick(
                                        this.menu.containerId,
                                        ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.BUTTON_CLEANSE);
                            }
                        })
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 28, this.topPos + 78, 50, 20)
                .build();
        this.confirmCancelButton = Button.builder(
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_cancel")),
                        button -> hideCleanseConfirm())
                .bounds(this.leftPos + 98, this.topPos + 78, 50, 20)
                .build();
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.confirmYesButton));
        this.addRenderableWidget(Objects.requireNonNull(this.confirmCancelButton));
        setConfirmOverlayVisible(false);
        applyPageVisibility();
        refreshButtons();
    }

    /**
     * Client presentation only — never sends packets or invokes gameplay.
     */
    private void setPage(@Nonnull ContainmentScreenPage next) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(next, "next");
        if (this.page == next) {
            return;
        }
        if (next == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA) {
            hideCleanseConfirm();
        }
        this.page = next;
        applyPageVisibility();
        refreshButtons();
    }

    private void applyPageVisibility() {
        boolean overview = this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW;
        if (this.dnaNavButton != null) {
            this.dnaNavButton.visible = overview && !this.confirmCleanseVisible;
        }
        if (this.backNavButton != null) {
            this.backNavButton.visible = !overview;
        }
        if (this.cleanseButton != null) {
            this.cleanseButton.visible = overview && !this.confirmCleanseVisible;
        }
        if (this.applyNameButton != null) {
            this.applyNameButton.visible = overview && !this.confirmCleanseVisible;
        }
        if (this.transferButton != null) {
            this.transferButton.visible = overview && !this.confirmCleanseVisible;
        }
        if (this.dnaVialButton != null) {
            this.dnaVialButton.visible = !overview;
        }
        if (!overview) {
            setConfirmOverlayVisible(false);
        }
    }

    private void showCleanseConfirm() {
        if (this.page != ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW) {
            return;
        }
        this.confirmCleanseVisible = true;
        setConfirmOverlayVisible(true);
        applyPageVisibility();
    }

    private void hideCleanseConfirm() {
        this.confirmCleanseVisible = false;
        setConfirmOverlayVisible(false);
        applyPageVisibility();
    }

    private void setConfirmOverlayVisible(boolean visible) {
        if (this.confirmYesButton != null) {
            this.confirmYesButton.visible = visible;
            this.confirmYesButton.active = visible;
        }
        if (this.confirmCancelButton != null) {
            this.confirmCancelButton.visible = visible;
            this.confirmCancelButton.active = visible;
        }
    }

    private boolean isOverviewOnlySlot(@Nullable Slot slot) {
        if (slot == null) {
            return false;
        }
        int index = slot.index;
        return index == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.OVERVIEW_SLOT_NAMING
                || index == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.OVERVIEW_SLOT_TRANSFER;
    }

    private boolean isDnaOnlySlot(@Nullable Slot slot) {
        if (slot == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return slot.index == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.DNA_SLOT_VIAL;
    }

    private boolean isOverSlotKind(double mouseX, double mouseY, boolean overviewOnly) {
        for (Slot slot : this.menu.slots) {
            boolean match = overviewOnly ? isOverviewOnlySlot(slot) : isDnaOnlySlot(slot);
            if (match
                    && this.isHovering(
                            this.leftPos + slot.x,
                            this.topPos + slot.y,
                            16,
                            16,
                            mouseX,
                            mouseY)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean shouldBlockSlotInteraction(double mouseX, double mouseY) {
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA) {
            return isOverSlotKind(mouseX, mouseY, true);
        }
        return isOverSlotKind(mouseX, mouseY, false);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseClicked(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (shouldBlockSlotInteraction(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseClicked(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseReleased(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button) {
        if (shouldBlockSlotInteraction(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseReleased(mouseX, mouseY, button);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean mouseDragged(double mouseX, double mouseY, int button, double dragX, double dragY) {
        if (shouldBlockSlotInteraction(mouseX, mouseY)) {
            return true;
        }
        return super.mouseDragged(mouseX, mouseY, button, dragX, dragY);
    }

    @Override
    protected void renderSlot(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, @Nonnull Slot slot) {
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA && isOverviewOnlySlot(slot)) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW && isDnaOnlySlot(slot)) {
            return;
        }
        super.renderSlot(graphics, slot);
    }

    @Override
    protected void slotClicked(
            @Nonnull Slot slot, int slotId, int mouseButton, @Nonnull ClickType type) {
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA
                && (slotId == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.OVERVIEW_SLOT_NAMING
                        || slotId == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.OVERVIEW_SLOT_TRANSFER
                        || isOverviewOnlySlot(slot))) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW
                && (slotId == ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.DNA_SLOT_VIAL || isDnaOnlySlot(slot))) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA
                && type == ClickType.QUICK_MOVE
                && isOverviewOnlySlot(slot)) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW
                && type == ClickType.QUICK_MOVE
                && isDnaOnlySlot(slot)) {
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA
                && type == ClickType.QUICK_MOVE
                && slot.index >= ContainmentPenAdmissionMenu.DNA_SLOT_VIAL + 1
                && !DnaVialItemHelper.isDnaVial(Objects.requireNonNull(slot.getItem()))) {
            // DNA page: only allow quick-move of vials into the DNA slot.
            return;
        }
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW
                && type == ClickType.QUICK_MOVE
                && DnaVialItemHelper.isDnaVial(Objects.requireNonNull(slot.getItem()))) {
            return;
        }
        super.slotClicked(slot, slotId, mouseButton, type);
    }

    @Override
    protected void containerTick() {
        super.containerTick();
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        if (this.confirmCleanseVisible && !this.menu.canCleanse(level)) {
            hideCleanseConfirm();
        }
        refreshButtons();
    }

    private void refreshButtons() {
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        boolean overview = this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW;
        boolean overlay = this.confirmCleanseVisible;
        if (this.dnaNavButton != null) {
            this.dnaNavButton.active = overview && !overlay;
            this.dnaNavButton.visible = overview && !overlay;
        }
        if (this.backNavButton != null) {
            this.backNavButton.active = !overview;
            this.backNavButton.visible = !overview;
        }
        if (this.transferButton != null) {
            this.transferButton.setMessage(transferLabel());
            this.transferButton.active =
                    overview && !overlay && (this.menu.canContain(level) || this.menu.canExtract(level));
            this.transferButton.visible = overview && !overlay;
        }
        if (this.applyNameButton != null) {
            this.applyNameButton.active = overview && !overlay && this.menu.canApplyName(level);
            this.applyNameButton.visible = overview && !overlay;
        }
        if (this.cleanseButton != null) {
            this.cleanseButton.active = overview && !overlay && this.menu.canCleanse(level);
            this.cleanseButton.visible = overview && !overlay;
        }
        if (this.dnaVialButton != null) {
            this.dnaVialButton.setMessage(dnaVialLabel());
            this.dnaVialButton.active = !overview && this.menu.canDnaVialAction(level);
            this.dnaVialButton.visible = !overview;
        }
    }

    @Nonnull
    private Component transferLabel() {
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        if (this.menu.isPenOccupied(level)) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(
                    Component.translatable("gui.biocraft_alien.containment_pen_admission.extract"));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                Component.translatable("gui.biocraft_alien.containment_pen_admission.contain"));
    }

    @Nonnull
    private Component dnaVialLabel() {
        if (this.menu.isDnaVialFilled()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.inject"));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.sample"));
    }

    @Override
    protected void renderBg(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, float partialTick, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        int x = this.leftPos;
        int y = this.topPos;
        graphics.fill(x, y, x + this.imageWidth, y + this.imageHeight, 0xC0101010);
        graphics.fill(x + 7, y + 16, x + 169, y + 74, 0xFF303030);

        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW) {
            graphics.fill(x + 25, y + 51, x + 43, y + 69, 0xFF8B8B8B);
            graphics.fill(x + 79, y + 51, x + 97, y + 69, 0xFF8B8B8B);
            graphics.fill(x + 112, y + 18, x + 164, y + 50, 0xFF202020);
            if (this.confirmCleanseVisible) {
                graphics.fill(x + 12, y + 20, x + 164, y + 110, 0xE0101010);
            }
        } else {
            // DNA vial slot chrome
            graphics.fill(x + 79, y + 39, x + 97, y + 57, 0xFF8B8B8B);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void renderLabels(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        Font font = Objects.requireNonNull(this.font);
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.DNA) {
            renderDnaLabels(graphics, font);
            graphics.drawString(
                    font,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(this.playerInventoryTitle),
                    this.inventoryLabelX,
                    this.inventoryLabelY,
                    0x404040,
                    false);
            return;
        }
        if (this.confirmCleanseVisible) {
            Component confirm = Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_confirm"));
            graphics.drawString(font, confirm, 20, 36, 0xFFAAAA, false);
            graphics.drawString(
                    font,
                    Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                            "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.cleanse_confirm_detail")),
                    20,
                    50,
                    0xFFFFFF,
                    false);
            return;
        }
        graphics.drawString(
                font,
                Objects.requireNonNull(this.title),
                this.titleLabelX,
                this.titleLabelY,
                0x404040,
                false);
        graphics.drawString(
                font,
                Objects.requireNonNull(this.playerInventoryTitle),
                this.inventoryLabelX,
                this.inventoryLabelY,
                0x404040,
                false);
        renderIdentityLabels(graphics, font);
    }

    private void renderDnaLabels(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, @Nonnull Font font) {
        graphics.drawString(
                font,
                Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.dna_title")),
                10,
                20,
                0xFFFFFF,
                false);
        graphics.drawString(
                font,
                Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.dna_profile")),
                10,
                34,
                0xA0A0A0,
                false);
        graphics.drawString(font, dnaProfileValue(), 10, 44, 0xFFFFFF, false);
        graphics.drawString(
                font,
                Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                        "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.dna_stub")),
                10,
                62,
                0x808080,
                false);
    }

    @Nonnull
    private Component dnaProfileValue() {
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        LivingEntity occupant = resolveOccupantLiving(level);
        if (occupant == null) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.unknown"));
        }
        ResourceLocation typeId = BuiltInRegistries.ENTITY_TYPE.getKey(
                Objects.requireNonNull(occupant.getType()));
        String profileId = MobHostRegistry.getDnaProfileId(typeId.getPath());
        if (profileId == null || profileId.isBlank()) {
            return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                    "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.unknown"));
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(Component.literal(profileId));
    }

    private void renderIdentityLabels(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, @Nonnull Font font) {
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        LivingEntity occupant = resolveOccupantLiving(level);
        if (occupant == null) {
            if (this.menu.isPenOccupied(level)) {
                graphics.drawString(
                        font,
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.subject_type")),
                        10,
                        20,
                        0xA0A0A0,
                        false);
                graphics.drawString(
                        font,
                        Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.unknown")),
                        10,
                        30,
                        0xFFFFFF,
                        false);
            }
            return;
        }
        Component typeLabel = Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.subject_type"));
        Component nameLabel = Objects.requireNonNull(Component.translatable(
                "gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.subject_name"));
        Component typeValue = Objects.requireNonNull(occupant.getType().getDescription());
        Component nameValue = subjectName(occupant);
        graphics.drawString(font, typeLabel, 10, 18, 0xA0A0A0, false);
        graphics.drawString(font, typeValue, 10, 27, 0xFFFFFF, false);
        graphics.drawString(font, nameLabel, 10, 37, 0xA0A0A0, false);
        graphics.drawString(font, nameValue, 10, 46, 0xFFFFFF, false);
    }

    @Nullable
    private LivingEntity resolveOccupantLiving(@Nullable Level level) {
        UUID occupantId = this.menu.occupantEntityUuid(level);
        if (occupantId == null || !(level instanceof ClientLevel clientLevel)) {
            return null;
        }
        for (Entity entity : clientLevel.entitiesForRendering()) {
            if (occupantId.equals(entity.getUUID())
                    && entity instanceof LivingEntity living
                    && living.isAlive()) {
                return living;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    @Nonnull
    private static Component subjectName(@Nonnull LivingEntity occupant) {
        if (occupant.hasCustomName()) {
            Component custom = occupant.getCustomName();
            if (custom != null) {
                return custom;
            }
        }
        return Objects.requireNonNull(
                Component.translatable("gui.biocraft_alien.containment_ui.unnamed"));
    }

    @Override
    public void render(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY, float partialTick) {
        this.renderBackground(graphics, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
        super.render(graphics, mouseX, mouseY, partialTick);
        if (this.page == ContainmentScreenPage.OVERVIEW && !this.confirmCleanseVisible) {
            renderOccupantPreview(graphics, mouseX, mouseY);
        }
        this.renderTooltip(graphics, mouseX, mouseY);
    }

    private void renderOccupantPreview(@Nonnull GuiGraphics graphics, int mouseX, int mouseY) {
        Level level = this.minecraft != null ? this.minecraft.level : null;
        LivingEntity occupant = resolveOccupantLiving(level);
        if (occupant == null) {
            return;
        }
        int x1 = this.leftPos + 114;
        int y1 = this.topPos + 18;
        int x2 = this.leftPos + 162;
        int y2 = this.topPos + 50;
        int scale = previewScale(occupant);
        try {
            InventoryScreen.renderEntityInInventoryFollowsMouse(
                    graphics,
                    x1,
                    y1,
                    x2,
                    y2,
                    scale,
                    0.0625F,
                    (float) mouseX,
                    (float) mouseY,
                    occupant);
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            // Failure behavior: hide preview (feature gate).
        }
    }

    private static int previewScale(@Nonnull LivingEntity occupant) {
        float height = Math.max(occupant.getBbHeight(), 0.5F);
        int scale = (int) (28.0F / height);
        return Math.max(8, Math.min(30, scale));
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.nest;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.nest.NestStructureGenerator;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;
import net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel;

/**
 * Nest / hive structure phase placement via {@link NestStructureGenerator}.
 */
public final class NestPortBuildPhases {

    private NestPortBuildPhases() {
    }

    public static boolean buildNestStructurePhase(QueenEntity queen, BlockPos nestPosition, int phase) {
        if (!(queen.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) || nestPosition == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return NestStructureGenerator.buildNestPhase(serverLevel, nestPosition, phase);
    }

    public static boolean buildHiveStructurePhase(
            QueenEntity queen,
            BlockPos nestPosition,
            int hivePhaseIndex,
            int nestBuildingPhases) {
        if (!(queen.level() instanceof ServerLevel serverLevel) || nestPosition == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return NestStructureGenerator.buildNestPhase(
                serverLevel, nestPosition, hivePhaseIndex + nestBuildingPhases);
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_7.nest;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.QueenNestProgress;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.territory.QueenNestRegistry;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.hive.NestBuildingWorkflow;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

/**
 * Thin L7 shell over {@link NestBuildingWorkflow} + {@link NestBuildingPortAdapter}.
 * Implements {@link QueenNestProgress}; goal construction lives in composition (L8).
 */
public class NestBuildingAI implements QueenNestProgress {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private final NestBuildingPortAdapter portAdapter;
    private final NestBuildingWorkflow workflow;

    public NestBuildingAI(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
        this.portAdapter = new NestBuildingPortAdapter(queen);
        this.workflow = new NestBuildingWorkflow(portAdapter, portAdapter.timing());
    }

    @Override
    public void tick() {
        if (queen.level().isClientSide()) {
            return;
        }
        workflow.tick();
    }

    @Override
    public void restoreNestState(
            BlockPosRef nestCenter,
            int buildingProgress,
            int hiveBuildingProgress,
            boolean expandingToHive) {
        workflow.restoreFromSave(nestCenter, buildingProgress, hiveBuildingProgress, expandingToHive);
    }

    public boolean hasNest() {
        return QueenNestRegistry.hasNest(queen.getUUID());
    }

    public BlockPos getNestPosition() {
        BlockPosRef ref = QueenNestRegistry.getNestCenter(queen.getUUID());
        return ref != null ? BoundaryRefs.toBlockPos(ref) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public int getBuildingProgress() {
        return workflow.getBuildingProgress();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isNestComplete() {
        return workflow.isNestComplete();
    }

    @Override
    public int getHiveBuildingProgress() {
        return workflow.getHiveBuildingProgress();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isExpandingToHive() {
        return workflow.isExpandingToHive();
    }

    public boolean isHiveExpansionComplete() {
        return workflow.isHiveExpansionComplete();
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_7.nest;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.spatial.BlockPosRef;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_0.validation.ValidationResult;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.ConfigCacheHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.NestBuildingPort;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.hive.NestBuildingTiming;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.services.BoundaryServices;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_1.territory.TerritoryValidator;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_2.territory.TerritoryProgressionSystem;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.boundary.BoundaryRefs;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.nest.NestPortTerritoryBinding;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_5.nest.NestPortStructureProbe;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.nest.NestPortBuildPhases;

import java.util.UUID;

import net.minecraft.core.BlockPos;

/**
 * NeoForge adapter for {@link NestBuildingPort}.
 *
 * <p>Delegates structure probe, territory binding, and phase placement to focused helpers.
 * Workflow orchestration is owned by L7 {@code NestBuildingAI}.
 */
public class NestBuildingPortAdapter implements NestBuildingPort {

    private final QueenEntity queen;
    private final EntityConfig config;
    private BlockPos nestPosition;

    public NestBuildingPortAdapter(QueenEntity queen) {
        this.queen = queen;
        this.config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    public NestBuildingTiming timing() {
        return new NestBuildingTiming(
                getNestBuildingPhases(),
                getHiveBuildingPhases(),
                getNestCreationCooldownTicks(),
                getPhaseBuildDelayTicks());
    }

    @Override
    public UUID queenId() {
        return queen.getUUID();
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPosRef queenPosition() {
        return BoundaryRefs.from(queen.blockPosition());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean checkForExistingNest() {
        return hasNestStructureNearby();
    }

    @Override
    public int detectNestProgress() {
        return detectedNestStructureProgress();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasNestStructureNearby() {
        return NestPortStructureProbe.hasNestStructureNearby(queen);
    }

    @Override
    public int detectedNestStructureProgress() {
        return NestPortStructureProbe.detectedNestStructureProgress(queen);
    }

    @Override
    public BlockPosRef currentNestCenter() {
        return nestPosition != null ? BoundaryRefs.from(nestPosition) : null;
    }

    @Override
    public void restoreNestState(
            BlockPosRef nestCenter,
            int buildingProgress,
            int hiveBuildingProgress,
            boolean expandingToHive) {
        this.nestPosition = NestPortTerritoryBinding.restoreNestState(queen, nestCenter, expandingToHive);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean validateNestLocation() {
        // TODO(FEATURE-NEST-002): validate openness / clearance around candidate centers,
        // not only territory exclusivity at the queen's current feet.
        ValidationResult validation = TerritoryValidator.validateNestLocation(
                BoundaryServices.worldQuery(),
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(queen.level()),
                queen.getUUID(),
                BoundaryRefs.from(queen.blockPosition()));
        return validation.isSuccess();
    }

    @Override
    public void registerTerritory(BlockPosRef nestPos, boolean hiveStage) {
        NestPortTerritoryBinding.registerTerritory(
                queen, nestPos, hiveStage, pos -> this.nestPosition = pos);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean buildNestStructurePhase(int phase) {
        return NestPortBuildPhases.buildNestStructurePhase(queen, nestPosition, phase);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean buildHiveStructurePhase(int hivePhaseIndex) {
        return NestPortBuildPhases.buildHiveStructurePhase(
                queen, nestPosition, hivePhaseIndex, getNestBuildingPhases());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean checkTerritoryProgression() {
        return TerritoryProgressionSystem.checkProgression(
                BoundaryRefs.worldFrom(queen.level()), queen.getUUID());
    }

    @Override
    public void onHiveStructureComplete() {
        TerritoryProgressionSystem.updateStructureToHive(queen.getUUID());
    }

    private int getNestBuildingPhases() {
        return AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "nest_building_phases");
    }

    private int getHiveBuildingPhases() {
        return AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "hive_building_phases");
    }

    private int getNestCreationCooldownTicks() {
        return AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "nest_creation_cooldown");
    }

    private int getPhaseBuildDelayTicks() {
        return AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "phase_build_delay");
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_8;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.AIConfigHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_2.entity.ConfigCacheHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_2_systems.level_0.ai.GoalPriorityResolver;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.AICompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_1.ai.CommonGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.StandardTargetingHelper;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_0.ai.NestBuildingGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.QueenAvoidanceAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.SurvivalAIGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.WanderNearNestGoal;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_7.nest.NestBuildingAI;

import java.util.Objects;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob;
import net.minecraft.world.entity.ai.goal.RandomStrollGoal;

/**
 * Queen goal composition — survival, nest building, avoidance, and territory patrol.
 *
 * <p>S2B playtest-confirmed (2026-07-24): queen melee / nest phases OK.
 */
public final class QueenCompositionStrategy implements AICompositionStrategy {

    private static final QueenCompositionStrategy INSTANCE = new QueenCompositionStrategy();

    public static void registerGoals(QueenEntity queen) {
        INSTANCE.applyGoals(queen);
    }

    @Override
    public void applyGoals(Mob mob) {
        if (!(mob instanceof QueenEntity queen)) {
            return;
        }

        EntityConfig config = ConfigCacheHelper.getConfig(XenomorphType.QUEEN);

        queen.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "survival"), new SurvivalAIGoal(queen));

        NestBuildingAI nestBuildingAI = queen.getNestProgress() instanceof NestBuildingAI existing
                ? existing
                : null;
        if (nestBuildingAI == null) {
            nestBuildingAI = new NestBuildingAI(queen);
            queen.setNestProgress(nestBuildingAI);
        }
        queen.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "nest"), new NestBuildingGoal(nestBuildingAI));

        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerMeleeAttackGoal(
                queen,
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "melee"),
                config.aiGoals.meleeAttackSpeed,
                true);

        QueenAvoidanceAI avoidanceAI = queen.getAvoidanceAI() instanceof QueenAvoidanceAI existingAvoidance
                ? existingAvoidance
                : new QueenAvoidanceAI(queen);
        queen.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "avoidance"),
                Objects.requireNonNull(avoidanceAI.createGoal()));

        queen.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "wander_near_nest"),
                new WanderNearNestGoal(queen));

        // Unrestricted stroll pulls the queen far from the nest; only use it before a nest exists.
        double strollSpeed = config.aiGoals.strollSpeed;
        int strollInterval = AIConfigHelper.requireIntFromSpecialAbilities(config, "stroll_interval");
        queen.goalSelector.addGoal(
                GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "stroll"),
                new RandomStrollGoal(queen, strollSpeed, strollInterval) {
                    @Override
                    public boolean canUse() {
                        return !queen.hasNest() && super.canUse();
                    }

                    @Override
                    public boolean canContinueToUse() {
                        return !queen.hasNest() && super.canContinueToUse();
                    }
                });

        float lookRange = config.aiGoals.lookAtPlayerRange;
        CommonGoalRegistrar.registerLookAtPlayerGoal(
                queen, GoalPriorityResolver.priority(XenomorphType.QUEEN, "look"), lookRange);

        StandardTargetingHelper.registerStandardTargetingGoals(queen, XenomorphType.QUEEN);
    }

    @Override
    public String strategyName() {
        return "queen";
    }
}

package com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_9;

import com.biocraft.alien.layer_0_domain.level_1.entity.XenomorphType;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.entity.EntityConfig;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_1.entity.EntityConfigStorage;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_1_infrastructure.level_0.platform.ModLogger;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.PassiveDevelopmentAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.ai.StrategicCommanderAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.ChestbursterEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.DroneEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.FacehuggerEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_2.entity.QueenEntity;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.DroneSwarmGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.FacehuggerStealthGoalRegistrar;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.HiveMotherAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_3.ai.StandardAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai.ChestbursterCompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai.DroneCompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_4.ai.FacehuggerCompositionStrategy;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_6.ai.PatientEggAI;
import com.biocraft.alien.layer_3_minecraft.level_8.QueenCompositionStrategy;

import net.minecraft.world.entity.PathfinderMob;

/**
 * Single owner for xenomorph AI goal registration.
 * Routes exclusively by entity JSON {@code ai_goals.behavior_type}; composition strategies are
 * leaf registrars invoked by that switch (no parallel {@link XenomorphType} router).
 */
public final class XenomorphCompositionDispatch {

    private XenomorphCompositionDispatch() {
    }

    public static void registerGoals(PathfinderMob entity, XenomorphType type) {
        BehaviorFactory.registerAIBehavior(entity, type);
    }

    /** Config-driven {@code behavior_type} routing — sole registration authority. */
    private static final class BehaviorFactory {

        private BehaviorFactory() {
        }

        static void registerAIBehavior(PathfinderMob entity, XenomorphType xenomorphType) {
            EntityConfig config = EntityConfigStorage.getConfig(xenomorphType);

            if (config == null || config.aiGoals == null) {
                ModLogger.warn("XenomorphCompositionDispatch", "No AI goals config found for " + xenomorphType);
                return;
            }

            String behaviorType = config.aiGoals.behaviorType;
            if (behaviorType == null || behaviorType.isBlank()) {
                ModLogger.warn("XenomorphCompositionDispatch",
                        "No behavior type specified for " + xenomorphType + " — contract should reject at load");
                return;
            }
            ModLogger.debug("XenomorphCompositionDispatch",
                    "Registering AI behavior: " + behaviorType + " for " + xenomorphType);

            switch (behaviorType) {
                case "stealthy_hunter" -> registerStealthyHunter(entity, config);
                case "escape_and_hide" -> registerEscapeAndHide(entity, config);
                case "passive_development" -> PassiveDevelopmentAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
                case "swarm_killer" -> registerSwarmKiller(entity, config);
                case "strategic_commander" -> StrategicCommanderAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
                case "hive_mother", "aggressive_queen" -> registerHiveMother(entity, config);
                case "patient_egg" -> PatientEggAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
                default -> {
                    ModLogger.warn("XenomorphCompositionDispatch",
                            "Unknown behavior type: " + behaviorType + " for " + xenomorphType);
                    StandardAI.registerGoals(entity, xenomorphType, config.aiGoals);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void registerStealthyHunter(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig config) {
            // Live facehugger product path is attachment composition; thin stealth registrar remains for non-FH.
            if (entity instanceof FacehuggerEntity facehugger) {
                FacehuggerCompositionStrategy.registerGoals(facehugger);
            } else {
                FacehuggerStealthGoalRegistrar.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
            }
        }

        private static void registerEscapeAndHide(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig config) {
            if (entity instanceof ChestbursterEntity chestburster) {
                ChestbursterCompositionStrategy.registerGoals(chestburster);
            } else {
                ChestbursterEscapeGoalRegistrar.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
            }
        }

        private static void registerSwarmKiller(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig config) {
            if (entity instanceof DroneEntity drone) {
                DroneCompositionStrategy.registerGoals(drone);
            } else {
                DroneSwarmGoalRegistrar.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
            }
        }

        private static void registerHiveMother(PathfinderMob entity, EntityConfig config) {
            if (entity instanceof QueenEntity queen) {
                QueenCompositionStrategy.registerGoals(queen);
            } else {
                HiveMotherAI.registerGoals(entity, config.aiGoals);
            }
        }
    }
}
